notes.title: v.263 Known Issues
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/bx3bprjv/240826_knownissue_wgc-1339_1100x225.jpg[/img]

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. [b]Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue.[/b] Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the [b]v.263 - Carcion Octo Fest[/b] update:

[u][b]Known Issues:[/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Hayato[/b][list][*]The skill description for Jin Quick Draw has not been updated to reflect the new skill changes.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Common[/b][list][*]In the EU region, Scania is visible on the world selection screen and clicking on it would sometimes cause the client to not work as intended. If Scania was selected, we suggest to either log in through the Fast Login UI or restarting the client.[/*][*]While in the world selection screen, the world types are sometimes not visible. We suggest changing regions then selecting your region again for the world types to appear.[/*][*]When purchasing items in the Cash Shop, Reward Points and Maple Points can both be selected as a method of payment and an error will popup. Cash Shop items can only be purchased with either Reward Points or Maple Points. Please make sure to select only one option.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Resolved Issues:[/b][/u]

tags.bug: The skill description for Jin Quick Draw has not been updated to reflect the new skill changes.

In the EU region, Scania is visible on the world selection screen and clicking on it would sometimes cause the client to not work as intended. If Scania was selected, we suggest to either log in through the Fast Login UI or restarting the client.
While in the world selection screen, the world types are sometimes not visible. We suggest changing regions then selecting your region again for the world types to appear.

When purchasing items in the Cash Shop, Reward Points and Maple Points can both be selected as a method of payment and an error will popup. Cash Shop items can only be purchased with either Reward Points or Maple Points. Please make sure to select only one option.

notes.title: v.263 - Carcion Octo Fest Update Preview
notes.content:
[p][img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/scpjhiim/wgc-2375-250826-v263-update-logo-and-key-art.gif"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Carcion Octo Fest[/b] is setting sail towards Maple World and it’s up to us to figure out what’s going on at the shores of Sunset Beach. While we got the octopuses roaming free, there's a new darkness within Tallahart, and his name is [b]Baldrix[/b]! Need a little push for the battle? Activate the [b]HEXA Stat III [/b]to increase your power! Before we get to that, let’s make sure you are accustomed to our new [b]UI Improvements[/b], since there are many new changes that make navigating through MapleStory even more efficient. But ARRRright mateys, enough yapping! Let's get straight to some of the treasures of the v.263 update.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/2a821f09a4af3dd7be51130fcc2d5efa7837d1ca.png"][/img]
[/p][p]The apostle, [b]Baldrix[/b], makes his appearance in front of the Adversary to overthrow Tallahart! Are you ready to take him on and unleash your wrath?!

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/3jrhnfrj/skeleton-animation_274.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0c38d0c17118f32839dc8d2c772dad47a241d7b2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Shiver me timbers, Maplers! We have an urgent call from Captain Kyrin! The [b]Carcion Octo Fest[/b] is setting sail straight to Sunset Beach in Carcion, and it looks like they brought a few octopus friends… Gather ‘round and pre-game at the [b]Daily Fest Prep[/b] and [b]Weekly Fest Prep[/b] for some extra loot before you hit up the [b]Great Octopus Buffet[/b] for the real feast! Make sure to collect all your Fatty and Tender Octopuses so you can grub on the Tangyoon or the Ano Dishes! Arrr ya’ feelin’ quite full? Burn off those calories by participating in the [b]Octo Hunt[/b] and earn additional rewards! Now let’s set sail! We don’t want you walkin’ the plank now, do we?

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ppjopaly/octo-fest-ui.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/414efd58ff92d52d19025b9bf13872d73ff03220.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Along with all the fun in-game events for v.263, we're also revamping the UI in-game with tons of sleek new changes! Get ready to glide through menus and navigate with more ease and efficiency. We'll see UI changes ranging from [b]Main Menus[/b], [b]Equipment Inventories[/b], and [b]Tooltip Revamps[/b]! Stay tuned for our upcoming Patch Notes as we will reveal more.

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/iqyebcto/maplestorya_nxl9dfgerk.gif"][/img] 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/b2faa53c81740b8f215315f7d46cd92d22ee0767.png"][/img] [/p][p]It’s time to bring out the big guns as the [b]3rd HEXA Stat[/b] can now be activated! If your HEXA Stat I and II are both enhanced to Lv. 20, then you can activate [b]HEXA Stat III[/b] for even more massive gains. Better start saving up your Sol Erda and Sol Erda Frags!

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/dcxccn5k/maplestorya_4l7sgexzg1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/1c667ff877b3f97b9cef6f0da623e9a0d9e871f6.png"][/img][/p][p]Oooh~ Do you feel like something is watching you...? I don’t feel so good... If you have the guts, join us and help solve the mysteries of the [b]Haunted Mansion[/b] to get to the bottom of this! Work your way through 9 floors of eerie distortions and you can earn some ghostly prizes.

 [img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/llbhqkip/maplestorya_xfmgqzujep.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/2e6ab644cd772d14c16617996f15a881240f48b8.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]3...2...1! HAPPY NEW - oh! Not that kind of countdown... We are heading to the cold season so let's bundle up and get cozy for the [b]Winter Countdown[/b]! Check in during this event period and you can easily stock up on some heated rewards.

 [img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zwfovurl/winter-countdown.png"][/img] 

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/0qmpulbw/button_forums.png"][/img]            [img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ssnnkg11/button_discord.png"][/img][/p][p]
[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/whllj3np/bottom.gif"][/img][/p]

[b]Friday, September 5, 2025[/b]

[b]EDT (UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 1:00 PM[/b]
[b]CEST (UTC +2): 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM
AEST (UTC +10): 12:00 AM - 3:00 AM (September 6)
[/b]

[b]What will be unavailable:[/b]
[list][*]All MapleStory game servers.[/*][/list]
[b]Changes and Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Resolved an issue where playing on Kanna characters could cause the client to crash.[/*][*]Resolved an issue preventing Guild and Alliance leaders from changing their Guild or Alliance name if it began with the letters 'A', 'E', or 'S'.[/*][*]Resolved an issue where Sia characters could start the '[Genesis Weapon] Weapon Reissue' quest while already having a Genesis Weapon in their inventory.[/*][/list]

[/b][/u]

In all such cases, you must[b] delete a character to free up a slot[/b] before you can proceed with the World Leap.[/u][/*][*][u]After deleting a character from Scania to free up a slot, you will be prevented from entering[u] [/u][b]Scania[/b][u] again until a character is selected. [/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]To proceed the leap, please go [/u][b]directly to Challenger World[/b][u] [/u][b]- Interactive[/b][u] and continue with the World Leap.[/u] [/u][/*][/list]

notes.title: v.262 - Midnight Carnival: Mu Lung Update Preview
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/97f2f50b17ec0e89a853de621e1aa42f180da760.jpg"][/img]Spend a night in the town of Sages! The [u][b]Night Troupe[/b][/u] is bringing a festival of dreams and illusions to Mu Lung. Plus, get ready to dive into the new [u][b]Legion Champion[/b][/u] system, where teamwork makes the dream work, and join the Champion Raid to hunt in new territories on Draco Isle. Not only that, [u][b]Champion Burning[/b][/u] is back to help you get ahead of the game! We’ll also be merging NA Interactive Worlds to create a more vibrant and connected experience for you to enjoy.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/24ed4e8553eed5f628677cae33c478dcbd1e5eb7.png"][/img]
The [u][b]Night Troupe[/b][/u] is making their way to Mu Lung, where you can be a full-fledged [u][b]Festival Designer[/b][/u] and turn this festival into a colorful and unforgettable experience! Decorate the festival grounds with [u][b]Festival Decorating[/b][/u] and [u][b]Designer Rank[/b][/u] to unlock special skills and progression perks. You can also earn rewards and progress faster with the [u][b]Night Troupe Sage Ticket[/b][/u] or receive buffs by lighting the [u][b]Lanterns Bright with Wishes[/b][/u]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/27b2b32c189170fb077c170263fd411b288bd173.png"][/img][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/5c15426d9c1eb7d3ba05f32376d041bad2d3ae61.png"][/img]  The Imperial Knight, Sir Hamselot, is here to support you and your journey to be a [u][b]Legion Champion[/b][/u]! You can assign up to 3 Champions to your Legion Champion team and work your way up the [u][b]Champion Ranks[/b][/u] to give your [u][b]Champion Insignia[/b][/u] extra buffs!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/07c4e1499bf156c8b290b2dc16d1982e0746b874.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/qc3lfu0t/header-champraid.png"][/img]Gather your [u][b]Legion Champion[/b][/u] team because a new territory has arrived, Draco Isle! Join the [u][b]Champion Raid[/b][/u] and complete missions to get through 6 stages of battles against the local dragons. During your battles, your [u][b]Bond Meter[/b][/u] with your Legion Champion team will fill as you fight for a Final Damage increase, making that last blow super effective!

notes.title: Maple Memo: Addressing v.260 and v.261 Issues
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5580/181107mm1100ip.jpg"][/img]Hello Maplers, 

First and foremost, we'd like to extend our deepest apologies for the various problems and major gameplay disruptions caused by live server maintenance recently.

While we've made extensive efforts to provide a large amount of content to enjoy throughout the summer, the overall stability fell short of expectations. Internally, we have been reflecting on this matter and are preparing systematic measures to prevent similar issues in the future. 

We also acknowledge that our communication has not been sufficient.

We had intended to share a message sooner, but ongoing issues required our immediate attention. We prioritized resolving the issues and planned to provide a comprehensive update once stability had been restored, rather than causing confusion with frequent partial updates. Unfortunately, this led to a long silence, and we apologize for the delay.

This memo will address the various issues that have taken place and our responses to them.

We are aware that a single message may not be enough to address every concern. Nevertheless, though delayed, we believe it is important to speak openly and provide context regarding the decisions we made and the responses we took at the time. We hope this will alleviate some of the inconvenience you have experienced. 

To begin, we would like to address the following issues that arose after the V.260 and V.261 updates.   

[b]Emergency Maintenance Following the V.260 Update[/b] 

Shortly after the V.260 Stargazer update went live, we found a serious error that allowed certain items to be duplicated in select situations. We quickly took the servers offline to conduct emergency maintenance and successfully resolved the root of the issue. However, due to the duplicated items and mesos already in circulation, we determined that the issue could significantly impact game balance and required a full-scale response. When the servers went offline, we conducted a thorough analysis, identified the source of the problem, resolved it, and implemented additional quality assurance for safety. All these steps were all done in real time and ended up taking longer than expected. 

The V.260 update introduced extensive changes to the game's system code, which unexpectedly conflicted with legacy Global MapleStory (GMS) code. This led to an obscure bug that only triggered under a unique condition and was not detected during our standard quality assurance processes. The issue was not identified until the update went live and the first instances began to appear on the live server. To explain, after the update, a specific condition appeared in the system code that caused an overflow error. When players unknowingly took certain actions while this condition was active, it created multiple copies of the same item.  

We conducted a thorough analysis to discover the source of the problem, before retrieving the duplicated items. The affected code was revised in full, and additional quality assurance tests were run to prevent this issue from occurring again. The depth of the investigation along with database-level processing required to retrieve all of the duplicated items took a significant amount of time, which inevitably led to the extended maintenance period.  

[b]Sia Astelle: Hyper Burning MAX[/b] 

Another error occurred after the V.260 update where some players were able to designate Sia Astelle as a Hyper Burning MAX character. Although we quickly dealt with the issue, the community raised concerns about fairness. It was pointed out that a few players gained an unfair advantage, that they had not been punished for doing so, and that perhaps all players should be allowed to designate Sia Astelle as a Hyper Burning MAX character. 

We would like to explain what happened and how we came to our decision.  

After investigating, we discovered that a very small number of players were impacted by this error relative to the total player base. We believe being fair and equitable is important when addressing bugs, but we ultimately decided against expanding Hyper Burning MAX to all Sia Astelle characters because doing so would have gone against the intent of our original design. 

In regard to potential penalties, we treated this situation as a separate case from the previous item duplication error due to two factors:
The nature of the error meant it could be triggered accidentally, with no ill intent from players. The overall impact to the game was negligible. Considering this, we decided that it would not be appropriate to punish the players in this instance.We know there were various suggestions regarding this decision, and there was considerable deliberation internally at the time.  We apologize for causing this issue and for the frustration it created due to a lack of sufficient explanation.

[b]Challenger World  [/b] 

Challenger World was one of the key features of this update. To allow more players to participate, we introduced the Challenger World system to Heroic Worlds for the first time. However, even though we prepared thoroughly, this was our first time implementing Challenger-Heroic Worlds and there were shortcomings in processing the unique specifications of Challenger and Heroic Worlds.  Several issues arose, including Link Skills being unintentionally active, errors in Coin Shop item setups, and the inability to trade Droplet Stones. These problems and others, both big and small, inconvenienced our players.

We have since fixed these issues through maintenance and updates. To make sure future Heroic World updates don’t repeat the same issues, we carefully reviewed potential oversights during version changes and had internal discussions on how we can improve things moving forward. This experience helped us identify additional key areas of consideration when managing complex world-level systems and applying new content. With these learnings, we will strive to provide more stable service in the future.  

[b]Compensation Boxes[/b] 

As the development workload grew due to the extended maintenances before and after the V.260 update, fatigue set in, leading to human error during the compensation box distribution process. Regardless of these circumstances, this mistake should not have occurred. We are reviewing and improving our live fix procedures to prevent similar issues from being repeated in the future.  

Over a short period of time, the unplanned compensation box went out to a small number of players. At the time, we considered various responses, including if we should distribute the same rewards to everyone. While we understood the potential value of expanding the rewards, we also had to carefully consider the long-term implications for game balance and operational stability, which is why we ultimately decided not to proceed with that approach. 

We have thoroughly discussed this issue internally and take the community's concerns around fairness seriously. Moving forward, we will give greater care and oversight to our compensation plans and distribution processes to ensure that similar incidents do not happen again. 

[b]Pottable Badges [/b] 

In last year's Ride or Die event, we introduced the Chains of Resentment as a limited-time item to help reduce the power gap caused by legacy content. Although it wasn’t a perfect solution, we believe the attempt to reduce the power gap through this approach was generally seen as a step in the right direction by many players. When bringing back Ride or Die, we attempted to apply a similar philosophy by offering a limited-time pottable badge from existing legacy content. However, we overlooked the fact that this item plays a different role than the Frenzy Totem, causing it to be far from what our players expected.

While both were introduced with the goal of reducing the power gap from legacy items, the way we implemented the Shackles of Resentment did not align with your expectations. We should have ensured that we had a deep understanding of player and community sentiments before approaching legacy items. However, our process of prior communications, feedback collection, and understanding overall sentiment was inadequate.  

We deeply apologize for the confusion and disappointment this has caused. 

[b]Recent Preemptive Bans[/b]

To quickly stem the spread of fraudulent activity, we took action by preemptively restricting accounts with even slightly suspicious log data and then investigating further. This approach caused some legitimate players to be affected, and we apologize for that. Moving forward, we will make improvements to ensure bans are done more carefully, based on thorough investigation and according to clearly defined criteria. 

[b]Repeated Emergency Maintenances and Maintenance Schedule Changes [/b]

The increased frequency of emergency maintenances, announcements of said maintenances being posted too soon, and last minute schedule changes have caused our players great inconvenience.

Shortly before maintenance began, our internal testing revealed unforeseen errors and risks. In order to prevent further issues, we ended up needing to adjust the schedule and extend the maintenance period. We apologize for the inconvenience and confusion that these oversights caused.

We will strive to improve our internal processes to minimize the need for emergency maintenances and maintenance extensions.

[b]Management of GMS-Exclusive Content [/b] 

GMS includes many pieces of original content, and we plan to continue adding exclusive content for our Maplers to enjoy.

Recently, we have seen numerous unverified claims and rumors in the community suggesting that content produced by TEAM GMS[u][u] [/u][/u]will lack future support or maintenance.

However, we promise that the content produced by TEAM GMS, such as Sia Astelle, will continue to be actively serviced alongside our ongoing development efforts.  

[b]Closing Message[/b] 

The GMS team has been working hard, through nights and weekends, to address the issues that have arisen and stabilize the game service. 

As GMS has continued down its independent path, we've encountered new kinds of issues stemming from incompatibilities with the code base. This has certainly caused instability, but it has also allowed us to clearly see our shortcomings and determine necessary improvements through discussion. 

As GMS continues to grow, we are actively building out our team to establish long-term stability. Upon reflection, we’ve had to wonder if simultaneously developing GMS-exclusive content alongside our other various efforts was overly ambitious.  However, we want to once again reassure the community that we won't back down from this challenge. We understand that meaningful progress takes time, and we remain committed to making steady improvements, step by step. While it may take time, we are focused on providing a better, more consistent, and enjoyable experience for all players. Your ongoing interest, support, and feedback through various channels are always a great encouragement to us. 

We've prepared a gift to express our sincere apologies.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="344,0"][tr][th colspan="2" colwidth="344,0"][p]Gift from TEAM GMS[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colspan="2" colwidth="344,0"][p][b]Claim Period: by August 10, 2025, 11:59 PM UTC[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p][b]Item[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Tradability/Duration[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p][b]CCPB (Petite Luna)[/b][/p][p][img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/tl5hwp5z/ccpb-med.png"][/img] [/p][/td][td][p]Untradable, 30-day duration [b] NOTE: [/b]The 30-day magic duration will start once you claim the gift from the Admin NPC, and cannot be extended[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p][b]Luxe Sauna Coupon (30 min) (x3)[/b][/p][p] [img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/gkphd5v1/luxesaunacoupon.png"][/img] [/p][/td][td][p]Untradable, 7-day duration[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colspan="2" colwidth="344,0"][p][/p][list][*][p]The gift can be claimed by characters over Lv. 101 or Zero characters that have cleared story quest chapter 2. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The gift is claimable once per account, through the [b]in-game Maple Administrator NPC. [/b][/p][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]Please understand that the purpose of this memo is to summarize the recent key issues and address them transparently. We’ll be back to share more about our vision and and what you can look forward to in the future.

We once again sincerely apologize to all our Maplers who experienced inconvenience during this process. We truly appreciate your continued passion and support. 

All the members of TEAM GMS are devoted to providing a better service for our players. 

Thank you, 

- TEAM GMS 
[/p]

notes.title: NA Interactive World Merge Is Coming This August 27!
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/hrdn1yrd/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg[/img]

Hey Maplers,

We are excited to announce the NA Interactive World Merge that was mentioned in one of Inkwell’s previous notes. Our goal with this merge is to create a more vibrant and connected experience by encouraging more opportunities for player interaction.

We also want to thank everyone who participated in the world merge survey from March 19th to April 1st. While the majority of the players supported some form of a merge, opinions were split on the number of worlds. After careful review, we’ve decided to move forward with retaining the very first two original worlds, [b]Scania [/b]and [b]Bera. [/b]We believe this will help create a more balanced population, boost the in-game economy, and improve player interaction, all while keeping our servers stable.

For Maplers whose worlds are affected by this merge, please refer to the details below:
[u][b]Schedule[/b][/u][list][*][b]August 27, 2025 (after maintenance)[/b][/*][/list][u][b]Target Worlds[/b][/u][list][*]Interactive worlds, [b]Aurora [/b]and [b]Elysium[/b], will be consolidated into [b]Scania[/b].[/*][*]Scania channels will be increased to a total of [u][b]30 channels[/b].[/u][/*][/list][u][b]World Merge FAQ[/b][/u]
To help you better prepare for the World Merge, please review the following FAQs during this process. Please note that we will be sharing additional updates and details at a later date.

[b]Does this change how I log in?[/b]
[list][*][b]Yes[/b]. If you were in [b]Aurora [/b]or [b]Elysium[/b], you will now log into your new merged world, [b]Scania[/b], from the world selection screen.[/*][/list]
[b]What happens when I exceed the max number of 58 character slots?[/b]
[list][*]All character slots from the merging worlds (Scania, Aurora, and Elysium) will be combined, including default slots. Your character display order will be reset.[/*][*]Up to 58 characters will be visible on the character selection screen.[list][*]If you have more than 58 characters, a Character Selection UI will appear where you must select 58 characters to display. Non-selected characters are not permanently removed but will be temporarily inaccessible until you remove some other characters. This UI will be available until [b]January 2026[/b].[/*][*]If 58 characters are not selected before the UI is removed, the highest level characters will automatically be displayed.[/*][*]You will not be able to create new characters unless the excess characters have been deleted.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]What happens to shared features like Storage, Cash Shop and Auction House?[/b]
[list][*][b]Storage Items[/b][list][*]Storage slots will be merged up to a maximum of 152 slots. Items beyond the limit will be hidden and can be retrieved by removing existing items.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Storage Mesos[/b][list][*]Mesos from all merging worlds will be combined up to 499 billion (499,999,999,999) mesos. Excess mesos will be sent as coins via the Gift Drop.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Cash Inventory[/b][list][*]Items beyond the limit will be hidden and will appear as space is available.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Auction House[/b][list][*]Items beyond the limit will be hidden until space is available. To buy or sell again, you must move items to your character's inventory.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Will my Guild be affected?[/b]
[list][*]Guild names must be unique per world. If there are duplicates, names will be automatically renamed with random characters.[/*][*]Renamed guilds and alliances will receive a name change UI upon login, and [b]only the Leader can change the name.[/b][list][*]If your leader is inactive, please contact [url=https://support-maplestory.nexon.com/hc/en-us]Player Support[/url].[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Will the Maple Rewards Shop purchase limit reset?[/b]
[list][*][b]No[/b], the purchase limit [b]will not reset[/b] with the merge.[/*][*]The next reset will occur with the start of the next calendar month.[b]
[/b][/*][/list]
We hope these changes allow players in the newly merged worlds to participate in more community activities. We’ll be updating this post as we receive more information. For live updates, join our official Discord server [url=https://discord.com/invite/maplestory][b]here[/b][/url]!

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: [Update July 22] Ride or Die Returns!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/267bceb59cbddfc022d0584e6b42d5e10ef29928.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Updated July 22] Note: [/b]The final score and participation count for [b]Week 1[/b] will be calculated from [b]July 16 (after maintenance) - July 22 at 11:59 PM UTC[/b].[/p][p]Kazax has returned to MapleStory with new powers, and Inspector Libae is enlisting your help in battling against this even greater threat! Call upon Althea in battle, harness the power of the Mapae, and earn prizes with each week's boss battle! Take on Kazan himself as the battlefield heats up. Don't forget the new Rank X challenge to test your prowess![/p][p][b]Event Duration:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, July 16, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, August 26, 2025 4:59 PM[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, July 16, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 27, 2025 1:59 AM[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, July 16, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 27, 2025 9:59 AM[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2][u]Ride or Die[/u][/h2][p][b]Quick Overview[/b][/p][list][*][p]Take on up to 5 bosses each week by choosing your difficulty level and setting challenges.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Requirement:[/b] Lv. 200 and above (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).[/p][/*][*][p]The higher the difficulty and number of challenges, the greater the rewards will be and a higher final score you'll receive![/p][/*][*][p]Earn rewards like Inspector Coins, Kazax’s Energy Fragments, and weekly Inspector Supply Boxes based on your final score.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]How to Participate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Select ‘Ride or Die’ from the Event List and click ‘Participate’ to start the Ride or Die event.[/p][/*][*][p]Upon accepting the quest, you’ll be teleported to the event map, where you’ll meet Libae, a new inspector who urgently needs your help to save Maple World![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Setting Boss Difficulty and Challenges[/b][/p][list][*][p]Face off against up to 5 bosses per week by choosing your difficulty and how many challenges you want to take on. The 5 bosses you can challenge are:[/p][list][*][p]Papulatus[/p][/*][*][p]Vellum[/p][/*][*][p]Horntail[/p][/*][*][p]Darknell[/p][/*][*][p]Magnus[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]There are four difficulties to choose from:[/p][list][*][p]Code B: Easy[/p][/*][*][p]Code A: Normal[/p][/*][*][p]Code S: Hard[/p][/*][*][p]Code X: Extreme[/p][list][*][p][b]Code X Requirements:[/b] Only your weapon, secondary weapon, and emblem can be equipped for this challenge. Swapping equipment will be disabled during battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Test your strength and limits in Code X to earn the highest reward box and a large number of Kazax fragments! With different bosses and fewer challenges this time, Code X is the perfect chance to push for a high score.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/05ca96d5ad560acb318a1f67835903343a30b342.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Ready for a challenge? You can set up to 15 challenges and one will be randomly assigned to you during each run. The following challenges are available:[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/b52a8f4396824dcafd92b9476e4bc11112b44a30.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The score multiplier for challenges have been increased, so the more challenges you take on, the higher your weekly score will be![/p][/*][*][p]You have a total of [b]20 lives shared across all 5 bosses per week[/b]. If you lose them all, you’re done for the week![/p][list][*][p]Use Practice Mode to familiarize yourself with the bosses! Speak with Libae to adjust the difficulty level and challenges as needed.[/p][list][*][p][b]Practice Mode is unavailable for Code X difficulty.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]An Investigation Result summary will appear when you successfully defeat a boss, showing your current Investigation Score and Weekly Score. Scores are calculated based on:[/p][list][*][p]Chosen difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Number of challenges set[/p][/*][*][p]Death count[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/6ce2f6ef14693e8e7388777f05a26395e13b6f41.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Althea's Support[/b][/p][list][*][p]Althea is here to support you during fights! Once inside the boss map, you’ll receive Althea’s Support, a special skill that charges support up to Lv. 3 as you fight.[/p][list][*][p]Charge the skill by collecting support! The more support you receive, the more powerful Althea’s Support skill effect will be![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/be38044964187919cfccaf82c41c892ef1123388.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The amount of support required to charge each level is 150.[/p][list][*][p]For every 15 support gained, one skill gauge slot fills.[/p][/*][*][p]Receive a small amount of support at regular intervals.[/p][/*][*][p]Receive a great amount of support when your character touches a summoned object.[/p][list][*][p]The object spawns at a random location every 30 seconds and disappears after a certain amount of time.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/5098ad28dab86395dcab90d2c039b64552289182.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Once the gauge is full, press the Interact key to activate one of Althea’s support skills at random. These help clear summoned enemies and disrupt Kazax’s interference.[/p][/*][*][p]Right-click the skill icon to toggle between automatic or manual activation.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Kazax's Interference[/b][/p][list][*][p]Kaxaz isn’t going to fight fair, so stay sharp! He’ll appear alongside bosses and randomly uses skills that interfere with your fight.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weekly Total Score Rewards[/b][/p][list][*][p]Defeat bosses to also earn usable items and Silver, Bronze, or Gold Inspector Coins which can be spent at the Coin Shop for exclusive rewards![/p][/*][*][p]Each week after the event reset, you'll receive a Weekly Total Score which will determine:[/p][list][*][p]Which Inspector's Supply Box you receive[/p][/*][*][p]How many Kazax's Energy Fragments you earn[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/957c1d5fb88a3a3b308c3a3774e40eaaa1b5431c.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]There are six levels of Inspector’s Supply Boxes that can be obtained. Don't forget the new Rank X challenge to test your prowess!
Take on up to 5 bosses each week by choosing your difficulty level and setting challenges.
Select ‘Ride or Die’ from the Event List and click ‘Participate’ to start the Ride or Die event.

notes.title: Violet and Unicube Potential Stat Error and Compensation
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/hrdn1yrd/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg[/img]

Hello Maplers,

We have identified an error where the Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat was obtainable using Violet Cubes and Unicubes.

In the v.237 update, we implemented a change where the Legendary Potential stat ‘Boss Damage +30%’ would no longer be obtainable when using Red Cube, Black Cube, Meister’s Cube, Unicube, Violet Cube, and Cube of Equality. However, we have identified an error starting in v.239 where the Potential stat was still obtainable when using only Violet Cubes and Unicubes. We sincerely apologize for this oversight.

We plan to resolve this in the v.261 update and provide compensation for affected players, as outlined below.

[u][b]Converting Potential Stats for Affected Legendary Equipment[/b][/u]
[list][*]The Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat will no longer be obtainable using Violet Cubes and Unicubes, and will be removed.[/*][*]For players who obtained the Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat using Violet Cubes and Unicubes and still have the affected equipment, the stat will be replaced with the 'Boss Damage +35%' Potential stat.[list][*]Equipment that obtained the Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat before the v.237 update will remain as is.[/*][*]The Unique 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat will remain as is.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Violet Cube and Unicube Compensation Details[/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Violet Cube[/b] and [b]Unicube[/b] will be issued as compensation for affected players on [b]July 16, 2025 (after maintenance)[/b] through the Gift Drop.[/*][*]Players who obtained the Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat for the first time using Violet Cubes and Unicubes will be compensated with the number of cubes used from that point onward, up to the last cube used.[list][*]The number of compensated cubes will be calculated based on the quantity used during each promotional sale period and within the valid usage window for those cubes.[/*][*]The total quantity includes cubes used when the Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat was first obtained.[/*][*]For [b]Violet Cubes[/b], the quantity will be based on when the stat appeared, not when the player selected it.[/*][*]For [b]Unicubes[/b], only cubes used to obtain the stat will be considered, excluding those used just for changing the line.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
We apologize for the inconvenience, and thank you for your continued support and patience as we work to make things right.

-The MapleStory Team

However, we have identified an error starting in v.239 where the Potential stat was still obtainable when using only Violet Cubes and Unicubes.
The Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat will no longer be obtainable using Violet Cubes and Unicubes, and will be removed.

During this process, we will remove exploited items and issue player bans as needed.

notes.title: [Updated 6/10] Prepare for the Hyperion World Leap Event coming June 11
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2098/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg[/img]

Hi Maplers,

The high population in Kronos has recently brought about technical challenges and difficulties in maintaining a stable and comfortable gaming environment. In an effort to provide this, we have prepared a special event allowing players to leap from [b]Kronos to Hyperion[/b]. By offering this option, we aim to address the inconveniences caused by the excessive population density in Kronos and revitalize Hyperion, thereby fostering better overall server balance and a more enjoyable gaming experience.

The Hyperion World Leap Event will be available during the upcoming Stargazer updates, and we have prepared additional perks for those choosing to leap so that they can quickly adjust to their new world.  

[b]Event Period: June 11, 2025 (after the maintenance) - August 26, 2025 11:59 PM UTC[/b]

[b]Requirements:[/b] Characters on Kronos Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2) created prior to [b]June 11, 12:00 AM UTC. [/b]

[b]Perk 1:[/b] Legion Leap Box
[list][*]The [b]Legion Leap Box[/b] allows players to carry over progress for Legion Coins, Artifact Points, and Artifact EXP to the new world![/*][*][b][Updated 6/10] [/b]Talk to Mover in Henesys and select "Create Legion Leap Box" to create the item. Only one Legion Leap Box can be created per account, and is tradable within account. It can be used until [b]September 2, 2025 at 11:59 PM[/b].[/*][*]Once created, the Legion Leap Box stores the following from your current world:[/*][list][*]The amount of Legion Coins you had when the Legion Leap Box was created.[/*][*]Up to 20,000 Legion Artifact Points.The Artifact Points will be distributed after the artifact points has been reset.[/*][*]100% of your Legion Artifact EXP. The Legion Artifact EXP will be distributed after the artifact level has been reset.[/*][/list][*]Legion Artifact stats and grade status will not carry over.[/*][*]If you use the Legion Leap Box without leaping to Hyperion, any stored Legion Coins, Artifact Points, and Artifact EXP will be returned to their original state from the time of creation.[/*][*]After you've leaped to Hyperion and used the box, click the 'Sync Artifact Special Mission' button to unlock special missions related to your Legion Artifact.[/*][/list]
[b]Perk 2:[/b] Players who World Leap from the new Challenger World to Hyperion will receive additional rewards for reaching [b]Emerald [/b]and [b]Diamond [/b]tiers:
[list][*][b]Ultimate Legion Growth Potion x15[/b] (instead of 10)[/*][/list]
[b]Perk 3:[/b] Hyperion World Perks
[list][*][b]June 11, 2025[/b] after the maintenance - [b]June 14, 2025[/b] at [b]11:59 PM UTC[/b] [list][*][b]+100% Rune EXP buff effect (3x normal EXP)[/b][/*][*][b]+300% Combo Kill EXP[/b][/*][*][b]2x EXP for Pollo, Fritto, and Especia Bounty Hunting[/b][/*][*][b]2x Inferno Wolf Exit EXP[/b][/*][*][b]2x chance for new Monster Collection monsters[/b][/*][*][b]1.5x Item Drop Rate[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][Updated 6/10] [/b]Before you leap from Kronos to Hyperion, here are a few important things to keep in mind to make sure your transfer goes smoothly.
[list][*][b]Guilds and Alliances[/b][list][*]Guild leaders must disband or leave their guild first.[/*][*]You must leave your guild or alliance before transferring.[/*][*]This includes pending guild applications.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Storage Restrictions[/b][list][*]Delivery Package Storage[/*][*]Hired Merchant[/*][*]NPC Fredrick[/*][*]Retrieve and collect any items before transferring from the following:[/*][*]You won’t be able to retrieve these items after transferring![/*][/list][/*][*][b]Cash Items[/b][list][*]Cash items in your character inventory will transfer. However, items in your Cash Shop Inventory will NOT, so don’t for get to move them over![/*][/list][/*][*]You can transfer even if the world you’re moving to has no empty character slots—unless you already have 58 characters there. If you do, you’ll need to delete a character to make space before transferring.[/*][*]Zero characters can’t be transferred if they were created before [b]June 11, 2025 at 12:00 AM UTC[/b], or if they haven’t completed Story Quest Chapter 2.[/*][*]In-game rankings or regularly updated game progression records such as Mu Lung ranking, Donation King, or Tower of Oz will not transfer.[/*][/list]
[b]What can be transferred during the World Leap?[/b]
To help you better prepare for the leap, please review the following list of things that can and cannot be transferred when making the leap:

notes.title: Important Changes Coming in v.260
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2098/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg[/img]

Hi Maplers,

We will be implementing changes to certain in-game features and would like to provide some information for what you can expect from these changes:
[list][*][b]Removal and Refunds of Custom Titles[/b][list][*]With the system revamp of the Medal and Title feature, Custom Titles and Medal Fusion Anvils will be removed from the Cash Shop and in-game.[/*][*]Due to this we will be providing refunds to players who currently have a Custom Title Coupon obtained from the recent sale of Easter Baskets. The refund amount will be based on the Easter Basket the item was obtained from:[list][*]Large Mysterious Easter Basket: [b]3,000 Maple Points[/b][/*][*]Small Mysterious Easter Basket:[b] 1,000 Maple Points[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Refunds will be processed in 2 waves:[list][*]Wave 1: During the maintenance on [b]June 11, 2025.[/b][/*][*]Wave 2: During a future maintenance in [b]August 2025.[/b][list][*]More details to follow in the future.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Please note the following:[list][*]Custom Titles will not function after the v.260 game update and we ask to refrain from using the Custom Title Coupon after the update.[/*][*]If you used a Custom Title Coupon to receive a Custom Title, you are eligible for refund in August.[/*][*]If you have a Medal Fusion Anvil Coupon or Medal Fusion Anvil, they will retain their functionality and still can be used.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Removal of Teleport Rocks from the Cash Shop[/b][list][*]As part of a revamp to the way players navigate around the game, will be ending the sale of [b]Teleport Rocks, Hyper Teleport Rocks,[/b] and [b]VIP Teleport Rocks[/b] through the Cash Shop starting after the maintenance on [b]June 11, 2025. [/b][/*][*]Players who currently have Teleport Rocks of any kind, including permanent ones, will still be able to use them alongside the revamp after the maintenance. Their functionality will remain unchanged from before the v.260 game update.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]New Style Box Stamp Shop[/b][list][*]We will be introducing a new type of Style Box Stamp, along with its very own Style Box Stamp Shop that you can look forward to in the Stargazer update.[/*][*]Without spoiling any surprises, this upcoming change will affect the way Surprise Style Box items can be exchanged for stamps. So please carefully observe the details below:[list][*]Items obtained from Surprise Style Boxes[b] AFTER June 25, 2025[/b] at [b]8:00 AM UTC[/b] can [b]ONLY [/b]be exchanged for stamps that will be used in the new Style Box Stamp Shop.[/*][*]Items obtained from Surprise Style Boxes [b]BEFORE June 25, 2025[/b] at [b]8:00 AM UTC[/b] can [b]ONLY [/b]be exchanged for stamps in the current Style Box Stamp Shop.[/*][*]The existing Style Box Stamp Shop through NPC Shiro will remain accessible for any players who own existing Style Box Stamps.[/*][*]The items that can be purchased from the existing Style Box Stamp Shop will be updated after [b]June 25, 2025 8:00 AM UTC.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]DirectX 11 Support[/b][list][*]We will be introducing DirectX 11 support to provide a more enjoyable gaming experience. As such, DirectX 9 support will be discontinued from this point onward. We ask that you update to DirectX 11.0 or higher to ensure your game runs smoothly as support for DirectX 9 will end after the game update.[/*][*][b]Troubleshooting [/b]- If the game doesn’t launch or you see a DirectX-related error after the update, we recommend checking your system’s DirectX version and updating if needed.[list][*]To download and update DirectX to the latest version, click [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-sg/download/details.aspx?id=35]HERE[/url].[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
We hope that everyone will be able to enjoy these changes along with the many others coming in the next Stargazer update. We thank you for your understanding and continued support!

~The MapleStory Team

tags.feature: With the system revamp of the Medal and Title feature, Custom Titles and Medal Fusion Anvils will be removed from the Cash Shop and in-game.
We will be introducing a new type of Style Box Stamp, along with its very own Style Box Stamp Shop that you can look forward to in the Stargazer update.

We will be introducing DirectX 11 support to provide a more enjoyable gaming experience. As such, DirectX 9 support will be discontinued from this point onward. We ask that you update to DirectX 11.0 or higher to ensure your game runs smoothly as support for DirectX 9 will end after the game update.

notes.content:

We recently updated our anti-cheat system to better detect macro users. - The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Addressing the Recent Kronos Server Downtime
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2167/maintenance-1100x225-maplestory.png[/img]

Greetings Maplers,

On [b]May 3rd[/b], at[b] 5:19 AM PDT[/b], Kronos servers experienced significant stability issues. To swiftly resolve this issue, the Kronos server was temporarily shut down and restarted for Kronos users to quickly return to the game. 

We understand this issue had a significant impact on some players. We are currently reviewing the cause and will be performing the following in an upcoming Server Maintenance:
[list][*]Resolve the Steam Market issue leading to the server crash.[/*][*]Enable Steam Market for all users.[/*][*]Provide compensation to impacted Kronos players.[/*][/list]
We will have more details to share soon. Please keep an eye on this post for more information on when the maintenance will occur.

Players who experienced a rollback during the time of the server issue, please report it to our Player Support team and we will do our best to respond sincerely to each case.  Please be advised that response times may be affected due to a high volume of support requests. We’ll carefully review each case and appreciate your patience as we work to assist those impacted by the issue.

Thank you everyone for your understanding.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: MapleStory's 20th Anniversary Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/c6df0c3b6c48d7556e2efc9e27575e80c84bbfb6.png[/img]

On May 11, 2005, MapleStory made its debut in North America, and in the 20 years that has come since, it's been our pleasure to watch you enjoy every moment of fun that has come in Maple World. We're celebrating these two decades with a special new update, featuring a new job to play, an exciting sports day event, and a special look at things to come!

[h2]Now Available: Mo Xuan![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/4235849a31ffeffc0f4a54a1555b2148c3c6e09b.png[/img]

A mighty new warrior has come to MapleStory, a talented martial artist with a power that's been passed down throughout the ages. Play as Mo Xuan, the Divine Fist, MapleStory's newest character and claim your rewards in the Xiao Xiao's Level-Up Support Event!

You can learn more about Mo Xuan, and find out what you can earn by leveling him up, [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/events/26251/now-available-mo-xuan]on the official MapleStory website[/url]!

[h2]Victoria Cup Event[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/10352a63bbe99f431c76a72af544eae3ece2f82e.png[/img]

The biggest Sports Day that Victoria Island has ever seen is here! Take on challenging sporting events such as Victoria Soccer, Boat Racing, Balloon Pop Challenge and much more to bring home trophies, unique outfits, and other amazing rewards!

[h2]20th Anniversary Patch Notes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/85e287c430194d5f892849afbcdcf1ffc50f6652.jpg[/img]

Learn everything about MapleStory's 20th Anniversary update, including the full details on the Victoria Cup, the newly added Grandis Familiars, a more convenient way to jump between characters on the same world, and more [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/update/26290/v-259-victoria-cup-20th-anniversary-patch-notes]in the patch notes on the official MapleStory website[/url]!

[h2]Read the latest Inkwell's Note![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0bf64ab1e82074b60ef490e5162dad056b986da4.png[/img]

Inkwell, MapleStory's Chief Product Officer, also recently penned a note to the MapleStory community, talking about the 20th anniversary, the last few months of updates, as well as a preview of all the changes and improvements we're looking to add to MapleStory soon. You can read it in full [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/general/26163/inkwell-s-note-20-th-anniversary]on the official MapleStory website[/url]!

notes.title: v.259 - Victoria Cup: 20th Anniversary Patch Notes
notes.content:
Two decades of adventure and still going strong. Get ready to meet [b]Mo Xuan[/b], our newest addition to the Job roster! Want to switch up your character real quick? The brand-new [b]Fast Character Change[/b] function makes it a breeze! It's been an incredible journey, and our passion is still burning bright. Head over to the [b]Victoria Cup Main Stadium[/b] to join the festivities and take part in exciting mini-games like [b]Victoria Soccer[/b], [b]Boat Racing[/b], and more for some easy rewards. We'll catch ya'll at the Main Stadium!

[b]Click [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/update/26290/v-259-victoria-cup-20th-anniversary-patch-notes]HERE[/url] to read the patch notes![/b]

notes.title: [Completed] Scheduled Game Update - April 29, 2025
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2167/maintenance-1100x225-maplestory.png[/img]

[b][Updated 12:00 AM PDT][/b] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for [b]7[/b] hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to make sure that you get the latest client! Thank you for your patience.

Due to technical issues, the Steam Community Marketplace and Oswell’s Scissors of Karma will be temporarily unavailable. We are working hard to correct this issue quickly and apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. Players will regain access to this feature once the issue has been resolved.

We will be performing a scheduled game update starting on [b]Tuesday[/b][b], April 29[/b][b], 2025 at 5:00 AM PDT (8:00 AM EDT / 2:00 PM CEST / 10:00 PM AEST). [/b]We anticipate the maintenance to conclude around [b]12:00 PM PDT (3:00 PM EDT / 9:00 PM CEST / 5:00 AM AEST April 30)[/b]. 

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

Following the maintenance, we'll be monitoring the game closely and may schedule an additional maintenance on Wednesday, April 30 to ensure a stable gameplay experience. Further details will be posted on a separate announcement.

Thanks for your patience!

[b]Times:[/b]

[b]Tuesday, April 29, 2025
PDT (UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 12:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 9:00 PM 
AEST (UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 5:00 AM April 30[/b]

[b]What will be unavailable:[/b]

notes.title: Additional Information on Issues Related to Cash Shop
notes.content:
Greetings Maplers,

Thank you very much for your enthusiastic interest in the v258 Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Collaboration patch with Steam Market, Auto-Harvesting, and other new features which came on March 19th.

In addition, we sincerely apologize for not providing a smooth playing environment due to errors and unscheduled maintenances.

Following our announcement about the [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/general/25147/addressing-the-philosopher-s-book-issue]Philosopher’s Book issue[/url] yesterday, we conducted an additional review internally and newly confirmed the two problems below.

We will explain the resolution and how we plan to address the following issues.

[b]1. April Fool's SSB Rewards Pre-Applied to 2025 Version[/b]

It has been confirmed that the rewards for the upcoming April Fool's SSB, scheduled to be sold on March 26 were pre-applied with the patch on March 19. While the box has not been officially sold yet, players in Heroic Worlds were able to obtain an April Fool’s SSB through the Philosopher’s Book. As a result, any April Fool’s SSB used after March 19 gave the 2025 April Fool’s rewards and the probability rates can be found through the following [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/general-post/5728]link[/url]. This does mean some players have gotten new April Fool’s items early.

If you have used an April Fool's Day SSB from March 19 to before this notice and you are not satisfied with the items you received, please contact Player Support and we will process the refunds according to our policy.

[b]2. An issue related to Pet Equipment in Heroic World[/b]

Among the Pet Equipment is Lil Nezuko's Ribbon equipment, an item that does not change her appearance. While this is noted in the item tooltip, we understand that this has caused confusion for our players, particularly in Heroic Worlds. Since the item does not have any effect, we have decided to stop selling the Nezuko Pet Equipment in Heroic World.

If you purchased Lil Nezuko’s Ribbon in Heroic World and would like a refund, please contact Player Support and we will process your request after retrieving the item.

Once again, we apologize for the inconvenience.

Our MapleStory Team is always listening and closely monitoring feedback from all players through various communities. We are committed to identifying and resolving issues as quickly as possible, and we continue to strive for a better MapleStory.

Thank you.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Steam Community Market (Beta) Issue Update
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

We’re excited to see everyone’s interest in the launch of the Steam Community Market (Beta) feature! However, we’re aware that a small number of players experienced an issue where their items disappeared when attempting to register them to the Steam Inventory UI.

As we continue to improve and refine this Beta feature, we’ve identified the cause and are working on a fix scheduled for next week’s maintenance.

To prevent further issues, we're temporarily disabling the ability to register items to the Steam Inventory UI and the sale of Oswell's Scissors of Karma today, at 2:00 PM PDT (5:00 PM EDT / 10:00 PM CET / 8:00 AM AEDT March 22), until the fix is in place. Please note that any items already in your Steam Inventory will continue to function normally on the Steam Community Market and can be retrieved as usual.

For players who were affected, any lost items will be returned once the issue is resolved.

We appreciate your patience and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

Thank you,

The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Introducing Steam Community Market (Beta)
notes.content:
Hi Maplers, 

We are excited to announce that the v.258 update will include a [u][b]beta [/b][/u]feature enabling the trading of various cosmetic items through the Steam Community Market. Access to this functionality will be available in-game and will include the ability to manage or add items into your respective Steam Inventory!

[b]What is the Steam Community Market?[/b]
[list][*]A dedicated marketplace within the Steam platform, where players can trade items using the Steam Wallet.[/*][*]The value of Steam marketplace items is determined by player transactions and prices may fluctuate according to supply and demand.[/*][*]Items that can be traded have no impact on in-game balance, and players neither lose nor gain anything even if they do not purchase any items.[/*][/list] 

[b]Trading Guidelines:[/b]
[b]Eligible Accounts[/b]
[list][*]Nexon accounts linked with a Steam account can access the in-game Steam Inventory UI.[/*][*]The linked Steam account must meet Steam's eligibility requirements for using the Steam Community Market.[/*][*]Once your Steam account is linked, you can still access your Steam Inventory UI in the game even if you launch MapleStory through the Nexon Launcher.[/*][/list]
[b]Target Worlds & Regions[/b]
[list][*]Trades can be made in both Interactive and Heroic Worlds, and can even be made between Interactive and Heroic Worlds.[/*][*]Trades can be made in both North America and Europe regions, and can even be made between the two regions. [/*][/list]
[b]Target Items[/b]
[list][*]Cosmetic items from Surprise Style Boxes sold from [b]January 2017 until now[/b] are included in the list of items that can be traded.[list][*]This restriction is to help better verify the stability of trades during this beta service period.[/*][*]The list of items is subject to change at any time.[/*][/list][/*][*]Only items that are [b][u]untradable[/u][/b] can be sold in the Steam Community Market. As such, items purchased from the Steam Community Market will be untradeable in-game. So, please be mindful when trading.[/*][/list]

[b]Oswell's Scissors of Karma:[/b]
[b]What are Oswell's Scissors of Karma?[/b]
[list][*]In order to trade items from Global MapleStory, [b]Oswell’s Scissors of Karma[/b] must be used to move an item from your inventory to your Steam Inventory.[/*][*]Only items that have been moved to your Steam Inventory can be viewed in the Steam Community Market storage. [/*][/list]
[center][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ki0nw0h0/ossy.png[/img][/center]

[b]Notice:[/b][list][*]The Steam Market is a separate platform from Nexon, so please forward any inquiries or requests for support to [url=https://help.steampowered.com/][b]Steam Customer Support[/b][/url] if you experience any issues.[/*][*]All transactions are made through the Steam Wallet.[/*][*]Before trading, please be sure to check the [b][url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/61F0-72B7-9A18-C70B]Steam Community Market FAQ[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/451E-96B3-D194-50FC]Trading and Market Restrictions[/url][/b] on the official Steam website.[/*][*]Due to Dutch law, players in the Netherlands [u]cannot[/u] access the in-game Steam Inventory UI.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Addressing the Recent Unicube Issues
notes.content:
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2098/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg[/img]

Hello Maplers,

We apologize for the delayed response regarding the Unicube issue that occurred on February 22nd in Interactive Worlds. We have been reviewing the Unicube usage logs, examining the list of fraudulent users, and examining the list of items that were abnormally enhanced. We ask for your understanding as this analysis takes time to ensure an accurate response and resolution.

Below is our planned course of action:
[olist][*]In order to prevent the further spread of problematic items on the server, we will be temporarily withdrawing abnormally enhanced items during today’s emergency maintenance.[/*][*]After thorough investigation, additional measures will be taken against users who have misused the Unicube.[/*][*]Once we’ve completed the investigation, compensation for the emergency maintenance will be provided.[/*][*]Retrieved items will be restored. If needed, there may be additional measures taken such as rolling items back to their state prior to Unicube usage and returning Unicubes where appropriate. [/*][/olist]
We are committed to strengthening our internal development processes to prevent such incidents from occurring again and to minimize any inconvenience for our MapleStory players. Once again, we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: MapleStory Worlds Europe and Mobile Soft Launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/5688c4017aae43a5c5cfa8958db4718e32f39303.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.nexon.com/msw/landing]The MapleStory Worlds Soft Launch rolls on and is now available in Europe and on mobile devices[/url]! Introducing an exciting new way to play and create - MapleStory Worlds is here with powerful tools to design your own adventures and enjoy the creations of your fellow Maplers, and Maplers in Europe and on mobile devices can now join the fun!

[url=https://www.nexon.com/msw/landing]Learn more at the MapleStory Worlds website[/url]!

[previewyoutube=qT_cgEgHObw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]What is MapleStory Worlds?[/b][/h2]
Immerse yourself in a whole new way to experience MapleStory! MapleStory Worlds is a dynamic platform where Players and Creators unite to explore custom-crafted Worlds and avatars. With robust worldbuilding tools and access to over 30 million MapleStory Assets, Creators can design immersive experiences that captivate players globally - and earn rewards for their unique creations.

[b]Unleash Your Creativity[/b]

Discover the stories of our Creators who have transformed their passions into playgrounds! Join this thriving community using the MapleStory Worlds platform to bring diverse visions to life. [url=https://maplestoryworlds-creators.nexon.com/en]Learn more in the Creator Center[/url]!

[b]Dive into a Vibrant Community[/b]

Experience the nostalgia of old-school MapleStory or dive into vibrant worlds crafted by our very own Creators. Each World available on the platform offers unique adventures and endless excitement! [url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play]Learn more in the Play Worlds page[/url]!

[b]Join the Creator Circle[/b]

Apply for our exclusive Creator Circle! We developed this ongoing monthly program to amplify the work of promising Creators like yourself. Take your world to the next level with promotional and technical support, mentorship from the MapleStory Worlds team, and a $3,500 USD monthly stipend. [url=https://forum.nexon.com/maplestoryworlds-creators-en/board_view?board=5485&thread=2665788]Learn more in the Creator Circle post[/url]!

[b]Available Regions and Platforms[/b]

MapleStory Worlds is now soft-launching in Europe in addition to North and South America. Players in the available regions can also play and create on Windows PC, Mac (Beta), and Mobile platforms! We plan on expanding MapleStory Worlds to additional regions later this year.

notes.title: Epic Dungeon: Angler Company Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/d33c7d707fc5958d38298179a3055d3847c4da7d.jpg[/img]

Angler Company, the great arms merchant of Grandis, has taken an important prisoner to their hidden undersea hideout. Play as Senya in this new Epic Dungeon and dive beneath the waves to rescue Cosim and uncover the Angler Company's deep secrets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/95d0e8c14a296fad9e78a0c7bee572bff76faa2a.png[/img]

Throughout the Epic Dungeon, you'll control Senya, and use her set of abilities to delve within the hostile facility, swarming with enemies to fight and control systems to overcome. You have only one hour to reach the end, charging energy gauges to advance through the stages. Successfully defeat the boss and earn EXP, Sol Erda, and more waiting for you when you clear the Epic Dungeon!
[h2]Epic Dungeon: Angler Company[/h2][list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 4:00 PM - Ongoing[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Thursday, January 16, 2025 1:00 AM - Ongoing[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Thursday, January 16, 2025 11:00 AM - Ongoing[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Requirement[/b]: Lv. 270 and above characters who have completed the ‘[Odium] Hundun Laid to Rest’ and ‘[Epic Dungeon] Sun God Mitra’ quests.
[list][*]Accept the ‘[Epic Dungeon] Angler Company’ quest by talking to Selazar located at Residential District in Odium.[list][*]Alternatively, select ‘Epic Dungeon: Angler Company’ in the Special Contents tab of the Maple Guide and click ‘Move’ to teleport directly to Selazar.[/*][/list][/*][*]Upon completing the quest, speak to Selazar again to begin the Story Mode where you’ll play as Senya Angler.[list][*]Progress and completion are saved per character.[/*][*]Once Story Mode is completed on one character, you can skip it for other characters within the same world.[/*][/list][/*][*]After completing Story Mode, talk to Selazar to access the Angler Company dungeon.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0b5295d93c5a4453ec33f13ed2482a5fee9fd3a1.png[/img]
[list][*]Within a 1-hour time limit, complete 8 stages by defeating monsters and bypassing systems.
[list][*]Charge the energy gauge to advance through the stages.[/*][*]Boss battles occur at Stage 4 and the final stage.[/*][/list][/*][*]Special skills are available to help assist you through your journey with the Angler Company:[/*][*]Clear the Angler Company Epic Dungeon to receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Sol Erda: [/b]Untradable, 30-day duration.[/*][*][b]Dense Sol Erda Energy: [/b]Untradable, 30-day duration.[/*][*][b]Heroic Worlds[/b][list][*][b]Sol Erda Fragment (x55):[/b] Untradable, Permanent.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Interactive Worlds[/b][list][*][b]Sol Erda Fragment (x10):[/b] Transferable within world, Permanent.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Interactive Worlds:[/b] Receive extra rewards by purchasing Bonus Rewards for 10,000 Maple Points or Special Bonus Rewards for 40,000 Maple Points. The following rewards will be given: [list][*][b]Sol Erda Bonus Rewards[/b][list][*][b]Sol Erda (x4): [/b]Untradable, 30-day duration.[/*][*][b]Dense Sol Erda Energy (x4): [/b]Untradable, 30-day duration.[/*][*][b]Sol Erda Fragment (x20):[/b] Transferable within world, Permanent.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]EXP Bonus Rewards[/b][list][*][b]Bonus EXP (x4)[/b] [/*][*][b]Sol Erda Fragment (x20):[/b] Transferable within world, Permanent.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Sol Erda Special Bonus Rewards[/b][list][*][b]Sol Erda (x8): [/b]Untradable, 30-day duration.[/*][*][b]Dense Sol Erda Energy (x8): [/b]Untradable, 30-day duration.[/*][*][b]Sol Erda Fragment (x40):[/b] Transferable within world, Permanent.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]EXP Special Bonus Rewards[/b][list][*][b]Bonus EXP (x8)[/b][/*][*][b]Sol Erda Fragment (x40):[/b] Transferable within world, Permanent.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Note: [/b]You can enter and clear the Angler Company Epic Dungeon [b]once a week per account[/b] and only with one character. Choose wisely as you can only enter either High Mountain or Angler Company, [b]but not both.[/b]
[list][*]The following Angler Company dungeon achievements have been added:[list][*][Epic Dungeon] The Company’s Secret[/*][*][Epic Dungeon] Diving Newbie[/*][*][Epic Dungeon] Intermediate Diver[/*][*][Epic Dungeon] Expert Diver[/*][/list][/*][*]The ‘Complete Angler Company Quest’ mission has been added to the Legion Artifact Special Missions tab.[/*][/list]
[b]Note: [/b]Entry count and dungeon progress resets every [b]Thursday at 12:00 AM UTC.[/b]

notes.title: New Name Auction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/499bb49a887d2b2d442202ab8b36e8b59594dcda.jpg[/img]

Ready to trade names? Sell off your characters' old names or find a new one with this special opportunity! Names will be available to buy or sell with Maple Points over the next four weeks. Check out the full details below!
[h2][b]New Name Auction[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Duration:[/b]
[list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, February 11, 2025 3:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 12, 2025 12:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 12, 2025 10:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]You can enter the New Name Auction by selecting 'New Name Auction' from the Event List and clicking ‘Participate’ or you can speak with Mr. Newname, located in major towns like Henesys.[/*][*][b]Requirement[/b]: Lv. 10 and above characters (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).[/*][*]You will be able to make transactions from Interactive and Heroic worlds![/*][*]Completed trade history is stored until June 10 at 11:59 PM UTC. Names and Maple Points from sales that aren't claimed during the storage period will disappear so make sure you claim them before then![/*][*]You can have up to 5 character name transactions (selling or bidding).[/*][*]Now, let’s start off by reviewing some major auction terms that you’ll need know before you begin![/*][/list][table][tr][td][b]Auction Terms[/b][/td][td][b]Description[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Bid[/b][/td][td]The act of writing and entering the desired amount by one who wishes to purchase a character name for sale.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Minimum Bid[/b][/td][td]The desired price that the seller wrote when registering the character name.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Current Bid[/b][/td][td]The desired price the buyer enters by raising the bid by at least the minimum bid amount.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Successful Bid[/b][/td][td]The trade is completed if the bid submitted by the buyer is the highest amount at the end of the sale.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Failed Bid, Unsuccessful Bid[/b][/td][td]Your bid gets canceled because someone else made a successful bid with an amount higher than the 'Current Bid' that you entered.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Registration Deposit[/b][/td][td]The amount automatically deducted when you start selling character names, which is 5% of the minimum bid.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Name Change Fee[/b][/td][td]Amount paid to Mr. Newname when changing character names.[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Now that you know the terminology, we can go over how to sell and bid on character names.[/*][/list]
[b]How to Sell Character Names:[/b]
[list][*]Enter the New Name Auction and start by entering your desired bid, duration, and a new character name.[list][*]Please note that character names that have started selling cannot be canceled or changed midway.[/*][*]The minimum bid starts at 50,000 Maple Points, and the registration deposit and name change fee are deducted at the time of registration.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/d32fed79a396cebc9547139c924ad2d8b9a5dd6e.png[/img]
[list][*]You can keep tabs on your current sale of character names by clicking the [Selling] button in the ‘Your Trades’ tab.[/*][*]When the character name sale is finished, you can check the results by clicking the [End Trade] button in the 'Your Trades' tab.[list][*]Transaction fees of 30% are deducted at the time of payment collection.[/*][*]Registration deposits are refunded if the sale is successful.[/*][*]If the registered character name was not sold, you can pay an additional registration deposit and re-list the name for sale or you can either return or claim your name back.[/*][*]Name change fees are non-refundable regardless of whether the sale was successful or not.[/*][*]You can claim your payment for the sold character name by clicking the [Collect] button in the ‘End Trade’ tab.[/*][/list][/*][*]Character names that were won while the New Name Auction was open, cannot be re-sold during the event period. [/*][/list]
[b]How to Purchase Character Names:[/b]
[list][*]Need to get a hold of that name? Head to the ‘New Name Auction’ UI and search for the character name you want in the search bar at the top left, or you can look through other name options from the ‘Character Names for Sale’ from the search tab.[/*][*]Enter your desired bid amount and submit.[list][*]The bidding price must be increased by at least the minimum bid amount.[/*][*]If your bid is unsuccessful, both the bid deposit and the name change fee will be refunded to you. Although, you will not be able to cancel after placing your bid.[/*][*]You can keep tabs on your current character bids by clicking the [Bidding] button in the ‘Your Trades’ tab.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]In the ‘Bidding’ tab, you can see the current highest bid for each available character name. If your bid is the highest, it will be labeled 'Highest Bid.' If another player bids higher, you can either increase your bid or back out.[/*][*]If you have won the Highest Bid, you can claim the name in the ‘End Trade’ tab.[list][*][b]Upon claiming the character name, your currently logged-in character's name will be immediately updated. The previous name will be permanently removed.[/b][/*][*]After your name change, you'll have to wait a week before you can change your new name with Mr. Newname.[/*][*]Please note that once the change is complete, you cannot restore your previous name.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Please note[/b]:
[list][*]The New Name Auction is unavailable in Burning World. Character names that break the naming policy will have their transaction forcefully canceled or changed.[/*][*]The name change fees and deposits will not be refunded. You can find other 'New Name Auction' related notes in the 'Please check all cautions' tab.[/*][/list]
