notes.title: Champion Burning Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/56a92caabf0cf95920d232e4d13fc1416217e305.png[/img]

Double it and give it to the next person? Let’s take it further - double the rewards for not just one but two characters at once! Set one character as your Leader and benefit two other characters at the same time, tripling the EXP you're earning overall and earning special rewards from the Champion Burning Coin Shop as well, featuring a selection of items to help your boosted characters keep their gear in top shape!
[h2][b]Champion Burning Double Up[/b][/h2][list][*][b]PST/PDT (UTC -8/-7): Tuesday, January 14, 2025 4:00 PM - Tuesday, March 18, 2025 4:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 1:00 AM - Wednesday, March 19, 2025 12:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 11:00 AM - Wednesday, March 19, 2025 10:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*][b]Requirements[/b]: Lv. 101 and above characters who have completed the ‘[Champion Burning] Your Champion and Mine’ quest (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).[/*][*]Select ‘Champion Burning’ from the Event List and click ‘Participate’ to start the Champion Burning Double Up event.[list][*]Alternatively, accept the ‘[Champion Burning] Your Champion and Mine’ quest by talking to Dame Appropriation..[/*][/list][/*][*]Participation is limited to [b]one world per account[/b], so choose wisely![/*][/list]
[b]Designating Characters:[/b]
[list][*]Open the Champion Burning UI and press the ‘Designate’ button.[/*][*]The [b]first Champion[/b] designated becomes the [b]Leader[/b], and 2 other characters can be designated as Champions.[list][*]The [b]Leader[/b] can be changed [b]once a week[/b] from your designated Champions.[/*][*]When switching Leaders, any unused Double Up EXP Points from the current Leader will be lost.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/8da27f1aa0c008298a6c8f7b5263f0261560c30b.png[/img]
[list][*]Once designated, there will be a visual effect where Champions are following the Leader. The effect activates automatically when changing maps or logging back in.[list][*]This effect can be toggled on/off through the Skills UI in the Beginner’s tab.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/b124868f507195978171db2b40fd9bad227a60ff.gif[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] If the Leader has [b]World Leaped[/b], a different character can be designated as the Leader in Burning World to participate in the event again.

[b]Double Up EXP Points:[/b]
[list][*]When the Leader defeats monsters near their level (20 levels below and 20 levels above), the other Champions receive 1 Double Up EXP Point for every monster defeated.[list][*]Monster defeats only count when in a solo party or not in a party at all.[/*][*]Monster defeats will count when summoning monsters with VIP Booster.[/*][/list][/*][*]Double Up EXP Points are evenly distributed among the Champions, with a weekly cap of [b]100,000 points.[/b][/*][*]Log in as each Champion to claim and use the earned EXP points.[list][*]Double Up EXP Points can be used on Mega Burning, Tera Burning, and Hyper Burning characters.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Note:[/b] If the Leader has [b]World Leaped[/b] and the remaining Champions in Burning World are not transferred, those Champions cannot use Double Up EXP Points or access the Double Up Coin Shop.

[b]Double Up Coins:[/b]
[list][*]The Leader can complete Double Up check-ins to earn Double Up Coins by defeating 2,000 monsters near their level (20 levels above or 20 levels below).[list][*]Check-in [b]3 times a week[/b], up to a total of 24 times.[/*][*]Only the Leader can click the ‘Claim’ check-in button.[/*][*]Monster defeats only count when in a solo party or not in a party at all.[/*][/list][/*][*]For each check-in, all Champions receive 2,500 Double Up Coins.[list][*]Coins and purchases in the Double Up Coin Shop are saved for existing Champions but are not shared among characters.[/*][/list][/*][*]Spend 3,000 Maple Points to use a Double Up Pass for missed check-in days.[list][*]All Champions will receive 2,500 Double Up Coins, for each Double Up Pass used.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Note:[/b] Double Up EXP Points and Double Up Check-in weekly records reset every [b]Thursday at 12:00 AM UTC.[/b]
[h2][b]Champion Burning Double Up Coin Shop[/b][/h2][list][*][b]PST/PDT (UTC -8/-7): Tuesday, January 14, 2025 4:00 PM - Sunday, March 23, 2025 4:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 1:00 AM - Monday, March 24, 2025 12:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 11:00 AM - Monday, March 24, 2025 10:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]Open the Champion Burning UI and press the ‘Open Shop’ button to open the shop.[/*][*][b]Requirements[/b]: Lv. 101 and above characters designated as Champion (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).[/*][*]Double Up Coins are specific to each Champion character and the quantity limit for items are limited to individual purchases per character. The quantity limit isn’t shared with all Champions together; it is instead applied for each individual Champion character.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/3d0eb9dffd5f511cf13d5d82df663009f0c707ff.png[/img]

tags.feature: Set one character as your Leader and benefit two other characters at the same time, tripling the EXP you're earning overall and earning special rewards from the Champion Burning Coin Shop as well, featuring a selection of items to help your boosted characters keep their gear in top shape!
Select ‘Champion Burning’ from the Event List and click ‘Participate’ to start the Champion Burning Double Up event.
Open the Champion Burning UI and press the ‘Designate’ button.
The first Champion designated becomes the Leader, and 2 other characters can be designated as Champions.
When switching Leaders, any unused Double Up EXP Points from the current Leader will be lost.
Once designated, there will be a visual effect where Champions are following the Leader. The effect activates automatically when changing maps or logging back in.
This effect can be toggled on/off through the Skills UI in the Beginner’s tab.
When the Leader defeats monsters near their level (20 levels below and 20 levels above), the other Champions receive 1 Double Up EXP Point for every monster defeated.
Double Up EXP Points are evenly distributed among the Champions, with a weekly cap of 100,000 points.
Log in as each Champion to claim and use the earned EXP points.
Double Up EXP Points can be used on Mega Burning, Tera Burning, and Hyper Burning characters.
The Leader can complete Double Up check-ins to earn Double Up Coins by defeating 2,000 monsters near their level (20 levels above or 20 levels below).
For each check-in, all Champions receive 2,500 Double Up Coins.
Coins and purchases in the Double Up Coin Shop are saved for existing Champions but are not shared among characters.
Spend 3,000 Maple Points to use a Double Up Pass for missed check-in days.
All Champions will receive 2,500 Double Up Coins, for each Double Up Pass used.
Open the Champion Burning UI and press the ‘Open Shop’ button to open the shop.

notes.title: Notice Regarding Ghastly the Snowman Reward Issue
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

An issue where the Steadfast Child Gift Box rewarded from the Ghastly the Snowman event could be claimed repeatedly has been fixed. Upon further investigation of the issue, we discovered there were many instances of players that took advantage of the bug and abused it to receive rewards in excess of the intended amounts. Therefore, the following actions have been taken against these players in accordance with our policies: 

[olist]
[*]Any accounts with more Steadfast Child Gift Boxes than what can normally be obtained per day have had their remaining boxes removed.
[*]Accounts that exploited this issue will be reviewed and actions will be taken according to our policies.
[/olist]
The Steadfast Child Gift Boxes will be re-enabled on December 20 after maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience to gameplay caused during this investigation, and will provide 30 Steadfast Child Gift Boxes to all players. These boxes can be claimed through the Gift Drop until [b]December 22 at 23:59 UTC.[/b]

We would like to take this opportunity to remind players that exploiting in-game bugs for personal gain is strictly against our Terms of Service. We ask players to take care and avoid being penalized by refraining from such activities.

Thank you for your understanding and patience as we work to resolve this issue.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: v.256 Known Issues
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. [b]Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue.[/b] Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you'll find a list of known and resolved issues from the [b]v.256 - The Dark Ride: Limbo[/b] update:

[u][b]Known Issues:[/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Common[/b][list][*]Using the 'Skip' feature during a boss battle may sometimes increase the boss's attack frequency significantly. To prevent this while we investigate the issue, we recommend not using the 'Skip' option during boss fights.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Resolved Issues:[/b][/u]
[list][*][b]December 20, 2024[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the ability for pets to add the “Ferocious Eternal Armor Box” and the “Divine Eternal Armor Box” to the pet pick-up item exception list.
[*]Adjusted the reset time for the “O Holy Fright” and “Slay Ride” minigames to coincide with weekly reset times.
[*]Fixed the issue causing the client to crash when opening the Character Info UI while having a summoned Familiar and an empty Familiar Slot.
[*]Fixed the issue where Normal Limbo listed the Grindstone of Life as a possible drop within the Maple Guide UI.
[*]Fixed the issue causing Ornaments to drop only for the first character that accepted the "Do You Fear What I Fear" quest.
[*]Fixed the issue displaying the incorrect number of clears needed for the Fright Totem in the "O Holy Fright" event.
[*]Fixed the issue where incorrect rewards were displayed in the "Wicked Wonderland" Event Preview window.
[*]Fixed the issue where some characters were unable to leave the "Dark Maplemas Eve" map through the exit portal.
[*]Fixed the issue where the "[Luna Crystal] Fairy Tale Tea Time" quest was not appearing after equipping a pet from the Petite Luna pet series.
[*]Fixed the issue where Neville was not selling Gold Emblems for Kanna, Hayato and Lynn characters.
[*]Fixed the issue preventing some players from entering the Ghastly the Snowman portal.
[*]Fixed the issue where Ornaments were dropping after 100 were collected for the “Do You Fear What I Fear?” event.
[*]Fixed the issue causing the “Ghastly the Snowman” portal to appear after the 3 time limit per day has been reached.
[*]Fixed the issue where the ‘?’ button in the “Do You Fear What I Fear?” event UI was displaying incorrect text.

notes.title: Dark Maplemas Events!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/aa7d8538363c768f7410093bdb76e771a68a4780.png[/img]

'Tis the season for Maplemas, and two visitors from across the dimensional rift have brought their own special flavor of the holiday for all Maplers to enjoy! This Maplemas might be a touch darker than you're used to, but Holly and Jolly have brought plenty of presents, games, and more to enjoy during the darkest time of the year (for those in the northern hemisphere)!
[h3][b]Dark Maplemas Event Duration[/b][/h3][list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): Tuesday, December 17, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, January 14, 2025 3:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Tuesday, December 17, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, January 15, 2025 12:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Tuesday, December 17, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, January 15, 2025 10:59 AM[/b][/*][/list][h2][b]Slay Ride[/b][/h2]
Take Holly and Jolly's special sleigh on a race through the snow, dodging seasonal tombstones and blowing past festive coffins, as you deliver presents at top speed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/6153fb7c6b9ec1e9bf1149d1a418871027e02cbf.png[/img]

Use the Left and Right keys to switch between lanes to avoid the tombstones, the Use/Interact key to knock down the caskets in your way, and collect the "RIDE" letters for a brief period of invulnerability! You'll earn special prizes the longer you travel, including the [b]Sleigh Chair[/b] and [b]Jolly Totem[/b] (90-day duration). Check out the full details below!

[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]Complete the quest '[Dark Maplemas] Slay Ride' through the Event List.[/*][*][b]Requirement[/b]: Lv. 101 and above characters (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).[/*][*]After completing the quest, head over to Jolly and accept the ‘[Dark Maplemas] Slay Ride’ quest to begin.[/*][*]There are 3 lanes to maneuver from but be careful of oncoming tombstones and coffins! Use your arrow keys and spacebar to avoid the obstacles.[/*][*]Collect letters to spell out “RIDE” to get a boost increase and become invincible.[/*][*]If you reach 10k meters, you will receive:[list][*][b]Mighty Child Present Box (x2): [/b][url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/update/21376/v-256-the-dark-ride-limbo-patch-notes#MightyChildPresentBox]Click here to view the possible reward items.[/url][/*][*][b]EXP Voucher (x200)[/b][/*][*]You can claim these rewards from Jolly in the Dark Maplemas Eve map.[/*][*]Up to 50k meters can be reached every week. (No entry count limit before reaching it).[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Event Rewards[/b]:
[list][*]Rewards are based on the meters you have accumulated.[/*][/list][table][tr][td]
[b]Meters Accumulated[/b]
[/td][td]
[b]Reward[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]100,000[/b]
[/td][td]
[b]Dark Maplemas Sleigh Chair[/b]: Tradable within world, Permanent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/794e2691bf5e9c83fd7edcbad9a64ab81df266a2.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]200,000[/b]
[/td][td]
[b]Jolly Totem[/b]: Untradable, 90-day duration. All Stats +25, Attack Power/Magic ATT +12, 3 Set Effect Attack power/Magic ATT +15.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/388af61bd5df581432e7e7f84acfafd2f9b9535c.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]O Holy Fright[/b][/h2]
Holly and Jolly's arrival in Maple World has brought along some unwelcome tag-alongs, and they need your help to chase them off and save Dark Maplemas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/7aa5eda83f10419015c29c5179111b6a849ce00a.png[/img]

Use Shift to fire your laser at the invading enemies, while dodging their attacks from on high! Your other skills will be disabled for this fight, so make sure to move carefully, beware reinforcements, and catch falling presents for a 7-second attack power boost and invulnerability! Clear the mission and earn your way towards the [b]Fright Totem[/b] (90-day duration) and [b]Dark Maplemas Damage Skin[/b], and see the full details below!

[b]Event Details:[/b]

[b]Requirement: [/b]Lv. 101 and above characters (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).

We must defend Maplemas from Fright, an invader from the outer spheres! Holly and Jolly are relying on us to help save Dark Maplemas from pesky present stealers.
[list][*]Complete the quest '[Dark Maplemas] O Holy Fright' through the Event List.[/*][*]After completing the quest, head over to Jolly and accept the ‘[Dark Maplemas] O Holy Fright’ quest to begin.[/*][*]Stay on your toes! If you get hit with the barrage you will get damaged. Use your Shift and direction keys to fire at Fright.[list][*]Keep in mind that your skills will not be available during this quest.[/*][/list][/*][*]There are 3 types of barrages that can cause damage:[list][*]Basic Barrage: Inflict 10% damage to your health.[/*][*]Confusion: Causes your keyboard directions to invert.[/*][*]Instant Kill Barrage: Inflicts 100% damage to your health.[/*][/list][/*][*]When you defeat Fright you will receive:[list][*][b]Mighty Child Present Box (x2): [/b][url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/update/21376/v-256-the-dark-ride-limbo-patch-notes#MightyChildPresentBox]Click here to view the possible reward items.[/url][/*][*][b]EXP Voucher (x200)[/b][/*][*]You can claim these rewards from Jolly in the Dark Maplemas Eve map.[/*][*]Can be cleared up to 5 times a week. [h2][b]Do You Fear What I Fear?[/b][/h2]
It wouldn't be Maplemas without a tree, even one as... hungry as this one looks. Still, a Maplemas Tree needs decorations, and Holly and Jolly want you to find them throughout your adventures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/107118d5eabde87e9ddfd0baa825122a782d587c.png[/img]

Collect Ornament Boxes by hunting monsters around your level, and when you get 10 of them, you'll be able to place an ornament on the tree and collect a [b]Dark Maplemas Gift Box[/b], containing your choice of progression, EXP, profession, or enhancement rewards. You can collect up to 10 gift boxes every day. See the full details below!

[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]You can join this event by accepting the '[Dark Maplemas] Do You Fear What I Fear?' quest from Holly.[/*][*][b]Requirement[/b]: Lv. 101 and above characters (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).[/*][*]When you defeat monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above), you can collect the dropped Ornament Boxes.[/*][*]You can exchange 10 Ornament Boxes for 1 Tree Ornament[/*][*]When you get 1 Tree Ornament, you will receive a [b]Steadfast Child Present Box[/b]![list][*]There are a total of 10 Tree Ornaments.[/*][*]Rewards can be claimed once a day per ornament, which means you can get a total of 10 Steadfast Child Present Boxes daily![/*][/list][/*][*]You can check the Ornament Box quantity, decorations, and claim rewards using the Event UI.[/*][/list]
[b]Event Rewards:[/b]

[h2][b]Ghastly The Snowman[/b][/h2]
♪ Ghastly the Snowman, is a very angry foe, made of snow and hate and magic too great because Holly's portal closed too slow! Ghastly the Snowman, can be fought in his own place, take the portal in and battle to win while you punch him in the face! ♪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/fc8e2940d28813ff27eefbb0ed9675c864da327c.png[/img]

Once you hunt 1,000 monsters around your level, a portal to Ghastly the Snowman's domain will appear, allowing for a fight similar to the Inferno Wolf's Den (only a bit colder). You'll have a minute to take him down with special prizes on the line based on how much damage you do. You can fight Ghastly the Snowman up to three times per day, so check out the full details below!

notes.title: v.256 - The Dark Ride: Limbo Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/60705a0a2c3224fe1e32eb1cb4186dab85e4bf8b.png[/img]

[b]Do You Fear What I Fear?[/b] A new boss, [b]Limbo[/b], is on his way to destroy Maple World this [b]Dark Maplemas[/b]! Upgrade your [b]HEXA Stat Node II[/b] and get ready to [b]Wreck the Halls[/b] as you battle through the [b]Wicked Wonderland[/b]. Head into the new year with [b]Blue Snake’s Wish[/b] and grab your dream name at the [b]New Name Auction[/b]. Then embark on expeditions with the [b]Extradimensional Visitors[/b] for endless gains!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/23d2ec7b41990b2cb5e2134731621e79c3696785.png[/img]

[b]Limbo[/b], an Apostle of Gerand Darmoor, has arrived in Carcion to seize the power of Keira, the Ancient God of Carcion. Take Limbo down before he absorbs her power and plunges the world into chaos. Maple World’s fate depends on you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/47f73c27aa943e9999755bad2aee198305d67be5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/3bc312fdaf691d655379840b7cb993bedf162c61.png[/img]

[b]Do You Fear What I Fear?[/b] Maplemas is here, but it’s not your usual holiday cheer - Holly and Jolly brought the chaos this year! Experience the [b]Wicked Wonderland[/b] and challenge [b]Ghastly the Snowman[/b] to receive awesome rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/81b806b7abd70c47d544ad1a69a5d4239ef4db03.png[/img]

Hop on a [b]Slay Ride[/b] to deliver presents and get your [b][Home]: Maplemas[/b] ready with festive decorations! Let the spooky holiday fun begin!

notes.title: Concerning the Release of Update v.255
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/a6b70cd8537f64c26cd06e6c19665d2b6c35b809.jpg[/img]

Hello, Maplers.

First, we'd like to apologize for the unexpected issues and gameplay disruptions that occurred when the v.255 update went live. We understand the severity of this situation, and will learn from it to improve our processes. We remain committed to supporting a stable and high quality play experience.

Below, we will outline the primary issues that occurred with the v.255 update and summarize the current state of affairs.

[b]1. Extended Maintenance[/b]

There were several issues pertaining to new content and system updates. The main issues were as follows:
[list][*]Extended maintenance on the day of the v.255 update: Parts of the game that worked as intended during internal testing suddenly became unplayable when running on live servers. The maintenance was extended beyond what was initially estimated to investigate, fix, and retest these issues.[/*][*]Crashes and additional maintenance: There were several crashes after the v.255 update went live:[/*][list][*]Server crashes when generating certain rewards upon defeating an enemy. Due to the frequency of the crashes, a maintenance was required to implement a quick fix.[/*][*]Server crashes when the Guardian Angel Slime would finish a boss pattern and then vanish.[/*][*]Client crashes when Shade used Soul Splitter while fighting Ursus.[/*][*]Aside from crashes, there was also an issue where a long quest was being finished quickly due to Black Mage Remnants erroneously remaining on a drop table. Separately, many rare boss rewards that should not have been affected by the drop rate increase were affected. Given the effect these issues would have on game balance and fairness to our players, it was clear we needed to take urgent action.[/*][*]Aside from the issues noted above, there was also an additional maintenance done to address the unintended functionality of the Frenzy Totem, rewards not being generated when Zero characters defeated a boss, and other issues with the new Ride or Die content.[/*][/list][/list]
[b]2. Content Issues[/b]
[list][*]Removal of certain Page of Memories mini-games:[/*][list][*]During internal testing, we discovered that the Spirit's Memories and Spirit's Emotions mini-games were causing extreme lag in most Global MapleStory service regions. The lag was severe enough that normal gameplay was being adversely affected. In these mini-games, a new sync method called "Lockstep" was used. However, this method was not well-suited to some environments with the network ping conditions of regions where Global MapleStory is serviced. Considering the limited time the live service team had to address the issue, the decision was eventually made to remove the affected mini-games for the sake of stability. To compensate, the EXP Vouchers that would have been granted by these mini-games were instead added to the Ride or Die Inspector Boxes. However, we overlooked the fact that the Ride or Die reward is given a week after the patch, and that players weren't made aware of that fact. We apologize for the confusion this has caused, and will strive to be more clear in the future.[/*][*]Please be aware that EXP Vouchers will also be obtainable from the Burning Express event and Dark Maplemas mini-game in the v.256 update.[/*][/list][*]Changes to the Intense Power Crystal:[/*][list][*]A change was made to the number of Intense Power Crystals that can be sold each week. However, the proper price adjustments were not made, causing a dip in some players' meso earnings.[/*][*]We are actively considering additional changes that will be applied during maintenance on Dec. 5, 2024. We apologize for the delay in confirming these changes.[/*][/list][*]Other Issues:[/*][list][*]We are aware that there are other issues not listed here. We will do our best to fix as many as we can in the upcoming maintenance on Dec. 5, 2024.[/*][/list][/list]
To apologize for any inconvenience you may have experienced, we've prepared the following compensation package for you.

[b]Server Maintenance Compensation[/b]
[list][*][b]Claim Period:[/b] Wednesday, November 27, 2024 1:25 AM UTC- Tuesday, December 10, 2024 11:59 PM UTC[/*][*][b]How to Claim:[/b] Talk to the Maple Administrator NPC in the Event Hall map, and select Server Maintenance Compensation to claim. (Limit once per account.)[/*][*][b]Package Contents[/b]:[/*][/list][table][tr][th]Item[/th][th]Count[/th][th]Duration (Days)[/th][th]Tradability[/th][/tr][tr][td]3x EXP Coupon (15 min)[/td][td]x15[/td][td]7[/td][td]Untradable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Special Medal of Honor[/td][td]x10[/td][td]7[/td][td]Untradable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Symbol Selector Coupons. Select one of the below:[list][*]Arcane Symbol Selector Coupon (100)[/*][*]Sacred Symbol Selector Coupon (25)[/*][/list][/td][td]x1[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][tr][td]Trait Boost Potion[/td][td]x3[/td][td]7[/td][td]Untradable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Extreme Growth Potion[/td][td]x5[/td][td]7[/td][td]Untradable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Growth Potion Selector Coupon. Select one of the below:[list][*]Growth Potion (200 - 209) (8)[/*][*]Growth Potion (200 - 219) (4)[/*][*]Growth Potion (200 - 229) (2)[/*][*]Typhoon Growth Potion (1)[/*][/list][/td][td]x1[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][tr][td]Karma Black Rebirth Flame[/td][td]x5[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][tr][td]Experience Nodestone[/td][td]x2[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][tr][td]VIP Buff Selector Coupon[/td][td]x3[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][/table]
We know many of you were excited for this update, and we apologize once again for failing to meet your expectations. We will redouble our efforts to prepare and review our work so we can provide better service in the future. Thank you for your understanding.

Thank you,

The MapleStory Team

tags.bug: - Server crashes when generating certain rewards upon defeating an enemy. Due to the frequency of the crashes, a maintenance was required to implement a quick fix.
- Server crashes when the Guardian Angel Slime would finish a boss pattern and then vanish.
- Client crashes when Shade used Soul Splitter while fighting Ursus.

- Aside from crashes, there was also an issue where a long quest was being finished quickly due to Black Mage Remnants erroneously remaining on a drop table. Separately, many rare boss rewards that should not have been affected by the drop rate increase were affected. Given the effect these issues would have on game balance and fairness to our players, it was clear we needed to take urgent action.

- Aside from the issues noted above, there was also an additional maintenance done to address the unintended functionality of the Frenzy Totem, rewards not being generated when Zero characters defeated a boss, and other issues with the new Ride or Die content.

- During internal testing, we discovered that the Spirit's Memories and Spirit's Emotions mini-games were causing extreme lag in most Global MapleStory service regions. The lag was severe enough that normal gameplay was being adversely affected. In these mini-games, a new sync method called "Lockstep" was used. However, this method was not well-suited to some environments with the network ping conditions of regions where Global MapleStory is serviced. Considering the limited time the live service team had to address the issue, the decision was eventually made to remove the affected mini-games for the sake of stability. To compensate, the EXP Vouchers that would have been granted by these mini-games were instead added to the Ride or Die Inspector Boxes. However, we overlooked the fact that the Ride or Die reward is given a week after the patch, and that players weren't made aware of that fact. We apologize for the confusion this has caused, and will strive to be more clear in the future.
- A change was made to the number of Intense Power Crystals that can be sold each week. However, the proper price adjustments were not made, causing a dip in some players' meso earnings.

As notified before, the dev team's intent was to keep the previous Frenzy Totem's mob regen speed and mob regen quantities, and this will apply in the same way to the new Chains of Resentment totems. The Chains of Resentment differs from the Frenzy Totems in whether the effect remains on the map when the caster moves maps, and the effects of the Chains of Resentment disappears when the caster moves maps. In order to prevent disrupting another player on a map where the Chains of Resentment have already been used due to this differentiation, the Chains of Resentment can't be used again on a map where the effect has already been applied. The Frenzy Totem being able to be used on the same map again was an intended mechanic, and any unintended changes after the v255 patch will be fixed with this maintenance, and please understand that the previous specs weren't intended.[/*][/list][/list][list][*][u][u]The Ride or Die Horntail HP has been adjusted.[/u][/u][/*][list][*][b][Dev Comment] [/b]The intent behind Ride or Die is to allow characters to defeat bosses based on their strength and earn rewards, thus motivating players to become stronger. This event has 6 types of bosses, and for the Horntail, we have confirmed that its HP is much lower than we first intended. This has allowed players to defeat the Horntail much more easily in Code S difficulty, resulting in an experience different from what we intended. Thus the dev team has decided to increase the Horntail's HP to provide a difficulty level more appropriate to the intended strength of the character. We apologize for the inconvenience for the Ride or Die event.[/*][/list][/list][list][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where the Genesis Crux would drop multiple Black Mage Remnants.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where Absolute Zero Aura: Vortex would crash other players on the map when the skill ends.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where the achievenment '[From Memory] The One Who's Touched the Sky of the Grand Athenaeum' was not obtainable.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where Exceptional Hammers were not displayed as rewards for Extreme Kaling and Kalos.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where both old enhancement and exceptional hammer still drop from the extreme bosses (Kaling, Black Mage, Seren, Kalos).[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where summoned familiars did not contribute towards total combat power.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where weekly participation for Ride or Die rewards did not have the correct duration listed.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where players would fall through platforms when fighting Guardian Angel Slime.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where certain characters were unable to join Item Burning.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where the text was cut off when speaking to Thales.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where the character deletion UI displayed incorrect text.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where Flushed Toothy Smirk Coupon and Blushing Toothy Smirk Coupon are unable to be claimed from The Dark Ride ticket.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where Damage Skin Slot Expansion Coupon's text had "C's" appearing in the description.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where the Papulatus Items were not dropping in Practice Mode for Ride or Die.[/u][/u][/*][*][u][u]Resolved an issue where players were unable to use buff skills and Atmospheric Effects in the 'In Front of the Temple' map. notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/021da7b54e6eb217ba333854e2d34864f9e3c9a9.jpg[/img]

Two of Maple World's legendary heroes have turned over a new leaf, with a revamped set of skills and abilities coming to the polearm-wielding Aran and spirit-brawler Shade!

Head to their Classes and Jobs pages to take a look at some of [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/game/classes-and-jobs/1295/Warrior]Aran's new abilities that get the most out of her polearm[/url], or [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/game/classes-and-jobs/1321/Pirate]the Forgotten Hero Shade's new powers calling upon his connection to the spirits[/url]. And when you're ready, get a bonus Hyper Burning Shade or Aran with the Blossoming by Moonshade events below!

[b]Event Duration:[/b]
[list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, February 11, 2025 3:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 12, 2025 12:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 12, 2025 10:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]

[list][*]Create a new Aran or Shade character and designate it as a ‘Blossoming by Moonshade: Hyper Burning’ character.[/*][list][*]If you do not have a character designated as a Hyper Burning yet, when creating an Aran or Shade, the Blossoming by Moonshade Hyper Burning will be applied first.[/*][/list][*]Existing Lv. 200 - 258 Aran/Shade characters can be set as Blossoming by Moonshade Hyper Burning by pressing the ‘Set as Hyper Burning’ button the the right side of the character selection window.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/3b59da18e978c18dee48d0dddeb995e9e5c37b3b.png[/img]

tags.feature: Two of Maple World's legendary heroes have turned over a new leaf, with a revamped set of skills and abilities coming to the polearm-wielding Aran and spirit-brawler Shade!

Head to their Classes and Jobs pages to take a look at some of [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/game/classes-and-jobs/1295/Warrior]Aran's new abilities that get the most out of her polearm[/url], or [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/game/classes-and-jobs/1321/Pirate]the Forgotten Hero Shade's new powers calling upon his connection to the spirits[/url].
And when you're ready, get a bonus Hyper Burning Shade or Aran with the Blossoming by Moonshade events below!
Create a new Aran or Shade character and designate it as a ‘Blossoming by Moonshade: Hyper Burning’ character.
If you do not have a character designated as a Hyper Burning yet, when creating an Aran or Shade, the Blossoming by Moonshade Hyper Burning will be applied first.
Existing Lv. 200 - 258 Aran/Shade characters can be set as Blossoming by Moonshade Hyper Burning by pressing the ‘Set as Hyper Burning’ button the the right side of the character selection window.
Blossoming by Moonshade Hyper Burning characters can earn two additional levels each time you gain a level up from Lv. 11 to Lv. 260!
Blossoming by Moonshade Hyper Burning characters can only use Typhoon Growth Potions, Magnificent Growth Potions, and Transcendent Growth Potions.
Blossoming by Moonshade Hyper Burning characters can unlock and claim rewards through the ‘Blossoming by Moonshade: Hyper Burning’ button in the star event notifier on the left side of the screen.
Characters leveling in Burning World can receive even more powerful Burning World rewards.
Level achievement rewards can be claimed once per account. You cannot claim it again even if you delete the character after claiming and create a new one.
Only characters who completed the 5th Job Advancement and the ‘A Greater Power’ quest can claim the Eternal Flame Title Coupon, Nodestone, and Infinite Flame Title Coupon rewards.
For an existing character that already has the Eternal Flame Ring, another of the same item cannot be obtained from the Eternal Flame Ring Coupon.
You cannot receive the Burning world reward and Interactive world reward under the same achievement conditions at the same time.
You can only obtain the symbol of the region you've completed the Arcane River and Grandis story quests, when you use the Arcane/Sacred Symbol Selector Coupon.
Each region's Arcane Symbol reward can be claimed after completing the relevant region's Arcane Symbol quest.

If the Arcane Symbol was transferred by using Arcane Catalyst, the Unstable Arcane Symbol must be normalized first and then claim the level achievement reward (Lv. 5/Lv. 8 Arcane Symbol) to enhance it properly.
For existing characters designated as Hyper Burning, only level achievement rewards will be available.
We prepared gifts for both new and existing Aran characters!

notes.title: The Dark Ride Burning Events!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0958eedffad942e583aeb1565dcd7c14c64732eb.jpg[/img]

The Dark Ride is here with a new collection of Burning Events to get your new characters up to high level faster than ever! The [b]Zero to One Hundred[/b] event is here to provide you a new way to race up to Lv. 100 in a single session of play, along with the returning [b]Tera Blink[/b]. Select characters for [b]Hyper Burning[/b] to get bonus levels each time you level-up, make your new characters on the temporary [b]Burning World[/b] to collect EXP even faster, and use the [b]Item Burning[/b] event to help your equipment keep up to your blazing-fast leveling!

Don't forget, the [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/events/21746/aran-and-shade-redux-events]Blossoming by Moonshade Event[/url] is also running, letting you designate newly revamped Shade or Aran characters as bonus Hyper Burning characters too!

[h3][b]Hyper Burning[/b][/h3][list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, February 11, 2025 3:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 12, 2025 12:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 12, 2025 10:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
[u]Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.[/u]

Create a brand-new character during the extra-long event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in all worlds, as well as Burning World, [b]except for Zero characters[/b].

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional [b]two levels[/b] all the way up to Lv. 260! You also have the option to designate one of your existing Lv. 200-258 characters as 'Hyper Burning' instead, allowing them to gain that benefit!

In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including [b]Root Abyss and Fafnir gear[/b]! When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training! You will receive additional rewards on your ‘Hyper Burning’ character at Lv. 200, Lv. 210, and every 5 levels after Lv. 210, up to Lv. 260!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/300444a7072d7aaeb56633390e4aea09c6de5c35.png[/img]

Once your ‘Burning’ character reaches Lv. 200 (or you designate an existing character as Burning), you can obtain [b]Bonus Rewards[/b] up until Lv. 260. You'll also get even better rewards for playing on Burning World![/*][/list]

[h3][b]Item Burning[/b][/h3][list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, February 11, 2025 3:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 12, 2025 12:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 12, 2025 10:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]Hyper Burning characters are about to get even more support to get caught up into the action with the all new Item Burning system![/*][*][b]Requirements: [/b]Lv. 200 newly created Hyper Burning character and have completed the ‘A Greater Power’ quest. (Newly created Hyper Burning Zero character that has completed Story Quest Act 2).[/*][*]Click on the Event Notifier or talk to the Administrator NPC located at the Event Hall and click the ‘Participate’ button.[/*][*]Starting with the new Hyperburning Aran or Shade from the Blooming Moon event? You can apply the Item Burning to these characters for an even smoother leveling experience![/*][*]After completing the ‘[Item Burning] Leveling Equipment - A necessity for Challengers’ quest you will receive 8 types of Challenger Equipment for your Job in your inventory.[/*][*]Equipment consists of the following:[/*][list][*]Challenger Weapon, Hat, Top, Bottom, Gloves, Shoes, Cape, and Shoulder Accessory.[/*][list][*]Xenon characters receive a regular weapon instead of a Thief or Pirate exclusive weapon.[/*][*]Zero characters receive 7 equipment pieces and do not receive a weapon.[/*][*]Stats for each equipment are predetermined and are based on your character’s Job. Please note that restrictions apply for Scroll use, Star Force enhancement, Transfer Hammer, Bonus Stats resetting, and Potential resetting.[/*][/list][/list][*]Challenger Equipment will be enhanced by completing the following missions:[/*][/list][table][tr][th]Stage[/th][th]Level[/th][th]Content[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][td]1[/td][td]200[/td][td]Defeat Zakum [Chaos] by yourself[/td][td]Challenger Equipment Perk 1[/td][/tr][tr][td]2[/td][td]210[/td][td]Defeat Vellum [Chaos] by yourself[/td][td]Challenger Equipment Perk 2[/td][/tr][tr][td]3[/td][td]220[/td][td]Defeat Papulatus [Chaos] by yourself[/td][td]Challenger Equipment Perk 3[/td][/tr][tr][td]4[/td][td]225[/td][td]Defeat Lotus [Normal] by yourself[/td][td]Challenger Equipment Perk 4[/td][/tr][tr][td]5[/td][td]230[/td][td]Defeat Guardian Angel Slime [Normal] by yourself[/td][td]Challenger Equipment Perk 5[/td][/tr][/table][list][list][*]Missions are completed if you defeat the boss on a higher difficulty by yourself.[/*][/list][*]A final Challenger’s Mission will be available when reaching Lv. 260, providing you with a special reward![/*][list][*][b]Challenger’s Mission[/b]: Defeat Lucid [Easy] by yourself.[/*][list][*]Reward:[/*][list][*][b]100 Sol Erda Fragments[/b], Untradable, Permanent.[/*][*][b]Level 5 Sacred Symbol: Cernium[/b], Untradable, Permanent.[/*][/list][/list][/list][*]You MUST clear the previous stage’s mission in order to be able to complete the next mission.[/*][*]Item Burning event can only be completed [b]PER ACCOUNT.[/b][/*][list][*]If you create a new character after deleting the character, you are unable to participate in the event again.[/*][/list][*]Equipment will be given after completion of the ‘[Item Burning] Leveling Equipment - A Necessity for Challengers’ quest, so make sure to complete the quest on the character you want the equipment on.[/*][*]Characters who have completed the 6th Job Advancement are able to use the Sol Erda Fragments.[/*][*]The Lv. 5 Sacred Symbol: Cernium can be claimed after completing the ‘A Divine Power’ quest.[/*][*]If Open Advancement is performed, the relevant Job’s weapon will be distributed for replacement upon completion of the next mission after Open Advancement.[/*][*]Fusion Anvil, Soul Collector, Soul, and Item Tag items are able to be used on Challenger equipment but will be reset when equipment growth is performed.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Zero to One Hundred[/b][/h3][list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, January 14, 2025 3:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, January 15, 2025 12:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, January 15, 2025 10:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]Boost to Lv. 100 with 7 characters in no time with the return of Zero to One Hundred![/*][*][b]Requirements[/b]: Characters between Lv. 10 - Lv. 100. Zero characters cannot participate in the event. Burning characters can also participate.[/*][*]Accept the '[Zero to One Hundred] Accelerated Zero to One Hundred’ quest through the star event notifier on the left side of the screen or talk to Spiegelette located in Henesys, Nameless Town, and Cernium.[/*][list][*]There will be a special Zero to One Hundred growth effect displayed on the character you designated in the character selection screen.[/*][/list][*]Characters designated for Zero to One Hundred can move to the hunting zone through the '[Zero to One Hundred] Move to the Leveling Acceleration Hunting Zone' quest in the star event notifier or by talking to Spiegelette.[/*][*]In the hunting zone, you’ll [b]defeat monsters that give accelerated EXP[/b].[/*][*]You can freely enter or exit the level acceleration hunting zone by talking to Spiegelette at any time during the event.[/*][*]There will be different hunting zones depending on your level that you will automatically move to upon entering.[/*][*]After reaching the level for the next hunting zone, you can move there by talking to Spiegelette within the current hunting zone.[/*][*]After you reach Lv. 101, you will be automatically moved to the map you were in prior to entering the hunting zone.[/*][*][b]Up to 7 characters[/b] per account can participate in the event.[/*][list][*]The count is deducted after setting the character for Zero to One Hundred.[/*][*]The count isn't restored even if the set character is deleted, and an additional selection can't be made that day.[/*][*]You can only set one character a day.[/*][/list][*]Certain jobs must complete their early tutorials to move to the Zero to One Hundred level-accelerated hunting zone.[/*][list][*]Cadena, Ark, and Illium cannot acquire EXP in level-accelerated hunting zones if they haven't completed their early tutorials.[/*][/list][*]Keep note that you cannot form parties with other characters within the hunting zone.[/*][*]The Atmospheric Effect that is used in the hunting zone is applied.[/*][*]EXP obtained from monsters in the hunting zone will have the EXP Boost buff effect applied.[/*][*]Characters will have their own monsters summoned in the hunting zone and will not share monsters with other players.[/*][*]You can still claim Level Achievement Rewards and special gifts even when reaching set levels outside the level-accelerated hunting zone.[/*][/list]

tags.feature: The Dark Ride is here with a new collection of Burning Events to get your new characters up to high level faster than ever! The [b]Zero to One Hundred[/b] event is here to provide you a new way to race up to Lv. 100 in a single session of play, along with the returning [b]Tera Blink[/b]. Select characters for [b]Hyper Burning[/b] to get bonus levels each time you level-up, make your new characters on the temporary [b]Burning World[/b] to collect EXP even faster, and use the [b]Item Burning[/b] event to help your equipment keep up to your blazing-fast leveling!

Don't forget, the [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/events/21746/aran-and-shade-redux-events]Blossoming by Moonshade Event[/url] is also running, letting you designate newly revamped Shade or Aran characters as bonus Hyper Burning characters too!

Create a brand-new character during the extra-long event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in all worlds, as well as Burning World, [b]except for Zero characters[/b].

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional [b]two levels[/b] all the way up to Lv. 260! You also have the option to designate one of your existing Lv. 200-258 characters as 'Hyper Burning' instead, allowing them to gain that benefit!

In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including [b]Root Abyss and Fafnir gear[/b]! When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training! You will receive additional rewards on your ‘Hyper Burning’ character at Lv. 200, Lv. 210, and every 5 levels after Lv. 210, up to Lv. 260!
Reach level 260 fast on a new or existing character with the Hyper Burning event!
After creating a new character, you will be given an option to give it a ‘Hyper Burning’ effect.
You [b]cannot[/b] go back to give it a ‘Burning’ effect after refusing to do so during character creation.
You can only 'Hyper Burn' 1 character per account during the event.
After your ‘Hyper Burning’ character reaches Lv. 10, they will start to earn two additional levels each time your character gains a level up to Lv. 260.
You will receive special Hyper Burning Rewards when your ‘Burning’ character meets the listed level milestones.
Alternatively, you may elect to set one of your existing Lv. 200 - 258 characters as 'Hyper Burning', by selecting it on character select screen and clicking on 'Set as Hyper Burning'.
Doing so will prevent you from designating a newly-created character as 'Hyper Burning'.
You will still be able to create 'Mega Burning' characters on Burning World.

There’s more rewards waiting for you past Lv. 200! Once your ‘Burning’ character reaches Lv. 200 (or you designate an existing character as Burning), you can obtain [b]Bonus Rewards[/b] up until Lv. 260. You'll also get even better rewards for playing on Burning World!

Hyper Burning characters are about to get even more support to get caught up into the action with the all new Item Burning system!
Starting with the new Hyperburning Aran or Shade from the Blooming Moon event? You can apply the Item Burning to these characters for an even smoother leveling experience!
After completing the ‘[Item Burning] Leveling Equipment - A necessity for Challengers’ quest you will receive 8 types of Challenger Equipment for your Job in your inventory.
Equipment consists of the following:
Challenger Weapon, Hat, Top, Bottom, Gloves, Shoes, Cape, and Shoulder Accessory.
Xenon characters receive a regular weapon instead of a Thief or Pirate exclusive weapon.
Zero characters receive 7 equipment pieces and do not receive a weapon.

Stats for each equipment are predetermined and are based on your character’s Job. Please note that restrictions apply for Scroll use, Star Force enhancement, Transfer Hammer, Bonus Stats resetting, and Potential resetting.
Equipment will be given after completion of the ‘[Item Burning] Leveling Equipment - A Necessity for Challengers’ quest, so make sure to complete the quest on the character you want the equipment on.
Characters who have completed the 6th Job Advancement are able to use the Sol Erda Fragments.
The Lv. 5 Sacred Symbol: Cernium can be claimed after completing the ‘A Divine Power’ quest.
If Open Advancement is performed, the relevant Job’s weapon will be distributed for replacement upon completion of the next mission after Open Advancement.
Fusion Anvil, Soul Collector, Soul, and Item Tag items are able to be used on Challenger equipment but will be reset when equipment growth is performed.
Boost to Lv. 100 with 7 characters in no time with the return of Zero to One Hundred!

Accept the '[Zero to One Hundred] Accelerated Zero to One Hundred’ quest through the star event notifier on the left side of the screen or talk to Spiegelette located in Henesys, Nameless Town, and Cernium.
There will be a special Zero to One Hundred growth effect displayed on the character you designated in the character selection screen.

Characters designated for Zero to One Hundred can move to the hunting zone through the '[Zero to One Hundred] Move to the Leveling Acceleration Hunting Zone' quest in the star event notifier or by talking to Spiegelette.
In the hunting zone, you’ll [b]defeat monsters that give accelerated EXP[/b].
You can freely enter or exit the level acceleration hunting zone by talking to Spiegelette at any time during the event.
There will be different hunting zones depending on your level that you will automatically move to upon entering.
After reaching the level for the next hunting zone, you can move there by talking to Spiegelette within the current hunting zone.
After you reach Lv. 101, you will be automatically moved to the map you were in prior to entering the hunting zone.
Up to 7 characters per account can participate in the event.
The count is deducted after setting the character for Zero to One Hundred.
The count isn't restored even if the set character is deleted, and an additional selection can't be made that day.
You can only set one character a day.
Certain jobs must complete their early tutorials to move to the Zero to One Hundred level-accelerated hunting zone.
Cadena, Ark, and Illium cannot acquire EXP in level-accelerated hunting zones if they haven't completed their early tutorials.
Keep note that you cannot form parties with other characters within the hunting zone.
The Atmospheric Effect that is used in the hunting zone is applied.
EXP obtained from monsters in the hunting zone will have the EXP Boost buff effect applied.
Characters will have their own monsters summoned in the hunting zone and will not share monsters with other players.
You can still claim Level Achievement Rewards and special gifts even when reaching set levels outside the level-accelerated hunting zone.

notes.content:

notes.title: MapleStory Worlds Americas Soft Launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/86365cca46e12f1d4de5ced699756728e8b748d5.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.nexon.com/msw/landing]MapleStory Worlds has now soft-launched in the Americas on Windows PC and Mac (Beta)[/url]! Introducing an exciting new way to play and create - MapleStory Worlds is here with powerful tools to design your own adventures and enjoy the creations of your fellow Maplers, and Maplers in North and South America can now join the fun!

[url=https://www.nexon.com/msw/landing]Learn more at the MapleStory Worlds website[/url]!

[previewyoutube=qT_cgEgHObw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]What is MapleStory Worlds?[/b][/h2]
Immerse yourself in a new way to play and create! In MapleStory Worlds, players and creators come together to explore magical experiences. With powerful worldbuilding tools and 30 million MapleStory Assets, creators craft immersive adventures for players around the world and earn from their unique designs.

[b]Unleash Your Creativity[/b]

Bring your imagination to life in a World you create! Select from over 30 million MapleStory game assets or import your own to design action-packed games, clever puzzles, or a place to hang out with friends. [url=https://maplestoryworlds-creators.nexon.com/en]Learn more in the Creator Center[/url]!

[b]Dive into a Vibrant Community[/b]

Explore thriving Worlds filled with diverse environments, each offering endless excitement! Your avatar is free to explore them all - with costumes and accessories designed to let you support your favorite creators. [url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play]Learn more in the Play Worlds page[/url]!

[b]Join the Creator Circle[/b]

Apply for the exclusive Creator Circle! As a member of this ongoing monthly program, you will improve your game, grow your player base, and earn income in MapleStory Worlds - all with the direct support of the Nexon team. [url=https://forum.nexon.com/maplestoryworlds-creators-en/board_view?board=5485&thread=2665788]Learn more in the Creator Circle post[/url]!

[b]Available Regions and Platforms[/b]

While MapleStory Worlds is currently only soft launching in North and South America on Windows PC for now, and in public Beta on Mac, we’ll be coming to Mobile platforms soon, and opening up in Europe in January 2025. It will be available for other regions later in the year.

notes.title: v.254 - Midnight Carnival - Ludibrium Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0235f86cb18a1f71d15439cb306468d361b6f812.png[/img]
        
[b]BOO![/b] Our [b]Night Troupe[/b] is making its daring return just in time for the mischievous season of Halloween! We have lots in store to really get this season going! You can start with earning bonus stats by leveling up your [b]Festival Designer Rank[/b] in Ludibrium or you can kick back and put together some solid fits through our [b]Maple Fashion Week[/b]. Is dressing yourself up not enough?! That’s fine! You can put your interior design skills to the test by decorating your space through the [b][Home] Halloween[/b] event!
        
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/224663ab4dd2c4c831a58f2912dedf6e2917e4ef.png[/img]
        
We’ve been to Henesys, Rien, Nautilus... and now, it’s time to explore the castle of toys! The [b]Night Troupe[/b] is back and this time, they’re taking us to [b]Ludibrium[/b]!
        
Level up your [b]Festival Designer Rank[/b] to unlock bonus stats, and power up even more with [b]Festival Decorating[/b] perks that give your character (and boss mules) extra gains! Time doesn’t play by the rules here! Choose to fill either the [b]Eos Hourglass[/b] or the [b]Helios Hourglass[/b] and enjoy a boost in EXP - past, present, or future, the choice is yours.
        
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/1489bd5858420cf067ce997be007ccc7dc05c28b.png[/img]
        
Need a break after all that grinding? Grab your friends and enjoy the [b]Ludibrium Fireworks Display[/b], then jump right back in for a fun challenge - [b]Knocking Down Blockulatus[/b]!
        
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/499f090039ae1f92031006d79d00230e23c62160.png[/img]
        
FashionStory IS the true endgame! Get ready, because [b]Hallowkitty[/b] and [b]Camila[/b] are back and thrilled to host [b]Maple Fashion Week[/b]! Defeat enemies to unlock your next outfit of the day and show off your style down the runway.
        
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/c3fc587fdd38e995c2e2315104f93e65c3ff83cb.png[/img]
        
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/dd5741e15e0dc3e869a00ff28ab15cb484834593.png[/img]
        
Your Maple World neighbors have no idea what Halloween is really about, so it’s time to team up with Querencia and show them what it’s all about… and maybe give them a little scare! Get creative and decorate your own [b]Halloween Manor[/b] to really set the mood for the perfect fright night!
        
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/bda962df85ebef8626eba64c3ba8f8a38f542045.png[/img]
        
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/6b7a58a3e43149718f077966ba58ca49041d6ef4.png[/img]
        
Race to the finish line in the [b]Legion Relay[/b]! Earn daily quests and earn rewards to supercharge your Legion! There are three types of [b]Relay Box Rewards[/b] to choose from, all offering the same rewards but in different quantities. The higher the quantity of the reward, the lower the chance of obtaining it. Choose wisely!
        
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/ec7865206d0a34f56b22027e88188e6b6e6af864.png[/img]
        
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/61634b02d3bf72bda2712964818dae1f85af91c5.png[/img]
        
[url=https://forums.maplestory.nexon.net/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/5b7efe6419854daad63823c680d80e76091a8d03.png[/img][/url][url=https://discord.gg/maplestory][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0df2c6483407a66266204e2cf67b874116bbd546.png[/img][/url]
        
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/f7aa9d280900342f15f20b256e92041511f4da49.png[/img]

notes.title: v.252 Known Issues & Hotfixes - July 18, 2024
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/2198/maintenance-post-banner-in-post-banner-1100x225.jpg[/img]

Hi Maplers,

As part of our commitment to transparency, we are introducing a new section after each update to highlight the known issues our team is actively addressing. This section will focus on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.252 GO WEST! Update:

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list][*][b]Follow-up on Angelic Buster Skin Color Issue.[/b]
[list][*]During the maintenance on June 28th, we made a change where the skin color of Angelic Buster's Dress-Up mode would start off the same as Normal mode for newly created Angelic Buster characters. The intention was to unify their skin colors at character creation. However, this change introduced a bug where it appeared that the Dress-Up mode skin color could no longer be changed when using any kind of skin color coupon. This bug has now been fixed after the v252 update. We understand that prior to the fix, some players may have used various skin color coupons on Angelic Buster's Dress-Up mode, including the Rosy or Flushed Skin Color Coupon from the recent Midnight Party event. Therefore, we are planning to redistribute any skin color coupons that were used on Angelic Buster characters after the 6/28 maintenance and before the 7/17 maintenance. These will be distributed in a future maintenance.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Resolution for Durational Maple Boys Chair Issue[/b][list][*]We will be distributing the permanent version of the Maple Boys Chair to players who claimed the durational version during the [GO WEST!] Star Queue event. The permanent chairs will be distributed in a future maintenance. [/*][/list][/*][*][b]Xenon characters unable to claim the Thief version of the 15-star Arcane Umbra Weapon Set Box (Time Restricted).[/b][list][*]The issue where Xenon characters could not claim the thief weapon from the 15-star Arcane Umbra Weapon in the v.252 patch. We will be redistributing the Arcane Umbra Weapon Box to Xenon players that claimed, but did not use the box in a future maintenance. [/*][*]Those who redeemed the Pirate weapon and would like the Thief Weapon instead can contact Player Support for an exchange.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Kanna can equip a shield.[/b][list][*]An Issue where Kanna could equip shields in the weapon slot is being investigated[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Resolved Issues:[/b]
[list][*][b]July 19, 2024 (Hotfixes)[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where daily Eternal Stones from Pharaoh's Treasure would reset when entering the event again with a character that had not participated yet. [/*][/list][/*][*][b]July 18, 2024 (Hotfixes)[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where Mitra's 3x EXP box from GO WEST! - Star Queue Encore disappears upon usage.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
Thank you for your patience and continued support as we work to enhance your gaming experience!

notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2167/maintenance-1100x225-maplestory.png[/img]

[b][Update 7/17/2024 at 8:00 PM PDT][/b] The investigation has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop for 6 hours. The following issues have been resolved:
[list]
[*] Resolved issues where Lynn’s ‘Spirit Guide Unity: Paeon’ Paeon buffs were not being activated properly with ‘HEXA Sneak Attack’.
[*] Resolved issues where multiple channels were crashing.
[*] Resolved issues where Luna Petite Pets were revivable with the normal water of life.[b] [Updated 7/17/2024] [/b]We will be reverting the duration of the Luna Petite Pets in a future maintenance. 
[/list]
We thank you for your patience throughout this time! 

[b][Update 7/17/2024 at 6:45 PM PDT][/b] We are actively working on resolving this issue. We will notify you once everything has been confirmed to be fixed and completed. 

Hi Maplers,

We are aware of an ongoing issue with channels crashing. To resolve the issues for affected players, we'll be temporarily shutting the game down. The game servers will be inaccessible until further notice. We will make sure this is resolved as quickly as possible and will provide updates when we can.

Thank you for your patience and we apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused. We will be shutting the game down today, [b]July 17, 2024 at 2:45 PM PDT (5:45 PM EDT/ 11:45 PM CEST/ 7:45 AM AEST July 18). [/b]

Thank you for your cooperation,

The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Claim the Pharaoh's Treasure!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/8845b95960bd410dda48ca1996463eedfeac383b.jpg[/img]

[b][Update July 22][/b] The Pharaoh's Treasure can be entered up to 10 times per account, not per character as initially reported. We apologize for the error.

[b]Event Duration:[/b]
[list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, July 17, 2024 (After Maintenance) - Tuesday, August 27, 2024 4:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, July 17, 2024 (After Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 28, 2024 1:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, July 17, 2024 (After Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 28, 2024 9:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
The Maple Expedition is gearing up for another dungeon crawl, and the mysterious appearance of a pyramid in the middle of the Nihal Desert has sent them looking for the help of adventurers to uncover the secrets of the pyramid and claim the Pharaoh's Treasure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/918bd481a61bebe15b5c5e2e3e14a0ecb6c8f521.png[/img]

The magic of the pyramid has a strange effect on those that delve within. Regardless of the equipment you bring, or the skills you have mastered, none of it will help you once you venture inside. Instead, you will need to claim powers from inside the pyramid, and find special relics to help you battle against the increasingly powerful foes you'll encounter within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/ea2d2cdff95bb4720de90c833ae1a9beab1973d2.png[/img]

Battle your way through the roguelike dungeon and defeat the final boss of each chamber to claim EXP and a wealth of special rewards from your share of the [b]Pharaoh's Treasure[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/00360982992cdc752e8b3b5b49dc47f064656a9d.png[/img]

[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]A giant pyramid has appeared in Nihal Desert! Who is brave enough to explore it?[/*][*][b]Requirements[/b]: Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters must have completed Story Quest Act 2).[/*][*]Accept the ‘[Urgent] Maple Expedition Exploration Request’ quest through the new Pharaoh’s Treasure notifier on the left side of the screen.[list][*]You can enter the Pharaoh’s Treasure event map through the notifier at any time.[/*][/list][/*][*]Play through the tutorial quest and story scenarios. After completing them, you can proceed by speaking with Pollion to select the entry chapter.[list][*]Tutorial and story progress is shared by account.[/*][/list][/*][*]There are 5 chapters total and 20 stages per chapter. If you forfeit or die, you will automatically exit the dungeon.[/*][*]You can enter up to [b]10 times per day per account[/b].[/*][*]There are 5 playable characters by class that are automatically selected based on the class you’re playing as: Warrior, Magician, Bowman, Thief, and Pirate.[list][*]All classes start with a basic attack skill and have a max number of 4 skills total.[/*][*]Each basic skill has a max level of 3.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can [b]enhance your character[/b] every time you clear a stage.[list][*]The rewards you can obtain from each stage are random.[/*][*]You can select from skills, stats, Relics, or Pyramid Coins to use in the shop.[/*][*]Once you exit the dungeon, all obtained character enhancement rewards are reset and you will start over from stage 1.[/*][/list][/*][*]Equip [b]Relics[/b] that can be obtained throughout the dungeon through completing stages. Relics provide stats increase or special effects that are activated upon equipping.[list][*]Relics are graded as Low, Intermediate, and High. [list][*][b]Low Relics[/b] appear regularly by defeating enemies or from Relic Altars (appears after clearing a stage).[/*][*][b]Intermediate Relics[/b] are obtained by combining Relics, a low chance from Relic Altars, or obtained from the shop.[/*][*][b]High Relics [/b]are only obtainable by combining Relics.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can combine 2 Relics to create a new Relic. You can get a special Relic by combining two specific Relics. The chance to receive a certain rank Relic are as follows: [table][tr][th]Type[/th][th]Advanced[/th][th]Intermediate[/th][th]Basic[/th][/tr][tr][th]Combine Basic + Basic[/th][td]0%[/td][td]70%[/td][td]30%[/td][/tr][tr][th]Combine Basic + Intermediate[/th][td]10%[/td][td]65%[/td][td]25%[/td][/tr][tr][th]Combine Basic + Advanced[/th][td]30%[/td][td]70%[/td][td]0%[/td][/tr][tr][th]Combine Intermediate + Intermediate[/th][td]50%[/td][td]50%[/td][td]0%[/td][/tr][tr][th]Combine Intermediate + Advanced[/th][td]60%[/td][td]40%[/td][td]0%[/td][/tr][tr][th]Combine Advanced + Advanced[/th][td]80%[/td][td]20%[/td][td]0%[/td][/tr][tr][th]Special Combination[/th][td]-[/td][td]-[/td][td]-[/td][/tr][/table][/*][/list][/*][*]You can permanently enhance your character through [b]Eternal Force[/b] and start the game in an even stronger state.[list][*]Consume [b]Eternal Stones[/b] that are obtained by playing the game and use them to enhance Trait Skills.[/*][*]Enhanced stats will be applied upon starting the dungeon.[/*][*]Eternal Stones obtained during the game are not reset.[/*][/list][/*][*]If you clear all chapters, you can attempt [b]Challenge Mode[/b]. In Challenge Mode, you play through Chapters 1-5 consecutively. There are 40 stages total and each chapter boss appears every 8 stages.[list][*]You can obtain rewards by completing quests and achievements.[/*][/list][/*][*]There are 7 types of stages:[list][*][b]Normal Stage[/b][list][*]Normal enemies appear consecutively.[/*][*]Clear by defeating all enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Elite Stage[/b][list][*]Elite Monster appears.[/*][*]When the Elite Monster is alive, normal enemies are summoned consecutively.[/*][*]Clear by defeating all enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Survival Stage[/b][list][*]A large number of enemies would appear at a set time and are continuously summoned regardless of if they've been defeated.[/*][*]If you survive a certain amount of time, all enemies are removed and the stage is cleared.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Bonus Stage[/b][list][*]Use the exclusive portal to enter the Bonus Stage to enter.[/*][*]Summons a large number of Powerful Enemies compared to a normal stage.[/*][*]Clear by defeating all enemies and obtain double rewards[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Goal Destruction Stage[/b][list][*]A large number of enemies are continuously summoned. Cleared when the Elite Monster is defeated and all enemies are removed.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Boss Stage[/b] 
[list][*]Clear by defeating all enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Non-Battle Stage[/b][list][*]Preparation Stage, Shop, HP Recovery, etc.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Game Elements[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/bb103d6e0b0518ff17f605ac83ebbc07898c48f4.png[/img][/*][/list][olist][*][b]Timer[/b]: Displayers Chapter/Stage information[/*][*][b]Character Status Window[/b]: Displays Stats and Owned/Equipped Relics in the exclusive Inventory.[/*][*][b]Skill Slot[/b]: Owned Skills information.[/*][*][b]Enemy[/b]: Defeat to clear the stage.[/*][*][b]Trap[/b]: Placed through all stages and damage taken when hit.[/*][*][b]Interaction Object[/b]: Interactive objects within stages.[list][*]Reward Altar: Obtains Character Enhancement Reward upon clicking[/*][*]Portal: Moves to the next stage[/*][*]Misc: Restore HP, purchase items, obtain buffs, etc.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Exit Button[/b].[/*][/olist]

notes.title: Minimum System Requirements Update in Early October
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/hrdn1yrd/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg[/img]

Attention Maplers,

In order to maintain the security and stability of MapleStory, we will be updating the Minimum System Requirements for MapleStory in an update scheduled for early October. Starting from that update, MapleStory will no longer be supporting operating systems below Windows 10. If you are using Windows 8.1 or below, you will be able to resume normal play after upgrading to Windows 10 or higher. For more information on upgrading Windows, please visit the [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/windows?r=1]Microsoft website[/url].

Thank you for your cooperation,

The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Investigation of Night Fragments
notes.content:
[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2098/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg[/img][/u]

Hi Maplers,

Thank you for your patience as we discussed next steps for the issue of players obtaining Night Fragments abnormally. We've concluded the investigation and have moved forward with the following:
[list][*]Night Fragments obtained abnormally by repeatedly claiming the weekly reward have been removed.[/*][*]Accounts that claimed and used an excess amount of Fragments have been issued a 7-day suspension.[/*][/list]
We considered multiple factors in determining the threshold at which players would be affected by our decision. Most importantly, we didn't want players who may have claimed extra Night Fragments mistakenly to be affected by an issue on our end. After evaluating the situation, we determined some accounts gained Night Fragments in significant enough quantities to warrant a temporary suspension from the game.

Even if it’s for simple curiosity, the act of using a system error will be considered abnormal gameplay and we would advise Maplers to not use these when they occur. Please report it through our Player Support Center and wait until more information has been announced.

Thank you for your cooperation,
The MapleStory Team

Fresh with an updated voiceover and skill sound effects, Angelic Buster is ready to sing!

notes.title: Tera Blink and Burning World Event
notes.content:
[img]https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/upjfch1u/1100x225-tera-blink-and-burning-world-maplestory.png[/img]

It's time to GO WEST with a new phase added to the classic Burning series of events! [b]Tera Blink[/b] is joining in this time, giving you a quick race up the levels as Spiegelmann runs down the basics of MapleStory, and with the returning [b]Hyper Burning[/b] you'll be hitting the Arcane River in no time. [b]Burning World[/b] is also returning for the summer to make the levels climb even faster! Make a new character to race up to Lv. 260, gain new rewards with the [b]Burning World Step Up Event[/b], and keep advancing your characters through Burning World before heading to another world in August's [b]Burning World Leap[/b]!
[h3][b]Hyper Burning[/b][/h3][list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, June 12, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, August 27, 2024 4:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CEST (UTC +2): Thursday, June 13, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 28, 2024 1:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEST (UTC +10): Thursday, June 13, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 28, 2024 9:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
[i]Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.[/i]

Create a brand-new character during the extra-long event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in all worlds, as well as Burning World, [b]except for Zero characters[/b].

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional [b]two levels[/b] all the way up to Lv. 260! You also have the option to designate one of your existing Lv. 200-258 characters as 'Hyper Burning' instead, allowing them to gain that benefit!

In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including [b]Root Abyss and Fafnir gear[/b]! When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training! You will receive additional rewards on your ‘Hyper Burning’ character at Lv. 200, Lv. 210, and every 5 levels after Lv. 210, up to Lv. 260!

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5786/newteraeffect.png[/img]

[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]Reach level 260 fast on a new or existing character with the Hyper Burning event![/*][*][b]Requirements:[/b] Either:[list][*]A newly created character made during the event period (Zero characters cannot participate in this manner.)[/*][*]A Lv. 200 - 258 character (Zero characters must be both within that range and have completed Story Quest Act 2)[/*][/list][/*][*]After creating a new character, you will be given an option to give it a ‘Hyper Burning’ effect.[/*][*]You [b]cannot[/b] go back to give it a ‘Burning’ effect after refusing to do so during character creation.[/*][*]You can only 'Hyper Burn' 1 character per account during the event.[/*][*]After your ‘Hyper Burning’ character reaches Lv. 10, they will start to earn two additional levels each time your character gains a level up to Lv. 260.[/*][*]You will receive special Hyper Burning Rewards when your ‘Burning’ character meets the listed level milestones.[/*][*]Alternatively, you may elect to set one of your existing Lv. 200 - 258 characters as 'Hyper Burning', by selecting it on character select screen and clicking on 'Set as Hyper Burning'.[list][*]Doing so will prevent you from designating a newly-created character as 'Hyper Burning'.[/*][*]You will still be able to create 'Mega Burning' characters on Burning World.[/*][/list][/*][*]There’s more rewards waiting for you past Lv. 200! Once your ‘Burning’ character reaches Lv. 200 (or you designate an existing character as Burning), you can obtain [b]Bonus Rewards[/b] up until Lv. 260. You'll also get even better rewards for playing on Burning World![/*][/list]
[b]Rewards:[/b]

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q2/1725/tera-burning-reward-boxes-maplestory.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Lv. 1: Mysterious Cryptic Chest:[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration. Open to receive:[list][*][b]Snail Pet:[/b] 30-day duration.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Lv. 30: Lv. 30 Equipment Box:[/b] Untradeable, box expires on [b]August 27[/b] at [b]1[/b][b][b]1:59 P[/b]M UTC[/b]. Can be opened at Lv. 30. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7, Defense +180, Speed +9, Jump +5. Upgrades available: 7.[/*][*][b]Frozen Suit:[/b] Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. [img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/1134/world-leap-screen.png[/img]

As the saying goes, the light that burns twice as bright burns half as long, and the Burning World will burn very brightly indeed. However, while this new world will be consumed at the end of it all, a new life awaits your characters in the other worlds of MapleStory!

Lv. 150+ characters in Burning World will be allowed to leap to another world of your choosing during the World Leap period, taking their equipped items, inventory, and mesos with them to join their new communities. When this period begins, all Burning World characters will be moved to the Burning Leap Zone map, where they will be able to speak to the NPC Mover to complete their exodus.
[list][*]Characters in Burning World must be at least Lv. 150 in order to World Leap, whether they were Mega Burning characters or not.[list][*]Zero characters must be both Lv. 150+ and having completed Story Quest Act 2.[/*][*]It will not be possible to leave the Burning Leap Zone map during this period, making it impossible to gain any more EXP.
