Combined with the Burning EXP bonus and boosted damage, you'll be able to power your way through those levels faster than ever before!
Additionally, even after your Mega Burning characters have been created, you'll be able to create another two characters to level up and leap, which will still benefit from the Burning skill!
Please note that, the default number of Character Slots on Burning World is six, and Character Slot Expansion Coupons cannot be used in Burning World.
You can move up to 5 characters that meet the requirements.

Additionally, Zero characters cannot be selected as a "Burning" character on character creation, but can be selected as your Hyper Burning character upon reaching Lv. 200 and completing Story Act Quest 2.
As Burning World is a temporary world to be removed at the end of the World Leap stage, some MapleStory features will be unavailable there:
Upon creating a Mega Burning character in Burning World (rewards can be received up to 3 times per world):
Slot Expansion: Equip, Use, Set-Up and Etc inventories expanded to 56 slots.
Granted via a quest available on logging in with a Burning character.
The Burning World Step Up event is here to enhance your leveling experience in Burning World even further!
Complete missions available to your Burning World character’s level and step-up while receiving special rewards!
Accept the "New! Burning World Step Up!" quest within the star event notifier on the left side of the screen.
Once you click the Burning World Step Up icon within the star event on the left side of your screen, you will have access to the Step Up UI.
When you reach the specified level milestone, remember to click ‘Start Mission!’ button to start the mission.
When you complete the mission, click ‘Claim Reward!’ button to receive the reward and move on to the next mission.
Burning World Step Up event can be completed by any characters in Burning World, regardless of having the ‘Burning’ effect or not.
Burning World Step Up event progress is shared with all your characters in Burning World.
There are certain missions that Zero characters cannot complete.
However, you are able to complete the mission on a different character and claim the reward on the Zero character.
Burning World Step Up event rewards can be obtained once per world.
As the saying goes, the light that burns twice as bright burns half as long, and the Burning World will burn very brightly indeed.
However, while this new world will be consumed at the end of it all, a new life awaits your characters in the other worlds of MapleStory!

Lv. 150+ characters in Burning World will be allowed to leap to another world of your choosing during the World Leap period, taking their equipped items, inventory, and mesos with them to join their new communities.
When this period begins, all Burning World characters will be moved to the Burning Leap Zone map, where they will be able to speak to the NPC Mover to complete their exodus.
Characters in Burning World must be at least Lv. 150 in order to World Leap, whether they were Mega Burning characters or not.
It will not be possible to leave the Burning Leap Zone map during this period, making it impossible to gain any more EXP.
Make sure you're Lv. 150 before the August 28 maintenance!

You do not need an empty character slot on the destination world for your new character (you will be granted a free Character Slot if you are at your unlocked limit on that world), however if you have reached the maximum character limit on that world, you will need to delete a character in order to make room for them.
Characters can be transferred to Interactive Worlds only.
Characters in Guilds will not be able to World Leap until they have either left or disbanded their Guild.
Your character's equipped items, inventory, and mesos will be transferred with your character, but items within your Storage, Cash Shop Inventory, mail, and auction house will not be.
Make sure you clear everything out before taking the big leap!
You may send your Burning World characters all to the same world, or to different worlds.
Medals obtained from regularly-resetting rankings will not be transferred, and your rankings in those pieces of content will also not be transferred.

[h2][b]Beast Tamer to Lynn Transfer[/b][/h2]
All Beast Tamer characters have had their Job changed to Lynn (Beginner) during the v.250 update.
[list][*]Upon logging in a previous Beast Tamer character, you will be moved to the Spring of the Past map.[/*][*]You will then be able to start the '[Lynn] Call of the Forest' quest by talking to Maple Admin to learn about the changes between the two Jobs.[/*][*]The following will be passed down from your Beast Tamer to Lynn without any changes:[list][*]Stats[/*][*]Level and Experience[/*][*]Arcane and Sacred Symbol Enhancement Stats[/*][*]Abilities[/*][*]Quest History[/*][*]Equipped items (Items that don't fit the Job restrictions will be marked with red.)[/*][*]Items in Inventory[/*][/list][/*][*]Beast Tamers that have completed the 5th Job advancement will be able to complete a simplified version after becoming a Lynn.[/*][*]All Nodes owned by Beast Tamers will be disassembled into [b]Node Shards[/b] and distributed at the following rates:
[list][*][b]Skill Nodes:[/b] 140 Node Shards per 50 EXP[/*][*][b]Boost Nodes:[/b] 70 Node Shards per 50 EXP[/*][*][b]Special Nodes:[/b] 250 Node Shards per 50 EXP[/*][*]The following Nodes are exceptions and will not be disassembled:
[list][*]True Arachnid Reflection[/*][*]Solar Crest[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Refunds will be sent out for remaining Beast Tamer Animal SP Reset Scrolls.
[list][*]1,000 Maple Points per scroll will be issued to Interactive World players and 10,000,000 mesos per scroll will be issued to Heroic World players.[/*][*]Please make sure to claim your SP Reset Scroll refund from the Gift Drop before [b]August 28, 2024 at 11:00 AM UTC[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]Beast Tamer Transparent Ears will be converted to Transparent Hat and Beast Tamer Transparent Tail will be converted to Transparent Cape.[/*][*]After completing the ‘[Lynn] Call of the Forest’ quest, you’ll be able to receive the following rewards:[/*][/list]
[b]Rewards:[/b]
[list][*][b]Drawing of Memories:[/b] Untradeable, permanent.[/*][*][b]Cute Ear Accessory:[/b] Untradeable, permanent.[/*][*][b]Cute Tail Accessory:[/b] Untradeable, permanent.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1471/cute-earrings-tail.jpg[/img][/*][/list]

[h2][b]Lynn Details[/b][/h2]
Growing up near the forest, Lynn felt watched over throughout her childhood. When she finally meets the friendly bear, Pan, Lynn learns of her destiny as the reincarnated Forest Child. Together Pan and Lynn begin a journey to awaken the master of the forest and ensure its protection. They are joined by two more critters: Penni the bird and Paeon the wolf.

Forest Child Lynn uses the power of the forest to help Maplers defeat their enemies! As a Magician, Lynn uses INT as her main stat. Her primary weapon is the Memorial Staff and her secondary weapon is a Leaf. Each of Lynn's animalistic Spirit Guides has their own skill set to aid her in battle. Lynn also possesses supporting skills to bolster her allies.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1316/lynn-spirit-guides.png[/img]

[b]Check out a few of Lynn's powerful skills[/b]:
[list][*][b]Peck[/b]: Penni flies about and automatically attacks enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. Available at 2nd Job Advancement. Max Level: 20.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1318/lynn-skill-peck.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Sneak Attack[/b]: Paeon hides in the darkness, then pounces to follow up the skills of the other Spirit Guides. Unaffected by attack reflection. Available at 3rd Job Advancement. Max Level: 20.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1321/lynn-skill-sneak-attack.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Roar[/b]: Pan lets out a mighty roar, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies. Available at 4th Job Advancement. Max Level: 20.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1322/lynn-skill-roar-1-complete.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Mother Nature's Touch[/b]: Shares the lifeforce of Mother Nature with all allies to provide healing effects. Restores HP, removes harmful effects, and grants continuous healing for a set time. Available at 4th Job Advancement. Max Level: 10.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1317/lynn-skill-mother-natures-touch.png[/img]

See the full skill list for Lynn [url=https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/all/17123#LynnSkills]here[/url]![u]
[/u]

notes.title: Maple Memo: GMS Roadmap Q2 2024
notes.content:
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5580/181107mm1100ip.jpg[/img]

Hi Maplers,

We apologize for the delay in the Q2 2024 roadmap and appreciate your patience. We will do our best to make sure future notices are published at the expected time.

As always, please be mindful that it will list the notable updates but not everything that will be included in each patch. We recommend waiting for the respective update’s Patch Notes post for details.

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1497/240325-wgc-859-ms-timeline-roadmap.png[/img][/u][u][/u]
[list][*][u]v.250 Update (early May) [/u][/*][list][*][u]Happy 19th Anniversary, MapleStory![/u][/*][*][u]New Job: Forest Child Lynn[/u][/*][*][u]Mayple Island[/u][/*][/list][*][u]v.251 Update (mid-June)[/u][/*][list][*][u]Angelic Buster Remaster[/u][/*][*][u]Legion Artifact[/u][/*][*][u]Epic Dungeon: High Mountain[/u][/*][*][u]Dreaming Lachelein[/u][/*][*][u]Midnight Party[/u][/*][*][u]Hyper Burning & Tera Blink[/u][/*][*][u]QoL Improvements[/u][/*][*][u]Special Event[/u][/*][/list][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1498/240416-wgc-859-ms-timeline-roadmap-post-v4.png[/img]

[b]v.250 - Happy 19th Anniversary, MapleStory![/b]

The 19th anniversary of Global MapleStory is coming up on May 11th! It’s crazy to think that we’ve been on this adventure with you all for 19 years. To celebrate, we’ve prepared special events as a thank you for being part of this community so be on the lookout for some sneak peeks!

[b]v.250 - New Job: Forest Child Lynn[/b]

The arrival of Forest Child Lynn is finally here! Lynn is a magician that uses a Memorial Staff weapon and the power of the forest to summon Spirit Guides to help her defeat her enemies. While she can do strong damage with her Spirit Guide skills, she also has a variety of healing skills and buffs to help her party, so she will be very helpful as a support. (Also since players have been asking, yes, she will be released on the day of the v.250 update!)

We know many of you are curious about the conversion details from Beast Tamer to Lynn. Please wait until the patch notes have been released as it states all the information related to this topic.

[b]v.250 - Mayple Island[/b]

Welcome to Mayple Island! Yes, we named it [/u]May[u]ple because it’s occurring in May! Mayple Island is a place that was created from the sparkling memories of Maplers. Meet those from your memories and receive abundant gifts by filling the Wish Orb that contains the dreams and hopes of people. The more you fill the Wish Orb, the better the rewards you’ll receive! Plus, there will be fun mini-games, photo booths, popularity contests, and other unique experiences throughout the event, including a museum exhibit where you can win OG Maple items. Don’t miss out and experience them all!

[b]v.251 - Angelic Buster Remaster[/b]

Our queen of music, Angelic Buster, has blessed us with her return! In addition to her new look that is cuter and lovelier than ever, check out the newly changed skills. She’s also releasing her first mini album for you loyal fans, so we better see Angelic Buster as one of your top listened to artists in your 2024 Wrapped!

[b]v.251 - Legion Artifact[/b]

After Monster Life ends, a new growth system called ‘Legion Artifact' will be included. Through various gameplay, players can naturally complete the missions and get time-limited stats that can be applied to all characters, introducing a new integrated character growth system.

[b]v.251 - Epic Dungeon: High Mountain[/b]

Introducing MapleStory's first epic dungeon for characters level 260 and above! Dive into the story of the awakened sun god Mitra who has returned to the High Mountain after a long slumber. Defeat numerous enemies and get plenty of EXP and rewards.

[b]v.251 - Dreaming Lachelein[/b]

We invite you to Lucid’s happy dream! Aren’t you curious about Lucid’s dreamy festival that isn’t a nightmare but something everyone can enjoy? Not only can you get LOADS of EXP, but there is a special reward shop, and content and mini-games for rapid leveling waiting for you. Explore all the exciting and special events that Lucid has prepared!

[b]v.251 - Midnight Party[/b]

Welcome to the Midnight Party! It’s not a real party without goodies, so participate in the daily and weekly parties by defeating monsters to earn unique rewards, such as custom Lachelein outfits and backgrounds. After you’re done partying, you can earn your very own Lucidroid to accompany you on all your future endeavors.

[b]v.251 - Hyper Burning & Tera Blink[/b]

Spiegelmann prepared a special map this time for Hyper Burning called Tera Blink! If you’re designated as a Hyper Burning character, you’ll be 200 with a blink of an eye in Spiegelmann’s ‘World Inside the Hat.’ Helpful rewards will be given every time you complete missions to help you progress even faster. So if you haven’t leveled your Legion yet, take this chance!

[b]v.251 - QoL Improvements[/b]
[list][*][u]Character Presets[/u][/*][list][*][u]Equipment presets have been added.[/u][/*][*][u]Ability presets have been added.[/u][/*][*][u]The cost to change Hyper Stat presets has been removed.[/u][/*][*][u]The default Legion Preset slots are now all permanent and will be increased to 5.[/u][/*][/list][*][u]Boss UI[/u][/*][list][*][u]You can now view Character Info in the Party Recruitment tab.[/u][/*][*][u]An exclusive UI for accessing bosses has been added.[/u][/*][*][u]You can now set Combat Power as a condition in the Party Recruitment tab.[/u][/*][*][u]Monster Park Extreme has been added to the Boss UI.[/u][/*][/list][*][u]Boss Entry Limits[/u][/*][list][*][u]The entry limit for all weekly and monthly bosses has been removed.[/u][/*][*][u]The daily limit for Balrog has been removed.[/u][/*][*][u]The quest requirements to unlock Lotus and Damien have been removed as long as you meet the level requirement.[/u][/*][*][u]A Practice Mode exclusive buff has been added, allowing you to apply buffs without actually consuming them for skills or items and without any restrictions.[/u][/*][/list][*][u]V Matrix Improvements[/u][/*][list][*][u]You can now open multiple Nodestones at once.[/u][/*][*][u]You can now easily enhance all of your equipped Nodes by clicking the new ‘Enhance All’ button.[/u][/*][/list][/list]
[b]v.251 - Special Event[/b]

Inkwell and Dr. Lim are preparing a special event for all of you. Please stay tuned for more details!

We hope you’re excited by this high-level view of the content and events arriving to GMS in v.250 - v.251 2024. 

As always, our goal with these roadmaps is to provide information that players may be curious about and assist players with advanced preparation. Please keep in mind that there is more content on the way in addition to those listed above, so we advise players to refer to the Update Preview post and Patch Notes post for the finalized details for every game update.

Thank you,

Mjollnir and the MapleStory Team

notes.title: v.250 - Mayple Island Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1248/header.png[/img]

[b]Happy 19th anniversary, MapleStory[/b]![u] Explore the numerous events, mini-games, and shops filled with one-of-a-kind goodies at [/u][b]Mayple Island[/b][u]. Experience the adorable new class, [/u][b]Forest Child Lynn[/b][u], and her versatile kit that will be influential in any party environment. Play through the newly revamped [/u][b][Hieizan] Theme Dungeon[/b][u] with quality of life and balance improvements. Organize your outfits and decorate all your characters with the return of the [/u][b]Cash Shop Transfer[/b][u] event. Create a [/u][b]Zero[/b] [u]character at any time of the year now that [/u][b]Zero[/b] [u]creation is no longer limited to specific seasons![/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1250/mayple-island.png[/img]

[u]The fairies of [/u][b]Mayple Island[/b][u] have prepared so many events for you in celebration of the 19th anniversary of Global MapleStory! Participating in challenges every day will fill up the [/u][b]Mayple Wish Orb[/b][u] with wishes which will reward you with items, such as Growth Potions and 3x EXP Coupons. There will be three currencies you can use to redeem for items, [/u][b]Mayple Leaves[/b][u], [/u][b]Mayple Candies[/b][u], and [/u][b]Mayple Stars[/b][u] that you can earn from participating in daily events and mini-games. Additionally, the Mayple Island event map has numerous interactive areas where you can take pictures with your friends, so try sitting on various parts of the island (our favorite is the [/u][b]Merry-Go-Round[/b][u]). We can’t wait for you to enjoy the beautiful Mayple Island![/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1249/mayple-island-ss.png[/img]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1246/child-of-the-forest-lynn.png[/img]

[b]Forest Child Lynn[/b][u] is our newest class who uses the power of the forest to help Maplers defeat their enemies! Her Spirit Guides, [/u][b]Pan[/b][u], [/u][b]Penni[/b][u], and [/u][b]Paeon[/b] [u]provide her with extra damage and each have special skills that can be helpful in any situation. Lynn has a few mobility skills including ‘[/u][b]Light Leap[/b][u]’ (flash jump) and ‘[b][Focus][/b] [/u][b]Support Flight[/b][u]’ which instantly transports herself to a target and vice versa. Additionally, her kit is quite versatile containing multiple healing skills and even having a skill that increases item drop rate for herself! Lynn will always be available for creation but we will have special durational rewards at launch, so we highly recommend creating her upon release![/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1247/forest-child-lynn-ss.png[/img]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1240/hieizan-theme-dungeon-revamp.png[/img]

[u]We’ve revamped the [/u][b][Hieizan] Theme Dungeon[/b][u] so farming ‘[/u][b]Kanna’s Treasure[/b][u]’ every week will be more efficient! First and foremost, you will no longer teleport when attacking [b]Mikagami[/b], but rather only when you are attacked. In addition, the number of hits required to defeat [b]Mikagami[/b] has been decreased. We’ve also made adjustments to the skills of [/u][b]Oura Shogun[/b][u], [/u][b]Miroku[/b][u], and [/u][b]Princess No[/b][u] to improve the overall balance of the dungeon.[/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1239/hieizan-theme-dungeon-revamp-ss.png[/img]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1245/cash-shop-transfer.png[/img]

[u]The [/u][b]Cash Shop Transfer[/b] [u]event has returned! For one week, you’ll be able to transfer Cash Shop items from a character to any other character of your choice within the same world. If you’re transferring to the same class, you’ll transfer through the Cash Inventory as usual without using the special new Cash Transfer button.[/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1244/cash-shop-transfer-ss.png[/img]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1252/zero-creation.png[/img]

[u]Currently, [/u][b]Zero[/b] [u]can only be created during specific seasons but starting from the v.250 update, Zero will be available for creation [/u][b]at all times[/b][u]! Please note that in order to create a Zero, you must already have an existing Lv. 100 character.[/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1251/zero-creation-ss.png[/img]

tags.feature: Explore the numerous events, mini-games, and shops filled with one-of-a-kind goodies at Mayple Island. Experience the adorable new class, Forest Child Lynn, and her versatile kit that will be influential in any party environment. Play through the newly revamped [Hieizan] Theme Dungeon with quality of life and balance improvements. Organize your outfits and decorate all your characters with the return of the Cash Shop Transfer event. Create a Zero character at any time of the year now that Zero creation is no longer limited to specific seasons!

Forest Child Lynn is our newest class who uses the power of the forest to help Maplers defeat their enemies! Her Spirit Guides, Pan, Penni, and Paeon provide her with extra damage and each have special skills that can be helpful in any situation. Lynn has a few mobility skills including ‘Light Leap’ (flash jump) and ‘Focus Support Flight’ which instantly transports herself to a target and vice versa. Additionally, her kit is quite versatile containing multiple healing skills and even having a skill that increases item drop rate for herself! Lynn will always be available for creation but we will have special durational rewards at launch, so we highly recommend creating her upon release!

tags.balance_change: We’ve revamped the [Hieizan] Theme Dungeon so farming ‘Kanna’s Treasure’ every week will be more efficient! First and foremost, you will no longer teleport when attacking Mikagami, but rather only when you are attacked. In addition, the number of hits required to defeat Mikagami has been decreased. We’ve also made adjustments to the skills of Oura Shogun, Miroku, and Princess No to improve the overall balance of the dungeon.

tags.feature: The Cash Shop Transfer event has returned! For one week, you’ll be able to transfer Cash Shop items from a character to any other character of your choice within the same world. If you’re transferring to the same class, you’ll transfer through the Cash Inventory as usual without using the special new Cash Transfer button.

Currently, Zero can only be created during specific seasons but starting from the v.250 update, Zero will be available for creation at all times! Please note that in order to create a Zero, you must already have an existing Lv. 100 character.

notes.title: Maple Memo: Font Change Update
notes.content:
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5580/181107mm1100ip.jpg[/img]

Hi Maplers,

After the v.249 update, you may have seen that the in-game font for multiple menus and titles was adjusted. We'd like to inform you that the font will be reverted back to the original style in the v.250 update and share with you why these changes were made.

While testing the new Character Info UI, we were finding that certain text and letters were not being properly aligned. To address the issue, the original font was modified to increase legibility which impacted all UI elements. We will be reverting this and only applying the legibility changes to the Character Info UI.
Additionally, specific letters such as "w", "v", "t" and "f" can be hard to distinguish when they are typed next to each other. Therefore, we applied a change that added more spacing between these characters. This change will also be reverted to the original spacing. 

Although we are reverting the font back to the original style, we will continue to focus on improving our players' day-to-day gameplay experience. As always, your feedback is immensely important to us and we appreciate your support.

Thank you,

Mjollnir

notes.title: v.249 - Minar Picnic Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2418/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_01.png[/img]

[u]Accept [/u][b]Chief Tatamo[/b][u][b]’s[/b] invitation to join a picnic with the [/u][b]Halflingers[/b] [u]in [/u][b]Minar Forest[/b][u]. Brush up on your MapleStory lore with two new sections added to the [/u][b]Grand Athenaeum[/b][u]. Improve your [/u][b]Crafting[/b][u], [/u][b]Smithing[/b][u], and [/u][b]Alchemy[/b] [u]skills with the [/u][b]Profession[/b] [u]revamp. Evaluate your  progress and personalize your avatar area with the [/u][b]Character UI[/b] [u]revamp. Upgrade your monster farm and show them more love with improvements to [/u][b]Monster Life[/b][u]. Last but certainly not least, check out the [/u][b]Better Maple[/b] [u]improvements![/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2414/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_02.png[/img]

[u]Did you pack your picnic mat and snacks? [/u][b]Chief Tatamo[/b][u] is inviting you to the [/u][b]Minar Picnic[/b][u] where you can join the [/u][b]Halflingers[/b] [u]for some wholesome fun! But you’ll need to fight off the monsters who are attempting to ruin your picnic and defend your new friends. To thank you for fighting them off, [/u][b]Chino[/b] [u]will reward you with an abundance of gifts, such as a [/u][b]Minar Picnic Box[/b][u] and [/u][b]Magnificent Growth Potion[/b][u]![/u]

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2409/minar-picnic-sc-1.png[/img][/u]

[u]To thank you for defending them, the [/u][b]Halflingers[/b][u] would like to reward you with a treasure hunt!  Assemble special lunches for the [/u][b]Halflingers[/b] [u]and send them out to various locations where they’ll bring back goodies to help you progress. These [/u][b]Halflingers[/b] [u]have prepared so many events for you so be sure to treat them well![/u]

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2410/minar-picnic-1-sc2.png[/img][/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2401/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_04.png[/img]

[u]Take a break from grinding and visit the [/u][b]Grand Athenaeum[/b][u] to read about the history of MapleStory! Learn about the riveting backstory of [/u][b]Carcion, the Cradle of Life[/b][u] which has been added to the [b]Book of Grandis[/b] and experience the art that is [/u][b]Grand Athenaeum Episode 7: Sefirot’s Gardener[/b][u].[/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2411/grand-athenaeum-sc.png[/img]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2402/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_06.png[/img]

[u]It’s harvesting season! The [/u][b]Profession[/b] [u]revamp will allow you to craft and farm faster than ever before. The crafting cooldown time has been removed for all items! You can now learn [/u][b]Accessory Crafting[/b][u], [/u][b]Smithing[/b][u], and [/u][b]Alchemy[/b] [u]at the same time in Interactive Worlds. [/u][b]Ardentmill’s[/b][u] harvesting maps are now instanced so you no longer need to be changing channels constantly to collect the items you need. We’ve also increased the maximum [/u][b]Fatigue[/b] [u]which will allow players to harvest for double the amount of time than before. Additionally, [/u][b]Accessory Crafting[/b][u], [/u][b]Equipment Crafting[/b][u], and [/u][b]Alchemy’s[/b] [u]mastery will no longer decrease! [/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2388/alchemy-ui.png[/img]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2403/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_09.png[/img]

[u]Want to know how you’re progressing? The [/u][b]Character UI[/b][u] is reorganized to better display information so it’s easier to see your performance. We’re adding new information, such as [/u][b]Combat Power[/b][u], [/u][b]Normal Enemy Damage[/b][u], and [/u][b]Cooldown Reduction[/b][u], so you have a better idea of how you’ll measure up in different areas. You’ll also be able to see more information about other players, such as their [/u][b]Arcane Symbols[/b][u], applied [/u][b]Link Skills[/b][u], and [/u][b]Hexa Matrix[/b][u]. Better get on those dailies…[/u] 

[u]Also, we know how much you love customization so we are adding backgrounds to your character’s avatar area. Now you can show off your outfit with a little more pizazz. Another element added for your fashionstory![/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2390/character-ui-sc.png[/img]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2404/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_11.png[/img]

[b]Monster Life[/b][u] will be improved so you can take better care of your farm! We’re increasing the chance of receiving a [/u][b]Special Category monster[/b] [u]when combining monsters. The maximum storage capacity of buildings will be increased by 400% so you can store 4x as much [/u][b]Waru[/b] [u]than before and auto-collect all the [/u][b]Waru[/b] [u]from all the buildings at once! You can then use that [/u][b]Waru[/b] [u]to extend the lifespan of certain ranked monsters. With these improvements, your monsters will be much happier than before![/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2415/monster-life-sc-1.png[/img]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2405/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_13.png[/img]

[u]What better way to improve your daily gameplay than with quality of life updates? [/u][u]Since you’re always grinding for [/u][b]Sol Erda Energy[/b][u] and [/u][b]Sol Erda Fragments[/b][u], you can now assign the [/u][b]Sol Erda UI[/b][u] to a shortcut so it can be more easily accessed. If you have the [/u][b]Sol Erda UI[/b][u] activated, it will be active even after logging off! Now the moment you’ve been waiting for…certain consumables, such as [/u][b]Power Elixirs[/b][u] and [/u][b]Mystical Cubes[/b][u], are now stackable up to x9999 per inventory slot they occupy! Hurray to inventory management![/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2413/better-maple-1.png[/img]
[table][tr][td][url=https://forums.maplestory.nexon.net][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2394/forum-btn-rest.png[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://discord.gg/maplestory][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2392/discord-btn-resst.png[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2417/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_15.png[/img]

notes.title: v.248 - Strawberry Farm Festival Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1325/top-front.png[/img]
Assist [b]Spiegelette[/b] with her [b]Strawberry Farm[/b] and receive cute strawberry-themed items. Explore the newly designed server selection screen and world groups: [b]Interactive[/b], [b]Heroic[/b], and [b]Seasonal[/b]. Help [b]Gold Richie[/b] unlock his safe with a secret code to win unique goodies. Transfer your highly trained [b]Burning[/b] characters into your desired world with [b]Burning World Leap[/b]. Last but not least…don’t forget about the exciting new collaboration with special items you won’t want to miss!

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1331/spiegelettes-strawberry-farm.png[/img]

Help [b]Spiegelette[/b] with her [b]Strawberry Farm[/b]! For those of you under Lv. 260, defeat monsters to obtain [b]Fertile Soil[/b] in order to enter her [b]Strawberry Farm[/b] where you can earn massive amounts of EXP! If you help her out enough, she’ll reward you with an adorable [b]Strawberry Outfit[/b], [b]Strawberry Damage Skin[/b], and more!

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1335/spiegelettes-strawberry-farm.png[/img]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1326/world-selection-reorganization.png[/img]

To celebrate the new names and groups of the worlds, we’ve redesigned the world selection screen! The new world groups are now arranged in their respective categories so whether your characters belong to [b]Interactive[/b], [b]Heroic[/b], or [b]Seasonal[/b] worlds, you can easily locate your world with the new intuitive design.

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1330/world-selection-reorganization.png[/img][/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1332/gold-richies-safe.png[/img]

It’s time to play mind games with the rest of the Maplers…[b]Gold Richie[/b] is back again with another safe to open! The player to enter the smallest unique code out of everyone in the world will win high-value prizes! You can enter by collecting [b]Safe Tickets[/b] that are dropped by monsters or earned from completing [b]Gold Richie[/b]’s quests. Happy guessing!

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1334/gold-richies-safe.png[/img][/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1321/burning-world-leap.png[/img]

These characters will join the rest of your fearless team and your Legion will look better than ever. Along with the character, you’ll bring your equipped items, inventory, and Mesos to your new world. Be sure to do this before the event ends because any characters not leapt will be deleted!

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1327/burning-world-leap.png[/img][/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1322/exciting-new-collaboration.png[/img]

notes.title: Maple Memo: GMS Roadmap Q1 2024
notes.content:
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5580/181107mm1100ip.jpg[/img]

Hi Maplers,

We’re here to share our Roadmap for Q1 2024! As always, please be mindful that it will list the notable updates but not everything that will be included in each patch. We recommend waiting for the respective update’s Update Preview post or Patch Notes post for details.

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1102/240105_banner_roadmaptimeline_wgc-492.jpg[/img][/u]
[list][*][u]v.248 Update (early February) [/u][/*][list][*][u]World Selection Reorganization[/u][/*][*][u]Burning World Leap[/u][/*][*][u]Spiegelette’s Strawberry Farm[/u][/*][*][u]Gold Richie’s Safe[/u][/*][*][u]Exciting New Collaboration![/u][/*][/list][*][u]v.249 Update (mid-March)[/u][/*][list][*][u]Minar Picnic[/u][/*][*][u]Grand Athenaeum[/u][/*][*][u]Profession Revamp[/u][/*][*][u]Character UI Revamp[/u][/*][*][u]Monster Life Improvements[/u][/*][*][u]Better Maple Improvements[/u][/*][/list][/list]
[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1114/240111-1_roadmaptimeline_wgc-492.jpg[/img][/u]

[b]v.248 - World Selection Reorganization[/b]

[u]As we announced in [/u][url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/87022/maple-memo-world-selection-reorganization-and-a-new-world][u]Maple Memo: World Selection Reorganization and a New World[/u][/url][u] in the November patch, we renamed worlds to give each world a unique identity. Additionally, we’ve created new names for the different groups of Worlds that are reflective of your playstyle and redesigned the server selection screen to display the World groups in a way that is more intuitive to new players.[/u]
[list][*][u]Scania, Bera, Aurora, Elysium, and Luna are grouped together as Interactive Worlds. [/u][/*][*][u]Kronos, Hyperion, and Solis are grouped together as Heroic Worlds. [/u][/*][*][u]Special limited-time events, such as Burning World or Super Yeti X Pink Bean, are grouped together as Seasonal Worlds.[/u][/*][/list]
[b]v.248 - Burning World Leap[/b]

[u]Burning World Leap is back! If you leveled multiple characters in Burning World, this is the time to have them join your team in regular worlds! Leveling your Legion has never felt so good.[/u]

[b]v.248 - Spiegelette’s Strawberry Farm[/b]

[u]Spiegelette needs help with her Strawberry Farm! Assist her in farming strawberries and she’ll reward you with EXP and other wonderful Strawberry-themed goodies![/u]

[b]v.248 - Gold Richie’s Safe[/b]

[u]Gold Richie is back and he is looking for certain lucky Maplers who can unlock his safe with the secret code! Hunt monsters to collect Safe Tickets for chances to unlock the safe and earn the delightful prizes that lie within.[/u][u]
[/u]

[b]v.248 - Exciting New Collaboration![/b]

[u]We’re very excited to announce that we have a new collaboration coming soon! Keep your eyes peeled for upcoming announcements - we can’t wait to show you what we have planned! [/u]

[b]v.249 - Minar Picnic[/b]

[u]It’s picnic season! Chief Tatamo invites you to Leafre to join a lovely picnic with the Halflingers and enjoy the nice weather outdoors. Defeat monsters who are trying to ruin your good time, explore the Minar Forest, and go on a treasure hunt to earn abundant rewards and EXP! [/u]

[b]v.249 - Grand Athenaeum[/b]

[u]Love learning about lore? For those of you who spend tons of time in Grand Athenaeum reading up on the compelling history of MapleStory, we’re adding two new sections, Grand Athenaeum: Book of Grandis and Grand Athenaeum Episode 7: Sephiroth’s Gardener.[/u]

[b]v.249 - Profession Revamp[/b]
[list][*][u]Learn Accessory Crafting, Smithing, and Alchemy at the same time in Interactive Worlds.[/u][/*][*][u]The crafting system’s Fatigue has been improved.[/u][/*][*][u]Accessory Crafting, Smithing, and Alchemy’s Mastery will no longer decrease. [/u][/*][*][u]Ardentmill’s harvesting maps have been improved and changed to instanced maps.[/u][/*][/list]
[b]v.249 - Character UI Revamp[/b]
[list][*][u]The Character UI has been improved so you can now see ‘Character Info’ and ‘Stats’ together.[/u][/*][*][u]We added new information such as ‘Combat Power’, ‘Normal Enemy Damage’, and ‘Cooldown’ to the Character UI.[/u][/*][*][u]Use the Character UI to check other characters’ stat and equipment information too.[/u][/*][*][u]Add a background to your character’s avatar area.[/u][/*][/list]
[b]v.249 - Monster Life Improvements[/b]
[list][*][u]Combine monsters with an increased rate of receiving a Special Category monster.[/u][/*][*][u]Harvest Waru from all buildings simultaneously when you use Auto Harvest.[/u][/*][*][u]Store more Waru with a 400% increase in the maximum storage capacity of buildings.[/u][/*][*][u]Use Waru to extend the lifespan of some ranked monsters.[/u][/*][*][u]Monster Life related items will no longer be sold in the Cash Shop, and some actions that required Gems will now require Waru. [/u][/*][/list]
[b]v.249 - Better Maple Improvements[/b]
[list][*][u]Hexa Matrix Prequest[/u][list][*]If you decide to skip the tutorial for the ‘[6th Job] Hexa Matrix’ quest, the quest will now be completed instantly.[/*][/list][/*][*][u]Sol Erda UI[/u][list][*][u]You can assign the Sol Erda UI to a shortcut so it can be easily accessed.[/u][/*][*][u]You can check your Sol Erda Energy and Sol Erda Fragments together in a combined UI.[/u][/*][*][u]If you have the Sol Erda UI activated, it will be maintained even after logging off.[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][u]Reporting Feature[/u][list][*][u]When reporting a player for illegal program usage, the list of reportable players’ names has been improved to show up to 3 players who were located on the same map but since left the map.[/u][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u]We hope you’re excited by this high-level view of the content and events arriving to GMS in v.248 - v.249 2024. [/u]

[u]In addition to these, we’re planning to release the sale of [/u]Sol Erda Booster [u]on [/u]January 17th[u] to help players progress with their 6th Job Skill enhancements! You’ll be able to obtain Sol Erda Energy and Sol Erda Fragments by simply logging in and claiming daily. Stay tuned for more information![/u]

[u]And finally, we’d like to talk about our long-term plans for Q1 2024 and beyond.[/u]

[b]Beast Tamer[/b]

[u]In our last Roadmap memo, we announced that Beast Tamer’s 6th Job would not be included - we’re happy to provide an update now!
[/u][u]Beast Tamer is getting an overhaul and becoming a new class: Forest Child Lynn. As the successor to Beast Tamer, Lynn will be able to fight battles alongside her powerful guardians and support their party members with a variety of abilities that utilize the power of the forest, [/u][u]so please look forward to seeing them in action[/u][u]. We’ll see you in May with a new look![/u]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1107/lynn.png[/img]

[b]What’s Next?[/b]

[u]As you already know, [/u][u]MapleStory is operated as separate services in different regions[/u][u]. We understand that you are always wondering if the contents of other services will affect Global MapleStory (GMS). [/u][u]Similar to other regions,[/u][u] GMS is a unique and independent service with a distinct player base. During our planning process for the game and each update, we consider the existing unique specifications of GMS and the play patterns and preferences of our players.[/u]

[u]Over the past few months, we have been working to create better distinctions between world types by providing the worlds Kronos [/u][u]and Solis unique names[/u][u], opening the new Hyperion world, [/u][u]and introducing new world group names as mentioned above.[/u][u] These efforts are part of our localization plan to highlight [/u][u]Global MapleStory as a unique service, reduce misunderstandings with the previous terminology,[/u][u] along with providing more intuitive guidance for all new players. [/u]

[u]As for our future plans for GMS, along with the separate memo and notices we've provided in the past, we started posting these roadmaps as part of our effort to inform you of any large changes coming to GMS as early as we can. We are committed to continuing to do so and informing you of major changes to GMS through these notices. As mentioned above, we will make decisions that are best for GMS, and if we decide to make any major changes you can expect to learn more details about it from us in advance. Please note that outside of what we have already mentioned above, we have no other plans to share.[/u]

[u]As always, our goal with these roadmaps is to provide information that players may be curious about and assist players with advanced preparation. Please keep in mind that there is more content on the way in addition to those listed above, so we advise players to refer to the Update Preview post and Patch Notes post for the finalized details for every game update.[/u]

[u]Thank you,[/u]

[u]Mjollnir and the MapleStory Team[/u]

Thanks for your patience!

[b]Time:[/b]

[b]Thursday, January 11, 2024
[/b][b]PST (UTC -8): 7:00 AM - 11:00 AM
EST (UTC -5): 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM
CET (UTC +1): 4:00 PM - 8:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +11): 2:00 AM (Jan. 12) - 6:00 AM (Jan. 12)[/b]

notes.content:

Miracle Summer worked so well, we're bringing it back for winter! During the winter, Miracle Time will be enabled for equipment for specific slots giving you double the chance to Rank-Up your gear once. Each slot will have a miracle window, so keep your eyes peeled for news on upcoming Miracle Time announcements!

On [b]Saturday, January 6, 2024[/b], Maplers on all Worlds will have Miracle Time enabled for [b]Tops, Bottoms, Overalls and Cape Equipment[/b]! Cube your shirts, breastplates, and blouses, your shorts, skirts, and greaves, your robes, dresses, and trenchcoats, and even your cloaks, backpacks, and capes of all sorts, all-day Saturday with the improved Rank-Up chances!

[b]Note[/b]: Miracle Winter dates are in UTC, precise times may differ based on your time zone.

notes.title: v.247 New Age: Into the Abyss Update Preview
notes.content:
[u][u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2286/231201-wgc-537-v247-update-preview_header.png[/img][/u][u][/u][/u]

Build and customize a team of Mercenaries to fight off monsters in the [b]Abyssal Expedition[/b]. Defend Ereve from a High Flora invasion aboard the impressive battleship, [b]Arteria[/b]. Protect the new area, [b]Carcion[/b], from Darmoor’s apostle who seeks the power of the ancient god, Keira. Gather your strongest team and prepare to battle new difficulties for [b]Kaling & Kalos the Guardian[/b]. After these intense fights, relax and enjoy the holiday season with new [b]Maplemas[/b] celebrations!

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2276/231201-wgc-537-v247-update-preview_btn-abyssal.png?width=1100&height=119&mode=max[/img][/u]

[b]Abyss[/b], a huge crack and unknown territory has been found throughout the Maple World! Who is brave enough to venture into the deepest part of the Abyss to fight [b]Abyss Manon[/b]?

Only true adventurers dare go in but it is a dangerous place and you cannot go alone. You’ll need your strongest team to go in and fight to gain access to the power of the [b]Abyss[/b]. Become the best expedition captain that will lead your team to victory! As a reward for your bravery, defeating [b]Abyss Manon[/b] will grant an exclusive [b]Legion Block[/b] that is not included in the number of member placement.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2302/untitled-4-v2.png[/img]

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2277/231201-wgc-537-v247-update-preview_btn-battleship.png[/img][/u]

Aboard the new Lv. 280+ sinister warship [b]Arteria[/b], [b]Reina[/b] prepares to invade Maple World with the High Flora army! As the new Apostle of Darmoor, she carries the power of a god within a special crystal. In this new region, you will fight armies of Flora soldiers and collect the new [b]Sacred Symbol: Arteria[/b]. Are you strong enough to defeat them?

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2304/untitled-2-v2.png[/img][/u]

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2278/231201-wgc-537-v247-update-preview_btn-carcion.png[/img][/u]

[b]Limbo[/b], another one of Darmoor's Apostles, has set his sight on [b]Carcion[/b], the Cradle of Life. For those of you above Lv. 285, join forces with the local residents to push back the encroaching force. notes.title: 6th Job is Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2049/wgc-437-231122-6th-job-available-in-post-banner-1100x225.jpg[/img] After the long Journey Toward the Sixth Star, 6th Job is finally available now!

[b]6th Job[/b]

[list][*]As the boundary between Maple World and Grandis is sundered, a new form of Erda has been unleashed. Taming this new power will do more than save the goddesses of the two worlds: it will unlock skills never seen before in either land.[/*][*][b]Requirement: [/b]Lv. 260 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). Character must have completed the ‘[Convergence] True Form’ quest, ‘5th Job: Record of Power’ quest, and 5th Job Advancement.[/*][*]The wait is over! [b]6th Job Advancement[/b] can be started by accepting the ‘[6th Job] Merged Dimension’ quest within the lightbulb notifier on the left side of the screen. [list][*][b]Reminder:[/b] Your character must meet the following requirements to start the 6th Job Advancement: [list][*]Lv. 260 and above[/*][*]Completed the ‘[Convergence] True Form’ and ‘5th Job: Record of Power’ quests[/*][*]Completed 5th Job Advancement[/*][/list][/*][*]While proceeding with the 6th Job Advancement quests, you can talk to Moco on the map to exit mid-way.[/*][*]You can return and continue where you left off with the 6th Job Advancement by accepting the ‘[6th Job] Continue with the Job Advancement’ quest within the lightbulb icon.[/*][/list][/*][*]As you progress through the quests, you’ll receive the following quest items. You must activate the stones and defeat monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) to fill each of them with EXP. Once you complete each quest, you will receive EXP as a reward. [list][*]My Arcane Stone[/*][*]Vanishing Journey Stone[/*][*]Chu Chu Island Stone[/*][*]Lachelein Stone[/*][*]Arcana Stone[/*][*]Morass Stone[/*][*]Esfera Stone[/*][/list][/*][*]Upon completing the 6th Job Advancement, you will gain access to [b]Hexa Matrix[/b] and activate your [b]Skill Node[/b].[/*][*]The following 6th Job-related quests have been added: [list][*][6th Job] Merged Dimension[/*][*][6th Job] An Erda That Didn't Exist Before[/*][*][6th Job] Goddess Inside Erda (1)[/*][*][6th Job] The Faint Voice[/*][*][6th Job] Goddess Inside Erda (2)[/*][*][6th Job] Whose Voice Is It?[/*][*][6th Job] Goddess Inside Erda (3)[/*][*][6th Job] Into the Sol Erda[/*][*][6th Job] A New Age[/*][*][6th Job] Collect the Vanishing Journey Symbol[/*][*][6th Job] Collect the Chu Chu Island Symbol[/*][*][6th Job] Collect the Lachelein Symbol[/*][*][6th Job] Collect the Arcana Symbol[/*][*][6th Job] Collect the Morass Symbol[/*][*][6th Job] Collect the Esfera Symbol[/*][*][6th Job] A New Power[/*][*][6th Job] HEXA Matrix[/*][/list][/*][/list] [b]Reward:[/b] [list][*][b]EXP[/b][/*][/list]

[b]Hexa Matrix[/b]

[b]Requirement: Lv. 260 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). Character must have completed the 6th Job Advancement.[/b] [list][*]The Hexa Matrix will allow you to improve the skills that you've been relying on for years, granting them brand new effects! Gain new strength as you infuse this power into your entire arsenal of abilities![/*][*]Complete the 6th Job Advancement to access the Hexa Matrix via your Skill UI under the “VI” tab.[/*][*]Hexa Matrix has 2 different system types: [b]Hexa Skills[/b] and [b]Hexa Stats[/b]. [list][*][b]Hexa Skills[/b] [list][*]Hexa Skill Nodes consist of the following: [list][*][b]Skill Node:[/b] New Origin skill will be given once activated[/*][*][b]Mastery Node:[/b] 4th Job or lower skill will either be enhanced or replaced once activated[/*][*][b]Boost Node:[/b] 5th Job skill will be enhanced once activated[/*][*][b]Common Node:[/b] New skill that is shared between characters of the same class will be given once activated. Common Nodes will be available at a later date, so stay tuned![/*][/list][/*][*]Skill Node for the job will be activated upon the completion of the 6th Job Advancement.[/*][*]Hexa Skill Nodes can be enhanced up to Rank 30. Once the node is enhanced, the skill that is affected by the node will also level up.[/*][*]Mastery Nodes and Boost Nodes can be activated when certain 5th Job skills reach a specific level, not counting the slot enhancement levels. [list][*]If the skill requirement of the skill that is being activated is no longer met due to unequipping or extracting the V Node, the Hexa Skill Node will be deactivated and the new skill given through the Hexa Skill Node will no longer be available.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Hexa Stats[/b] [list][*]Hexa Stats are stats that can be obtained and enhanced through Hexa Stat Nodes.[/*][*]Hexa Stats consist of the following stats: [list][*]Critical Damage[/*][*]Boss Damage[/*][*]Ignore Defense[/*][*]Damage[/*][*]Attack Power & Magic ATT[/*][*]STR/DEX/INT/LUK[/*][/list][/*][*]There are a total of six Hexa Stat Nodes and one can be activated starting with this v.246 update. The rest of the Hexa Stat Nodes will be added at a later date.[/*][*]You can set one [b]Main Stat[/b] with a higher value and two [b]Additional Stats[/b] with a lower value per each Hexa Stat Node. [list][*]You can set one type of stat once within all Hexa Stat Nodes [list][*][u][b]Ex:[/b] Boss Damage stat can only be set as a Main Stat for one of the six Hexa Stat Nodes[/u][/*][/list][/*][*]You can set up to two duplicate types of stats as Additional Stats within all Hexa Stat Nodes [list][*][u][b]Ex:[/b] Critical Damage stat can be set as one of the two Additional Stats on Stat Node #1 and Stat Node #2[/u][/*][/list][/*][*]You are unable to equip the same type of stats within the same Stat Node [list][*][u][b]Ex:[/b] If the Main Stat is set as DEF Ignore, the two Additional Stats have to be set among the five other stats[/u][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Hexa Stat Node can be enhanced up to Rank 20 and one of the three stats’ level will increase with a fixed rate per each rank-up attempt. [list][*]Each individual stat can be enhanced up to Rank 10.[/*][*]The higher the level of the Main Stat, the more [b]Sol Erda Fragments[/b] will be needed for each subsequent enhancement.[/*][*]The higher the level of the Main Stat, the more stats are granted.[/*][/list][/*][*]Once Hexa Stat Node has been enhanced to Rank 20, the enhancement can be saved. Though, be mindful of the following rules: [list][*]Certain functions, such as enhancing or resetting, will be disabled for saved nodes[/*][*]You can select one node that has been enhanced or a saved node to apply to a character[/*][*]If you attempt to save when there is already a saved node, the previously saved node information will be replaced[/*][/list][/*][*]Once Hexa Stat Node has been enhanced to Rank 10, its stat level can be reset using mesos. Hexa Stat Node rank and each individual stat level will reset to 0 afterward.[/*][*]You can also use mesos to reset the type of stats set on the Hexa Stat Node.[/*][*]The meso prices for changing stat type and resetting stat level on your Hexa Stat Node are the following: [list][*][b]Stat Type Change:[/b] 100 million mesos[/*][*][b]Hexa Stat Node Reset:[/b] 10 million mesos[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Hexa Skills and Hexa Stats can be activated or enhanced by using enhancement materials: [b]Sol Erda[/b] and [b]Sol Erda Fragment[/b]. [list][*][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1533/sol-erda.png?width=39&height=37&mode=max[/img] Sol Erda[/b] [list][*]Sol Erda is used in the following ways: [list][*]Activate and enhance Hexa Skills[/*][*]Activate Hexa Stats[/*][/list][/*][*]Sol Erda can be obtained by earning [b]Sol Erda Energy[/b] after completing the 6th Job Advancement.[/*][*]You can earn Sol Erda Energy by the following methods: [list][*]Completing daily quests[/*][*]Defeating monsters in Sacred Powered Grandis areas[/*][*]Defeating the following bosses: [list][*]Lotus (Hard)[/*][*]Damien (Hard)[/*][*]Lucid (Hard)[/*][*]Will (Hard)[/*][*]Verus Hilla (Normal, Hard)[/*][*]Guardian Angel Slime (Chaos)[/*][*]Gloom (Chaos)[/*][*]Darknell (Hard)[/*][*]Black Mage (Hard, Extreme)[/*][*]Chosen Seren (Normal, Hard, Extreme)[/*][*]Kalos the Guardian (Chaos)[/*][*]Kaling (Normal)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You can create 1 Sol Erda (untradeable) when you collect 1,000 Sol Erda Energy.[/*][*]Each character can have up to max 20 Sol Erda. If the character has 20 Sol Erda in their possession already, Sol Erda Energy will no longer drop for that character.[/*][/list][/*][*][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1532/sol-erda-fragment.png[/img] Sol Erda Fragment[/b] [list][*]Sol Erda Fragment is used in the following ways: [list][*]Activate and enhance Hexa Skills[/*][*]Activate and enhance Hexa Stats[/*][/list][/*][*]Sol Erda Fragment can be obtained after completing the 6th Job Advancement. [list][*]You can earn Sol Erda Fragment by the following methods: [list][*]Completing daily quests[/*][*]Defeating monsters in Sacred Powered Grandis area[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Sol Erda Fragment is tradeable within account in Aurora, Bera, Elysium, Luna, and Scania worlds. It is untradeable in Reboot worlds.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]For characters that completed 6th Job Advancement, you will the following sources to earn Sol Erda Energy and Sol Erda Fragments: [list][*][b]Daily Quest[/b][list][*]You will be asked to defeat 3,000 monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) in the Grandis area to complete the daily quest.[/*][*]Daily quests can be completed per character.[/*][*]Upon completing the daily quest, you can receive the following Daily Quest Rewards:[list][*][b]Sol Erda Energy (x600):[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/*][*][b]Sol Erda Fragment (x12):[/b] Tradeable within account, Permanent. (Item is untradeable in Reboot worlds.)[list][*][b]Sol Erda Fragments are given only once a day per world[/b]. After claiming the Sol Erda Fragment for the day, additional characters that complete the daily quest will only receive Sol Erda Energy.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[b]6th Job Skills[/b]

To learn more about all the new 6th Job Skills, you can refer to the v246 Patch Notes [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/86907/v-246-new-age-6th-job-patch-notes]here[/url]!

tags.feature: As the boundary between Maple World and Grandis is sundered, a new form of Erda has been unleashed. Taming this new power will do more than save the goddesses of the two worlds: it will unlock skills never seen before in either land.
The wait is over! [b]6th Job Advancement[/b] can be started by accepting the ‘[6th Job] Merged Dimension’ quest within the lightbulb notifier on the left side of the screen.

As you progress through the quests, you’ll receive the following quest items. You must activate the stones and defeat monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) to fill each of them with EXP. Once you complete each quest, you will receive EXP as a reward.
Upon completing the 6th Job Advancement, you will gain access to [b]Hexa Matrix[/b] and activate your [b]Skill Node[/b].
The following 6th Job-related quests have been added:

The Hexa Matrix will allow you to improve the skills that you've been relying on for years, granting them brand new effects! Gain new strength as you infuse this power into your entire arsenal of abilities!
Complete the 6th Job Advancement to access the Hexa Matrix via your Skill UI under the “VI” tab.
Hexa Matrix has 2 different system types: [b]Hexa Skills[/b] and [b]Hexa Stats[/b].
Hexa Skill Nodes consist of the following:
Skill Node for the job will be activated upon the completion of the 6th Job Advancement.
Hexa Skill Nodes can be enhanced up to Rank 30. Once the node is enhanced, the skill that is affected by the node will also level up.
Mastery Nodes and Boost Nodes can be activated when certain 5th Job skills reach a specific level, not counting the slot enhancement levels.
Hexa Stats are stats that can be obtained and enhanced through Hexa Stat Nodes.
Hexa Stats consist of the following stats:
There are a total of six Hexa Stat Nodes and one can be activated starting with this v.246 update. The rest of the Hexa Stat Nodes will be added at a later date.
You can set one [b]Main Stat[/b] with a higher value and two [b]Additional Stats[/b] with a lower value per each Hexa Stat Node.
Hexa Stat Node can be enhanced up to Rank 20 and one of the three stats’ level will increase with a fixed rate per each rank-up attempt.
Each individual stat can be enhanced up to Rank 10.
The higher the level of the Main Stat, the more [b]Sol Erda Fragments[/b] will be needed for each subsequent enhancement.
The higher the level of the Main Stat, the more stats are granted.
Once Hexa Stat Node has been enhanced to Rank 20, the enhancement can be saved. Though, be mindful of the following rules:
Once Hexa Stat Node has been enhanced to Rank 10, its stat level can be reset using mesos. Hexa Stat Node rank and each individual stat level will reset to 0 afterward.
You can also use mesos to reset the type of stats set on the Hexa Stat Node.
The meso prices for changing stat type and resetting stat level on your Hexa Stat Node are the following:
Hexa Skills and Hexa Stats can be activated or enhanced by using enhancement materials: [b]Sol Erda[/b] and [b]Sol Erda Fragment[/b].
Sol Erda is used in the following ways:
Sol Erda can be obtained by earning [b]Sol Erda Energy[/b] after completing the 6th Job Advancement.
You can earn Sol Erda Energy by the following methods:
You can create 1 Sol Erda (untradeable) when you collect 1,000 Sol Erda Energy.
Each character can have up to max 20 Sol Erda. If the character has 20 Sol Erda in their possession already, Sol Erda Energy will no longer drop for that character.
Sol Erda Fragment is used in the following ways:
Sol Erda Fragment can be obtained after completing the 6th Job Advancement.
You can earn Sol Erda Fragment by the following methods:
Sol Erda Fragment is tradeable within account in Aurora, Bera, Elysium, Luna, and Scania worlds. It is untradeable in Reboot worlds.
For characters that completed 6th Job Advancement, you will the following sources to earn Sol Erda Energy and Sol Erda Fragments:
You will be asked to defeat 3,000 monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) in the Grandis area to complete the daily quest.
Daily quests can be completed per character.
Upon completing the daily quest, you can receive the following Daily Quest Rewards:
Sol Erda Fragments are given only once a day per world. After claiming the Sol Erda Fragment for the day, additional characters that complete the daily quest will only receive Sol Erda Energy.
To learn more about all the new 6th Job Skills, you can refer to the v246 Patch Notes [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/86907/v-246-new-age-6th-job-patch-notes]here[/url]!

notes.title: New Age Hyper Burning and Burning World!
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1806/1100x225-new-age-hyper-burning-event-burning-world-maplestory.jpg[/img]

The New Age update is here with 6th Job, and [b]Hyper Burning[/b] is returning until February! [b]Burning World[/b] is also returning for the winter to make the levels climb even faster! Make a new character to race up to Lv. 260, gain new rewards with the [b]Burning World Step Up Event[/b], and keep advancing your characters through Burning World before heading to another world in February's [b]Burning World Leap[/b]!


[h3][b]Hyper Burning[/b][/h3][list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 15, 2023 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, February 6, 2024 3:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 15, 2023 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 7, 2024 12:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, November 15, 2023 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 7, 2024 10:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.

Create a brand-new character during the extra-long event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in all worlds, as well as Burning World, [b]except for Zero characters[/b].

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional [b]two levels[/b] all the way up to Lv. 260! You also have the option to designate one of your existing Lv. 200-258 characters as 'Hyper Burning' instead, allowing them to gain that benefit!


In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including [b]Root Abyss and Fafnir gear[/b]! When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training! You will receive additional rewards on your ‘Hyper Burning’ character at Lv. 200, Lv. 210, and every 5 levels after Lv. 210, up to Lv. 260!

Once your ‘Burning’ character reaches Lv. 200 (or you designate an existing character as Burning), you can obtain [b]Bonus Rewards[/b] up until Lv. 260. notes.title: Maple Memo: v.246 New Age Update Clarification
notes.content:
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5580/181107mm1100ip.jpg[/img]

Hi Maplers,

We understand that there are a lot of concerns about information that was recently revealed regarding the v.246 New Age: 6th Job update. First, we would like to truly apologize for causing concern due to the lack of prior information regarding New Age’s 6th Job content. We would like to clarify the development intentions for the parts our Maplers are currently worried about, and share future plans.

[u][b]6th Job Advancement: Sol Erda[/b][/u]
As we prepared the 6th Job Advancement update, our goal was to provide motivations to our players for character growth and enhancement, as well as provide content that players would be able to use actively and flexibly, without being limited to only mobbing. We wanted to consider the appropriate daily material acquisition rate and method, taking into consideration our existing players’ behavior, while also taking into account the difficulty level where newer players wouldn’t feel like it would be too much of a hurdle. We wanted to mitigate the negative aspects to the gameplay experience such as illegal tool usage or paying for services for other players to farm that occurs as a result of having an acquisition method that was mainly focused on mobbing.

With these goals in mind, we wished to lower the burden that our players might feel regarding play time and increase the accessibility for casual players by distributing the Sol Erda Energy and the Sol Erda Fragments through the Daily Quest. Additionally, we added the daily cap because we wished to narrow the gap that depended on playtime between the hardcore players and those who could not dedicate as much time to the game. We were planning to monitor the actual acquisition time of our players, the play time, and adjust the cap as needed. We understand that seeing changes like this being shown in gameplay videos and streams without detailed context from our team has caused a lot of anger and frustration with you all. We would like to apologize to our Maplers once again, since the design intention for this part has not been explained enough in advance. Regardless of the design intentions, we understand that there are many aspects to these changes that you are understandably concerned about, so in addition to the Daily Quest that will remain, [b]we will remove the cap and explore separate improvement measures for parts that could be harmful for the gameplay experience[/b].

Also, we would like to share that we have no plans to release the Sol Erda Booster at the same time as the 6th Job Advancement update. We will review the progress of our players’ 6th Job Advancement and determine if and when there is a need to further augment the ways in which players can obtain Sol Erda.

[u][b]Frenzy Totem[/b][/u]
We would like to confirm that - contrary to some information being circulated in the community - Frenzy Totems were always planned to function as they normally do outside of instanced maps and that is intended to remain the same in the New Age update. There was a bug in our test server regarding this functionality and we did not properly address this situation before the information was discovered and spread within the community. As mentioned in the v.246 patch notes released yesterday, the instanced maps are provided during the New Age patch duration for the Sacred Power fields, and the way the Frenzy Totem works in these instanced fields are as follows:
[list][*][list][*]Frenzy Totem effects will only apply to the hunting map of the character that used the Frenzy Totem. The effect will disappear once the character leaves the instanced map.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
We understand that this kind of communication should have come out sooner and the context for why we made these changes should have been delivered at the same time we announced them. We hope that this memo can, at the very least, give you insight into how we implement design changes to our service.

Sincerely,

Mjollnir and the MapleStory Team

notes.title: v.245 Hotfixes - October 19, 2023
notes.content:
In the midst of our scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, we sometimes perform hotfixes to address a variety of bugs and issues without bringing down the servers. We will use this post as a collective hub to update our players with the hotfix details, such as when and which fix was applied. Each time there is an update, this post will be bumped up on our news page and the update will clearly be indicated with the date the hotfix was applied. We hope that this will be a useful record and helpful information for our players.

Here you'll find a list of hotfixes that addresses a variety of bugs and issues reported within the v.245 - Midnight Carnival - Nautilus update.

[b]Hotfixes:[/b]
[list][*][b]October 19, 2023
[/b][list][*]The Pumpkin pets from Wisp's Wondrous Wonderberry in Reboot worlds have been changed to the versions that do not provide buffs. Please see the new pets below:
[list][*]Pumpkin Zack[/*][*]Pumpkin Mack[/*][*]Pumpkin Jack[list][*]Players who had the pumpkin pets will have them removed and replaced with the new version that do not provide buffs. Please see this post [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/86829/investigation-on-na-reboot-server-issues-october-19-2023]here[/url] for additional information.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: [Update Oct 26] World's Best Punch King Winners
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1232/inpost-1100x225-maplestory-worlds-best-punch-king-winners.jpg[/img]

[b][Update Oct 26][/b] We are aware of an issue where some of the World's Best Punch King winners have received incorrect in-game rewards for their placement in the Top 10 Rankings. For those that were affected, please go ahead and claim the rewards, [b]even if they are incorrect[/b], by [b]October 31, 2023 11:59 PM UTC[/b], and we will swap it out for the correct reward during the an upcoming scheduled maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

The [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/85511/v-244-punch-king-palooza-patch-notes#7][b]World’s Best Punch King[/b][/url] event has ended and now it’s time for the top-ranked players to receive their rewards! Players who participated in the event had to defeat Punch King monsters and score at least 1,500 points in order to register in the ranking.

[b]Check out the #1 top-ranked Maplers from each job [/b][url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/rankings/punchking][b]HERE[/b][/url]!

Rankings are registered separately for NA and EU worlds, and separately for Reboot and Aurora, Bera, Elysium, Luna, and Scania worlds too. You can also see the top 10 ranked winners from these worlds.

[b]Reward Retrieval[/b]:
[list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, October 17 at 5:00 PM - Tuesday, October 31 at 4:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, October 18 at 2:00 AM - Wednesday, November 1 at 12:59 AM CET[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, October 18 at 11:00 AM - Wednesday, November 1 at 10:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Details[/b]:
[list][*]To get your rewards, accept the ‘[Punch King] World's Best Punch King Ranking Reward’ quest from the event notifier on the left side of the screen, or talk to Champion Toben Hair located in major towns.[/*][*]Rewards can only be claimed by the character registered on the rankings.[/*][*][b]Make sure to claim your rewards before the last day![/b][/*][/list]
[b]Rewards:[/b]
[list][*]Top 10 ranked players (achieved rank 1-10) receive:
[list][*][b]World's Best Punch King Chair Coupon:[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration. Use to receive:
[list][*][b]World's Best Punch King Chair:[/b] Untradeable, Permanent. The chair will display the highest rank you achieved (1 to 10) when used.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1055/1st.png[/img]
[list][*]The #1 ranked players (achieved 1st place) also receive:
[list][*][b]World's Best Effect Coupon:[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration. Use to receive:
[list][*][b]World's Best Effect:[/b] Untradeable, Permanent. Use the item to obtain an effect engraved with a pattern that symbolizes your specific job.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1056/effect.png[/img]
