tags.feature: The party isn't over yet with a trio of new Hyper Ignition Events to give you even more rewards, more Ignition Coins, and more fun to have!
Enjoy the missions and rewards prepared by Wonky the Fairy!
Get ready to collect letters of the alphabet to spell our related MapleStory Event terms for rewards!
It's time for some Mini-games and Mike's got you covered!
Talk to Flaming Mike in the Hyper Ignition map to access the Mini-game Lounge.
The mini-game available will change every 15 minutes, but you can play the Challenge Mini-game anytime.
One Card
Starts every hour on the dot.
Each hero will receive 7 cards when the game starts.
On your turn, you can select and play one card of the same color or number as the card placed in the center.
If you have no cards you can play, click the cards in the center to draw one.
You win by getting rid of all cards in your hand.
If you have 17 or more cards, you will automatically lose.
Cards are made up of regular cards, magic cards, attack cards, and knight cards.
Attack cards cannot be blocked with a weaker attack card.
Monster Pyramid
Starts every hour at the 30-minute mark.
In Monster Pyramid, there are a total of 36 glass cups filled with monsters.
Three heroes are distributed with 12 glass cups each when the game begins.
When it's your turn, you can select 1 cup to stack it on top of another cup of the same shape.
Special cups can be stacked on top of any cup, regardless of shape, but no cups can be stacked on top of a special cup.
Earn points per every glass cup that is used.
If the score is a tie, whoever reached the score first is ranked higher.
The round ends if there is a hero that placed all of their glass cups in the pyramid, or if nobody can place glass cups anymore.
There are a total of 3 rounds. When all rounds finish, ranks are determined based on the final amount of points.
Supernatural Yut
Starts every hour at the 15-minute mark.
You are given 2 one-time supernatural powers when the game starts.
Supernatural abilities can be used once per each turn, before throwing the Yut
Throw the Yut on your turn and move your pieces along the designated path based on the Yut results.
If you get a four or a five after throwing the Yut, or if you capture an opponent's piece, you can throw the Yut one more time.
You win if you get all 4 of your pieces to the goal first within the time limit.
Reverse Battle
Starts every hour at the 45-minute mark.
Start game with either Slime or Pink Bean when you enter the game.
Slime places the stone first and then you take turns placing stones.
When you place a stone on your turn, flip over all stones of the opponent between the stone you just put down and the stone that was already placed, and they will be yours.
Flip the opponent's stone to reduce their HP, and you will win if you make their HP reach 0.
The game will end if there are no more places to put the stone within the time limit or if one player's HP reaches 0.
Up and Down Seesaw
Hero and Wonky the Fairy begin the seesaw upon entering the mini-game.
Press the Interact/Harvest key when the arrow reaches the yellow area of the gauge, to successfully jump.
As the jump count increases, the seesaw speed will increase and the yellow area will decrease.
Earn points per successful jump, and earn higher points for increasing the number of successes.
Failing the jump, or successfully jumping 40 times will end the game.
Earn Hyper Ignition Points upon successful jumps.
Ignition Party Column
Floors will appear one by one on the side, when the Ignition Party Column begins.
You can stack the floor that appears by pressing the Space key. (However, you must stack the floor within a certain range of the floor that was stacked immediately before.)
Earn more points by stacking the floors higher.
The game ends when you go outside the range of the floor that was stacked immediately before. (Or, the game ends when you reach the 5 minute time limit.)
Earn Hyper Ignition Points each time you build up the tower.
Ignition Boat Rush
Ride the boat and use the left and right arrow keys to avoid the obstacles that appear.
There are a total of 3 lanes, and obstacles show up in 2 lanes.
Speed is gradually increased as the time passes.
Game ends when colliding with obstacles.
Earn Hyper Ignition Points per distance traveled.
Colorful Ignition Invitation
Send an invitation to DJ Selena.
Press the button of the same color as the invitation that appeared on the center.

A special invitation will appear in 3 different types and colors in Colorful Ignition Invitation, and the special invitation will keep its true form hidden until moments before sending the invitation out, and transform into one of the 3 types.
The Fever Gauge fills up as you send the invitations.
Once it's full, quickly press the Space key.
You can send the invitation faster.
Earn Hyper Ignition Points each time you send an invitation.
Game will automatically end if you do not play within the turn time limit.
Penalty will be applied if a set number of turns are played automatically, or you exit during the game. (Reward cannot be claimed and cannot participate in all mini game for 15 minutes)
Please exit by talking to NPC Flaming Mike in the exit map after the mini game has completed ended.
Hyper Ignition Points will not be transferred during Burning World Leap, and mini game achievements will not be maintained after Leap.
Depending on the game results, Hyper Ignition Points will be distributed upon exiting after playing the mini-game.
You can earn up to 300 Hyper Ignition Points a day per world.
Entry is permitted to those who earned all the available points of the day, but they cannot earn more points.
Lv. 200+ and Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2 can talk to Flaming Mike to exchange Hyper Ignition Points with EXP.
Talk to Flaming Mike after completing an achievement to earn set rewards per mini-game.
Achievement counts per mini-game will be applied per world, and each reward can be received once per world.

Compensation for the recent extended maintenance and unscheduled maintenance will be given out in the next few days.

We will be performing a scheduled minor patch on[b] Thursday, January 5th, 2023 at 6:00 AM PST (9:00 AM EST / 3:00 PM CET / 1:00 AM AEDT Jan. 6).[/b] We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 4 hours, concluding around [b]10:00 AM PST (1:00 PM EST / 7:00 PM CET / 5:00 AM AEDT Jan. 6)[/b]. notes.title: Magical Miracle Time - NA Reboot World
notes.content:
Maplers on NA Reboot World will be able to sign-up for your own personal Miracle Time periods for double the chance for rank up your gear's Potentials, and a chance to rank up twice with one Cube!

[u][b]Magical Miracle Time Registration - NA Reboot World
[/b][/u]
[b]Event Duration:
[/b]
[b]PST (UTC -8): Tuesday, December 27, 2022 4:00 PM - Saturday, December 31, 2022 3:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, December 28, 2022 1:00 AM - Sunday, January 1, 2023 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, December 28, 2022 11:00 AM - Sunday, January 1, 2023 10:59 AM[/b]

[b]Event Details:[/b]

[list]
[*]A character registering for Magical Miracle Time on NA Reboot World must be Lv. 101 or above.
[*]When the Registration Period begins, use the Star Event Notifier to accept the "[MMT] Magical Miracle Time Pre-registration" quest to be awarded a registration coin, and select which date you'd like to try to purchase a [b]Magical Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] for.
[*][b]Requirements:[/b] Characters on NA Reboot World that are Lv. 101 or above can register (all characters on the account on NA Reboot World will benefit from it, however).
[*]Use the Star Event Notifier to travel to the Miracle Time Registration Map, and speak to the Cassandra to purchase a [b]Magical Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] for the previously selected day. In order to prevent overcrowding, [b]you will only have 60 seconds to make the purchase[/b], after which time you will be returned to the previous map you were on, and have to select a day again. Failing to purchase a ticket will not prevent you from accessing the same [b]Magical Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] vendor.
[*]Miracle Time will, as usual, occur during three hour-long periods during the day. For example, a 1/6 Magical Miracle Time Registration Ticket will enable Miracle Time during the following periods:
[b][*]PST (UTC -8): 7:00 PM – 8:00 PM January 5, 2023 & 12:30 AM – 1:30 AM January 6, 2023 & 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM January 6, 2023
[*]CET (UTC +1): 4:00 AM – 5:00 AM January 6, 2023 & 9:30 AM – 10:30 AM January 6, 2023 & 11:00 PM – 12:00 AM January 6, 2023
[*]AEDT (UTC +11): 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM January 6, 2023 & 7:30 PM – 8:30 PM January 6, 2023 & 9:00 AM – 10:00 AM January 7, 2023[/b]
[*]During each day of the pre-registration event 1,200 tickets will be available for each Magical Miracle Time date, with 600 tickets available at [b]12:00 AM UTC[/b] and then another 600 tickets restocked at [b]12:00 PM UTC[/b].
[*]You can purchase and use only one ticket per world.
[*]Make sure you are free during the date you register for, these tickets [b]cannot be exchanged or refunded[/b]!
[*]Players cannot enter the lobby map between [b]11:55 AM - 12:05 PM UTC[/b] and [b]11:55 PM - 12:05 AM UTC[/b] while the shops are being restocked.
[*]Players that purchased a ticket can no longer enter a lobby map where the registration tickets are sold.
[*]Once a ticket is purchased, it must be used to complete the registration.
[*]The purchased ticket must be used within 5 days after the purchase, after which it will expire and no longer be usable.
[*]Players can check the registered date by hovering over the cube icon on the left side of the screen.
[*]The quest will only be shown on the first character that logs in that is over level 101+.
[*]If you happen to get reset, you should check if you got the coin again the following day and try to reregister. If this does not resolve your issue, please contact our Player Support team.
[*]We will process unresolved registration issues in the maintenance before the actual event start time, currently scheduled for January 5, 2023.
[/list]

[b]Magical Miracle Time Event - NA Reboot World[/b]


[b]Event Duration: Wednesday, January 5, 2023 - Sunday, January 10, 2023

[list]
[*]PST (UTC -8): 7:00 PM – 8:00 PM & 12:30 AM – 1:30 AM & 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM
[*]CET (UTC +1): 4:00 AM – 5:00 AM & 9:30 AM – 10:30 AM & 11:00 PM – 12:00 AM
[*]AEDT (UTC +11): 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM & 7:30 PM – 8:30 PM & 9:00 AM – 10:00 AM
[/list][/b]

[b]Event Details:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Note:[/b] Available in NA Reboot World only.
[*]During the noted periods, you will be able to Cube away with [b]Red Cubes[/b] and [b]Black Cubes[/b] with double the chance of rank-up, and even the chance of increasing your equipment's Potential rank [b]twice [/b]with a single cube, possibly letting you jump from Rare straight to Unique!
[*]All characters on the account on NA Reboot World will benefit from Miracle Time during your period, even if they are below Lv. 100.
[*]You cannot use skills or chairs, enhance equipment, change channels, or summon pets/familiars in the event map.
[/list]

notes.title: Maple Memo: GMS Roadmap Q1 2023
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

We’re here to share our Roadmap for Q1 2023! As always, please be mindful that it will list the notable updates but not everything that will be included in each patch. We recommend waiting for the respective update’s Update Preview post or Patch Notes post for details.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2096/maplestory-q1-2023-quarter.png[/img]
[list][*]January 2023[list][*]Hyper Ignition Event[/*][*]New Area: Odium[/*][*]Boss Extreme Mode[/*][/list][/*][*]Early February 2023[list][*]Neo Tokyo Event[/*][*]Fairy Bros' Golden Giveaway[/*][*]Cube Revamp[/*][/list][/*][*]March 2023[list][*]Super Yeti x Pink Bean World[/*][*]Grand Athenaeum Update[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2097/maplestory-q1-2023-roadmap.png[/img]

[b]January - Hyper Ignition Event[/b]

The Fireworks Festival Parade closes out with one last set of events and mini-games to enjoy as we ring in the new year! This is also your last chance to claim the many rewards from the Fireworks Festival Parade, so enjoy the fun and rocket off into 2023 with some exciting new activities to master!

[b]January - New Area: Odium[/b]

Beyond Karote, The Unending Tower, lies Odium, a building full of untouched mysteries behind its locked doors. No one knows who built it or with what purpose, and it’s a mystery as to what is happening within... Uncover the secrets as you make your way into Odium in this new content for players Lv. 275 and up!

[b]January - Boss Extreme Mode[/b]

Take on Seren and Black Mage on the newest difficulty mode, Extreme! These already-powerful bosses will have more HP to burn through and greater power in their attacks, but that's not all. The familiar mechanics of these bosses will be tweaked to make Extreme difficulty far more than just needing bigger numbers to win– you'll need to give it your all to have a chance!

[b]February - Neo Tokyo Event[/b]

Take a trip into the future and take part in the long-awaited Neo Tokyo Event! This limited-time, time-twisting tale will be opened for you to experience for the first time ever, with plenty of secrets to learn and temporal phenomena to untangle!

[b]February - Fairy Bros’ Golden Giveaway[/b]

The Fairy Bros are back to reward you for your attendance in MapleStory! Keep coming back to MapleStory throughout this update and the months to follow for a wide array of fantastic prizes! 

[b]February - Cube Revamp[/b]

We will be retiring the current slate of Cubes with the February update and providing a new set of Cubes. The new set of Cubes will have a chance for double rank-up and there will be changes to how Cube Fragments function. You can see the full details on the [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/78538/upcoming-cube-changes]Upcoming Cube Changes post[/url].

[b]March - Super Yeti x Pink Bean World[/b]

The chaotic ball of energy Pink Bean, and the kind-yet-powerful Yeti are back again, and their rivalry hasn't cooled down at all! Enjoy these two unique playable jobs and show off their powerful skills once again!

[b]March - Grand Athenaeum Update[/b]

The Grand Athenaeum is being updated with a look back on some high level content! Re-experience the events of the Arcane River and Grandis storylines that you've already completed!

We hope you’re excited by this high-level view of the content and events arriving to GMS between January - March 2023. As always, our goal with these roadmaps is to provide information that players may be curious about and assist players with advanced preparation. Please keep in mind that there is more content on the way in addition to those listed above, so we advise players to refer to the Update Preview post and Patch Notes post for the finalized details for every game update. If plans change due to unforeseen circumstances, we will have a mid-update post to inform players of the changes to the proposed timeline. Have a happy holidays and we’ll see you in the new year with the next roadmap!

Thank you,

Evolys and the MapleStory Team

notes.title: Upcoming Cube Changes
notes.content:
Attention Maplers,

As noted in the [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/78539/maple-memo-gms-roadmap-q1-2023]Q1 2023 Roadmap post[/url], MapleStory will be retiring the current set of Cubes with our February update, currently scheduled for [b]February 8, 2023[/b], and releasing a new slate of Cubes, utilizing a new Cube Fragment system, and allowing some Cubes to have a chance for double rank-ups.

The following existing cubes will be discontinued starting February 8, 2023:
[list][*][b]Occult Cubes[/b][/*][*][b]Bonus Occult Cubes[/b][/*][*][b]Master Craftsman’s Cubes[/b][/*][*][b]Meister’s Cubes[/b][/*][*][b]Red Cubes[/b][/*][*][b]Black Cubes[/b][/*][*][b]Bonus Potential Cubes[/b][/*][*][b]White Cubes[/b][/*][*][b]Karma Meister’s Cubes[/b][/*][*][b]Karma Master Craftsman’s Cubes[/b][/*][*][b]Karma Bonus Occult Cubes[/b][/*][/list]
The following new cubes will be released on February 8, 2023:
[list][*][b]Mystical Cubes[/b]: Obtained in-game. Can be used on Rare to Epic items.[/*][*][b]Bonus Mystical Cubes[/b]: Obtained in-game. Can be used on items up to Rare tier.[/*][*][b]Hard Cubes[/b]: Obtained in-game. Can be used on Rare to Unique items. There is a chance of double rank up if used on Rare items.[/*][*][b]Solid Cubes[/b]: Obtained in-game. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items. There is a chance of double rank up if used on Rare items.[/*][*][b]Glowing Cubes[/b]: Can be purchased from Cash Shop. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items, with a chance for a double rank-up.[/*][*][b]Bright Cubes[/b]: Can be purchased from Cash Shop. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items, with a chance for double rank-up and the option to choose before or after Potential lines.[/*][*][b]Bonus Glowing Cubes[/b]: Can be purchased from Cash Shop. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items, with a chance for double rank-up.[/*][*][b]Bonus Bright Cubes[/b]: Can be purchased from Cash Shop event sales. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items, with a chance for double rank-up and the option to choose before or after Potential lines.[/*][*][b]Karma Solid Cubes[/b]: Obtained through in-game events. Can be used on Rare to Legendary untradeable items.[/*][*][b]Karma Hard Cubes[/b]: Obtained through in-game events. Can be used on Rare to Unique untradeable items.[/*][*][b]Karma Bonus Mysterious Glowing Cubes[/b]: Obtained in-game. Can be used on Rare untradeable items.[/*][/list]
There will also be adjustments to how the Cube Fragment system works. The new Cubes will give new Cube Fragments when used, and these Fragments can be exchanged for a variety of items listed below:
[list][*][b]Advanced Potential Scroll[/b]: 5 Cube Fragments[/*][*][b]Special Potential Scroll[/b]: 10 Cube Fragments[/*][*][b]Bonus Potential Scroll 70%[/b]: 15 Cube Fragments[/*][*][b]Perfect Potential Stamp[/b]: 30 Cube Fragments[/*][*][b]Perfect Bonus Potential Stamp[/b]: 50 Cube Fragments[/*][*][b]Special Bonus Potential Stamp[/b]: 100 Cube Fragments[/*][*][b]Epic Potential Scroll 80%[/b]: 100 Cube Fragments[/*][/list]
Existing Cube Fragments – including [b]Red Cube Fragments[/b], [b]Black Cube Fragments[/b], [b]Bonus Potential Cube Fragments[/b], and [b]White Cube Fragments[/b] – that are obtained prior to the February 8, 2023 update will be usable until [b]March 22, 2023[/b].

During the February patch, any existing unused Cubes that remain in players’ inventory will be replaced with the corresponding new Cubes, on a 1:1 basis. In addition, during the December update, currently scheduled for [b]December 14, 2022[/b], the permanent duration Red Cubes and Black Cubes that can be purchased in Reboot world’s Cash Shop for mesos will be changed to have a 90-day duration. Reboot world players who purchased the permanent duration Red and Black Cubes from the Cash Shop prior to this duration change will have the option to request a meso refund via the Maple Admin NPC from [b]December 14, 2022 (after maintenance)[/b] to [b]February 8, 2023 (before maintenance)[/b]. The requested refunds will be processed in two iterations - once during the [b]January 5, 2023 maintenance[/b], and once during the [b]February 8, 2023 maintenance[/b].

Finally, we will be running a Miracle Time event during the December patch for all worlds during the following times:

[b]Aurora, Bera, Elysium, Scania, and Luna worlds:[/b]
[list][*]UTC: December 17 at 8:30 AM - 9:30 AM, 10:00 PM - 11:00 PM[/*][*]UTC: December 18 at 3:00 AM - 4:00 AM[/*][/list]
[b]Reboot worlds:[/b]
[list][*]UTC: December 18 at 8:30 AM - 9:30 AM, 10:00 PM - 11:00 PM[/*][*]UTC: December 19 at 3:00 AM - 4:00 AM[/*][/list]
Reboot will be running Miracle Time without the registration again. There will be a 2-3 second delay between Cubing attempts during Miracle Time to help alleviate the lag. tags.feature: MapleStory will be retiring the current set of Cubes with our February update, currently scheduled for [b]February 8, 2023[/b], and releasing a new slate of Cubes, utilizing a new Cube Fragment system, and allowing some Cubes to have a chance for double rank-ups.
[b]Mystical Cubes[/b]: Obtained in-game. Can be used on Rare to Epic items.
[b]Bonus Mystical Cubes[/b]: Obtained in-game. Can be used on items up to Rare tier.
[b]Hard Cubes[/b]: Obtained in-game. Can be used on Rare to Unique items. There is a chance of double rank up if used on Rare items.
[b]Solid Cubes[/b]: Obtained in-game. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items. There is a chance of double rank up if used on Rare items.
[b]Glowing Cubes[/b]: Can be purchased from Cash Shop. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items, with a chance for a double rank-up.
[b]Bright Cubes[/b]: Can be purchased from Cash Shop. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items, with a chance for double rank-up and the option to choose before or after Potential lines.
[b]Bonus Glowing Cubes[/b]: Can be purchased from Cash Shop. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items, with a chance for double rank-up.

[b]Karma Hard Cubes[/b]: Obtained through in-game events. Can be used on Rare to Unique untradeable items.
[b]Karma Bonus Mysterious Glowing Cubes[/b]: Obtained in-game. Can be used on Rare untradeable items.
There will also be adjustments to how the Cube Fragment system works. The new Cubes will give new Cube Fragments when used, and these Fragments can be exchanged for a variety of items listed below:

[b]Special Potential Scroll[/b]: 10 Cube Fragments
[b]Bonus Potential Scroll 70%[/b]: 15 Cube Fragments
[b]Perfect Potential Stamp[/b]: 30 Cube Fragments
[b]Perfect Bonus Potential Stamp[/b]: 50 Cube Fragments
[b]Special Bonus Potential Stamp[/b]: 100 Cube Fragments
[b]Epic Potential Scroll 80%[/b]: 100 Cube Fragments

Existing Cube Fragments – including [b]Red Cube Fragments[/b], [b]Black Cube Fragments[/b], [b]Bonus Potential Cube Fragments[/b], and [b]White Cube Fragments[/b] – that are obtained prior to the February 8, 2023 update will be usable until [b]March 22, 2023[/b].
During the February patch, any existing unused Cubes that remain in players’ inventory will be replaced with the corresponding new Cubes, on a 1:1 basis.

tags.balance_change: In addition, during the December update, currently scheduled for [b]December 14, 2022[/b], the permanent duration Red Cubes and Black Cubes that can be purchased in Reboot world’s Cash Shop for mesos will be changed to have a 90-day duration.

notes.title: Monster Park Extreme is Back!
notes.content:
Monster Park Extreme is back! Characters that are Lv. 260 or higher can now take their party of up to 4 players into the Extreme difficulty of the classic Monster Park encounter.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1966/about-monster-park-extreme-maplestory.png[/img]

Venture into the new Unknown Area and hunt down the monsters that your friendly guide Spiegelmann calls out to you in order to empower the altar in the center of the zone. Once you take down the requisite number of monsters, you can activate the altar, summoning the powerful Extreme Bigfoot monster!

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1968/monster-park-extreme-combat-maplestory.png[/img]

You'll only have a limited amount of time to attack Extreme Bigfoot until he flees from the field, so make sure you're ready for him and pile on the damage! Once Extreme Bigfoot escapes, you'll need to defeat more monsters to charge the altar and bring him out again to pour on more damage. Extreme Bigfoot will escape four times in total, and on his fifth appearance he'll stay until he's either defeated, or your 30-minute time limit in Monster Park Extreme elapses. Take down Extreme Bigfoot to complete the mode and earn your extremely large amount of EXP and [b]Monster Park Days-of-the-Week Box[/b]!

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1967/monster-park-extreme-bigfoot-maplestory.png[/img]

[b]Monster Park Extreme Details:[/b]
[list][*]Party of 1 to 4 players[/*][*]Monster Park Extreme has been closed for a long time but has now reopened![/*][*]Monster Park Extreme can be cleared only once a day per world. Clear count isn't deducted if you fail to clear or exit midway.[/*][*]The party leader of a party of 1-4 that are Lv. 260 or above can enter the Monster Park Extreme portal.[/*][*]Spiegelmann informs you of the type and number of enemies required to hunt when the game starts.[/*][*]The big altar in the middle of the map can be activated when the number of enemies you were informed about have been hunted. When one of the party members presses the Interact/Harvest key at the big altar, "Extreme Bigfoot" is summoned.[/*][*]Extreme Bigfoot appears somewhere on the map and escapes after some time passes. Spiegelmann lets you know the remaining time until it escapes.[/*][*]When Extreme Bigfoot escapes from the map, you can hunt and activate the big altar again to summon it.[/*][*]When Extreme Bigfoot is defeated within the time limit, you can clear Monster Park Extreme.[/*][*]If you don't defeat Extreme Bigfoot within the time limit, it will be processed as a fail.[/*][*]Extreme Bigfoot won't escape anymore after escaping several times.[/*][/list]
[b]Monster Park Extreme Rewards:[/b]
[list][*][b]EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Monster Park Days-of-the-Week Box:[/b] Untradeable, Permanent.[/*][/list][h2]Monster Park Improvements[/h2]
We've also implemented a few improvements to Monster Park in general with the Ignition: Cygnus Knights update earlier in the month, check them out below!

notes.title: Hyper Burning Event and Burning World!
notes.content:
The Ignition: Cygnus Knights Redux update is here, and Tera Burning Plus has been upgraded to [b]Hyper Burning[/b], with [b]Burning World[/b] to make it even easier to now reach Lv. 250! Make a new character to race up to Lv. 250, gain new rewards with the [b]Burning World Step Up Event[/b], and keep advancing your characters through Burning World before heading to another world in February's [b]Burning World Leap[/b]!

[b]Hyper Burning[/b][/h2][list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 16, 2022 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, February 7, 2023 3:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 16, 2022 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 8, 2023 12:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, November 16, 2022 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 8, 2023 10:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in all worlds, as well as Burning World, [b]except for Zero characters[/b].

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional [b]two levels[/b] all the way up to Lv. 250! You also have the option to designate one of your existing Lv. 200-248 characters as 'Hyper Burning' instead, allowing them to gain that benefit!


In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including [b]Root Abyss and Fafnir gear[/b]! When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training! You will receive additional rewards on your ‘Hyper Burning’ character at Lv. 200, Lv. 210, and every 5 levels after Lv. 210, up to Lv. 250!

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5786/newteraeffect.png[/img]

[h2][b]Burning World[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Wednesday, November 16, 2022 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 8, 2023 (Start of Maintenance)[/b][/*][/list]
Burning World is a special world with special rules that will exist only for the duration of the Burning World event, filled with boosts to make it easier than ever to level up fast. While on Burning World, all characters will gain the special [b]Burning[/b] skill, which grants the following bonuses:
[list][*][b]1.5x EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +50[/b][/*][*][b]Damage against Normal Monsters +30%[/b][/*][*][b]Damage against Bosses +30%[/b][/*][*][b]Critical Rate +30%[/b][/*][*][b]Critical Damage +30%[/b][/*][*][b]Knockback Resistance +100%[/b][/*][*][b]STR/DEX/INT/LUK +50[/b][/*][*][b]MaxHP/MaxMP +2500[/b][/*][/list]
You will also be able to create [b]three Mega Burning [/b]characters, who operate in the same manner as in previous Mega Burning events: After reaching Lv. 10, every time that character levels up, they will also gain [b]two bonus levels[/b], all the way up to Lv. 150. Combined with the Burning EXP bonus and boosted damage, you'll be able to power your way through those levels faster than ever before!

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1584/burning-world-character-selection.png[/img]

Additionally, even after your Mega Burning characters have been created, you'll be able to create another three characters to level up and leap, which will still benefit from the Burning skill! Please note that, the default number of Character Slots on Burning World is six, and Character Slot Expansion Coupons cannot be used in Burning World. [b]Additionally, Zero characters cannot be selected as a "Burning" character on character creation[/b], but can be selected as your Hyper Burning character upon reaching Lv. 200 and completing Story Act Quest 2.

As the saying goes, the light that burns twice as bright burns half as long, and the Burning World will burn very brightly indeed. However, while this new world will be consumed at the end of it all, a new life awaits your characters in the other worlds of MapleStory!

Lv. 150+ characters in Burning World will be allowed to leap to another world of your choosing during the World Leap period, taking their equipped items, inventory, and mesos with them to join their new communities. When this period begins, all Burning World characters will be moved to the Burning Leap Zone map, where they will be able to speak to the NPC Mover to complete their exodus.
[list][*]Characters in Burning World must be at least Lv. 150 in order to World Leap, whether they were Mega Burning characters or not.[list][*]Zero characters must be both Lv. 150+ and having completed Story Quest Act 2.[/*][*]It will not be possible to leave the Burning Leap Zone map during this period, making it impossible to gain any more EXP. [b]Make sure you're Lv. 150 before the February 8 maintenance[/b]![/*][/list][/*][*]You do [b]not[/b] need an empty character slot on the destination world for your new character (you will be granted a free Character Slot if you are at your unlocked limit on that world), however if you have reached the maximum character limit on that world, you will need to delete a character in order to make room for them.[/*][*]Characters can be transferred to [b]Aurora, Bera, Elysium, Luna, and Scania worlds only[/b].[/*][*]Characters in Guilds will not be able to World Leap until they have either left or disbanded their Guild.[/*][*]Your character's equipped items, inventory, and mesos will be transferred with your character, but items within your Storage, Cash Shop Inventory, mail, and auction house will not be. [b]Make sure you clear everything out before taking the big leap![/b][/*][*]You may send your Burning World characters all to the same world, or to different worlds.[/*][*]Medals obtained from regularly-resetting rankings will not be transferred, and your rankings in those pieces of content will also not be transferred.[/*][*]Ignition Coin Shop and Flare Coin Shop item quantity limits will follow the limit of the world that the character leaps to.[/*][*]Ignition Coins will be transferred with the World Leap, but Flare Coins will not be transferred so remember to use all your Flare Coins before the start of the World Leap period![/*][*]Remember to claim all the Ignition Flame Festival rewards through the Flame Festival UI before leaping if you participated in the event on Burning World.[/*][/list]

tags.feature: The Ignition: Cygnus Knights Redux update is here, and Tera Burning Plus has been upgraded to [b]Hyper Burning[/b], with [b]Burning World[/b] to make it even easier to now reach Lv. 250!

Make a new character to race up to Lv. 250, gain new rewards with the [b]Burning World Step Up Event[/b], and keep advancing your characters through Burning World before heading to another world in February's [b]Burning World Leap[/b]!
After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional [b]two levels[/b] all the way up to Lv. 250!
You also have the option to designate one of your existing Lv. 200-248 characters as 'Hyper Burning' instead, allowing them to gain that benefit!
In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including [b]Root Abyss and Fafnir gear[/b]!
When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training!
You will receive additional rewards on your ‘Hyper Burning’ character at Lv. 200, Lv. 210, and every 5 levels after Lv. 210, up to Lv. 250!
Reach level 250 fast on a new or existing character with the Hyper Burning event!
After creating a new character, you will be given an option to give it a ‘Hyper Burning’ effect.
You [b]cannot[/b] go back to give it a ‘Burning’ effect after refusing to do so during character creation.
After your ‘Hyper Burning’ character reaches Lv. 10, they will start to earn two additional levels each time your character gains a level up to Lv. 250.
You will receive special Hyper Burning Rewards when your ‘Burning’ character meets the listed level milestones.
Alternatively, you may elect to set one of your existing Lv. 200 - 248 characters as 'Hyper Burning', by selecting it on character select screen and clicking on 'Set as Hyper Burning'.
Doing so will prevent you from designating a newly-created character as 'Hyper Burning'.
You will still be able to create 'Mega Burning' characters on Burning World.
There’s more rewards waiting for you past Lv. 200!
Once your ‘Burning’ character reaches Lv. 200 (or you designate an existing character as Burning), you can obtain [b]Bonus Rewards[/b] up until Lv. 250.

Burning World is a special world with special rules that will exist only for the duration of the Burning World event, filled with boosts to make it easier than ever to level up fast.

While on Burning World, all characters will gain the special [b]Burning[/b] skill, which grants the following bonuses:

You will also be able to create [b]three Mega Burning [/b]characters, who operate in the same manner as in previous Mega Burning events: After reaching Lv. 10, every time that character levels up, they will also gain [b]two bonus levels[/b], all the way up to Lv. 150.
Combined with the Burning EXP bonus and boosted damage, you'll be able to power your way through those levels faster than ever before!
Additionally, even after your Mega Burning characters have been created, you'll be able to create another three characters to level up and leap, which will still benefit from the Burning skill!
Please note that, the default number of Character Slots on Burning World is six, and Character Slot Expansion Coupons cannot be used in Burning World.

The Burning World Step Up event is here to enhance your leveling experience in Burning World even further!
Complete missions available to your Burning World character’s level and step-up while receiving special rewards!
Accept the "Participate in the Burning World Step Up Event!" quest within the star event notifier on the left side of the screen.
Once you click the Burning World Step Up icon within the star event on the left side of your screen, you will have access to the Step Up UI.
When you reach the specified level milestone, remember to click ‘Mission Start!’ button to start the mission.
When you complete the mission, click ‘Mission Complete!’ button to receive the reward and move on to the next mission.
Burning World Step Up event can be completed by any characters in Burning World, regardless of having the ‘Burning’ effect or not.
Burning World Step Up event progress is shared with all your characters in Burning World.
There are certain missions that Zero characters cannot complete. However, you are able to complete the mission on a different character and claim the reward on the Zero character.
Burning World Step Up event rewards can be obtained once per world.

notes.title: Wild Totem Discontinuation and Star Force Enhancement Cost Reduction
notes.content:
Hi Maplers, 

We’d like to provide a status update regarding Wild Totems, which many of you have been curious about since our adjustments to Kanna’s Kishin Shoukan skill. As previously mentioned in the [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/71380/maple-memo-addressing-recent-issues-and-upcoming-content][b]Maple Memo: Addressing Recent Issues and Upcoming Content[/b][/url], we made adjustments to the Kishin Shoukan skill to align with the overall direction of the game by changing the spawn-enhancing effect from the skill to a 10% additional EXP effect. In the same update as the Kishin Shoukan skill changes, Star Force enhancement costs were reduced by 20% in cumulative enhancement cost (based on the 24-Star enhancement); as we understood that spawn-enhancing effects had a large role in meso acquisition, and we hoped to alleviate the difficulty of the transition by reducing the cost in the area where most mesos are spent by players.

In alignment with the changes to Kishin Shoukan’s skill effect, Wild Totems will be discontinued in the next upcoming update. As we’ve done when Kishin Shoukan skill was changed to no longer provide spawn-enhancing effects, we will further reduce Star Force enhancement costs by an additional 20% when discontinuing Wild Totems. There will also be some changes made to the Fairy Bros Daily Gifts rewards to reflect the discontinuation of Wild Totems. The below changes to Fairy Bros Daily Gifts rewards will be reflected starting [b]November 1, 2022[/b].
[list][*]Day 8 will now provide Mega Burninator x1[/*][*]Day 10 and Day 19 will now provide 2x EXP Coupon (30 min) x2[/*][/list]
The discontinuation of Wild Totems is currently scheduled to be implemented with our November update, tentatively scheduled for [b]November 16, 2022[/b]. Wild Totems that are already in players’ inventory prior to the November update will remain usable with their current functionality until the item expires. Any Wild Totem coupons without an expiration date will be usable until [b]December 31, 2022[/b]. 

Thank you,  

The MapleStory Team

notes.title: v.236 - Midnight Carnival Patch Notes
notes.content:
Halloween is approaching and Maple World is preparing for the [b]Night Troupe[/b] and various Halloween-themed events! Hunt monsters and participate in events to raise your [b]Festival Designer Rank[/b] and use the [b]Festival Decorating[/b] to design the festival! More buildings means more passive skills that benefit all characters eligible for the event. Earn bonus EXP with the [b]Ride Attractions[/b] or obtain growth enhancements like [b]Arcane Symbols[/b] from the [b]Human Cannonball Attraction[/b]! Increasing your [b]Festival Designer Rank[/b] will also unlock handy bonuses such as a [b]Character Burninator[/b] or the [b]Safety Zone[/b]. Special activities like the [b]Giant Iceberg Breaker Festival[/b] will be available to help you earn additional [b]Troupe Points[/b] in addition to the other events. A special [b]Home[/b] story chapter is also available, leading to a new [b]Shopping[/b] category for Halloween-themed [b]Furnishings[/b]! The [b]Midnight Carnival[/b] awaits!

Read the Midnight Carnival Patch Notes [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/76820/v-236-midnight-carnival-patch-notes]here[/url]!

notes.title: Maple Memo: GMS Roadmap Q4 2022
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

We’re here to share our Global MapleStory (GMS) Roadmap for Q4 2022! As always, please be mindful that it will list the notable updates but not everything that will be included in each patch. We recommend waiting for the respective update’s Update Preview post or Patch Notes post for details.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2054/banner_2022_q4_roadmap_timeline.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Early October Update 2022[/b]
[list][*]Night Troupe[/*][*]Halloween Candy Party[/*][*]Home Halloween Event[/*][*]Cash Inventory Transfer Event (Early November)[/*][/list][/*][*][b]November Update 2022[/b]
[list][*]Cygnus Knights Redux[/*][*]Monster Park Extreme[/*][*]Hyper Burning[/*][*]Job Balances[/*][*]Fireworks Festival Parade[/*][/list][/*][*][b]December Update 2022[/b]
[list][*]New Area: Odium (January Release)[/*][*]Boss Extreme Mode (January Release)[/*][*]New Overseas Event[/*][*]Holiday Events[/*][*]Fireworks Festival Parade (Continued)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2097/2022_q4_roadmap_timeline.jpg?width=964&height=1017&mode=max[/img]

[b]Early October - Midnight Carnival[/b]
Night Troupe at Rien awaits! Take a look around and select an attraction that best suits your needs. You’ll receive generous perks that include stat bonuses, EXP buffs, and more. If spending your time at Rien isn’t giving you the chills, join the spooky Halloween Candy adventures and decorate your Home with Halloween furnishings for an eerie touch. There are plenty of events and rewards to keep everyone entertained!

[b]November - Cygnus Knights Redux[/b]
Our loyal Cygnus Knights will undergo a revamp this winter! Here’s a list of the Cygnus Knights that will have their skills revamped:
[list][*][b]Mihile[/b][/*][*][b]Dawn Warrior[/b][/*][*][b]Blaze Wizard[/b][/*][*][b]Wind Archer[/b][/*][*][b]Night Walker[/b][/*][*][b]Thunder Breaker[/b][/*][/list]
There will be more changes on the way in addition to the skill revamps but we’ll share detailed information when it gets closer to the update release date.

[b]November - Hyper Burning[/b]
You’ve never seen burning this hot ever before… Hyper Burning will allow players to earn an additional 2 levels for each level up until the character reaches not Lv. 215, not Lv. 230, but all the way up to Lv. 250! Break the limit with Hyper Burning!

[b]November/December - Fireworks Festival Parade[/b]
We’re holding a Fireworks Festival Parade in celebration of our winter update and you are invited! Come participate in exciting events and complete daily, weekly, and monthly missions to earn event coins and special rewards. The event shops have plenty of functional and cosmetic items in stock for you to grab. Enjoy the festival with Maplers and make memories that are simply unforgettable.

[b]December (January Release) - Odium[/b]
Beyond Karote, The Unending Tower, lies Odium, a building full of untouched mysteries behind its locked doors. No one knows who built it or with what purpose, and it’s a mystery as to what is happening within... Uncover the secrets as you make your way into Odium!

Those are the high-level contents and events arriving to GMS between early October - December 2022 that we wanted to share with you today. We hope these roadmaps have been providing information that players may be curious about and that it assists with advanced preparation. Please do keep in mind that there is more content on the way in addition to those listed above, so we advise players to refer to the Update Preview post and Patch Notes post for the finalized details for every game update. If plans change due to unforeseen circumstances, we will have a mid-update post to inform players of the changes to the proposed timeline.We hope you enjoy our winter updates as well as the holidays until we return with the next roadmap!

Thank you,
Evolys and the MapleStory Team

notes.title: Upcoming NX Prepaid and NX Credit Merge
notes.content:
Attention Maplers,

With the v.236 update, currently scheduled for early October, we will be making a major change to how NX, the paid currency for many Nexon games including MapleStory, is handled. With this change, [b]NX Prepaid and NX Credit will be merged[/b], with every Nexon player's balance of the two currencies being combined together. We hope to make for a simpler process for our customers, no longer having to sort out between the two forms of currency, and how each is acquired.

As part of this, there will be some changes to how certain Cash Shop purchases and actions function, in order to prevent fraudulent charges and protect the game economy. Some of these changes have already gone live as part of the v.235 Update on August 31st, and include:
[list][*]Cash Shop Items that were previously unpurchasable with NX Credit can now be purchased normally.[/*][*]Cash Shop Items that could only be purchased at a certain level with NX Credit no longer have any level restriction on purchase when being purchased.[/*][*]Purchased items cannot be gifted to other players within 7 days of first NX charge. Note, if you have already charged NX to your account in the past, you will not be restricted from gifting.[/*][*]Note: First Charge restrictions that are in place for NX Credit will also be applied to the merged NX. If you have cleared those restrictions in the past, then that status will be carried over to the new merged NX.[/*][/list]
We will let you know more as the update approaches.

- The MapleStory Team

tags.feature: NX Prepaid and NX Credit will be merged
Cash Shop Items that were previously unpurchasable with NX Credit can now be purchased normally.
Cash Shop Items that could only be purchased at a certain level with NX Credit no longer have any level restriction on purchase when being purchased.
Purchased items cannot be gifted to other players within 7 days of first NX charge. Note, if you have already charged NX to your account in the past, you will not be restricted from gifting.

Note: First Charge restrictions that are in place for NX Credit will also be applied to the merged NX. If you have cleared those restrictions in the past, then that status will be carried over to the new merged NX.

notes.title: MapleStory x MapleStory M Link Event
notes.content:
Maple World isn't just available on your computer! MapleStory M has been available on Android and iOS mobile devices for over four years, allowing you to create characters and hunt monsters on the go. We're teaming up with them to give you a power boost in MapleStory M by playing your MapleStory characters, with daily missions to complete and the ability to assign your highest level MapleStory character to MapleStory M's Legion Synergy Grid!

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1163/maplestory-x-maplestory-m-link-event.png[/img][/u]

[b]Event Details:[/b]

[b]Daily Missions[/b]
[list][*]You can now earn rewards in [url=https://maplestorym.nexon.com]MapleStory M[/url] by completing daily missions in MapleStory![/*][*][b]Requirements:[/b] Lv. 60 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2).[/*][*]Accept the "[MapleStory M] Mobile MapleStory!" quest within the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. You will then have access to the MapleStory M Link UI.[/*][*]You can now link your MapleStory account to your MapleStory M account using the MapleStory M Link UI, instead of talking to Maple Administrator!
[list][*]Click the button on the bottom of the UI to proceed with linking your accounts.
[list][*]Linking accounts via Maple Administrator will only be available until July 28 at 12:59 AM UTC.[/*][/list][/*][*]Please make sure your MapleStory account is linked to your MapleStory M account prior to completing the missions.[/*][*]You must have a character Lv. 60 and above to link your MapleStory account to your MapleStory M account.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will be given the following daily MapleStory missions to complete:
[list][*]Defeat 500 enemies near your level[/*][*]Reach 300 Combo Kills[/*][*]Defeat 2 Elite Monsters or Elite Champions[/*][*]Activate Runes 2 times[/*][*]Clear Monster Park 1 time[/*][/list][/*][*]Once you complete the daily missions in MapleStory, you must click the "Claim" button on the MapleStory M Link UI. Afterward, you can receive rewards on the MapleStory M account linked to the MapleStory account based on the number of missions you’ve completed. 
[list][*]You can claim the rewards in MapleStory M via the Mail.[/*][/list][/*][*]Daily mission completion is shared between your characters once a mission has been completed by a character.[/*][*]Daily missions can be completed once per MapleStory account and will reset [b]every day at 12:00 AM UTC[/b].[/*][*]Daily mission rewards can be claimed once per MapleStory account.[/*][/list]
[b]Legion Block[/b]
[list][*]You can assign your highest level MapleStory character to MapleStory M’s Legion Synergy Grid.[/*][*]The MapleStory character Legion Block can be placed without being limited by the number of characters placed on the MapleStory M Legion Synergy Grid.[/*][*]The quality of the Legion Block will increase based on the level of your highest level MapleStory character. The rank will be the same level as that of MapleStory M. 
[list][*][b]B:[/b] Lv. 60[/*][*][b]A:[/b] Lv. 100[/*][*][b]S:[/b] Lv. 150[/*][*][b]SS:[/b] Lv. 200[/*][/list][/*][*]Legion Synergy Grid effect will be applied and other perks related to Legion will be provided as well.[/*][/list]
[b]MapleStory M Rewards:[/b]
[list][*][b]Daily Missions[/b]
[list][*]Complete 1 Daily Mission
[list][*][b]Red EXP Increase Ticket (x2)[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete 2 Daily Missions
[list][*][b]Orange EXP Increase Ticket[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete 3 Daily Missions
[list][*][b]Auto-Battle Charge Ticket (10 min)[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete 4 Daily Missions
[list][*][b]Yellow EXP Increase Ticket[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete 5 Daily Missions
[list][*][b]Automatic Battle Reload Coupon (10 min) (x3)[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]MapleStory M Legion Block of highest level MapleStory character[/b][/*][/list]

notes.title: v.234 - Destiny: Homecoming Patch Notes
notes.content:
The new [b]Home[/b] offers a new way for Maplers to express their personality and interests through intricate designs! Design your dream home with furniture placement and hang out with your friends while listening to your favorite MapleStory background music! Relax in the comfort of your virtual home. When you feel like venturing outside your comfy space, take on the challenge and test your strength against the boss [b]Kalos[/b], fierce guardian at the top of [b]Karote, The Unending Tower[/b]. Along with everything else, [b]Beast Tamer[/b] and [b]Zero[/b] character creation will be available on all worlds, including Reboot and Burning World. All of this and more await you in the [b]Destiny: Homecoming[/b] update!

Read the Destiny: Homecoming Patch Notes [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/75294/v-234-destiny-homecoming-patch-notes]here[/url]!

notes.title: [Update Jun 14] Compensation for Players who Used Cubes without MMT Effect
notes.content:
[b][Update Jun 14][/b] Updated the post to clarify that only Cubes that were used during the expected event period and did not benefit from the Magical Miracle Time bonus will qualify for the refund.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience.

Thank you,

notes.title: Magical Miracle Time Benefits and Upcoming Reboot World Maintenance
notes.content:
Attention Maplers,

[u][b]Receiving Magicial Miracle Time Benefits[/b][/u]
We received a report about an issue where players would not properly receive the Magical Miracle Time (MMT) benefits until logging in or changing channels to see the scroll announcement and the “It’s Miracle Time!” badge on top of the screen. While we investigate this issue, we ask players to please make sure you see the scroll announcement and badge prior to proceeding with your cubing activities once MMT starts for your registered date. This will ensure that you will properly receive the benefits of MMT during the event duration.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1027/double-miracle-time-maplestory-notice.png[/img]

[u][b]Upcoming Reboot World Maintenance on July 7[/b][/u]
We plan to have a Reboot world maintenance on [b]Thursday, July 7th[/b], in order to address the issue where MMT Pre-Registration selection was not saved after logging out for some players. For players that were affected by the above issue and were unable to properly register even with the temporary workaround from [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/75337/reboot-world-magical-miracle-time-pre-registration-issues]our post[/url], the maintenance will set the MMT date the player initially registered for prior to the date not saving. Players that were able to successfully re-register during the pre-registration period will keep the date displayed on their MMT cube icon. Please keep a look out for our maintenance post this week for the exact time and details.

However, the players that purchased the July 6 and July 7 MMT tickets would have had their sessions end by the time we have the maintenance. For these players, we plan to hold a make-up MMT event at a later date. Please keep an eye out for updates for more details. Thank you.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Maple Memo: GMS Roadmap Q3 2022
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

As mentioned in our [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/73984/maple-memo-update-on-the-january-gms-roadmap]April 20th Maple Memo[/url], we will be releasing Global MapleStory (GMS) roadmaps every quarter that cover the high-level contents and changes coming within the next 3-4 months. Since it’s only high-level contents and changes, please be mindful that it will list the notable updates but not everything that will be included in each patch. We recommend waiting for the respective update’s Update Preview post or Patch Notes post for details. Now without further ado, here is the GMS roadmap for July - early October 2022!

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/2220/july-october-2022-roadmap-update-timeline-badge.png[/img]
[list][*][b]July 2022[/b]
[list][*]Boss Kalos[/*][*]New Lv. 250 Equipment Set[/*][*]Player Housing Content[/*][*]Starlight Symphony Event (Continued)[/*][*]Zero and Beast Tamer Creation Event[/*][/list][/*][*][b]August 2022[/b]
[list][*]Mu Lung Dojo Revamp[/*][*]Legion Rank Expansion[/*][*]Kao’s Memories[/*][*]Theme Dungeon: Ellin Forest Revamp[/*][*]Better Maple[/*][*]Spiegelmann's Starlight Box[/*][*]Maple Pop Star Dreams![/*][/list][/*][*][b]Early October 2022[/b]
[list][*]Night Troupe[/*][*]Halloween Events[/*][*]Cash Inventory Transfer Event[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/2221/july-october-2022-roadmap-update-timeline.png?width=852px&height=714px[/img]

[b]July - Destiny: Homecoming Update[/b]
Briefly introduced on our [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/micro-site/destiny]Destiny microsite[/url] and our [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/73984/maple-memo-update-on-the-january-gms-roadmap]April 20th Maple Memo[/url], the second part of our summer update, Destiny: Homecoming, is coming soon on July 20th. It will introduce not only the boss Kalos in Karote, The Unending Tower but also the Lv. 250 Eternal Equipment Set. Our long awaited Home, a player housing system where players can decorate to their heart’s content, will also be included to put Maplers’ FashionStory to the next level. Starlight Symphony will continue with a few new events and Zero and Beast Tamer Character Creation Event will make a return.

[b]August - Mu Lung Dojo Revamp & Legion Rank Expansion[/b]
Up, up, and away! Mu Lung Dojo will be expanded from 80 floors to 100 floors, accompanied with other improvements. A new Legion Rank will be added above the current Legendary Legion Rank. The new Legion Rank V will require 12,500 cumulative level and 5,000 Legion Coins to rank up while it provides 45 assigned members and accumulates up to 1,000 Legion Coins.

[b]August - Spiegelmann’s Starlight Box & Maple Pop Star Dreams![/b]
Spiegelmann is preparing a Starlight Box filled with special gifts! Once players complete the daily mission by defeating monsters near their level, players will earn valuable rewards such as Symbol Selector Coupons, Growth Potion Selector Coupons, and various cosmetic items. Ever dreamt of being a pop star? Players can defeat monsters near their level and collect quest items to trade in and decorate their very own stage! Players will get to unlock customizations for the chair and receive functional and cosmetic rewards when they reach level milestones.

[b]Early October - Night Troupe[/b]
Night Troupe is returning, but in Rien this time! Players can enjoy various attractions and receive generous perks that include stat bonuses, EXP buffs, and more. There are plenty of events and rewards to keep everyone entertained so make sure to keep an eye out for the details once the update is near.

That’s the high-level contents and events we wanted to share about the upcoming GMS updates between July - early October 2022. We hope this roadmap sheds light on and provides information that players may be curious about and assists with advanced preparation. As mentioned, there are more contents coming than those listed so please refer to the Update Preview post and Patch Notes post for the finalized details. Though, if plans change due to unforeseen circumstances, we will post a mid-update to inform players of the changes to the proposed timeline. The next GMS Roadmap for Q4 2022 will be released tentatively near the end of September.

Thank you,
Mjollnir and the MapleStory Team

notes.title: [Update Jul 1] Magical Miracle Time - Reboot World
notes.content:
[b][Update Jul 1][/b] A character registering for Magical Miracle Time on Reboot World must be Lv. 101 or above. We apologize for the error in not communicating that before.

The Destiny update is in full swing, and with 14 revamped classes to dive into, there's a lot of gear that needs its full potential to be explored! Maplers on Reboot World will be able to sign-up for your own personal Miracle Time periods to use to Cube up your gear to its maximum Potentials! Those of you [b]not [/b]on Reboot World, [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/75080/magical-miracle-time-bera-scania-aurora-elysium-luna-and-burning-worlds]take a look at the Magical Miracle Time - Bera, Scania, Aurora, Elysium, Luna, and Burning Worlds post[/url] for instructions on when to join us for three hour-long Miracle Time periods on [b]Saturday, July 2[/b]!
[h1][b]Magical Miracle Time Registration - Reboot World
[/b][/h1]
[b]Event Duration:[/b]
[list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Thursday, June 30, 2022 5:00 PM - Tuesday, July 5, 2022 4:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CEST (UTC +2): Friday, July 1, 2022 2:00 AM - Wednesday, July 6, 2022 1:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEST (UTC +10): Friday, July 1, 2022 10:00 AM - Wednesday, July 6, 2022 9:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/2175/magical-miracle-time-registration-ticket-maplestory-reboot-world.png[/img]

[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]When the Registration Period begins, use the Star Event Notifier to accept the "[MMT] Magical Miracle Time Pre-registration" quest to be awarded a registration coin, and select which date you'd like to try to purchase a [b]Magical Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] for.[/*][*][b]Requirements[/b]: Characters on Reboot World that are Lv. 101 or above can register (all characters on the account on Reboot World will benefit from it, however).[/*][*]Use the Star Event Notifier to travel to the Miracle Time Registration Map, and speak to the NPC there to purchase a [b]Magical Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] for the previously selected day. In order to prevent overcrowding, [b]you will only have 60 seconds to make the purchase[/b], after which time you will be returned to the previous map you were on, and have to select a day again. Failing to purchase a ticket will not prevent you from accessing the same [b]Magical Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] vendor.[/*][*]Miracle Time will, as usual, occur during three hour-long periods during the day. For example, a [b]7/8 Magical Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] will enable Miracle Time during the following periods:[list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): 8:00 PM – 9:00 PM July 7, 2022 & 1:30 AM – 2:30 AM July 8, 2022 & 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM July 8, 2022[/b][/*][*][b]CEST (UTC +2): 5:00 AM – 6:00 AM July 8, 2022 & 10:30 AM – 11:30 AM July 8, 2022 & 12:00 AM – 1:00 AM July 9, 2022[/b][/*][*][b]AEST (UTC +10): 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM July 8, 2022 & 6:30 PM – 7:30 PM July 8, 2022 & 8:00 AM – 9:00 AM July 9, 2022[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]For the [b]July 6[/b] window, 1,800 tickets will be available initially, with an additional 900 available tickets restocking each day at [b]12:00 AM UTC[/b] and [b]12:00 PM UTC[/b], for a total of 9,000.[/*][*]For the [b]July 7 - 10[/b] windows, 1,200 tickets will be available initially for each day, with an additional 600 available tickets restocking each day at [b]12:00 AM UTC[/b] and [b]12:00 PM UTC[/b], for a total of 6,000 for each day.[/*][*]You can purchase and use only one ticket per world.[/*][*]Make sure you are free during the date you register for, these tickets [b]cannot be exchanged or refunded[/b]![/*][*]Players cannot enter the lobby map between [b]11:55 AM - 12:05 PM UTC [/b]and [b]11:55 PM - 12:05 AM UTC [/b]while the shops are being restocked.[/*][*]Players that purchased a ticket can no longer enter a lobby map where the registration tickets are sold.[/*][*]Once the player purchased the ticket, they must use the ticket by [b]July 6 at 2:00 AM UTC[/b] to complete the registration.[/*][*]Purchased ticket can be used for 5 days after the purchase.[/*][*]Players can check the registered date by hovering over the cube icon on the left side of the screen.[/*][/list][h1][b]Magical Miracle Time Event - Reboot World
[/b][/h1]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/2052/double-miracle-time-cubes-maplestory-reboot.png[/img]

[b]Event Duration: [/b][b]Wednesday, July 6, 2022[/b] - [b]Sunday, July 10, 2022[/b]

[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]You must use your [b]Magical Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] prior to [b]July 6 at 2:00 AM UTC[/b] to gain the benefits of the [b]Magical Miracle Time Event[/b].[/*][*][b]Note:[/b] Available in Reboot World only.[/*][*]You will gain the benefits of Miracle Time during three hour-long periods during the day. For example, a [b]7/8 Magical Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] will enable Miracle Time during the following periods:[list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): 8:00 PM – 9:00 PM July 7, 2022 & 1:30 AM – 2:30 AM July 8, 2022 & 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM July 8, 2022[/b][/*][*][b]CEST (UTC +2): 5:00 AM – 6:00 AM July 8, 2022 & 10:30 AM – 11:30 AM July 8, 2022 & 12:00 AM – 1:00 AM July 9, 2022[/b][/*][*][b]AEST (UTC +10): 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM July 8, 2022 & 6:30 PM – 7:30 PM July 8, 2022 & 8:00 AM – 9:00 AM July 9, 2022[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]During the noted periods, you will be able to Cube away with [b]Red Cubes[/b] and [b]Black Cubes[/b] with double the chance of rank-up, and even the chance of increasing your equipment's Potential rank [b]twice[/b] with a single cube, possibly letting you jump from Rare straight to Unique![/*][*]Activating a [b]Magical Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] on a world will enable doubled rank-up chance for [b]all of your characters on that world[/b]! Get prepared, gather your cubes, and enjoy this new way to powerfully cube your items![/*][*]All characters on the account on Reboot World will benefit from Miracle Time during your period, even if they are below Lv. 100.[/*][*]You cannot use skills or chairs, enhance equipment, change channels, or summon pets/familiars in the event map.[/*][/list]

notes.title: v.233 Hotfixes - July 6, 2022
notes.content:
In the midst of our scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, we sometimes perform hotfixes to address a variety of bugs and issues without bringing down the servers. We will use this post as a collective hub to update our players with the hotfix details, such as when and which fix was applied. Each time there is an update, this post will be bumped up on our news page and the update will clearly be indicated with the date the hotfix was applied. We hope that this will be a useful record and helpful information for our players.

Here you'll find a list of hotfixes that addresses a variety of bugs and issues reported within the v.233 Destiny: Remastered update.

[b]Hotfixes:[/b]
[list][*][b]July 6, 2022[/b][list][*]We distributed the following compensation to players that were affected by the issue where Lucid (Hard) and Will (Hard) did not drop soul shards once defeated [b]between June 23 (after maintenance) and June 30 (before maintenance)[/b]:
[list][*]Characters with a record of defeating Lucid (Hard) between June 23 (after maintenance) and June 30 (before maintenance)
[list][*]Lucid Soul Shard[/*][/list][/*][*]Characters with a record of defeating Will (Hard) between June 23 (after maintenance) and June 30 (before maintenance)
[list][*]Will Soul Shard[/*][/list][/*][*]Please claim the items via your in-game Gift Drop [b]prior to July 20 at 11:59 PM UTC[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]We temporarily blocked the access to Tengu boss battle until we address the issue mentioned in [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/75295/tengu-boss-battle-cannot-be-completed-until-v-234-update]this post[/url].[/*][*]Fixed the issue where the 4-hour 2x EXP Special Coupon is incorrectly displayed as 1-day 2x EXP Special Coupon despite functioning for 4 hours as intended.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]July 4, 2022[/b][list][*]As mentioned on our [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/75339]webpost[/url], the 20,000 Maple Point Gift Certificate from the New Journey event's Lv. 220 reward will temporarily not be distributed until we further investigate the issue[/*][/list][/*][*][b]June 17, 2022[/b][list][*]Fixed the issue where Starlight Symphony's Starlight Chariot Daily Missions did not reset until the Starlight Chariot UI was opened after 12:00 AM UTC. [/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Destiny Tera Burning Plus, Burning World and more!
notes.content:
The Destiny: Remastered update is upon us, and [b]Tera Burning Plus[/b] is back once again with [b]Burning World[/b] to make the it even easier to see the full power of the remastered Explorer classes! Make a new character to race up to Lv. 220, gain new rewards with the [b]Burning World Step Up Event[/b], get a rebate on your NX purchases in Burning World with the [b]Burning World Big Spender Event[/b], finish off strong with the [b]Burning World EXP Event[/b] in August, and keep advancing your characters through Burning World before heading to another world in September's [b]Burning World Leap[/b]!
[h1][b]Tera Burning Plus
[/b][/h1][list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, June 15, 2022 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, August 30, 2022 4:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, June 15, 2022 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 31, 2022 1:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, June 15, 2022 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 31, 2022 9:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in all worlds, as well as Burning World, [b]except for Zero characters[/b].

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional [b]two levels[/b] all the way up to Lv. 200!

In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including [b]Root Abyss and Fafnir gear[/b]! When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training! You will receive additional rewards on your ‘Burning’ character at Lv. 200, Lv. 205, Lv. 210, Lv. 215, and Lv. 220!

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5786/newteraeffect.png[/img]

[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]Reach level 200 fast on your new characters with the Tera Burning Plus event![/*][*][b]Requirements:[/b] This event can only be started by characters created during the event period. (Zero characters cannot participate in this event.)[/*][*]After creating a new character, you will be given an option to give it a ‘Burning’ effect.[/*][*]You [b]cannot[/b] go back to give it a ‘Burning’ effect after refusing to do so during character creation.[/*][*]You can only Tera Burn 1 character per account during the event.[/*][*]After your ‘Burning’ character reaches Lv. 10, they will start to earn two additional levels each time your character gains a level up to Lv. 200.[/*][*]Once you reach Lv. 200 with your Tera Burning character, you will receive [b]Tera Character Burninator[/b] item to raise another existing character to Lv. 200!
[list][*]In this section, characters with Tera Burning effect from the event will be indicated as [b]“Tera Burning character”[/b] and characters with Tera Burning effect from using the Tera Character Burninator item will be indicated as [b]“Tera Burninator character”[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive special Tera Burning Rewards when your ‘Burning’ character meets the listed level milestones.
[list][*]If you’ve obtained the Tera Burning Rewards and deleted the character, a newly created ‘Burning’ character will be able to receive the rewards again.[/*][*]Your Tera Burninator character can receive these rewards for meeting the level milestones as well.[/*][/list][/*][*]There’s more rewards waiting for you past Lv. 200! Once your ‘Burning’ character reaches Lv. 200, you can obtain [b]Bonus Rewards[/b] up until Lv. 220.
[list][*][b]Lv. 200 - 210[/b] [b]Bonus Rewards[/b] can be obtained [b]once each[/b] with the [b]Tera Burning[/b] character and the [b]Tera Burninator[/b] character. If you’ve obtained the Bonus Rewards and deleted the character, a newly created ‘Burning’ character [b]cannot[/b] receive the rewards again.
[list][*][b]Tera Burning[/b] character must claim the Lv. 200 to Lv. 210 Bonus Rewards by [b]August 30 at 11:59 PM UTC[/b].[/*][*][b]Tera Burninator[/b] character can claim the Lv. 200 to Lv. 210 Bonus Rewards within the 6 weeks after using the Tera Character Burninator item.[/*][*]If you have more than one [b]Tera Burninator[/b] character during the event duration (Tera Burning Plus and [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/74813/explorer-s-new-journey-event]New Journey event[/url]), [b]only one of them[/b] can receive the Lv. 200 - 210 Bonus Rewards when reaching the respective level milestones.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Lv. 215 - 220 Bonus Reward[/b] can be claimed [b]only[/b] once per account during the Tera Burning Plus event duration, regardless of [b]Tera Burning/Burninator[/b] status.
[list][*]Lv. 215 - 220 Bonus Reward must be claimed by [b]August 30 at 11:59 PM UTC[/b].[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Rewards:[/b]

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q2/1725/tera-burning-reward-boxes-maplestory.png[/img]

[list][*][b]Snail Pet:[/b] 30-day duration.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Lv. 30: Lv. 30 Equipment Box:[/b] Untradeable, box expires on [b]August 30[/b] at [b]12:00 AM UTC[/b]. Can be opened at Lv. 30. Additional rewards for reaching Lv. 200 to Lv. 220 can be obtained once per region. These rewards cannot be obtained again if you delete the existing 'Burning' character that claimed these rewards and create a new 'Burning' character.
[list][*][b]Lv. 200:[/b] Reach Lv. 200 on your Tera Burning character to receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]Nodestone (x30):[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Lv. 205:[/b] Reach Lv. 205 on your Tera Burning character to receive the following rewards:

[h1][b]Burning World Leap[/b][/h1]
[list][*][b]Wednesday, August 31, 2022 (End of Maintenance) - Thursday, September 15, 2022 (Start of Maintenance)[/b][/*][/list]
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/1134/world-leap-screen.png[/img]

As the saying goes, the light that burns twice as bright burns half as long, and the Burning World will burn very brightly indeed. However, while this new world will be consumed at the end of it all, a new life awaits your characters in the other worlds of MapleStory!

Lv. 150+ characters in Burning World will be allowed to leap to another world of your choosing during the World Leap period, taking their equipped items, inventory, and mesos with them to join their new communities. When this period begins, all Burning World characters will be moved to the Burning Leap Zone map, where they will be able to speak to the NPC Mover to complete their exodus.
[list][*]Characters in Burning World must be at least Lv. 150 in order to World Leap, whether they were Mega Burning characters or not.[list][*]Zero characters must be both Lv. 150+ and having completed Story Quest Act 2.[/*][*]It will not be possible to leave the Burning Leap Zone map during this period, making it impossible to gain any more EXP. [b]Make sure you're Lv. 150 before the September 15 maintenance[/b]![/*][/list][/*][*]Even if you have more than six Lv. 150 characters on Burning World, [b]only six of them[/b] will be allowed to World Leap.[/*][*]You do [b]not[/b] need an empty character slot on the destination world for your new character (you will be granted a free Character Slot if you are at your unlocked limit on that world), however if you have reached the maximum character limit on that world, you will need to delete a character in order to make room for them.[/*][*]Characters can be transferred to [b]Aurora, Bera, Elysium, Luna, and Scania worlds only[/b].[/*][*]Characters in Guilds will not be able to World Leap until they have either left or disbanded their Guild.[/*][*]Your character's equipped items, inventory, and mesos will be transferred with your character, but items within your Storage, Cash Shop Inventory, mail, and auction house will not be. [b]Make sure you clear everything out before taking the big leap![/b][/*][*]You may send your Burning World characters all to the same world, or to different worlds.[/*][*]Medals obtained from regularly-resetting rankings will not be transferred, and your rankings in those pieces of content will also not be transferred.[/*][/list]

notes.content:
[b][Update Jul 18][/b] Updated the post to clarify that the Lv. 220 reward includes a choice between the +17 AbsoLab Weapon Box and the +15 Dominator Pendant Box, not both boxes. We apologize for the error in the event post. 

The Explorer classes have been remastered, bringing them into line with the power and creativity of MapleStory's most recent classes, and we want you to experience the fun of these expanded classes with a big giveaway of prizes! Make a new Explorer character, or join in with an existing favorite, and earn a ton of rewards including the Goddess's Grace Outfit, Dreaming of Adventure Chat Ring, Label Ring, Damage Skin and more, and a wealth of functional items including Nodestones, AbsoLab Weapons and more!

notes.title: v.232 Hotfixes - June 2, 2022
notes.content:
In the midst of our scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, we sometimes perform hotfixes to address a variety of bugs and issues without bringing down the servers. We will use this post as a collective hub to update our players with the hotfix details, such as when and which fix was applied. Each time there is an update, this post will be bumped up on our news page and the update will clearly be indicated with the date the hotfix was applied. We hope that this will be a useful record and helpful information for our players.

Here you'll find a list of hotfixes that addresses a variety of bugs and issues reported within the v.232 Blooming Forest update.
