[/*][*][b][Updated October 13] [/b]Fixed the issue where Night Troupe's Fireworks Festival Parade dialogue states the inaccurate level requirement and max level up amount.
[/*][*][b][Updated October 13][/b] Fixed the issue where Mage V Skill 'Unreliable Memory' no longer ignores the used skills' MP cost and cooldown after the v.227 update.[/*][*][b][Updated October 13][/b] Fixed the issue where the Tera/Mega Character Burninator item description listed the incorrect level range.
[/*][*][b][Updated October 13][/b] For the eligible players listed on the SSB Gender-locked Item Issue Compensation post, the compensations will be available after the maintenance by talking to Maple Administrator located in the Event Hall and from the Gift Drop [b]until November 30 at 11:59 PM UTC[/b]. notes.title: Pink Bean Bulletin - v.225 Issues (Compensation Update!)
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

We know many of you have been asking about the details for the v.225 instability issues compensation. We’re sorry that we’re sharing the details with you so late, but we’d like to share that there will be a [b]2x EXP and Drop event this weekend[/b] as compensation for the various crashing issues and extended downtime following the v.225 update. As mentioned in the [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/69289/compensation-2x-exp-drop-event]event post[/url], we will be having a 2x EXP and Drop event in all worlds on [b]September 25[/b] and [b]September 26[/b] at the following UTC times.
[list][*][b]Saturday, September 25[/b]
[list][*]UTC: 10:00 AM - 1:00 PM[/*][*]UTC: 7:00 PM - 10:00 PM[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Sunday, September 26[/b]
[list][*]UTC: 2:00 AM - 5:00 AM[/*][/list][/*][/list]
Please check the post for additional details on the event!

You may be curious why there was not much in the way of compensation updates until now. It took us additional time to finalize the details for the compensation as we also addressed some of the live issues. We wanted to share the details with you after the compensation event was confirmed and tested so that we could make sure everything was working properly first. We understand it may have been frustrating to wait without news, and we would like to thank you for your patience!

We hope you’ll enjoy the 2x EXP and Drop event!

[i]- Evolys and MapleStory Production Team[/i]

notes.title: SSB Gender-locked Item Issue Update
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

Our internal teams have once again reviewed the compensation plans that we shared in the [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/68797/surprise-style-box-gender-locked-item-issue]Surprise Style Box Gender-locked Item Issue post[/url] that went live August 27th. We realized that we may not have taken into consideration the non-Zero characters that were affected by the lack of clarity on how gender-locked items are obtained from the boxes. To provide compensation that will encompass non-Zero players affected by the issue, we are planning to adjust our compensation plan for Zero and non-Zero characters that received gender-locked items from opening a purchased SSB item. When we discussed the overall compensation once again, we came to the conclusion that the Royal Hair/Face Coupons may not be the proper compensation for this issue. Thus, we replaced the previous compensation with the newly updated plan. Please refer to the newly finalized compensation plan below.

[u][b]All Accounts with Lv. 30 Character[/b][/u]
For players who have an account with a character Lv. 30 and above (including players that meet the below criteria) created [b]prior to August 27, 2021 at 11:59 PM PDT[/b] will receive the following items as a token of our apology for the incorrect information we provided:
[list][*]You will be able to choose between the following 2 outfit sets. Please choose the set according to the gender of the character you would like to use it on.
[list][*][b]Moonlight Set (M)
[/b][list][*][b]Moonlight Floral Hat[/b][/*][*][b]Moonlight Costume[/b][/*][*][b]Moonlight Marble Shoes[/b][/*][*][b]Fluttering Camellia Flower[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Moonlight Set (F)
[/b][list][*][b]Moonlight Floral Hairpin[/b][/*][*][b]Moonlight Outfit[/b][/*][*][b]Moonlight Marble Shoes[/b][/*][*][b]Fluttering Camellia Flower[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Legendary Bebe Box[/b]
[list][*][b]2x EXP Coupon (15 min) (x30)[/b][/*][*][b]2x Drop Coupon (15 min) (x30)[/b][/*][*][b]Special Medal of Honor (x10)[/b][/*][*][b]Arcane Symbol Selector Coupon (x20)[/b][/*][*][b]Trait Boost Potion (x3)[/b][/*][*][b]Selective Slot Coupon (x4)[/b][/*][*][b]Extreme Growth Potion (x3)[/b]: Use on a character between Lv. 141 and Lv. 199 to gain up to 10 levels max. The higher your character level, the lower the likelihood of getting more levels. The potion will have no effect on characters with Lv. 200 and above.
[list][*][i][b]Note:[/b] There was an issue where the Lv. 200 - 249 growth potion item had an incorrect name. We apologize for the confusion due to this issue and we plan to fix the Lv. 200 - 249 growth potion item’s name during the September 2 maintenance.[/i][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Eternal Rebirth Flame (x5)[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Accounts that Purchased SSB Items (Zero and non-Zero characters)[/b][/u]
For accounts that received gender-locked items from opening a purchased SSB item [b]between April 22, 2015 and August 27, 2021 at 11:59 PM PDT[/b], you will be given two selection options. 
[list][*]We have maintained the related logs from April 22, 2015 onwards and would like to compensate all players for whom we have records.[/*][*]The number of times you can use the selection feature is limited to the amount of gender-locked items you’ve received from opening a purchased SSB item during the period mentioned above. 
[list][*][i][b]Note:[/b] Gender-locked items received through Auction House purchases or 1-to-1 player trades will not be eligible for the compensation.[/i][/*][/list][/*][*]The number of times available will be deducted each time you make a selection and receive the compensation.[/*][*]The gender-locked items do not have to be in the character’s possession for you to receive the compensation.[/*][*][i][b]Ex:[/b] If you received 10 male-specific items from opening the SSB items between April 22, 2015 and August 27, 2021 at 11:59 PM PDT, you can make the selection between the 2 selection options a total of 10 times. Once you’ve made the selection 3 times, you will have 7 times remaining.[/i][/*][/list]
The eligible players will receive the following two selection options:
[olist][*]Receive the corresponding untradeable item for the opposite gender for the item you’ve obtained from opening a purchased SSB item.
[list][*][i][b]Note:[/b] This is not an exchange and you will not lose the existing item if you have it in your possession.[/i][/*][/list][/*][*]Receive a Maple Point Exchange Coupon for the item.
[list][*]Each Maple Point Exchange Coupon will provide 3,400 Maple Points, the price of one SSB item.[/*][*][i][b]Note:[/b] This is not an exchange and you will not lose the existing item if you have it in your possession.[/i][/*][/list][/*][/olist]
The eligible players can utilize this system to either obtain Maple Points or the counterpart item for the gender-locked SSB items that were received. Since this will be a new system, our MapleStory team is working to develop this feature to provide compensation for the affected players. We’ll update with more details, such as the date, in a future post. Again, we express our sincere apologies for the SSB gender-locked item issue and we thank you all for your patience.

 - The MapleStory Team

notes.title: [Updated September 2] Surprise Style Box Gender-locked Item Issue
notes.content:
[b][Updated September 2][/b] Hi Maplers, this compensation was replaced with the newly updated plan. Please check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/216150/view/2963919986473315459]updated compensation plan here[/url].

Hi Maplers,

We're aware of the recent community concerns about the issue with the Surprise Style Boxes (SSBs) containing gender-locked items. As we complete our review of this issue, we would like to share the details of what we have discussed.

First, we would like to express our sincere apologies concerning how items can be obtained from these SSB items. We acknowledge that there was an issue where Zero characters were not able to obtain some gender-locked items listed. They, having both Alpha and Beta, should have been able to obtain either gender-locked items depending on which gender is active during the time the box is opened. However, they were only able to obtain male and unisex items up until our v.225 game patch update.

Also, there was an issue with the way the SSB rates were published on our [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/micro-site/36184]website [/url]which caused confusion about how the items were given depending on the gender of your character.

To better clarify the circumstances, our SSB rates pages currently indicate that all items have an equal chance of being obtained, but the way the percentage rates were displayed was misleading because it shows each gender-locked item as having an equal chance of redemption each time the box was opened, even though it was not feasible for male characters to receive the female equivalent item and vice versa. This means that there was a shared chance of obtaining [u][b]either[/b] [/u]a male or female item (depending on what gender you are opening the boxes with) instead of having equal chances of obtaining [u][b]each[/b] [/u]gendered item from the list.

As an example, here is an excerpt of how the rates are currently displayed for an SSB that contains 50 items in the reward pool:
[table][tr][td]
[b]Items[/b]
[/td][td]
[b]Rates[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[u]Item A (M)[/u]
[/td][td]
[u]2%[/u]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[u]Item A (F)[/u]
[/td][td]
[u]2%[/u]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[u]Item B (Unisex)[/u]
[/td][td]
[u]2%[/u]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[u]Item C (Unisex)[/u]
[/td][td]
[u]2%[/u]
[/td][/tr][/table]
Here is an excerpt of how the rates should be displayed for an SSB that contains 50 items in the reward pool with 2 of those items being gender-locked:
[table][tr][td]
[b]Items[/b]
[/td][td]
[b]Rates[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[u]Item A (M)[/u][u]  [/u]
[/td][td]

[u]2.04%[/u]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[u]Item A (F)[/u]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[u]Item B (Unisex)[/u]
[/td][td]
[u]2.04%[/u]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[u]Item C (Unisex)[/u]
[/td][td]
[u]2.04%[/u]
[/td][/tr][/table]
The difference between what was published on our website and what should have been published was due to our oversight, not realizing that the rates should be recalculated with consideration for gender-locked items. We apologize for our error and the lack of clarity on the distribution rates for the gender-locked items, which led to us presenting misleading and confusing information on our website. Going forward, we will include additional items in the SSB reward pool if there are gender-locked items included in the SSB reward to account for the shared slot of male and female items, so that each probability slot will have a fixed rate of 2% (or 1% if there are 100 slots).  

As a sincere apology, we are planning the following compensation:
[list][*][b]For Zero characters in all worlds that have purchased an SSB item:[/b]
[list][*]We will distribute the female counterpart item for the male SSB items that were received [b]between April 22, 2015 and August 25, 2021 (before maintenance)[/b]. 
[list][*]We have maintained the related logs from April 22, 2015 onwards and would like to compensate all players for whom we have records. [/*][/list][/*][*]We will give you an update on how the items will be distributed once our investigation is finalized. [/*][/list][/*][*][b]For players in all worlds that have purchased an SSB item that included male/female-specific rewards (including the Zero characters that meet the above criteria) in the past 2 years:[/b]
[list][*]We will distribute the following items:
[list][*][b]Royal Hair Coupon (x2)[/b][/*][*][b]Royal Face Coupon (x2)[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]All players who have an account with a character Lv. 30 and above (including players that meet the above criteria) created prior to this announcement will receive the following items as a token of our apology for the incorrect information we provided:[/b] 
[list][*]You will be able to choose between the following 2 outfit sets. Please choose the set according to the gender of the character you would like to use it on.
[list][*][b]Moonlight Set (M)
[/b][list][*][b]Moonlight Floral Hat[/b][/*][*][b]Moonlight Outfit[/b][/*][*][b]Moonlight Marble Shoes[/b][/*][*][b]Fluttering Camellia Flower[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Moonlight Set (F)
[/b][list][*][b]Moonlight Floral Hairpin[/b][/*][*][b]Moonlight Costume[/b][/*][*][b]Moonlight Marble Shoes[/b][/*][*][b]Fluttering Camellia Flower[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Legendary Bebe Box[/b]
[list][*][b]2x EXP Coupon (15 min) (x30)[/b][/*][*][b]2x Drop Coupon (15 min) (x30)[/b][/*][*][b]Special Medal of Honor (x10).[/b][/*][*][b]Arcane Symbol Selector Coupon (x20)[/b][/*][*][b]Trait Boost Potion (x3)[/b][/*][*][b]Selective Slot Coupon (x4)[/b][/*][*][b]Extreme Growth Potion[/b][/*][*][b]Eternal Rebirth Flame (x5)[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
Further updates and information about the distribution period for the compensation will be shared in a future post. Again, we sincerely apologize for having misleading SSB item rates information on our website. We’ll clarify the rates and indicate the gender-locked items on the [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/micro-site/36184]current SSB rates pages[/url] as soon as possible and provide the accurate rates for all Surprise Style Boxes going forward. 

 - The MapleStory Team

Also, there was an issue with the way the SSB rates were published on our [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/micro-site/36184]website [/url]which caused confusion about how the items were given depending on the gender of your character.

notes.title: v.225 - Goo Island Getaway Patch Notes
notes.content:
After investigating a mysterious Gachapon that suddenly appears in Maple World, you find yourself drifting to [b]Goo Island[/b], a place inhabited by Goos! New activities await your arrival on this mysterious island. Make friends with the Goos and complete daily activities to be awarded with the [b]Blessing of Goo[/b]! Join one of three camps on Goo Island and participate in activities to boost your rank and earn better rewards. Prove your strength to the Goos as you compete against other players in [b]Goo Battle[/b]! If you’re feeling adventurous, [b]Goo Ruins Exploration[/b] is the place for you. PLUS, now is the time for characters Lv. 150 and above to make the leap from [b]Burning World[/b] to a non-Reboot world of your choice!

Read the Goo Island Getaway Patch Notes [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/68486/v-225-goo-island-getaway-patch-notes]here[/url]!

[previewyoutube=3uk608pamLo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update on Elite Mob Drop Change Investigation
notes.content:
Hi Maplers, 

As briefly announced on our Community platforms, we are aware of the player concerns regarding the Elite mob drop changes after the v.224 update maintenance. We investigated the Cube and Rebirth Flame drop rates with high priority and confirmed that there was an error in the Elite mob drop rate logic that did not align with our development goals of improving the accessibility of these items.

After we discovered the error, we planned to conduct an in-depth review to determine the proper changes that would both provide an improved experience to players and meet our development goals. However, such a review requires additional time for us to thoroughly calculate the drop rate after reviewing players' levels and the number of Elite mobs that players defeated. As this delay would lengthen the time our players experience the inconvenience, we have decided to roll back the following parts of the v.224 Better Maple update:
[list]
[*] [b]"Elite Monsters and Elite Champions now have a chance to drop cubes and flames when defeated"[/b]
[*] [b]"The following items have been removed from the respective content (Ex. Elite Monster and Elite Champion's Golden Hammer 50%)"[/b]
[/list]
We will revert the changes to how they used to be in the v.223 update while we continue to conduct an in-depth review of how to improve this experience in the future. The stated rollback is planned to be done during our [b]August 5 unscheduled maintenance[/b].

We are deeply sorry for the inconvenience you may have experienced due to this error and, as a token of our apology, we will be giving the following items once per account to players that have a character Lv. 101 and above and a login record between [b]July 21 (after maintenance) and August 5 (before maintenance)[/b]:
[list]
[*] [b]2x EXP Coupon (15 min) (x10):[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*] [b]2x Drop Coupon (15 min) (x10):[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*] [b]Powerful Rebirth Flame (x10):[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*] [b]Eternal Rebirth Flame (x5):[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*] [b]Master Craftsman’s Cube (x30):[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*] [b]Meister Cube (x15):[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[/list]
Please claim the above items via Gift Drop on the left side of the screen after the August 5 maintenance [b]until August 18 at 11:59 PM UTC[/b]. Once our in-depth review has been completed, we’ll provide an update about our next planned actions to improve the accessibility of Cubes and Rebirth Flames as an intended Better Maple Change. Again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and delay.

- The MapleStory Team

We will revert the changes to how they used to be in the v.223 update while we continue to conduct an in-depth review of how to improve this experience in the future.

notes.title: Update on Cube Removal from Bosses
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

As the removal of Cubes from bosses in all worlds has been a recent hot topic in the community, we would like to share more details of the reasoning behind this implementation as well as our plans to address the community concerns. While implementing the Cubes and Rebirth Flames Obtainment Improvements as part of the Better Maple changes in the v.224 update, our goal was to improve the obtainment experience by removing the Cube and Rebirth Flame items that dropped at a chance from bosses and adding them to Elite Monsters and Elite Champions instead. We believed that this change would lower the hurdle of obtaining these items by allowing players to obtain them while training in maps where Elite Monsters and Elite Champions appear frequently. Our goal was to increase the accessibility of obtaining these items, as well as to provide better experiences through future boss reward revamps. 

However, we realized that we may have overlooked the inconvenience this change would cause to players who rely on bosses as their primary source of obtaining Cubes. We apologize for not taking this into consideration when we worked on the change, and for not providing a detailed announcement ahead of time.

After the v.224 Patch Notes and game update went live, we kept a close eye on players’ feedback and saw the concerns regarding the Cube removal change. We urgently reviewed the decision to remove Cubes from bosses. We decided that, while keeping Cubes as drops from Elite Monsters and Elite Champions, we will add Cubes back to the boss rewards in all worlds, but at a lower obtainment of 70-80% of the amount that players used to obtain from bosses prior to the v.224 update. We plan to implement this change before the upcoming weekend during an unscheduled maintenance. Please keep an eye on the [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news]News page of our Official MapleStory website[/url] for more details on the upcoming maintenance.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, and we will continue to monitor different aspects of the game to improve your MapleStory experience.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Part 2 of Tera Burning Plus Begins!
notes.content:
The Neo: Light's Wrath update is upon us, and [b]Tera Burning Plus[/b] is back for a second round of power-leveling fun! Make a new character to race up to Lv. 220, and keep advancing your characters through Burning World in advance of August's Burning World Leap!

[previewyoutube=xbwiAOFfloY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Neo Tera Burning Plus - Part 2
[/h1][list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, July 21, 2021 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, August 24, 2021 4:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, July 21, 2021 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 25, 2021 1:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, July 21, 2021 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 25, 2021 9:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.

The second round of the [b]Tera Burning Plus Project[/b] is here to help you level a brand-new character up, not just to Lv. 200, but Lv. 220 as well with another character!

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, [b]except for Zero and Kain characters[/b].

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional [b]two levels[/b] all the way up to Lv. 200!


In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including [b]Root Abyss and Fafnir gear[/b]! When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training! You will receive additional rewards on your ‘Burning’ character at Lv. 200, Lv. 205, Lv. 210, and Lv. 220!

[b]Here's How it Works[/b]

Create a brand-new character during the event period. From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect. Then, accept the quest "It's the Tera Burning Project gift giveaway!" from the star event notifier on the left-side of the game window in order to start receiving rewards! Only one character on your account can have the "Burning" effect.

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5786/newteraeffect.png[/img]

notes.title: Mark Your Miracle Time Event
notes.content:
Double Miracle Time is returning to MapleStory in late July... but not as it once was. In the past, Double Miracle Time would run for three hour-long periods on a Saturday, giving everyone in MapleStory double the odds of ranking-up their equipment's Potential through [b]Red Cubes[/b], [b]Black Cubes[/b], [b]Bonus Potential Cubes[/b], [b]White Cubes[/b], and [b]Violet Cubes[/b]. Maplers all over the world would make sure to be online for those periods, ready to get the most out of their equipment's improvements... which sometimes resulted in server instability issues.

In order to make sure that you get the most out of Double Miracle Time this time around, we're launching the [b]Mark Your Miracle Time Event[/b]! Instead of taking place for three hours on a particularly frenetic Saturday, Maplers can schedule one day from [b]Wednesday, July 28, 2021[/b] through [b]Tuesday, August 3, 2021[/b] to have their Miracle Time, spreading out the demands on MapleStory's servers and making sure that everyone gets the most out of their Miracle Time!

[previewyoutube=HsZUct-U124;full][/previewyoutube]

You can learn more about the origin of this event change in the [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/68001/maple-memo-double-miracle-time-more-july-16]July 16 Double Miracle Time & More Maple Memo[/url], or look below to see the full details about how this new event will work!

[h1][b]Mark Your Miracle Time Registration[/b][/h1]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1238/mark-your-miracle-time-map-maplestory.png[/img]

[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]When the Registration Period begins, use the Star Event Notifier to accept the "[Miracle Time] Hurry and Mark Your Miracle Time" quest to be awarded a registration coin, and select which date you'd like to try to purchase a [b]Mark Your Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] for.[/*][*]Use the Star Event Notifier to travel to the Miracle Time Registration Map, and speak to the NPC there to purchase a [b]Mark Your Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] for the previously selected day. In order to prevent overcrowding, [b]you will only have 60 seconds to make the purchase[/b], after which time you will be returned to the previous map you were on, and have to select a day again. Failing to purchase a ticket will not prevent you from accessing the same [b]Mark Your Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] vendor.[/*][*]Miracle Time will, as usual, occur during three hour-long periods during the day. For example, an [b]8/1 Mark Your Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] will enable Miracle Time during the following periods:[list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): [/b][b][b]10:00 PM – 11:00 PM July 31, 2021 & [/b]1:30 AM – 2:30 AM August 1, 2021 & 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM August 1, 2021 
[/b][/*][*][b]CEST (UTC +2): [/b][b][b]7:00 AM – 8:00 AM August 1, 2021 & [/b]10:30 AM – 11:30 A[/b][b]M August 1, 2021 & 12:00 AM – 1:00 AM August 2, 2021
[/b][/*][*][b]AEST (UTC +10): [/b][b][b]3:00 PM – 4:00 PM August 1, 2021 & [/b][/b][b]6:30 PM – 7:30 PM August 1, 2021 & 8:00 AM – 9:00 AM August 2, 2021
[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]4,000 tickets will be available for each date per world, with 400 available tickets per day restocking at [b]12:00 AM UTC[/b] and [b]12:00 PM UTC [/b]every day. You can purchase and use only one ticket per world.[/*][*]Make sure you are free during the date you register for, these tickets [b]cannot be exchanged or refunded[/b]![/*][*]Players cannot enter the lobby map between [b]11:55 AM - 12:05 PM UTC [/b]and [b]11:55 PM - 12:05 AM UTC [/b]while the shops are being restocked.[/*][*]Players that purchased a ticket can no longer enter a lobby map where the registration tickets are sold.[/*][*]Once the player purchased the ticket, they must use the ticket by [b]July 28 at 4:00 AM UTC[/b] to complete the registration.[/*][*]Players can check the registered date by hovering over the cube icon on the left side of the screen.[/*][*]Mark Your Miracle Time Registration is available for all worlds, including Reboot world and Burning World.[/*][/list][h1][b]Mark Your Miracle Time Event

For example, an [b]8/1 Mark Your Miracle Time Registration Ticket[/b] will enable Miracle Time during the following periods:[list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): [/b][b][b]10:00 PM – 11:00 PM July 31, 2021 & [/b]1:30 AM – 2:30 AM August 1, 2021 & 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM August 1, 2021

notes.title: Safety Gem Compensation Enabled
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

We have once again enabled the Safety Gem Compensation that we [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/67419/safety-gem-compensation-temporarily-disabled]temporarily disabled on June 11[/url]. If you have yet to claim the below compensation from the Gift Drop prior to it being disabled, you can now claim it [b]until October 5 at 11:59 PM UTC[/b].

The following is the Safety Gem compensation that has been enabled:
[list]
[*] Permanent duration Safety Gems obtained through Cash Shop sales will be removed and accounts affected by the removal will be fully refunded with Maple Points.
[*] The Marvel Machine coupons for Safety Gems will be disabled at 7:00 PM PDT on June 7, and accounts affected by the coupon disabling will be refunded with 1,640 Maple Points (1/3 of Marvel Machine spin price) per coupon.
[/list]
We have also distributed the compensation for Safety Gem Marvel Machine coupons that had their expirations extended after we [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/52831/updated-october-7-coupon-redemption-temporarily-disabled]temporarily disabled the coupon redemption[/url] in September 2019. Thank you for your patience and please remember to claim them before they expire in the Gift Drop!  

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Hotel Maple Shops Reopening
notes.content:
All Hotel Maple shops will reopen after the [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/67488/scheduled-minor-patch-june-17-2021]June 17 maintenance[/url], and will now run [b]until June 20 at 11:59 PM UTC[/b]. We had an issue where players received an error message when attempting to purchase from any of the Hotel Maple shops on June 13 UTC and we were aware that some players had yet to spend their Sweet 16 Coins and VIP Coupons. After the maintenance, you can access the Hotel Maple shops via the "[Hotel Maple] Travel to <Hotel Maple>!" quest within the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. 

We will also be distributing the VIP Coupons that players had before they expired on June 14 at 11:59 PM UTC. You can claim the VIP Coupons from the Gift Drop after the June 17 maintenance. The newly distributed VIP Coupons will now expire [b]June 21 at 11:59 PM UTC[/b].

Please use all your remaining Sweet 16 Coins and VIP Coupons while the Hotel Maple shops are [b]available once again until June 20 at 11:59 PM UTC[/b]! Thank you for your patience, and we apologize for any inconvenience you may have experienced due to this issue.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Safety Gem Compensation Temporarily Disabled
notes.content:
We've discovered an issue with the Safety Gem compensation for the [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/66883/updated-june-7-death-penalty-and-safety-charm-changes-in-v-223]Death Penalty and Safety Charm Changes in v.223[/url] and will be temporarily disabling it from the Gift Drop until further notice. The issue was that the Safety Gem compensation could be claimed multiple times.

The following is the Safety Gem compensation that has been disabled:
[list]
[*] Permanent duration Safety Gems obtained through Cash Shop sales will be removed and accounts affected by the removal will be fully refunded with Maple Points.
[*] The Marvel Machine coupons for Safety Gems will be disabled at 7:00 PM PDT on June 7, and accounts affected by the coupon disabling will be refunded with 1,640 Maple Points (1/3 of Marvel Machine spin price) per coupon.
[/list]
We are currently investigating this issue and will make the above compensation available to those that have yet to claim it from their Gift Drop as soon as we can. In addition to the above, we're also looking into the issue where the compensation for Safety Gem Marvel Machine coupons that had their expirations extended after we [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/52831/updated-october-7-coupon-redemption-temporarily-disabled]temporarily disabled the coupon redemption[/url] in September 2019 was not distributed. We'll provide an update once we've investigated these issues and are ready to enable the compensation once again. We apologize for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Power-level with Tera Burning Plus and Burning World Events!
notes.content:
[b]Tera Burning[/b] is back with some bonus power, and [b]Burning World[/b] has returned alongside! Make some new characters and race them up the levels, all the way to Lv. 220 in record time with Tera Burning Plus and Burning World!

[previewyoutube=xbwiAOFfloY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Neo Tera Burning Plus - Part 1[/h1]
[list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, June 9, 2021 (After Maintenance) - Tuesday, July 20, 2021 4:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, June 9, 2021 (After Maintenance) - Wednesday, July 21, 2021 1:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, June 9, 2021 (After Maintenance) - Wednesday, July 21, 2021 9:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]
Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.

The [b]Tera Burning Plus Project[/b] is here to help you level a brand-new character up, not just to Lv. 200, but Lv. 220 as well!

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, [b]except for Zero and Kain characters[/b].

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional [b]two levels[/b] all the way up to Lv. 200!

In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including [b]Root Abyss and Fafnir gear[/b]! When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training! You will receive additional rewards on your ‘Burning’ character at Lv. 200, Lv. 205, Lv. 210, and Lv. 220!

[b]Here's How it Works[/b]

Create a brand-new character during the event period. From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect. Then, accept the quest "It's the Tera Burning Project gift giveaway!" from the star event notifier on the left-side of the game window in order to start receiving rewards! Only one character on your account can have the "Burning" effect.

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5786/newteraeffect.png[/img]

After completing the quest "It's the Tera Burning Project gift giveaway!," you will receive all of your gifts immediately; however, you will not be able to use all of them until you meet the required level for each reward.

Burning World is a special world with special rules that will exist only for the duration of the Burning World event, filled with boosts to make it easier than ever to level up fast. [list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, August 24, 2021 5:00 PM - Thursday, September 9, 2021 (Start of Maintenance)[/b][/*][*][b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, August 25, 2021 2:00 AM - Thursday, September 9, 2021 (Start of Maintenance)[/b][/*][*][b]AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, August 25, 2021 10:00 AM - Thursday, September 9, 2021 (Start of Maintenance)[/b][/*][/list]
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/1134/world-leap-screen.png[/img]

As the saying goes, the light that burns twice as bright burns half as long, and the Burning World will burn very brightly indeed. However, while this new world will be consumed at the end of it all, a new life awaits your characters in the other worlds of MapleStory!

Lv. 150+ characters in Burning World will be allowed to leap to another world of your choosing during the World Leap period, taking their equipped items, inventory, and mesos with them to join their new communities. When this period begins, all Burning World characters will be moved to the Burning Leap Zone map, where they will be able to speak to the NPC Mover to complete their exodus.
[list][*]Characters in Burning World must be at least Lv. 150 in order to World Leap, whether they were Mega Burning characters or not.[list][*]Zero characters must be both Lv. 150+ and having completed Story Quest Act 2.[/*][*]It will not be possible to leave the Burning Leap Zone map during this period, making it impossible to gain any more EXP. [b]Make sure you're Lv. 150 before the August 25 maintenance[/b]![/*][/list][/*][*]Even if you have more than six Lv. 150 characters on Burning World, [b]only six of them[/b] will be allowed to World Leap.[/*][*]You do [b]not[/b] need an empty character slot on the destination world for your new character (you will be granted a free Character Slot if you are at your unlocked limit on that world), however if you have reached the maximum character limit on that world, you will need to delete a character in order to make room for them.[/*][*]Characters can be transferred to [b]non-Reboot worlds only[/b].[/*][*]Characters in Guilds will not be able to World Leap until they have either left or disbanded their Guild.[/*][*]Your character's equipped items, inventory, and mesos will be transferred with your character, but items within your Storage, Cash Shop Inventory, mail, and auction house will not be. [b]Make sure you clear everything out before taking the big leap![/b][/*][*]You may send your Burning World characters all to the same world, or to different worlds.[/*][*]Medals obtained from regularly-resetting rankings will not be transferred, and your rankings in those pieces of content will also not be transferred.[/*][/list]

notes.title: MapleTV to be Removed in October 2021
notes.content:
Attention Maplers,

With our October 2021 update, we will be removing MapleTV from MapleStory. MapleTV served as a promotional feature in the past, however, it is no longer in use and has become more of an inconvenience to players by overlapping with objects and portals in maps. Thus, MapleTV will be removed from major town maps, such as Henesys, after the October 2021 update. 

The following MapleTV-related items will no longer be available for purchase in the Cash Shop [b]after the June 9 maintenance[/b]:
[list]
[*] [b]MapleTV Messenger[/b]
[*] [b]MapleTV Star Messenger[/b]
[*] [b]MapleTV Heart Messenger[/b]
[*] [b]Megassenger[/b]
[*] [b]Star Megassenger[/b]
[/list]
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/532366863137767424/852289587154124860/MapleTV.PNG[/img]

We thank you for your understanding,

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Ultrafine Monster Box Beryl Monster Obtainment Issue
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

We discovered an issue with Monster Life's [b]Ultrafine Monster Box[/b] where the Beryl monster could not be obtained from opening the boxes. We sincerely apologize for the issue and the delay in identifying it. We plan to apply a fix during our [b]June 9 maintenance[/b]. After the maintenance, players will be able to properly obtain the Beryl monster from opening the Ultrafine Monster Box.

The following monsters will be available from the Ultrafine Monster Box after the [b]June 9 maintenance[/b]:
[list]
[*] Iruvata 
[*] Dodo
[*] King Clang
[*] Moon Bunny
[*] Snow Witch
[*] Beryl
[*] Dunas
[*] Frankenroid
[*] Timer
[*] Lilynouch
[*] Apsu
[*] Viking Squad
[*] Pink Bean
[/list]

We plan to provide the following compensation to the players who have been affected by this issue:
[list]
[*] Players that used the Ultrafine Monster Box [b]between May 1, 2019 and June 9, 2021 (before maintenance)[/b] will receive [b]Monster Life Gems (x8)[/b] per box used.
[*] Players that have monsters in the above list registered to the Monster Life Picture Book [b]prior to the time of this announcement (June 7 at 11:30 AM PDT)[/b] will receive [b]Monster Life Gems (x300)[/b] per account.
[list][*] We are, unfortunately, unable to recover the data for Ultrafine Monster Box usage prior to May 1, 2019 due to our policy of storing this information for a limited amount of time.[/list]
[*][i]Note: Players that meet both criteria will receive both compensation sets.[/i]
[/list]

The [b]Monster Life Gems[/b] from the compensation will be added directly to the player's Monster Life Gem inventory. Again, we apologize for such an issue with the Ultrafine Monster Box and we will work harder towards providing a better experience in the future.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Death Penalty and Safety Charm Changes in v.223
notes.content:
Attention Maplers,

With the v.223 Update, currently scheduled for June 9, we will be making a change to the character death penalty in MapleStory. Instead of removing already earned EXP from characters upon death, characters will receive EXP at a reduced rate and a reduced drop rate for a period of time after their death.

While we will have more to share about this major change in the future, we would like to give you advanced notice about how this change will affect [b]Safety Charms and Safety Gems[/b], Cash Shop items which currently protect players from losing EXP upon death. After the v.223 Update, [b]Safety Charms and Safety Gems[/b] will change in the following ways:
[list][*]Safety Charms' functionality will be changed to immediately remove the reduction in EXP earned and drop rates due to the character’s death.[/*][*]Rookie Defense Charms, which could be obtained from previous events, will be deleted with the changes to the death penalty.[/*][*]For Safety Charms obtained and owned through in-game events or NPCs, we plan to remove them from the [Etc] inventory and distribute updated versions. notes.title: Personal Identification Code to be Removed with v.224
notes.content:
Attention Maplers,

As a result of the rollout of a pair of Two-Factor Authentication and Trusted Devices systems, we are excited to share with you that the v.224 update, currently scheduled for late July, will see the [b]removal of the Personal Identification Code (PIC) security system from MapleStory[/b]. PIC entry will be removed throughout the client, including in the following locations:
[list][*]Character Log-in/Creation/Deletion[/*][*]When using the Meso Market[/*][*]Cash Item 1:1 Trades[/*][*]Enhancing or Crafting V Matrix Nodes[/*][*]Character Name Change[/*][*]Cash Item Deletion[/*][*]Cash Item Gifting[/*][*]Accessing Storage[/*][/list]
While the PIC system has served us well in the past, it has been made redundant by the more secure and convenient Two-Factor Authentication systems and integration with the Nexon Launcher and Steam. We believe that the removal of the PIC system will be an extremely welcome change for player satisfaction and enjoyment, and will also allow us to provide even better security and account protection for all Maplers via the superior Two-Factor Authentication and Trusted Devices System!

These Two-Factor Authentication methods and Trusted Devices can be found in the [url=https://www.nexon.com/account/en/setting]"Password & Security" tab in the Account Settings[/url] page.  These methods will provide superior security and convenience for your account compared to the PIC system, and we encourage everyone to set up one of the following methods as soon as possible.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1372/two-factor-authentication-nexon.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Authenticator App[/b]: This option allows you to generate a secure, single-use passcode through your smartphone, using the free Google Authenticator app. This code will be required whenever you sign into your Nexon account while on a non-trusted computer, and changes frequently to prevent the code from being reusable or guessable.[/*][*][b]SMS[/b]: The SMS (Short Message Service, better known as Text Messaging) option will allow you to register your phone number with your Nexon account, where you will be texted a single-use passcode to be used alongside your password in order to log into your Nexon account while on a non-trusted computer.[/*][*][b]Email Verification[/b]: Upon logging into the Nexon Launcher on a non-trusted computer, you will be sent an email with a secure, single-use passcode required to verify your account. This is required of all Nexon accounts, in order to limit the likelihood of an unauthorized user gaining control over your account.[/*][*][b]Trusted Devices[/b]: Once you have completed email verification, you will be given the option to trust the device you are logging on with, allowing you to bypass both Email Verification and any other Two-Factor Authentication protections on that device for an even smoother login process. You can remove trusted devices via the Account Settings page at any time.[/*][/list]
Again, we strongly encourage everyone to set up Two-Factor Authentication on your Nexon Accounts, either with an Authenticator App or through SMS (Text) Messaging. Doing so will help keep your account as safe and secure as can be. Please note that you can disable either factor whenever you wish, and while we encourage you to add an additional layer of security to your account in one of the manners described above, this is by no means a requirement to play MapleStory, and we will continue to do our best to protect your accounts regardless.

Thank you,

-The MapleStory Team

tags.feature: Head into battle for some Special Therapy or sit by the pool and stack some fruity concoctions with Monster Pyramid, and earn enough [b]Sweet 16 Coins[/b] to get all the rewards you're aiming for!
Strategically stack monster-themed drinks in the shape of a pyramid against other players!
Talk to Little Richie located in the Hotel Rooftop map to queue up for a Monster Pyramid match against two other players.
There are a total of 36 blocks given out in each turn, with 12 of them distributed randomly to each player: 7 blocks of each of 5 types, and one special block.
Blocks can be placed on the bottom row or on top of two other potions, if one of the blocks is of the same type. Placing a block earns you 10 points.
The Special Block can be placed on top of any potion, and blocks cannot be placed upon it.
Each player places a potion, one at a time. If a player cannot legally place a potion, their turn is skipped, and the next player may place one.
You have only 10 seconds to place a block. If you fail to do so, Little Richie will make a move for you and you will earn 0 points for the move.
If you miss your turn 3 times, you will forfeit the match, receive no rewards, and will not be allowed to join a new match for 15 minutes.
The round ends when a player has placed all of their blocks into the pyramid, or when there are no remaining legal moves (due to no players being able to place any blocks).
Each match of Monster Pyramid consists of 3 rounds, with prizes awarded to players based on your score and ranking in the match:
1st Place and 2nd Place: [b]1 Sweet 16 Coin[/b] for every 100 points scored in Monster Pyramid
3rd Place: No Reward.
Tiebreaker: If two players have the same number of points at the end of the match, the player who reached their final point total first will place higher.
If you reach your Sweet 16 Coin limit for the day, you can still participate in the game, but will not receive any coins.
Accept the ’[Hotel Maple] VIP Hunter Club: Special Therapy’ quest within the star event notifier on the left side of the screen or by talking to Swanson located on the Hotel Maple map.
Upon accepting the quest, the "7-Star Catered Buffet" skill will be removed and you will gain the "Special Therapy" skill in its stead.

As you defeat monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) with the Special Therapy skill, the Candle Gauge on the right side of the screen will increase. You will obtain [b]Sweet 16 Points[/b] whenever the Candle Gauge increases.
When the Candle Gauge is full, a Therapy Time will start and attack nearby monsters. You will obtain additional Sweet 16 Points with each attack.
The Special Therapy skill will not be available during the following situations:
Maps without monsters near your level.
Special maps such as Mirror World, Story Mode, etc.
When you’ve reached Sweet 16 Coin capacity for the day.

notes.title: Maple Memo: Communication Improvement - May 12
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

Today, I would like to give you an update about what [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/66412/updated-april-6-maple-memo-mechanical-hearts-and-player-feedback-april-6]we discussed last time through the previous memo[/url]. I apologize that it took more time to release this follow-up memo, but we wanted to make sure that we could give our players more meaningful information with our update.

[b]Better Explanation of Game Changes and Updates[/b]
[list][*]We plan to provide additional context and intention behind some of the important changes that will be implemented in future game updates through our Patch Notes. Our goal is to provide better visibility to our players about why a specific change is being made. We will continue to release Maple Memos for bigger changes in-game that we need to explain to our players with more context.[/*][/list]
[b]Recent Korea Player Conference and Game Improvements[/b]
[list][*]We closely monitor our community platforms on a daily basis and we’re aware of the topics and suggestions that our players discuss, including the player conference that was held in Korea. We were reviewing when we can implement the changes that are being discussed into the game. As you may know, we normally have 5 to 6 months of time to bring these updates to our game service. However, since we know that the Quality of Life changes that Korea MapleStory recently implemented are special revamps that you are looking forward to, we have been actively reviewing the contents to see if we can bring at least some of the changes to our region earlier than our normal 5-6 month cycle. For now, here are the changes that we’re considering to implement in July. Please note that we will provide the details with our July update Patch Notes.[/*][list][*]Improvements in acquisition of Cubes and Flames[/*][*]Arcane River Droplet Stones will become exchangeable in Reboot world[/*][*]Star Force enhancements and Spell Trace enhancements’ animation time will be shortened to ⅕ of current time[/*][*]Keeping certain buff effects active on the character when the game client closed[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Sharing High-Level Roadmap of Future Updates with the Community[/b]
[list][*]We tend to be very cautious when sharing information about future updates with you since there’s a possibility that the plan can change due to unforeseen circumstances that we didn’t expect during the planning stage. However, we understand that our players would like to know our future update plan to better prepare themselves, and so we will do our best to share this type of information with you as early as possible. We are still coming up with ways to best communicate these topics, but I want to let you know that we’re actively brainstorming ideas.[/*][*]Until we have a better channel to discuss our future plans, I want to give you some information on what we’re working on for our summer update. As you can expect, we’re currently working on our June and July Neo updates. Our plan is to release the first part of our Neo update on [b]June 9[/b], and this will be an exciting update since the max level will increase to Lv. 300. There will be various changes for fast growth, such as a 20% reduction in required EXP for level-ups between Lv. 210-250, as well as an EXP increase when defeating monsters of the same level as you. Additionally, the death penalty will be changed with the Neo update and the max damage and meso limit will be increased. Most importantly, a new character, also known as the Darkness Chaser will join the MapleStory journey with the Neo update.[/*][*]Here are some additional highlights of the Neo update that I hope you find exciting:[list][*][b]June 9[/b]: [b]Burning World [/b]and [b]Tera Burning [/b]will return with an opportunity for 1+2 rapid level-up![/*][*][b]June 9[/b]: Neo Castle events are coming your way[/*][*][b]June 9[/b]: A new region arrives--a sacred city where an ancient god lies dormant--known as "[b]Cernium[/b], City of the Gods"[/*][*][b]July Update[/b]: A derelict hotel in a vast desert, another new region called "[b]Hotel Arcus[/b]" will be unveiled[/*][*][b]July Update[/b]: Meet new boss "[b]Chosen Seren[/b]", the holy guardian of the sword![/*][*][b]July Update[/b]: [b]Zero and Beast Tamer character creation [/b]will be available in all worlds during the July update period[/*][/list][/*][*]We’re also reviewing the feasibility of having another Better Maple with our July update, following June, so we will keep you updated once we finish our reviewing process.[/*][/list]
These are the updates that I have for today but please know that we’re discussing and reviewing other things as well that were mentioned in our previous memo.

Thank you,

[u]- Anna[/u]

tags.feature: - Find the mushrooms that Mushroom Researcher Scarrs has left blooming in the safe places of Maple World!
- Speak to Mushroom Researcher Scarrs though the star event notifier and accept the quest "Scarrs' Prank" to receive the April Fools' Magnifying Glass.
- Go to Henesys, Kerning City, Perion, Ellinia, Lith Harbor, and the Six Path Crossway to look for mushrooms on display that seem... out of place.
- Use the April Fools' Magnifying Glass near one of the suspicious mushrooms to mark it off!
- There are eight mushrooms spread across the six areas, and when you've found them all speak to Mushroom Researcher Scarrs again to complete the quest and claim your prizes!
- And when you're done, you might want to check on the [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/rankings/overall-ranking/legendary]Player Rankings[/url], something odd seems to be going on right now...

- Coy Face Accessory: Permanent, cannot be traded.
- Forced Smile Face Accessory: Permanent, cannot be traded.
- Grinning Face Accessory: Permanent, cannot be traded.
- Round-Eyed Face Accessory: Permanent, cannot be traded.
- Sobbing Face Accessory: Permanent, cannot be traded.

- You can see the all the reward rates for this item [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/micro-site/66294]here[/url]. It can also be [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/66170/cash-shop-update-for-march-31]purchased in the Cash Shop[/url].

notes.title: The Marvel Machine Returns March 26!
notes.content:

notes.title: v.221 - Spring Blossoms Patch Notes
notes.content:
The season of flowers, Spring has blossomed! Stroll through the cherry blossom trees and explore the [b]Zipangu Revamp[/b] with changes to Showa Town, Ninja Castle, Hieizan, and more. Hop on your favorite Legend in [b]The Legends Return![/b], claim victory, and climb up the rankings to receive new ranking rewards! When you run out of breath from all that excitement, take a break at the [b]Maple Cafe on a Spring Day[/b] and befriend the baristas to unlock rewards with exclusive items available for [b]Pit-a-Pat Pass[/b] holders. Our fan-favorite, [b]Mechanical Hearts[/b] is back again! Master the jump quests, rescue the Wondroids, and get your hands on exclusive Androids and Hearts. Start your Springtime with [b]Spring Blossoms[/b].

Read the Spring Blossoms Patch Notes [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/65824/v-221-spring-blossoms-patch-notes]here[/url]!

notes.title: Pixel Picks Voting Is Back!
notes.content:
Ever wanted to have a say in which cosmetic items are available in the Cash Shop? Now with [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/game/pixelpicks][b]Pixel Picks[/b][/url], you can vote on your favorite items to get them back in the Cash Shop! You can vote for one item in each category; once the voting period has ended, the community’s top choices will be included in one of our upcoming sales rotations!

Go [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/game/pixelpicks]here[/url] to vote on which items you'd like to bring back. The top two outfit style winners of this round will be added to the upcoming [b]April 28 Premium Surprise Style Box[/b] rotation. notes.title: v.221 - Spring Blossoms Update Preview
notes.content:
The season of flowers, Spring has blossomed! Stroll through the cherry blossom trees and explore the [b]Zipangu Revamp[/b] with changes to Showa Town, Ninja Castle, Hieizan, and more. Hop on your favorite Legend in [b]The Legends Return![/b], claim victory, and climb up the rankings to receive new ranking rewards! When you run out of breath from all that excitement, take a break at the [b]Maple Cafe on a Spring Day[/b] and befriend the baristas to unlock rewards with exclusive items available for [b]Pit-a-Pat Pass[/b] holders. Our fan-favorite, [b]Mechanical Hearts[/b] is back again! Master the jump quests, rescue the Wondroids, and get your hands on exclusive Androids and Hearts. Start your Springtime with [b]Spring Blossoms[/b].

You can read the Spring Blossoms Update Preview [url=https://maplestory.nexon.net/news/65355/v-221-spring-blossoms-update-preview]here[/url]!

tags.feature: Two new mini-games have arrived to challenge your reflexes and strategic planning, as you play a cunning game of potion stacking in Potion Pyramid, and dodge a simply obscene number of energy blasts in Wisp Wallop!
Strategically stack potions in the shape of a pyramid against other players!
Talk to Ephony the Fairy located in the Full Moon Party Venue map to queue up for a Potion Pyramid match against two other players.
There are a total of 36 potions given out in each turn, with 12 of them distributed randomly to each player: 7 potions of each of 5 types, and one special potion.
Potions can be placed on the bottom row or on top of two other potions, if one of the potions is of the same type. Placing a potion earns you 10 points.
The Special Potion can be placed on top of any potion, and potions cannot be placed upon it.
Each player places a potion, one at a time. If a player cannot legally place a potion, their turn is skipped, and the next player may place one.
You have only 10 seconds to place a potion. If you fail to do so, Ephony the Fairy will make a move for you and you will earn 0 points for the move.
If you miss your turn 3 times, you will forfeit the match, receive no rewards, and will not be allowed to join a new match for 15 minutes.
The round ends when a player has placed all of their potions into the pyramid, or when there are no remaining legal moves (due to no players being able to place any potions).
Each match of Potion Pyramid consists of 3 rounds, with prizes awarded to players based on their ranking (which is determined by the number of points each player earned):
1st Place: 40 Cotton Candy
2nd Place: 20 Cotton Candy
3rd Place: 10 Cotton Candy
Tiebreaker: If two players have the same number of points at the end of the match, the player who reached their final point total first will place higher.
You can receive up to 100 Cotton Candy across all events each day. If you reach your Cotton Candy limit for the day, you can still participate in the game, but will not receive any Cotton Candy.
Fly around avoiding incoming missiles while collecting candies!
You can accept the invitation quest every hour on the 15-minute and the 45-minute mark from the invitation that appears on top of your character.
There are a total of 3 stages. There must be a minimum of 10 participants for the game to start (up to 50 players may play per round).
The goal of this game is to successfully avoid attacks and obtain as many candies as possible within the time limit to earn Cotton Candy.

When you are hit by an attack, you will briefly become unable to move or catch any candy. Once you are able to move again, you will have a few seconds of invulnerability for you to get to safety (and maybe grab some candy along the way!).
Not all candy is worth the same! The bigger the piece, the sweeter the reward, and once a piece of candy is caught by a player, no one else can grab it!
When each stage ends, Cotton Candy will be distributed based on your ranking:
1st Place: 50 Cotton Candy
2nd - 10th Place: 30 Cotton Candy
11th - 20th Place: 20 Cotton Candy
21st - 30th Place: 15 Cotton Candy
31st - 50th Place: 10 Cotton Candy
You can receive up to 100 Cotton Candy across all events each day. If you reach your Cotton Candy limit for the day, you can still participate in the game but no longer obtain Cotton Candy.
You cannot earn the rewards if you leave during the game.
Rankings reset after every stage, and the challenge of dodging the attacks gets harder as well!

notes.title: [Update] Magic Wagon Temporarily Closed

- The MapleStory Team

notes.content:

[list][*]Open the Star Event Notifier on the left side of the screen, or speak to So Gong in Henesys, Leafre, or Nameless Town, and accept the "[Awake Warm-Up] Warm-Up In Order to Wake Up!" quest to begin![/*][*][b]Requirement[/b]: Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2).[/*][*]Every day, use the Star Event Notifier, or speak to So Gong in Henesys, Leafre, or Nameless Town, and accept the "[Awake Warm-Up] Awakening Coin" quest to receive a Frozen Awakening Coin.[/*][*]After 30 uninterrupted minutes of being logged in on that character, the coin will be suitably warmed-up and defrost into an Awakening Coin, which you can use to complete the "[Awake Warm-Up] Awakening Coin" quest.[/*][*][b]When the Awake update arrives on November 18[/b], you can receive the Awake Warm-up Box reward through the "[Awake Warm-up] Receive Awake Warm-up Box Reward" quest, which will award you additional prizes based on the number of Daily Quests you've completed (ex: if you complete 6 Daily Quests, you'll be able to claim rewards for 2x Daily Quests, 4x Daily Quests, and 6x Daily Quests)![/*][/list]

[b]Event Rewards:[/b]
[list][*][b]Daily Reward:[/b][list][*][b]2x EXP Coupon (2) (15 Min)[/b]: 7-day duration, can be transferred to characters on the same account and world.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]2x Daily Quest Completions:[/b][list][*][b]Character Slot Expansion Coupon[/b]: 7-day duration, untradable.[/*][*]Can be claimed after the Awake update on November 18.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]4x Daily Quest Completions:[/b][list][*][b]So Gong Pet Package[/b]: Package has a 7-day duration, can be transferred to characters on the same account and world. Open the package to receive:[list][*][b]So Gong Pet[/b]: 90-day duration, untradable. Can be transferred to Cash Inventory. Duration can be extended with Waters of Life items.[/*][*][b]So Gong's Wooden Stick[/b]: Pet Equipment for So Gong, permanent, untradable. Can be transferred to Cash Inventory.[/*][/list][/*][*]Can be claimed after the Awake update on November 18.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]6x Daily Quest Completions:[/b][list][*][b]Arcane Symbol Selection Coupon (30)[/b]: 7-day duration, can be transferred to characters on the same account and world.[/*][*]Can be claimed after the Awake update on November 18.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]8x Daily Quest Completions:[/b][list][*][b]Nodestone (15)[/b]: 7-day duration, can be transferred to characters on the same account and world.[/*][*]Can be claimed after the Awake update on November 18.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]10x Daily Quest Completions:[/b][list][*][b]All Star Hair Coupon Ticket[/b]: 7-day duration, can be transferred to characters on the same account and world.[/*][*][b]All Star Face Coupon Ticket[/b]: 7-day duration, can be transferred to characters on the same account and world.[/*][*]Can be claimed after the Awake update on November 18.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
You can also take advantage of the Cash Inventory Transfer Event when it hits next week. This rare opportunity to move cash items between your characters goes away when the Awake update arrives on November 18!
[h2]Cash Inventory Transfer Event[/h2][list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 11, 2020 11:30 AM - Wednesday, November 18, 2020 (Start of Maintenance)
[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 11, 2020 8:30 PM - Wednesday, November 18, 2020 (Start of Maintenance)
[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Thursday, November 12, 2020 6:30 AM - Wednesday, November 18, 2020 (Start of Maintenance)[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]It's the time you have been waiting for! Transfer your cash items between your characters within the same world![/*][*]Take this opportunity to move cash cover items between characters, move a beloved pet to a new character, and so much more![/*][*]Follow these simple steps to transfer cash items between your characters:
[list][*]Enter the Cash Shop.[/*][*]Pick an eligible item you would like to transfer to a different character, and move it into your Cash Inventory.[/*][*]Right-click the item.[/*][*]Click the "Transfer Within World" button from the menu.[/*][*]Select the recipient of the item from the drop-down menu and click the 'OK' button.[/*][*]The selected item will now appear in the other character’s Cash Inventory the next time you log in to that character.[/*][/list][/*][*]Rules and Restrictions
[list][*]This event is available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds.[/*][*]You can only transfer cash items between characters in the same world.[/*][*]Cash items cannot be transferred using the "Transfer Within World" button between the classes that already share their Cash Inventory.[/*][*]Items that stack in one inventory slot cannot be split up and transferred.[/*][/list][/*][*]There are a few items that are not able to be transferred:
[list][*]EXP Coupons[/*][*]Potion Pot[/*][*]Friendship and Couple Items[/*][/list][/*][/list]

Pick an eligible item you would like to transfer to a different character, and move it into your Cash Inventory.
Click the "Transfer Within World" button from the menu.
Select the recipient of the item from the drop-down menu and click the 'OK' button.
The selected item will now appear in the other character’s Cash Inventory the next time you log in to that character.
This event is available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds.
You can only transfer cash items between characters in the same world.
Cash items cannot be transferred using the "Transfer Within World" button between the classes that already share their Cash Inventory.

notes.title: Burning World Event
notes.content:
Are you ready to race new characters to Lv. 150 with the biggest level-up event in MapleStory history? We're creating an entire new World with one purpose only: Powering through the early levels!
[h1][b]Burning World[/b][/h1]
[list][*][b]Wednesday, July 22, 2020 (End of Maintenance) - Thursday, September 17, 2020 (Start of Maintenance)[/b][/*][/list]
Burning World is a special world with special rules that will exist only for the duration of the Burning World event, filled with boosts to make it easier than ever to level up fast. While on Burning World, all characters will gain the special [b]Burning[/b] skill, which grants the following bonuses:
[list][*][b]1.5x EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +50[/b][/*][*][b]Damage against Normal Monsters +30%[/b][/*][*][b]Damage against Bosses +30%[/b][/*][*][b]Critical Rate +30%[/b][/*][*][b]Critical Damage +30%[/b][/*][/list]
You will also be able to create [b]three Mega Burning [/b]characters, who operate in the same manner as in previous Mega Burning events: After reaching Lv. 10, every time that character levels up, they will also gain [b]two bonus levels[/b], all the way up to Lv. 150. Combined with the Burning EXP bonus and boosted damage, you'll be able to power your way through those levels faster than ever before!

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/1140/burning-world-menu-v2.png[/img]

Additionally, even after your Mega Burning characters have been created, you'll be able to create another three characters to level up and leap, which will still benefit from the Burning skill! Please note that, while the default number of Character Slots on Burning World is eight, and can be expanded via Character Slot Coupons awarded from Daily Gifts and other avenues, only six characters will be able to World Leap when the Burning World event comes to a close, even if you have more than six Lv. 150 characters on the world.

As Burning World is a [b]temporary[/b] world to be removed at the end of the World Leap stage, some MapleStory features will be unavailable there:
[list][*]The Meso Market will not be available.[/*][*]Link Skills cannot be transferred between characters on Burning World (the Burning skill will have to be enough!).[/*][*]Maple Legion will be unavailable; the UI will be unavailable and you will be unable to progress on it past talking to Legion NPCs.[/*][*]Monster Collection will be unavailable, monsters will not be added to the collection and the UI will not open.[/*][*]Maple Tour will not be available.[/*][*]The following quests connected to the above features cannot be completed:[list][*]Teaching Link Skill[/*][*]Teaching Zero's Link Skill[/*][*][Legion] Whip the Whelps[/*][*][Legion] Defeat the Golden Wyvern[/*][*][Legion] We Are Legion[/*][*]Talk to Dame Appropriation[/*][*][Legion] Legion Introduction[/*][*][Monster Collection] Monster Collector[/*][/list][/*][*]The following Cash Shop items cannot be purchased on Burning World:[list][*]Character Slot Coupon[/*][*]Add 4 Slots (Storage)[/*][*]Add 8 Slots (Storage)[/*][*]House Wedding Ticket[/*][*]Commitment of Love Ticket[/*][*]Custom Title Package[/*][*]Promise Ring[/*][*]Cupid Ring[/*][*]Cloud Promise Ring[/*][*]Venus Fireworks[/*][*]Crossed Hearts[/*][*]Illumination Couples Ring[/*][*]Friendship Ring: Clover[/*][*]Friendship Ring: Flower Petal[/*][*]Friendship Ring: Star[/*][*]Snow Dome Friendship Ring[/*][/list][/*][/list][h1][b]Burning World Rewards[/b][/h1]
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/1132/burning-world-items.png[/img]

[b]Upon creating a Mega Burning character in the Burning World[/b]:
[list][*][b]Flameborn Medal:[/b] Untradeable, does not expire. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +5, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, MaxHP/MaxMP +250.[/*][*][b]Pearl Maple Armor Box:[/b] Untradeable, box expires after 7 days. Open to receive:[list][*][b]Pearl Maple Hat:[/b] Can be traded once within the same account. Req. Lv: 30. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +6, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +100. Upgrades available: 7. Part of the Maple White Set.[/*][*][b]Pearl Maple Suit:[/b] Can be traded once within the same account. Req. Lv: 30. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +155. Upgrades available: 10. Part of the Maple White Set.[/*][*][b]Pearl Maple Cape:[/b] Can be traded once within the same account. Req. Lv: 30. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +2, MaxHP/MaxMP +50, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +40. Upgrades available: 5. Part of the Maple White Set.[/*][*][b]Pearl Maple Gum:[/b] Can be traded once within the same account. Req. Lv: 30. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +5, Defense +10. Upgrades available: 5. Part of the Maple White Set.[/*][*][b]Pearl Maple Pendant:[/b] Can be traded once within the same account. Req. Lv: 30. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +8, Defense +100. Upgrades available: 5. Part of the Maple White Set.[/*][*][b]Pearl Maple Buckle: [/b]Untradeable. Req. Lv: 30. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +3, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +20. Upgrades available: 3. Part of the Maple White Set.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Slot Expansion:[/b] Equip, Use, Set-Up and Etc inventories expanded to 56 slots. Granted via a quest available on logging in with a Burning character.[/*][*][b]Hyper Teleport Rock:[/b] Untradeable. 30-day duration. Can be used repeatedly until it expires.[/*][/list]
[b]Additional Mega Burning Rewards[/b]:

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q2/1002/burning-rewards-icons.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Mysterious Cryptic Chest:[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration. Open to receive:
[list][*][b]Snail Pet:[/b] 5-hour duration.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Lv. 30 Equipment Box:[/b] Untradeable, box expires on [b]September 17 at 1:59 PM UTC[/b]. Can be opened at Lv. 30. Open to receive a weapon and armor set suitable for your class.[/*][*][b]Legendary Cryptic Chest:[/b] Untradeable, box expires on [b]September 17 at 1:59 PM UTC[/b]. Can be opened at Lv. 100. Open to receive:
[list][*][b]Frozen Hat:[/b] Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +23, MaxHP/MaxMP +270, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +293. Upgrades available: 10.[/*][*][b]Frozen Cape:[/b] Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7, Defense +180, Speed +9, Jump +5. Upgrades available: 7.[/*][*][b]Frozen Suit:[/b] Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +27, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +315. Upgrades available: 10.[/*][*][b]Frozen Weapon Box:[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration. Open to receive:
[list][*][b]Frozen Weapon:[/b] Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. Stats will vary based upon your job.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Frozen Secondary Weapon Box:[/b] Untradeable, 7-day duration. Open to receive:
[list][*][b]Frozen Secondary Weapon:[/b] Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. Stats will vary based upon your job.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Mastery Box (x8):[/b] Untradeable.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Keep On Burning Title Coupon:[/b] Title. Untradeable, coupon expires on [b]September 17 at 1:59 PM UTC[/b], stat duration lasts for 14 days. Can be used at Lv. 130. Grants durational stats STR/DEX/INT/LUK +10, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10, Boss Damage +10%, Ignore Defense +10%, MaxHP/MaxMP +400.[/*][/list]
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q2/1117/pixel-burning-rewards-maplestory-mega-burning-at-the-pixel-party.png[/img]
[h1][b]World Leap[/b][/h1][list][*][b]Thursday, September 17, 2020 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, October 7, 2020 (Start of Maintenance)[/b][/*][/list]
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/1134/world-leap-screen.png[/img]

As the saying goes, the light that burns twice as bright burns half as long, and the Burning World will burn very brightly indeed. However, while this new world will be consumed at the end of it all, a new life awaits your characters in the other Worlds of MapleStory!

Lv. 150+ characters on the Burning World will be allowed to Leap to another World of your choosing during the World Leap period, taking their equipped items, inventory, and mesos with them to join their new communities. When this period begins, all Burning World characters will be moved to the Burning Leap Zone map, where they will be able to speak to the NPC Mover to complete their exodus.
[list][*]Characters on the Burning World must be at least Lv. 150 in order to World Leap, whether they were Mega Burning characters or not.[list][*]Zero characters must be both Lv. 150+ and having completed Story Quest Act 2.[/*][*]It will not be possible to leave the Burning Leap Zone map during this period, making it impossible to gain any more EXP. notes.title: MapleStory's new update brings Burning World, rise events, and Yum Yum Island
notes.content:
Following the recent - and pretty hefty - MapleStory Rise: Promise of the Guardian update, the MMORPG is in for another chunky content drop with Rise: Surge of Power. The online RPG game's publisher Nexon America has announced the second portion of its big summer update will bring a "Burning World event", new Rise events, and discover secrets in a new island area.

The MapleStory Rise: Surge of Power event kicks off on July 22, and adds a brand-new Burning World event to the game, which means the chance - for a limited period of time - to create up to three Mega Burning characters. That is, get some characters levelled up in super quick time - running until September 17, the event will help you gain three levels every time you level up, until you hit 150.

In addition, new Rise events packed with Rise Coins include things like Eileen's support event, which gets you to eliminate monsters to hit some "training goals", and has a special skill on offer.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Huge new MapleStory update adds Adele class, new region, themed Rise events, more
MapleStory's Pathfinder: Squadron of Heroes adds a new Party Quest, dungeon, and Gorgons
We're giving away 50 leveling packs in MapleStory to celebrate Pathfinder!

Freed to answer the desperate prayer of a young man, she summons Aether Swords to strike at her foes, and any who might endanger her new charge. notes.title: Rise Up with Tera Burning!
notes.content:
[list][*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, June 10, 2020 (After Maintenance) - Tuesday, July 21, 2020 4:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, June 10, 2020 (After Maintenance) - Wednesday, July 22, 2020 1:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, June 10, 2020 (After Maintenance) - Wednesday, July 22, 2020 9:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]

[i]Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.[/i]

The [b]Tera Burning Project[/b] is here to help you level a brand-new character up to Lv. 200!

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, except for Zero and Adele characters.

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional [b]two levels[/b] all the way up to Lv. 200 (once your character hits Lv. 199, they will only be leveled up to Lv. 200)!

In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including [b]Root Abyss and Fafnir gear[/b]! When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training! You will receive additional rewards every time you gain 5 levels on your ‘Burning’ character starting Lv. 200 until Lv. 210!

[b]Here's How it Works[/b]

Create a brand-new character during the event period. From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect. Then, accept the quest "It's the Tera Burning Project gift giveaway!" from the star event notifier on the left-side of the game window in order to start receiving rewards! Only one character on your account can have the "Burning" effect.

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5786/newteraeffect.png[/img]


After completing the quest "It's the Tera Burning Project gift giveaway!," you will receive all of your gifts immediately; however, you will not be able to use all of them until you meet the required level for each reward. 

[b]Rewards:[/b]

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q2/1725/tera-burning-reward-boxes-maplestory.png[/img]

You must move to the correct answer zone within the given time limit.[/*][*]Some questions will come with Surprise Difficulty settings, such as swapping the answer's sides, the question itself becoming obscured or revealed at odd times, and more, so keep on your toes![/*][*]If you answer incorrectly, you will be moved to the bottom of the map. After a certain stage, a Survivor's List UI will be displayed only for those who lost the game. These players can select 1 survivor listed in the UI within the time limit. At the end of the stage, if the survivor you chose remains standing, you will also receive a part of the points for that round.[/*][*]The game will end when there are no more surviving characters, or when all 10 questions are answered.[/*][*]You can join as many times per day as you wish![/*][*]If you listen to the game explanation from Gym Cat located at Extravagameza Event Hall, you'll receive a [b]Divine Intelligence Badge[/b]. [/*][/list]

[list][*][b]Extravagameza Coins[/b][/*][*][b]Divine Intelligence Badge: [/b]Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +5, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1. [/*][/list][h1][b]High Noon Gunslinger[/b][/h1][list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): Tuesday, February 11, 2020 4:00 PM – Tuesday, February 25, 2020 3:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]EST (UTC -5): Tuesday, February 11, 2020 7:00 PM – Tuesday, February 25, 2020 6:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, February 12, 2020 1:00 AM – Wednesday, [b]February 26, 2020[/b] 12:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, February 12, 2020 11:00 AM – Wednesday, [b][b]February 26[/b], 2020[/b] 10:59 AM[/b][/*][/list]

[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list][*]It's high noon, so grab some big iron and take down your friends with this Gunslinger mini-game![/*][*][b]Requirement:[/b] Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2).[/*][*]Talk to Game Master Jun located at Extravagameza Event Hall to queue for High Noon Gunslinger. Once 4 players have queued, you will be moved to the lobby map and the game will begin.[/*][*]The goal of this game is to drop your opponents by shooting the platforms they are on until you are the last one standing.[/*][*]During your turn, you will have 10 seconds to choose which direction to move (left, right, down, or stationary) and choose the platform to shoot.[/*][*]The quicker you input your directions and shot selection, the better your chances will be at going first. A sign will appear above your character's head indicating the order.[/*][*]If you shoot first and your opponent drops, they lose the chance to shoot on that turn.[/*][*]You can participate in the High Noon Gunslinger game 10 times per day per world. notes.title: v.211 - Mechanical Utopia Patch Notes
notes.content:
Prepare yourself for [b]Mechanical Hearts: The Great Escape[/b]! Something disastrous is happening in Aspire after its collapse.
