notes.title: Double Miracle Time Event
notes.content:
[b]Saturday, December 21, 2019[/b]
[list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): 12:30 AM – 1:30 AM & 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM & 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM[/b][/*][*][b]EST (UTC -5): 3:30 AM – 4:30 AM & 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM & 12:00 AM ([b]Dec 22[/b]) – 1:00 AM ([b]Dec 22[/b])[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): 9:30 AM – 10:30 AM & 11:00 PM – 12:00 AM ([b]Dec 22[/b]) & 6:00 AM ([b]Dec 22[/b]) – 7:00 AM ([b]Dec 22[/b])[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): 7:30 PM – 8:30 PM & 9:00 AM ([b]Dec 22[/b]) – 10:00 AM ([b]Dec 22[/b]) & 4:00 PM ([b]Dec 22[/b]) – 5:00 PM ([b]Dec 22[/b])[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds.[/b]

If you've been searching for ways to boost your power, you're in luck! This Saturday is all about making you stronger through the mysterious power of Potential. Potential is a nifty system that allows you to add bonus effects to your equipment to make it truly heroic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/73436475a02abe1e041461a910c5dcd3a479923c.jpg[/img]

Cube away with [b]Red Cubes[/b], [b]Black Cubes[/b], and [b]Bonus Potential Cubes[/b] during the Double Miracle Time event times with double the rates of a rank-up! If you've got [b]White Cubes[/b] and [b]Violet Cubes[/b], you can use them for double the rates of a rank-up as well. There's a chance to raise your equipment's Potential rank TWICE with one cube! This means you could jump from Rare to Unique!

Make sure to earn those [b]Reward Points[/b] and visit the Maple Rewards Shop, located in the Event > Maple Rewards Shop category of the Cash Shop. You can get [b]Red Cubes[/b] and [b]Black Cubes[/b] with your points!

We're also having the following special sales in non-Reboot worlds on[b] December 21[/b] only!
[list][*][b]Radiant Red Cube Pack[/b], [b]Brilliant Black Cube Pack[/b], and [b]Dazzling Bonus Potential Cube Pack[/b] (which contain Red, Black or Bonus Potential Cubes, as well as a Unique Potential Scroll 30% Coupon)[/*][/list]
We're having the following special sale in Reboot world on [b]December 21[/b] only!
[list][*][b]30-packs of Red and Black Cubes[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Note[/b]: We have lowered the minimum level required to purchase cubes with NX Credit or Maple Points. You need to have a character Lv. 60 or above in order to purchase cubes with NX Credit or Maple Points. There is no such restriction for purchasing cubes with NX Prepaid.

Please note that Double Miracle Time will be available on all worlds, including Reboot.
[list][*]A scrolling message and a Cube icon will appear at the top of the screen during Double Miracle Time.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0badcfb624c7793bb5ed9d60585d6793fb08f2f3.jpg[/img]
[list][*]During the event, you'll have a 2x rate of increasing your potential's rank through Red Cubes, Black Cubes, Bonus Potential Cubes, White Cubes, and Violet Cubes![/*][*]Cubes CAN be used on sealed equipment.[/*][*]Also, some of the luckiest players will be granted a [b]Double Miracle Time Blessing[/b] after successfully increasing rank TWICE! This buff will allow everyone in the map to receive Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +30 for 15 minutes.[/*][/list]

notes.title: v.210 - Glory: Savior of Hope Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Cernium [/b]needs help from you and the Maple Alliance to protect the Holy City. Explore Cernium and discover [b]The Chosen One[/b] who’ll save the day with the power of the Holy Sword Azor. notes.content:
[h1][b][u]Tera Burning Event[/u][/b][/h1][list][*][b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 20, 2019 (After Maintenance) - Tuesday, January 28, 2019 11:59 PM[/b][/*][*][b]EST (UTC -5): Wednesday, November 20, 2019 (After Maintenance) - Wednesday, January 29, 2019 2:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 20, 2019 (After Maintenance) - Wednesday, January 29, 2019 8:59 AM[/b][/*][*][b]AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, November 20, 2019 (After Maintenance) - Wednesday, January 29, 2019 6:59 PM[/b][/*][/list]
[i]Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.[/i]

The [b]Tera Burning Project[/b] is here to help you level a brand-new character up to Lv. 200!

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, except for Zero and Hoyoung characters.

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional [b]two levels[/b] all the way up to Lv. 200 (once your character hits Lv. 199, they will only be leveled up to Lv. 200)!

In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including [b]permanent Root Abyss and Fafnir gear[/b]! And if that wasn't enough, each time your character levels up between Lv. 201 and 220, you'll receive [b]Arcane Symbols[/b] - all you have to do is accept the 'Tera Burning Project Arcane Symbols' quest!

[u][b]Here's How it Works[/b][/u]

Create a brand-new character during the event period. From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect. Then, accept the quest "It's the Tera Burning Project gift giveaway!" from the star event notifier on the left-side of the game window in order to start receiving rewards! Only one character on your account can have the "Burning" effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/9b58043e1c72d837d1b0efcabe93e4c853b86dd1.png[/img]

notes.title: v.209 Glory: Strengthened Alliances Patch Notes
notes.content:
What happened after the Black Mage fell? Empress Cygnus has called upon the brave to join the Maple Alliance. Become part of the [b]Glory Guard[/b] and complete special missions to rebuild Maple World while collecting coins to spend in the [b]Alliance Supply Depot[/b]. To double the fun, [b]Hoyoung[/b], the Capricious Sage, has left Cheong-woon Valley to explore Maple World! Join this new character for an adventure. We’re also preparing [b]Better Maple[/b] and [b]Growth Improvements[/b], and new [b]5th Job Skills[/b] to make your gameplay even better! Level a new character up faster than ever with even more perks in [b]Tera Burning[/b] and [b]Extreme Breakthrough[/b]! Join the fun and be ready to lead the Glory Guard!

Read the v.209 Patch Notes [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/news/53901/v-209-glory-strengthened-alliances-patch-notes#5th]here[/url]!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NCvb1fBPrfE

notes.title: v.208 - Fabled Melody Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]The Story of Pebble and Wind[/b] is here to tell all the big and small stories of Maple World! Complete quests and earn points to spend in the[b] Coin Shop[/b]. You can also help [b]Bard [/b]finish his songbook of forgotten songs and earn a [b]Legendary Bard Chair[/b] along the way. That’s not all! Hallowkitty is back with an assortment of [b]Halloween [/b]events to get you in the spooky spirit, and the fan-favorite [b]Dark Lords of Darkness[/b] also returns! On top of all these, our[b] Cash Shop[/b] is getting a whole new makeover with new modern UI and convenient features. There’s lots for you to check out, so dive right in and enjoy the ride.

To read the whole v.208 Patch Notes, click  [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/news/52972/v-208-fabled-melody-patch-notes]here[/url]!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xDZijf0Ey7U

notes.title: Hot Week Gifts!
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Sunday, September 22, 2019 5:00 PM - Sunday, September 29, 2019 4:59 PM[/b][/*]
[*][b]EDT (UTC -4): Sunday, September 22, 2019 8:00 PM - Sunday, September 29, 2019 7:59 PM[/b][/*]
[*][b]CEST (UTC +2): Monday, September 23, 2019 2:00 AM - Monday, September 30, 2019 1:59 AM[/b][/*]
[*][b]AEST (UTC +10): Monday, September 23, 2019 10:00 AM - Monday, September 30, 2019 9:59 AM[/b][/*]
[/list]
MapleStory will be having a whole week of [b]Hot Days[/b]! All you have to do is log in to start receiving great items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/2e84a9105683ebb6b16bf0581975b3c8694ff396.png[/img]

Log in each day with a character Lv. 30 or above, and click the gift box icon on the left side of the screen to receive a Gift Box, and then double-click the box in your inventory to open it. The Gift Box can be obtained [b]once in a 24-hour period every day[/b], resetting at [b]5:00 PM PDT / 8:00 PM EDT / 2:00 AM CEST / 10:00 AM AEST.[/b]

Once you receive the gift box, you can open it anytime before [b]2:00 AM PDT / 5:00 AM EDT / 11:00 AM CEST / 7:00 PM AEST[/b] of the following day.

If you have more than 30 unclaimed gifts, you may not be able to see the Hot Week reward. Please clear any unclaimed gifts and login again to see the Hot Week reward.

All rewards are for both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds unless specifically noted below.
[list]
[*]Monday, September 23[/*]
[list][*][b]Pendant of the Spirit (7 Day)[/b]: Unique equipped item. Untradeable, Time limit extension is not possible, 7-day duration.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Tuesday, September 24[/*]
[list][*][b]Nodestone[/b]: Untradeable.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Wednesday, September 25[/*]
[list][*][b]Character Slot Expansion Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Thursday, September 26[/*][list]
[*][b]2x EXP Coupon (30 Min) (x3)[/b]: Use to receive 2x EXP for 30 minutes. Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Friday, September 27[/*][list]
[*][b]Special Medal of Honor (x3)[/b]: Untradeable.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Saturday, September 28[/*][list]
[*][b]Selective 8-Slot Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Sunday, September 29[/*][list]
[*][b]Hyper Teleport Rock Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/*]
[*]Plus select one additional reward from the items given Monday through Saturday![/*]
[/list]
[/list]
If you obtain and [b]open[/b] each Gift Box every day from Monday to Saturday, then on Sunday—in addition to Sunday's reward—you can have another gift! You can select one from all of the items that were given out from Monday to Saturday. You are not required to have received each day's Gift Box on the same character in order to be eligible for the extra gift, but it does have to be with characters in the same world.

This event is available to players Lv. 30 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). You can receive one gift box per account per day.

You can also help Bard finish his songbook of forgotten songs and earn a Legendary Bard Chair along the way.
Hallowkitty is back with an assortment of Halloween events to get you in the spooky spirit, and the fan-favorite Dark Lords of Darkness also returns!

Join the [b]Maplehood Watch[/b] to protect the neighborhood and earn free Cash items! Log in during the event days ([b]Mondays[/b], [b]Wednesdays[/b] and [b]Saturdays[/b]) and hunt monsters within your level range to receive the day's reward!

notes.title: Level Up With the Double Mega Burning Project!
notes.content:
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, July 24, 2019 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, August 27, 2019 4:59 PM[/b]
[b]EDT (UTC -4): Wednesday, July 24, 2019 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, August 27, 2019 7:59 PM[/b]
[b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, July 24, 2019 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, August 28, 2019 1:59 AM[/b]
[b]AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, July 24, 2019 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, August 28, 2019 9:59 AM[/b]

[i]Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.[/i]

The [b]Double [/b][b]Mega Burning Project[/b] is here to help you level not one, but [b]two [/b]brand-new characters up to Lv. 150!

Create two brand-new characters during the event period and select them to have the special "Burning" effect. After your characters reach Lv. 10, every time they level up they will gain an additional [b]two levels[/b] all the way up to Lv. 150! This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, except for Pathfinder and Zero characters. (Please note that if you create an Illium character and select it as "Burning", you will need to complete your Illium questline first before teleporting out of the area. Otherwise you won't be able to get your 2nd job advancement properly).

[b][u]Here’s How it Works[/u][/b]

Create two brand-new characters during the event period. From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/a3e346bd7c72059f8c503f0e9e6058a7450e43e7.png[/img]

Only two characters per world can have the "Burning" effect. Log in with your characters and select the quest '[Adventure] 1+2 Level Up Challenge!' from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. You will receive the following special gifts!

[b]Rewards[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/19800f227c7f00c3444653254fbdb0e29a2f064e.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Lv. 30 Equipment Box[/b]: Untradeable. Can only be opened at Lv. 30. Open to receive a weapon and armor set suitable for your class.[/*]
[*][b]Mysterious Cryptic Gift Box[/b]: Untradeable. 7-day duration. Open to receive:[list]
[*][b]Snail[/b]: 5-hour Duration. Skills: Meso Magnet, Item Pouch. Cannot be moved to Cash Inventory. Cannot be revived with the Water of Life.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Legendary Cryptic Chest[/b]: Untradeable. Can only be opened at Lv. 100. Open to receive:[list]
[*][b]Frozen Hat[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +23 MaxHP/MaxMP +270, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +293. Upgrades available: 10.[/*]
[*][b]Frozen Cape[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7, Defense +180, Speed +9, Jump +5. Upgrades available: 7.[/*]
[*][b]Frozen Suit[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +27, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +315. Upgrades available: 10.[/*]
[*][b]Frozen Weapon Box[/b]: Untradeable. 7-day duration. Open to receive: 
[list]
[*][b]Frozen Weapon[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. Stats will vary based upon your job.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Frozen Secondary Weapon Box[/b]: Untradeable. 7-day duration. Open to receive:[b]
[/b][list]
[*][b]Frozen Secondary Weapon[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. Stats will vary based upon your job.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Mastery Box (x8)[/b]: Untradeable.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Keep on Burning Title Coupon[/b]: Untradeable. Can only be used at Lv. 130. Use to receive:[list]
[*][b]Keep on Burning[/b]: Title. Untradeable. 14-day duration on stats. Req. Lv: 130. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +10, MaxHP/MaxMP +400, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10, Boss Damage +10%, Ignore DEF +10%.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
Each time one of your characters levels up, they will receive two additional levels! Work your way up to Lv. 150, so you can wear those sweet equips!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/19619f0bdf4d643c5f8ced3bc420d7ce6d26c8fa.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Double Miracle Time Event
notes.content:
[b]Saturday, July 6 2019[/b]
[list]
[*][b]PDT (UTC -7): 1:30 AM – 2:30 AM & 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM & 10:00 PM – 11:00 PM[/b][/*]
[*][b]EDT (UTC -4): 4:30 AM – 5:30 AM & 6:00 PM – 7:00 PM & 1:00 AM – 2:00 AM ([b]July 7[/b])[/b][/*]
[*][b]CEST (UTC +2): 10:30 AM – 11:30 AM & 12:00 AM – 1:00 AM ([b][b]July 7[/b][/b]) & 7:00 AM – 8:00 AM ([b][b]July 7[/b][/b])[/b][/*]
[*][b]AEST (UTC +10): 6:30 PM – 7:30 PM & 8:00 AM – 9:00 AM ([b][b]July 7[/b][/b]) & 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM ([b][b]July 7[/b][/b])[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b]Available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds.[/b]

If you've been searching for ways to boost your power, you’re in luck! This Saturday is all about making you stronger through the mysterious power of Potential. Potential is a nifty system that allows you to add bonus effects to your equipment to make it truly heroic.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/97410666a9c42697aef63b5acef6b83db3271073.jpg[/img]

Cube away with [b]Red Cubes[/b], [b]Black Cubes[/b], and [b]Bonus Potential Cubes[/b] during the Double Miracle Time event times with double the rates of a rank-up! If you’ve got [b]White Cubes[/b] and [b]Violet Cubes[/b], you can use them for double the rates of a rank-up as well. There’s a chance to raise your equipment's Potential rank TWICE with one cube! This means you could jump from Rare to Unique!

Make sure to earn those [b]Reward Points[/b] and visit the Maple Rewards Shop, located in the Special Promotions > Maple Rewards Shop category of the Cash Shop. You can get [b]Red Cubes[/b] and [b]Black Cubes[/b] with your points!

We’re also having the following special sales in non-Reboot worlds on [b]July 6[/b] only!
[list]
[*][b]Cube Adventurers' Packs[/b] (which contain 60 Red, Black or Bonus Potential Cubes, as well as 5 Philosopher's Book items, Violet Cubes or White Cubes, and a Golden Hammer 100% Coupon)[/*]
[*][b]Radiant Red Cube Pack[/b], [b]Brilliant Black Cube Pack[/b], and [b]Dazzling Bonus Potential Cube Pack[/b] (which contain Red, Black or Bonus Potential Cubes, as well as a Unique Potential Scroll 30% Coupon)[/*]
[*][b]Red Cube[/b] [b]and[/b] [b]Black Cube Twelve Packs[/b] (which contain Red or Black Cubes and a Gold Awakening Stamp Coupon)[/*]
[*][b]Gold and Silver Bonus Potential Packages[/b] (which contain Bonus Potential Cubes, Silver or Golden Bonus Potential Stamps, and a Special Bonus Potential Scroll)[/*]
[*]Discounted [b]11-packs of Red and Black[/b] [b]Cubes[/b] and [b]10-packs of [/b][b]Bonus Potential Cubes[/b][/*]
[/list]
We’re having the following special sale in Reboot world on [b]July 6[/b] only!
[list]
[*]Discounted single [b]Red and Black Cubes[/b][/*]
[*]Discounted [b]6-packs of Red and Black Cubes[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b]Note[/b]: We have lowered the minimum level required to purchase cubes with NX Credit or Maple Points. You need to have a character Lv. 60 or above in order to purchase cubes with NX Credit or Maple Points. There is no such restriction for purchasing cubes with NX Prepaid.

Please note that Double Miracle Time will be available on all worlds, including Reboot.
[list]
[*]A scrolling message and a Cube icon will appear at the top of the screen during Double Miracle Time.[/*]
[*]During the event, you’ll have a 2x rate of increasing your potential’s rank through Red Cubes, Black Cubes, Bonus Potential Cubes, White Cubes, and Violet Cubes![/*]
[*]Cubes CAN be used on sealed equipment.[/*]
[*]Also, some of the luckiest players will be granted a [b]Double Miracle Time Blessing[/b] after successfully increasing rank TWICE! This buff will allow everyone in the map to receive Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +30 for 15 minutes.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: 14th Anniversary Events Continue!
notes.content:
Nexon America’s celebration of 14 Years of MapleStory continues with these new [b]14th Anniversary Events[/b]! Head on down to 14th Street and join in on these fun events to rack up [b]14th Street Points[/b]. Every 100 14th Street Points will earn you one [b]14th Street Coin[/b], which can be traded in at the [b]Big Bang Store[/b] for exclusive new gifts (there is a limit of 20,000 14th Street points you can earn per day).

In addition to these new events starting now, there are plenty of other 14th Anniversary Events still ongoing which you can read all about [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/news/45932/updated-may-16-explore-14th-anniversary-events]here[/url]!

[h1][b]Becoming a Celeb![/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 21, 2019 5:00 PM[b] - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 4:59 PM[/b]
[/b][/*]
[*][b]EDT (UTC -4): [b]Tuesday, May 21, 2019 8:00 PM[b] - [b]Tuesday, June 11, 2019 7:59 PM[/b][/b][/b]
[/b][/*]
[*][b]CEST (UTC +2): [b]Wednesday, May 22, 2019 2:00 AM[b] - Wednesday, [b]June 12[/b], 2019 1:59 AM[/b][/b]
[/b][/*]
[*][b]AEST (UTC +10): [b]Wednesday, May 22, 2019 10:00 AM[b] - [b]Wednesday, [b]June 12[/b], 2019 9:59 AM[/b][/b][/b][/b][/*]
[/list]
Characters Lv. 61 and up can pay a visit to [b]14th Street[/b] by selecting the '[14th Street] Maple 14th Street Fair Festivites' quest from the 14th Street icon on the notifier on the left side of the screen. After accepting, you'll immediately receive the [b]14th Street Fairgoer [/b]title. As you complete 14th Street Events, your 14th Street Celebrity Status will increase and your 14th Street Fairgoer title stats will increase along with it!
[list]
[*][b]14th Street Fairgoer[/b]: Title. Untradeable, stats duration lasts until June 12 at 12:00 AM UTC. Grants durational stats STR/DEX/INT/LUK + Celeb Status, MaxHP/MaxMP + (Celeb Status x 50), Weapon ATT/Magic ATT + Celeb Status, + Celeb Status% damage when attacking monsters, + Celeb Status% damage when attacking bosses, Ignore Defense + Celeb Status%.
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/a5fd1b26254c3ff65e278284335286f502fe7726.png[/img]

Complete all the events on 14th Street to become a [b]14th Street Celebrity[/b]! Players Lv. 61 and up can participate by accepting the ‘[14th Street Celeb] Celeb Status’ quest through the 14th Street icon in the star event notifier. Once you've met all the requirements for each event, you'll earn the [b]14th Street Celeb [/b]medal!
[list]
[*][b]14th Street Celeb[/b]: Medal. Untradeable. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK + 14, MaxHP/MaxMP +750, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d4096efcc928ed98e7473b839e84a06334357a78.png[/img]

Though some 14th Street events have already ended, you can still become a 14th Street Celeb! Accept the ‘[14th Street Celeb] Becoming a 14th Street Celeb!’ quest within the star event notifier on the left side of the screen, then hunt monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) - the monsters will drop [b]14th Street Celeb Passes[/b]. These passes will help fulfill 14th Street Celeb requirements for the 14th Street events that have ended (you cannot fulfill requirements for events that are still in progress.). You can collect up to 100 14th Street Celeb Passes a day per character. 
[list]
[*][b]Override Fashion[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Obtain 100 Override Fashion Coupons[/b]: 100 14th Street Celeb Passes
[/*]
[*][b]Obtain 200 Override Fashion Coupons[/b]: 200 14th Street Celeb Passes
[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Restaurant RED Maplelin Star Grub[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Hunt Hidden Monster 15 times[/b]: 75 14th Street Celeb Passes
[/*]
[*][b]Obtain Maplelin Star Grub! Reward 300 times[/b]: 200 14th Street Celeb Passes
[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]FIREPOWER Mega Burning[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Reach Lv. 130[/b]: 130 14th Street Celeb Passes
[/*]
[*][b]Reach Lv. 150[/b]: 150 14th Street Celeb Passes
[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Nova Planetarium Sub-Zero Hunt[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Charge monsters consecutively for 3 days[/b]: 150 14th Street Celeb Passes
[/*]
[*][b]Charge 15,000 or more monsters[/b]: 200 14th Street Celeb Passes
[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[h1][b][/b][/h1]

[h1][b]14th Street Big Bang Attack[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 21, 2019 5[b]:00 PM[/b] - Tuesday, June 4, 2019 4:59 PM[/b][/*]
[*][b]EDT (UTC -4): [b]Tuesday, May 21[/b][b][b], 2019 8[b]:00 PM[/b][/b][/b] - [b]Tuesday, June 4, 2019 7:59 PM[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b]CEST (UTC +2): [b]Wednesday, [b]May 22[/b][b],[/b][b] 2019 2[b]:00 AM[/b][/b][/b] - Wednesday, [b]June 5[/b], 2019 1:59 AM[/b][/*]
[*][b]AEST (UTC +10): [b]Wednesday, May 22[b], 2019 10[b]:00 AM[/b][/b][/b] - [b]Wednesday, [b]June 5[/b], 2019 9:59 AM[/b][/b][/*]
[/list]
Collect 14th Street Coins by using a special new skill! Characters Lv. 61 and up can participate by accepting the ‘[14th Street] Big Bang Attack! Can you handle it?’ quest through NPC Toben Hair Hero next to Big Bang Store, located in Maple 14th Street Fair map.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/0d096ab73af349b5d607ff1e0be2739247e9dd17.png[/img]

When you accept the quest, you'll acquire the '[b]Big Bang Attack[/b]' skill. You can charge it by hunting monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above). When the skill is charged, you can unleash it to collect [b]14th Street Points (x300)[/b]. You'll also earn an additional 15 points and a 50% EXP bonus for every monster hunted with 'Big Bang Attack' skill. If you've reached your coin capacity of the day, you can no longer use ‘Big Bang Attack’ to obtain 14th Street Coins.

[h1][b]Renegade Personal Fitness Training[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 21, 2019 5[b]:00 PM[/b] - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 4:59 PM[/b][/*]
[*][b]EDT (UTC -4): [b]Tuesday, May 21[/b][b][b], 2019 8[b]:00 PM[/b][/b][/b] - Tues[b]day, June 11, 2019 7:59 PM[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b]CEST (UTC +2): [b]Wednesday, [b]May 22[/b][b],[/b][b] 2019 2[b]:00 AM[/b][/b][/b] - Wednesday, [b]June 12[/b], 2019 1:59 AM[/b][/*]
[*][b]AEST (UTC +10): [b]Wednesday, May 22[b], 2019 10[b]:00 AM[/b][/b][/b] - Wedn[b]esday, [b]June 12[/b], 2019 9:59 AM[/b][/b][/*]
[/list]
Earn EXP by training at the [b]Renegade Fitness [/b]gym! If you visit the gym, you'll earn EXP proportionate to your level every 10 seconds just by standing in the gym! You can do this for up to 8 hours a day.

Characters Lv. 105 and up can earn even more EXP by accepting the ‘[14th Street] Renegade Personal Training’ quest through NPC So Gong in front of Renegade Fitness. After talking to NPC So Gong, you can designate a coach character and a trainee character to provide support perks while out hunting monsters. The character you are currently logged in as will become the coach. Once per world, you can designate another character on your account as the trainee character (the trainee character must be above level 105 and below 190; your trainee character cannot have a higher level than that of your coach character, and cannot be Zero or Pink Bean characters. You cannot cancel or change your coach and trainee characters once chosen). When you hunt monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) with your coach character, a portion of the EXP gained will automatically be applied to the trainee character!

Once your trainee reaches Lv. 190, the event effect will disappear and you'll earn the [b]Personal Training Completionist [/b]title!
[list]
[*][b]Personal Training Completionist[/b]: Title. Untradeable, stat duration lasts for 30 days. Grants durational stats Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, 15% additional EXP.
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/2ef1e30cb0f806d462350d1082604db47748dfca.png[/img]

[h1][b][/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Round-We-Go Cafe Rising Heroes![/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 21, 2019 5[b]:00 PM[/b] - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 4:59 PM[/b][/*]
[*][b]EDT (UTC -4): [b]Tuesday, May 21[/b][b][b], 2019 8[b]:00 PM[/b][/b][/b] - [b]Tuesday, June 11[/b][b], 2019 7:59 PM[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b]CEST (UTC +2): [b]Wednesday, [b]May 22[/b][b],[/b][b] 2019 2[b]:00 AM[/b][/b][/b] - Wednesday, [b]June 12[/b], 2019 1:59 AM[/b][/*]
[*][b]AEST (UTC +10): [b]Wednesday, May 22[b], 2019 10[b]:00 AM[/b][/b][/b] - Wedn[b]esday, [b]June 12[/b], 2019 9:59 AM[/b][/b][/*]
[/list]
Earn EXP coupons by visiting [b]Cafe Rising Heroes[/b] with your friends! Form a party with 3 or more guild members and be on the same map and channel, and enter Cafe Rising Heroes from 14th Street. After hanging out there for a minute, you'll have the option to leave and receive a [b]2x EXP Coupon[/b]! You can receive this reward once per day.

You can also earn 14th Street Points by juggling drink orders (literally!) in the Cafe Rising Heroes[b] [/b]mini-game! Characters Lv. 61 and above can play by accepting the ‘[14th Street] Round-We-Go Cafe Rising Heroes!’ quest through NPC Eileen in front of Cafe Rising Heroes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/cd50a1930b10111924f74a0beeb4a0278d47a777.png[/img]

The goal of this game is to avoid the falling germs while keeping the tea cups balanced. Use your mouse to move the stick balancing the cup on the tray, and avoid all falling obstacles without spilling the drink. There are a total of 15 stages; you'll earn stacking [b]14th Street Points [/b]as you clear each stage. Even if you have reached the daily limit, you can keep playing the Cafe Rising Heroes game. 

[h1][b]14th Street Sky[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 28, 2019 5[b]:00 PM[/b] - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 4:59 PM[/b][/*]
[*][b]EDT (UTC -4): [b]Tuesday, May 28[/b][b][b], 2019 8[b]:00 PM[/b][/b][/b] - [b]Tuesday, June 11, 2019 7:59 PM[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b]CEST (UTC +2): [b]Wednesday, [b]May 29[/b][b],[/b][b] 2019 2[b]:00 AM[/b][/b][/b] - Wednesday, [b]June 12[/b], 2019 1:59 AM[/b][/*]
[*][b]AEST (UTC +10): [b]Wednesday, May 29[b], 2019 10[b]:00 AM[/b][/b][/b] - [b]Wednesday, [b]June 12[/b], 2019 9:59 AM[/b][/b][/*]
[/list]
Soar above the city to earn 14th Street Coins at [b]Legends Tower 62[/b]! Characters Lv. 61 and up can play by accepting the ‘[14th Street] 14th Street Sky’ quest through NPC Grizzle in front of Legend Tower 62.

The goal of this game is to fly as far as you can to earn 14th Street Points. Dash and jump your way through as many items as you can—you'll earn [b]14th Street Coins[/b] depending on how far you flew! You'll also earn Sky Points as you fly, which will grant special level-up effects once you collect enough, allowing you to earn even more 14th Street Coins! If you've reached your daily coin capacity of the day, you will no longer obtain 14th Street Coins, but you can keep playing 14th Street Sky.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/15cc1af3f89b4ae8f559fb5ac229e90980c9e5b8.png[/img]

You can also visit the roof of Legends Tower 62 to obtain [b]Legendary Maple Leaves[/b]! Every 5 minutes the maple trees will drop leaves which you can collect in order to earn [b]Honor EXP[/b]! You need to leave and re-enter to spawn more leaves.

[h1][b]Finding Spiegelmann's Art[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 28, 2019 5[b]:00 PM[/b] - [b]Tuesday, June 11[/b], 2019 4:59 PM[/b][/*]
[*][b]EDT (UTC -4): [b]Tuesday, May 28[/b][b][b], 2019 8[b]:00 PM[/b][/b][/b] - [b]Tuesday, June 11[/b][b], 2019 7:59 PM[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b]CEST (UTC +2): [b]Wednesday, [b]May 29[/b][b],[/b][b] 2019 2[b]:00 AM[/b][/b][/b] - Wednesday, [b]June 12[/b], 2019 1:59 AM[/b][/*]
[*][b]AEST (UTC +10): [b]Wednesday, May 29[b], 2019 10[b]:00 AM[/b][/b][/b] - [b]Wednesday, [b]June 12[/b], 2019 9:59 AM[/b][/b][/*]
[/list]
Pay a visit to the [b]Ark Museum[/b] and earn Trait Points! Stand next to one of the designated status in the museum, and after appreciating it a bit, you'll earn [b]+2 Trait Points[/b]! You can earn up to 500 points per trait daily.

You can also help Spiegelmann retrieve his art collection! Characters Lv. 61 and up can start by accepting the ‘[14th Street] Spiegelmann’s Art Retrieval’ quest through NPC Spiegelmann in front of Ark Museum. Hunt monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) to get monsters to drop [b]Spiegelmann’s Artwork[/b]. Each Spiegelmann's Artwork will automatically grant you [b]14th Street Coins (x2)[/b], and you can collect up to 100 pieces of Spiegelmann’s Artwork a day per character.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/27af483d7bfdc10c1f386c6f61c14118698a7451.png[/img]

You can also receive a daily reward when you complete the quest once a day per world. For your daily reward, you can select 1 of the following:
[list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/0d177ec60c76e2944dcb13486a715b7277cd18c2.png[/img]

[h1][b]Big Bang Store[/b][/h1]

Pay a visit to the [b]Big Bang Store[/b] and spend your hard-earned [b]14th Street Coins[/b] on amazing rewards! You can access the Big Bang Store by talking to NPC Yeti on the Maple 14th Street Fair Map. Weekly items will reset every Thursday at 12:00 AM UTC during the event period.

tags.feature: Characters Lv. 61 and up can pay a visit to [b]14th Street[/b] by selecting the '[14th Street] Maple 14th Street Fair Festivites' quest from the 14th Street icon on the notifier on the left side of the screen. After accepting, you'll immediately receive the [b]14th Street Fairgoer [/b]title. As you complete 14th Street Events, your 14th Street Celebrity Status will increase and your 14th Street Fairgoer title stats will increase along with it!

Complete all the events on 14th Street to become a [b]14th Street Celebrity[/b]! Players Lv. 61 and up can participate by accepting the ‘[14th Street Celeb] Celeb Status’ quest through the 14th Street icon in the star event notifier. Once you've met all the requirements for each event, you'll earn the [b]14th Street Celeb [/b]medal!

Though some 14th Street events have already ended, you can still become a 14th Street Celeb! Accept the ‘[14th Street Celeb] Becoming a 14th Street Celeb!’ quest within the star event notifier on the left side of the screen, then hunt monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) - the monsters will drop [b]14th Street Celeb Passes[/b]. These passes will help fulfill 14th Street Celeb requirements for the 14th Street events that have ended (you cannot fulfill requirements for events that are still in progress.). You can collect up to 100 14th Street Celeb Passes a day per character.

Collect 14th Street Coins by using a special new skill! Characters Lv. 61 and up can participate by accepting the ‘[14th Street] Big Bang Attack! Can you handle it?’ quest through NPC Toben Hair Hero next to Big Bang Store, located in Maple 14th Street Fair map.

When you accept the quest, you'll acquire the '[b]Big Bang Attack[/b]' skill. You can charge it by hunting monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above). When the skill is charged, you can unleash it to collect [b]14th Street Points (x300)[/b]. You'll also earn an additional 15 points and a 50% EXP bonus for every monster hunted with 'Big Bang Attack' skill. If you've reached your coin capacity of the day, you can no longer use ‘Big Bang Attack’ to obtain 14th Street Coins.

Earn EXP by training at the [b]Renegade Fitness [/b]gym! If you visit the gym, you'll earn EXP proportionate to your level every 10 seconds just by standing in the gym! You can do this for up to 8 hours a day.

Characters Lv. 105 and up can earn even more EXP by accepting the ‘[14th Street] Renegade Personal Training’ quest through NPC So Gong in front of Renegade Fitness. After talking to NPC So Gong, you can designate a coach character and a trainee character to provide support perks while out hunting monsters. The character you are currently logged in as will become the coach. Once per world, you can designate another character on your account as the trainee character (the trainee character must be above level 105 and below 190; your trainee character cannot have a higher level than that of your coach character, and cannot be Zero or Pink Bean characters. You cannot cancel or change your coach and trainee characters once chosen). When you hunt monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) with your coach character, a portion of the EXP gained will automatically be applied to the trainee character!
Once your trainee reaches Lv. 190, the event effect will disappear and you'll earn the [b]Personal Training Completionist [/b]title!

Earn EXP coupons by visiting [b]Cafe Rising Heroes[/b] with your friends! Form a party with 3 or more guild members and be on the same map and channel, and enter Cafe Rising Heroes from 14th Street. After hanging out there for a minute, you'll have the option to leave and receive a [b]2x EXP Coupon[/b]! You can receive this reward once per day.

You can also earn 14th Street Points by juggling drink orders (literally!) in the Cafe Rising Heroes[b] [/b]mini-game! Characters Lv. 61 and above can play by accepting the ‘[14th Street] Round-We-Go Cafe Rising Heroes!’ quest through NPC Eileen in front of Cafe Rising Heroes.

The goal of this game is to avoid the falling germs while keeping the tea cups balanced. Use your mouse to move the stick balancing the cup on the tray, and avoid all falling obstacles without spilling the drink. There are a total of 15 stages; you'll earn stacking [b]14th Street Points [/b]as you clear each stage. Even if you have reached the daily limit, you can keep playing the Cafe Rising Heroes game.

Soar above the city to earn 14th Street Coins at [b]Legends Tower 62[/b]! Characters Lv. 61 and up can play by accepting the ‘[14th Street] 14th Street Sky’ quest through NPC Grizzle in front of Legend Tower 62.

The goal of this game is to fly as far as you can to earn 14th Street Points. Dash and jump your way through as many items as you can—you'll earn [b]14th Street Coins[/b] depending on how far you flew! You'll also earn Sky Points as you fly, which will grant special level-up effects once you collect enough, allowing you to earn even more 14th Street Coins! If you've reached your daily coin capacity of the day, you will no longer obtain 14th Street Coins, but you can keep playing 14th Street Sky.

You can also visit the roof of Legends Tower 62 to obtain [b]Legendary Maple Leaves[/b]! Every 5 minutes the maple trees will drop leaves which you can collect in order to earn [b]Honor EXP[/b]! You need to leave and re-enter to spawn more leaves.

Pay a visit to the [b]Ark Museum[/b] and earn Trait Points! Stand next to one of the designated status in the museum, and after appreciating it a bit, you'll earn [+2 Trait Points]! You can earn up to 500 points per trait daily.

You can also help Spiegelmann retrieve his art collection! Characters Lv. 61 and up can start by accepting the ‘[14th Street] Spiegelmann’s Art Retrieval’ quest through NPC Spiegelmann in front of Ark Museum. Hunt monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) to get monsters to drop [b]Spiegelmann’s Artwork[/b]. Each Spiegelmann's Artwork will automatically grant you [b]14th Street Coins (x2)[/b], and you can collect up to 100 pieces of Spiegelmann’s Artwork a day per character.
You can also receive a daily reward when you complete the quest once a day per world. For your daily reward, you can select 1 of the following:

Pay a visit to the [b]Big Bang Store[/b] and spend your hard-earned [b]14th Street Coins[/b] on amazing rewards! You can access the Big Bang Store by talking to NPC Yeti on the Maple 14th Street Fair Map. Weekly items will reset every Thursday at 12:00 AM UTC during the event period.

The [b]FIREPOWER [/b][b]Mega Burning Project[/b] is here to help you level a brand-new character up to [b]Lv. 150[/b]!

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 150! This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, except for Zero characters. Please note that if you create an Illium character and select it as "Burning", you will need to complete your Illium questline first before teleporting out of the area. Otherwise you won't be able to get your 2nd job advancement properly.

Create a brand-new character during the event period. From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/7bee54352e4c40de1d2d0e41026e801c6b28172f.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3ff12c2d2bf2f65137100824c77b5889fa4c7703.png[/img]

[*][b]Frozen Suit[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +27, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +315. Upgrades available: 10.[/*]
[*][b]Frozen Weapon Box[/b]: Untradeable. 7-day duration. Open to receive: 
[list]
[*][b]Frozen Weapon[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. Stats will vary based upon your job.[/*]
[/list][/*]

[/b][list]
[*][b]Frozen Secondary Weapon[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. Stats will vary based upon your job.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Mastery Book 20 (x4)[/b]: Untradeable.[/*]
[*][b]Mastery Book 30 (x4)[/b]: Untradeable.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Keep on Burning Title Coupon[/b]: Untradeable. Can only be used at Lv. 130. Use to receive:[list]
[*][b]Keep on Burning[/b]: Title. Untradeable. 14-day duration on stats. Req. Lv: 130. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +10, MaxHP/MaxMP +400, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10, Boss Damage +10%, Ignore DEF +10%.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
Each time your character levels up, they will receive two additional levels! Work your way up to Lv. 150, so you can wear those sweet equips!

notes.title: v.204 - LINE FRIENDS X MapleStory Update Preview
notes.content:
Time sure does fly; this month marks MapleStory’s [b]14th Anniversary[/b], and we’re having a whole smattering of new events to celebrate! Help Pink Bean realize his dreams of becoming a movie star; dine at one of the finest restaurants in Maple World in Restaurant RED; compete in a dance battle in Club V; and join in on tons of other fun events to celebrate MapleStory’s anniversary! We’re also having a special co-promotion event with none other than the [b]LINE FRIENDS[/b] characters! Pick up fun new LINE FRIENDS-themed items at the Cash Shop, and enjoy new special events including an item hunt with CONY and a picture-taking event where you can earn special LINE FRIENDS stickers. There’s plenty to do, so come celebrate in [b]LINE FRIENDS X MapleStory[/b]!

Learn more [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/news/43520/v-204-line-friends-x-maplestory-update-preview]here[/url]!

notes.title: Mystery Solving Events!
notes.content:
There are mysteries afoot in Maple World that need solving, so get your inner private eye in gear for these fun new events!

[b][u]Peplock Holmes Detective Office[/u][/b]

[b][b][b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, April 9, 2019 5:00 PM – Tuesday, April 23[b][b], 2019[/b][/b] 4:59 PM
[/b]
[b]EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, April 9[b], 2019[/b] 8:00 PM – Tuesday, April 23[b][b], 2019[/b][/b] 7:59 PM
[/b]
[b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, April 10[b], 2019[/b] 2:00 AM – Wednesday, April 24, 2019 1:59 AM
[/b]
[b]AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, April 10[b], 2019[/b] 10:00 AM – Wednesday, April 24, 2019 9:59 AM[/b][/b][/b]

Peplock Holmes needs your help cracking cases! Players Lv. 61 and up can help Peplock Holmes and his trusty sidekick Yettson by accepting the ‘[Peplock Holmes] Peplock Holmes Detective Office’ quest through the star event notifier on the left side of the screen or through NPC Peplock Holmes, who can be found in Henesys, Leafre, or Nameless Town.

Once you accept the quest, hunt down monsters near your level (20 levels above or 20 levels below). The monsters will drop [b]Detective Office Passes[/b]—once you have collected 200 Detective Office Passes, return to NPC Peplock Holmes and you can begin solving mysteries!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3abf763f05037e2a270ec1e668406a1f6867018d.png[/img]

There are 13 episodes altogether, each with a special mission for you to complete. New episodes will unlock every day at 12:00 AM UTC during the event period. Once episodes are available, you can complete them at any time during the event period.

[list]

[b][u]Spot the Difference[/u][/b]

[b][b][b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, April 9, 2019 5:00 PM – Tuesday, April 23[b][b], 2019[/b][/b] 4:59 PM[/b]
[b]EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, April 9[b], 2019[/b] 8:00 PM – Tuesday, April 23[b][b], 2019[/b][/b] 7:59 PM[/b]
[b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, April 10[b], 2019[/b] 2:00 AM – Wednesday, April 24, 2019 1:59 AM[/b]
[b]AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, April 10[b], 2019[/b] 10:00 AM – Wednesday, April 24, 2019 9:59 AM[/b][/b][/b]

Think you've got a good eye for snooping out the little details? Put it to the test in our [b]Spot the Difference[/b] mini-game! Players Lv. 61 and up can participate by accepting the ‘[Event] Spot the Difference with Everyone!’ quest through the magnifying glass icon within the star event notifier. You can accept the invitation quest every hour at the 15 minute and 45 minute mark from the invitation that appears on top of your character.

In this game, 3 players work together to find the most differences between two near-identical pictures. There are a total of 5 stages per game, and the goal is to find the most differences and clear all 5 stages within the time limit. You'll earn points by finding the correct answers individually and by clearing the stage as a group.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/87b28193f42405560fe2160c61c24ff2851c0ff1.jpg[/img]

You can participate in Spot the Difference up to 5 times a day per character, and there are a total of 50 different puzzles. If you participate in the event 15 times, you'll earn the [b]Spotting Master [/b]medal!
[list]
[*][b]Spotting Master[/b]: Medal, Untradeable. Stat effects will last for 14 days. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +20, ATT/Magic ATT +20, MaxHP/MaxMP + 3000, +15% Boss Damage.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/ec7327616aa64adaadee794c9b5bc5597b21e785.png[/img]

You can also trade in the points that you earn during the event for special rewards through the ‘[Event] Spot the Rewards’ quest by clicking the magnifying glass icon. 

[b]Items Available for Purchase:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Epic Potential Scroll 50%[/b]: 7,000 Points. Limited quantity: 1 daily. Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/*]
[*][b]2x EXP Coupon (15 min)[/b]: 3,000 Points. Limited quantity: 3 daily. Untradeable, 7-day duration. Use to receive 2x EXP for 15 minutes.[/*]
[*][b]Nodestone[/b]: 5,000 Points. Limited quantity: 3 daily. Tradeable within account.[/*]
[*][b]Bonus Occult Cube[/b]: 6,000 Points. Limited quantity: 10. Untradeable.[/*]
[*][b]Powerful Rebirth Flame[/b]: 5,000 Points. Limited quantity: 5. Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/*]
[*][b]Magnificent Portrait Chair[/b]: 15,000 Points. Limited quantity: 1. Untradeable.[/*]
[*][b]Trait Boost Potion[/b]: 15,000 Points. Limited quantity: 1. Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/*]
[*][b]Storm Growth Potion[/b]: 15,000 Points. Limited quantity: 2. Tradeable within account, 7-day duration.[/*]
[*][b]Selective 8 Slot[/b]: 7,000 Points. Limited quantity: 3. Untradeable, 7-day duration. Excludes Storage Room slots.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/1c49fdafd1f7a89a20dd3a34b5d405d614fc9c91.png[/img]

The monsters in Maple World have gotten all funky, and it's up to you to hunt them down to receive special April Fools' rewards!

Characters Lv. 33 and up can participate by accepting the quest "[Event] Funky April Fools' Day" from the quest notifier on the left side of the screen. While out hunting monsters near your level range (20 levels above and below), you'll have the chance to run into a [b]Funky Slime[/b], [b]Funky Yeti[/b], or [b]Funky Orange Mushroom[/b]![b]
[/b]

MapleStory will be having a [b]Hot Day [/b]on April 1st (UTC)! This is no prank either, so don't miss out on these great items!

notes.content:
Blast back to the 8-bit era with these [b]Retro World Events[/b]! Characters Lv. 61 and up can participate by opening the ‘[Event] Retro World Opens!’ quest through the 8-bit ‘R’ icon within the star notifier or though the Retro World Console, which can be found in Henesys, Leafre, or Nameless Town. Participate in these events to earn [b]Retro Points[/b]. For every 100 Retro Points, you’ll automatically receive [b]1 Retro Coin[/b], which can be used in the [b]Retro World Coin Shop[/b]! (You can earn up to 20,000 Retro Points every day, and 40,000 Retro Points every Sunday).

notes.title: Cash Inventory Transfer Event
notes.content:
[b]Thursday, February 28 to Wednesday, March 6[/b]
[list]
[*]This event will begin after the maintenance on February 28.
[*]This event will end after the maintenance on March 6.[/list]
Do you have a cash item you’ve wanted to move to another character on your account? Now you can!

For a limited time, you will be able to transfer most cash items between your characters within the same world. Take this opportunity to share a Hyper Teleport Rock, move cash cover items between characters, move a beloved pet to a new character, and more!

This event is available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds. You can only transfer cash items between characters in the same world. This does not include different worlds in the same world alliance. For example, you can transfer items between two characters on Mardia, but you cannot transfer an item from a character on Mardia to a character on Kradia.

Trading cash items between your characters is easy! All you need to do is follow these simple steps:

1. Enter the Cash Shop.
2. Pick an eligible item you would like to transfer to a different character, and move it into your Cash Inventory.
3. Right-click the item.
4. Click the ‘TRANSFER’ button.
5. Select the recipient of the item from the drop down.
6. Click the ‘OK’ button.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3c0b5a311ef300da61c0d3336329fecde77229a3.png[/img]

The selected item will now appear in the other character’s Cash Inventory the next time you login to that character. All jobs are able to transfer cash items between each other, except Explorers since they already share their Cash Inventory.

There are a few items that are not able to be transferred:
[list]
[*]EXP Coupons
[*]Potion Pot
[*]Friendship and Couple items[/list]

notes.title: Lunar New Year Events!
notes.content:
The Year of the Pig is officially upon us, so welcome the [b]Lunar New Year[/b] with these special MapleStory events!

[b][u]Gold Richie’s Lunar New Year Party[/u][/b]

[b]PST (UTC -8): Tuesday, January 29, 2019 4:00 PM – Tuesday, February 12, 2019 3:59 PM
EST (UTC -5): Tuesday, January 29, 2019 7:00 PM – Tuesday, February 12, 2019 6:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, January 30, 2019 1:00 AM – Wednesday, February 13, 2019 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, January 30, 2019 11:00 AM – Wednesday, February 13, 2019 10:59 AM[/b]

[b]Gold Richie[/b] is having a party to celebrate the [b]Lunar New Year[/b] with a variety of fun events! Characters Lv. 61 and above can participate by talking to NPC Yoria in Henesys, Leafre, or Nameless Town, or by selecting the 2019 Lunar New Year event notifier on the left side of the screen and accepting the quest ‘[Lunar New Year] Surprises and Celebration!’

Once you've accepted the quest, talk to NPC Gold Richie and accept the '[Lunar New Year] Gold Richie's Soiree!' quest to move to the Lunar New Year Party map! The quest can also be found in the New Year Event icon in the notifier on the left side of the screen. 

Take part in these events to earn special rewards including Hong Bao currency, which can be traded in at the [b]Hong Bao[/b] shop! Each event will be available during the time frame listed above. You can read more about these individual events [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/news/42703/lunar-new-year-events]here[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/a84216e542cbf2a2b9eb62c813ea815700eb21bc.png[/img]

[b][u]Hong Bao Shop[/u][/b]

Here's where you can spend all your Hong Bao earned during the Lunar New Year event! Speak to NPC Yoria in Henesys, Leafre, or Nameless Town to hear about what's new in the Hong Bao Shop, and access the store by speaking to NPC Hong Bao Shop.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/43e829724584ab70dcd717ea51f6703105dcf4e1.png[/img]

notes.title: Level Cap Increase & More!
notes.content:
Now that the Black Mage is finally gone, there are many changes happening in Maple World! We're increasing the max level cap, unveiling new Genesis Weapons, making Tenebris available permanently, and more! Read all about it below:

[h1][u][u][b]Level Cap Increase[/b][/u][/u][/h1]

To celebrate the defeat of the Black Mage, we're increasing the max level cap to [b]Lv. 275[/b]! Now you can make your character stronger than ever. If you can reach Lv. 275, as a reward you'll receive the [b]Symbol of Brilliant Honor Chair[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/6966193f1be8610f034b9debf844119c22ea665a.png[/img]

[h1][u][u][b]Tenebris Content Available Pemanently![/b][/u][/u][/h1]

Even though the war is over, we will opening the Tenebris region for players to explore permanently! You can enter Moonbridge, the Labyrinth of Suffering, and Limina if you meet the following conditions:

[list]
[*][b]Moonbridge[/b]: Characters Lv. 245 and above that have completed the Esfera: Origin Sea story quest
[*][b]Labyrinth of Suffering[/b]: Characters Lv. 250 and above that have completed the Moonbridge story quest
[*][b]Limina[/b]: Characters Lv. 255 and above that have completed the Labyrinth of Suffering story quest
[/list]

New quests will be added to Tenebris daily. You can play the daily quests by clearning the story quests in each region of Tenebris. You can play 1 quest in each region for a total of up to 3 daily quests each day.

You can still face the deadly bosses of Tenebris as well, including the Black Mage himself! Here's how to fight each boss:

[b][u]Gloom[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Complete the Moonbridge story quest to find Gloom in the Eye of the Void.
[*]A party of 1-6 can fight Gloom.
[*]Entry count limited to once daily. Clear count limited to once per week.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b98bdcbb6157711b31a9ca9991ad5e22b9c2597f.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Verus Hilla[/u][/b]

[list]
[*]Complete the Labyrinth of Suffering story quest and clear the Labyrinth of Suffering Deep Core Dungeon to find Verus Hilla.
[*]A party of 1-6 can fight Verus Hilla.
[*]Entry count limited to once daily. Clear count limited to once per week.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/85b5c74adeb99f7d2479e85e36b499363693c4ad.png[/img]

[b][u]Guard Captain Darknell[/u][/b]

[list]
[*]Complete the Limina story quest to find Darknell in the Final Horizon.
[*]A party of 1-6 can fight Guard Captain Darknell.
[*]Entry count limited to once daily. Clear count limited to once per week.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c7833c7a23a82c9a6396b71dd3738c921f194126.png[/img]

[b][u]The Black Mage[/u][/b]

[list]
[*]Complete the Limina story quest to find the Black Mage in the Giant's Heart.
[*]You need the Fragment of Destiny to find the Black Mage. to craft it, you will need the following materials:
[list]
[*]Spark of Determination: Acquire by completing Tenebris daily quests and by defeating Gloom or Darknell.
[*]Shadow of Annihilation: Acquire by eliminating Verus Hilla.
[/list]
[*]A part of 1-6 can fight the Black Mage.
[*]Entry count limited to once daily. Clear count limited to once per week.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/8d6584a2908ff71e04d1a011287427c143fddfa0.png[/img]

[h1][u][b][u]New Genesis Weapons[/u][/b][/u][/h1]

Characters Lv. 225 and above that have made the 5th job advancement can track down the remnants of the Black Mage's power to unlock new [b]Genesis Weapons[/b]! Once you complete the Limina story quest, you'll receive the Genesis weapon quest through the notifier on the left side of the screen. Accept the quest receive a [b]Sealed Genesis Weapon Box[/b] from the quest to obtain a weapon based on your class!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/da93bfa18dab81f1c7eea57676acfa793f99183a.png[/img]

You can complete various missions afterwards to unleash the true power of your sealed Genesis weapon. These missions involve defeating each of the Black Mage's Commanders with special restrictions in place. Upon defeating each Commander (excluding Von Leon), you'll also need to defeat the Black Mage's Afterimage 8 times so you can claim a trace item. Upon completing all missions, Zero will acquire a [b]Genesis Essence[/b] that can enhance Lapis/Lazuli to a Type 10.

Each character can have 1 Genesis weapon, and it cannot be traded. If you lose any of the Genesis weapon items (sealed Genesis weapon, Genesis weapon, Genesis Essence) during your quest, then you must start over from the first mission. When the final seal on the Genesis weapon is removed, your weapon will receive the following qualities:

[list]
[*]Use all available upgrade count with 15% Spell Trace enhancements suitable to each job.
[*]Star Force 22-Star Enhancement
[*]Has Unique Potential
[*]Has Epic Bonus Potential
[*]Additional Star Force and scroll enhancements are not available.
[*]Zero can choose whether to transfer Potential and Bonus Potential.
[/list]

You can also use the two new skills listed below when you equip the Genesis weapon, depending on its unleashed state:

[list]
[*][b]Aeonian Rise[/b]: Use the power of creation to become invincible for 12 sec. When the skill ends, activates the Genesis Force which attacks 12 enemies with 1,500% damage 7 times. Use the skill again to end immediately. Cooldown: 180 sec.
[*][b]Tanadian Ruin[/b]: When the attack hits, the Power of Destruction activates and increases Final Damage by 15% for 30 sec. Cooldown: 90 sec.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b209d2a6252012a12fac156d02dc2102ad0de7cd.png[/img]

[b][u]The Story Continues[/u][/b]

Just because the Black Mage has finally been defeated doesn't mean the story's over yet...

Coming soon in a future update, prepare to return to [b]Grandis[/b] to learn more about [b]Magnus [/b]and his master, [b]Gerand Darmoor[/b]. There's plenty more to be revealed, so stay tuned and get ready for a new, epic chapter of MapleStory to unfold!

notes.title: Maple Alliance Events Continue!
notes.content:
The final fight against the Black Mage is almost here, so jump into these Maple Alliance events to help complete the Journey of Destiny! If your character is Lv. 61 or higher, join the Maple Alliance and start completing Maple Alliance missions to accumulate [b]Determination[/b]. As you and other players gain Determination, the World Gauge will gradually fill up and progress the story, and help to unlock the final battle against the Black Mage! Starting with the opening of the Limina region, the daily Determination cap for players has been raised to [b]50,000[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/59e090c5f9541defcc02b4e646ae51da40352827.png[/img]

In addition, every time one of the three goddess statues is completely filled with Determination, a 2x EXP event will activate for 24 hours in all Reboot and non-Reboot worlds! This event will start up to 1 hour after the goddess statue is completed. Go out and gather Determination to help the Maple Alliance!

[b][u]Enter Limina: The Black Mage's Keep[/u][/b]

After escaping the Labyrinth of Suffering and defeating Verus Hilla, the final Tenebris region of [b]Limina[/b] will unlock! Players who are Lv. 200 or higher and have completed the 5th Job advancement can enter Limina by completing the "[Black Mage] Outpost Gathering" quest.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c71a2b22f50542ea2b54324a1e6f3af35cf92c37.jpg[/img]

Once you reach Limina, accept the "[Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Limina" quest to help the Tenebris Expedition on their journey through this perilous region! After you accept the mission, you'll be given three random Expedition Missions that will require you to face various deadly trials throughout the Limina region. Some of these trials involve facing an onslaught of monsters like the Seeds of Life, while others will require you to avoid destructive incoming attacks like the Light of Annihilation beam! You can play [b]three[/b] of these quests per day, with the timer resetting at midnight UTC. If you can complete all three in a day, you'll receive [b]10,000 Determination[/b], as well as the quest "[Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Limina" which you can complete to earn the following Alliance Drops!
[list]
[*][b]6,000,000 Mesos[/b]
[*][b]Nodestone (x2)[/b] (Untradeable)
[*][b]Rare Treasure Chest.[/b] Each account has a daily limit of opening 30 chests per day. Contains one of the following:[list]
[*][b]Soul Shard[/b]: Untradeable.
[*][b]Clean Slate Scroll 10%[/b]
[*][b]Innocence Scroll 50%[/b]
[*][b]Chaos Scroll 60%[/b]
[*][b]Bonus Potential Scroll 50%[/b]
[*][b]Master Craftsman's Cube:[/b] Tradeable within account.
[*][b]Meister's Cube:[/b] Tradeable within account.
[*][b]Chaos Scroll of Goodness 30%[/b]
[*][b]Epic Potential Scroll 50%[/b]
[*][b]Intermediate Bonus Potential Stamp[/b][/list][/list]
Be careful when you're wandering through Limina however; occasionally, an [b]Erda Surge[/b] will overtake the map, forcing you to take shelter under protective barriers while monsters attempt to destroy your cover!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/aa18f2bf3e2d82afef9da7b44d66c1650f6e0374.png[/img]

Orchid will also attempt to halt your progress by casting an all-consuming [b]Black Hole[/b]! You'll need to defeat 30 Ascendions in a limited amount of time before getting sucked into the void!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/96c68e00ed4309c1cd62e4c181dd269e988712dc.png[/img]

Once the Determination Gauge has been filled for this region, you'll be able to do battle with the region's boss, [b]Guard Captain Darknell[/b]. You can access Guard Captain Darknell by entering "World's Sorrow" through the portal to the right of the Maple Alliance Outpost. While fighting Darknell, meteors will plummet all around you, dealing constant damage and potentially stunning you. At the same time, Darknell will summon powerful foes to distract you, including Elite Bosses, Corrupted Warriors, Rampant Cyborgs, and more, so come prepared for this fierce opponent! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c7833c7a23a82c9a6396b71dd3738c921f194126.png[/img]

Keep fighting your way through Limina...the Black Mage is near!

[b][u]Cleansing Light[/u][/b]

[b]This mission will start alongside the Limina Expedition, and will last until the Black Mage is defeated.[/b]

Use the power of light to defeat your enemies! In [b]Cleansing Light[/b], characters Lv. 61 and above that have completed the "[Black Mage] Outpost Gathering!" quest and joined the Maple Alliance will gain access to a new mission called "[Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Cleansing Light." Accepting this quest will grant you the "Cleansing Light" skill.

You can activate "Cleansing Light" by right-clicking in a map with monsters near your level range (20 levels above or 20 levels below). Eliminating monsters while this skill is activated has the potential to trigger a countdown timer. Once the timer reaches zero, a powerful light will shine above your character, delivering massive damage to monsters and granting you Determination! You can earn [b]10 Determination[/b] for each monster eliminated with the Cleansing Light, with a daily cap of 150 Determination.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/05f000ab474399769b414cc07ac04d931a80d534.png[/img]

[b][u]Battle at Sea[/u][/b]

[b]This mission will start alongside the Limina Expedition, and will last until the Black Mage is defeated.[/b]

Take to the sea in the fight against the Black Mage! In the [b]Battle at Sea[/b] mission, characters Lv. 61 and up that have completed the "[Black Mage] Outpost Gathering!'" quest and joined the Maple Alliance will have access to the quest "[Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Battle at Sea" from the notifier or Athena Pierce at the Outpost.

Begin the quest by speaking to NPC Olaf in the Waiting Area. You'll be placed on a naval ship, where you and your crew will have a limited amount of time to defeat as many enemies as possible! The level of your ship and crew will be determined by your Captain Rank. By defeating waves of enemies, you'll earn Naval Battle Points and Gold Coins. Your Gold Coins can be used to enhance your ship or hire new crew mates (you can also gain crew members by saving captured prisoners that have been taken by the Black Mage's sea army). Your Naval Battle Points can used to increase your Captain Rank, which will increase the speed of your ship as well as your crew's baseline level.

At the end of the mission, you can trade your Naval Battle Points for [b]Determination[/b]! 100 Naval Battle Points can be traded for 1 Determination. You can earn a daily cap of 1 million Naval Battle Points in this mission. Sail the high seas and earn Determination for the Maple Alliance!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/375d5af2b2ed00667c933d8c0d06544bc69699c3.png[/img]

notes.title: Holiday Hot Week!
notes.content:
[b]PST (UTC -8): Sunday, December 23, 2018 4:00 PM – Tuesday, January 1, 2019 3:59 PM
EST (UTC -5): Sunday, December 23, 2018 7:00 PM – Tuesday, January 1, 2019 6:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Monday, December 24, 2018 1:00 AM – Wednesday, January 2, 2019 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Monday, December 24, 2018 11:00 AM – Wednesday, January 2, 2019 10:59 AM[/b]

To celebrate the holidays, MapleStory will be having a whole week of [b]Hot Days[/b]! All you have to do is log in to start receiving great items!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/0b8ee2bb25f6d7f205efd73b14ee3cc2a108be46.png[/img]

Log in each day with a character Lv. 30 or above, and click the gift box icon on the left side of the screen to receive a Gift Box, and then double-click the box in your inventory to open it. The Gift Box can be obtained [b]once in a 24-hour period every day[/b], resetting at [b]4:00 PM PST / 7:00 PM EST / 1:00 AM CET / 11:00 AM AEDT[/b].

Once you receive the gift box, you can open it anytime before [b]1:00 AM PST / 4:00 AM EST / 10:00 AM CET / 8:00 PM AEDT[/b] of the following day.

If you have more than 30 unclaimed gifts, you may not be able to see the Hot Week reward. Please clear any unclaimed gifts and login again to see the Hot Week reward.

All rewards are for both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds unless specifically noted below.
[list]
[*]Monday, December 24[list]
[*][b]Pendant of the Spirit[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]
[*]Tuesday, December 25[list]
[*][b]Nodestone[/b]: Untradeable[/list]
[*]Wednesday, December 26[list]
[*][b]Character Slot Expansion Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]
[*]Thursday, December 27[list]
[*][b]2x EXP Coupon (30 min) (x3)[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]
[*]Friday, December 28[list]
[*][b]Alliance Medal (x50)[/b]: Untradeable.[/list]
[*]Saturday, December 29[list]
[*][b]Selective 8 Slot Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]
[*]Sunday, December 30[list]
[*][b]1,000 Maple Reward Points[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*]Plus select one additional reward from the items given Monday through Saturday![/list]
[*]Monday, December 31[list]
[*][b]2x Drop Coupon (1 hour) (x3)[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]
[*]Tuesday, January 1[list]
[*][b]Hyper Teleport Rock Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list][/list]
If you obtain and [b]open[/b] each Gift Box every day from Monday to Saturday, then on Sunday—in addition to Sunday's reward—you can have another gift! You can select one from all of the items that were given out from Monday to Saturday. You are not required to have received each day’s Gift Box on the same character in order to be eligible for the extra gift, but it does have to be with characters in the same world (multiple worlds in World Alliances don't count).

This event is available to players Lv. 30 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). You can receive one gift box per account per day.

notes.content:
[b]Saturday, December 22, 2018[/b]
[list]
[*][b]PST (UTC -8): 12:30 AM – 1:30 AM & 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM & 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM[/b]
[*][b]EST (UTC -5): 3:30 AM – 4:30 AM & 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM & 12:00 AM – 1:00 AM (December 23)[/b]

[b]Available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds[/b]

If you've been searching for ways to boost your power, you’re in luck! This Saturday is all about making you stronger through the mysterious power of Potential. Potential is a nifty system that allows you to add bonus effects to your equipment to make it truly heroic.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/73436475a02abe1e041461a910c5dcd3a479923c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Maple Alliance Events!
notes.content:
The war against the Black Mage has finally begun, so join Cygnus in her quest to bring peace to Maple World with these Maple Alliance events! Players Lv. 61 and up will be able to join the Maple Alliance, and start completing Maple Alliance missions to accumulate [b]Determination[/b]. As you and other players gain Determination, the World Gauge will gradually fill up and progress the story, and help to unlock the final battle against the Black Mage!

In addition, every time one of the three goddess statues is completely filled with Determination, a [b]2x EXP event[/b] will activate for [b]24 hours[/b] in all Reboot and non-Reboot worlds! This event will start up to 1 hour after the goddess statue is completed. Go out and gather Determination to help the Maple Alliance!

Here's a taste of what's available this week as part of the Maple Alliance events:

[b][u]Step Into the Labyrinth of Suffering[/u][/b]

Players who are Lv. 200 or higher and have completed the 5th Job advancement can enter the second region of Tenebris: [b]Labyrinth of Suffering[/b]. Once you step into the Labyrinth, you'll be separated from your party members and forced to find each other in the Labyrinth's ever-shifting hallways! You'll also be given 3 Spirit Stones upon entering the Labyrinth; you'll lose one Spirit Stone each time you die, and if you lose all 3, you'll be banished from the Labyrinth!

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/ceca699fd736ff1affd0320748abecb65c02cb3c.png[/img]

While inside the Labyrinth, you can help the Maple Alliance by joining the [b]Expedition Mission: Labyrinth of Suffering[/b]. Each day you'll be given a selection of 3 different missions, which you can complete for [b]10,000 Determination each[/b]! Missions including hunting down monsters like golems, the Blackheart Negative, and beings from the Dimensional Crack!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e509d070f865408d312318630323754fe6e38aba.png[/img]

Complete all three of these each day and you'll also receive the following:
[list]
[*][b]6,000,000 Mesos[/b]
[*][b]Nodestone (x2) (Untradeable)[/b]
[*][b]Rare Treasure Chest[/b]. Each account has a daily limit of opening 30 chests per day. Contains one of the following:[list]
[*][b]Soul Shard[/b]: Untradeable.
[*][b]Clean Slate Scroll 10%[/b]
[*][b]Innocence Scroll 50%[/b]
[*][b]Chaos Scroll 60%[/b]
[*][b]Bonus Potential Scroll 50%[/b]
[*][b]Master Craftsman's Cube[/b]: Tradeable within account.
[*][b]Meister's Cube[/b]: Tradeable within account.
[*][b]Chaos Scroll of Goodness 30%[/b]
[*][b]Epic Potential Scroll 50%[/b][/list][/list]
In order to complete the Labyrinth, you must find the Labyrinth Core deep within the maze. You will find an altar there, which you can light with candles by using up your party's remaining Spirit Stones. Only then will you be able to destroy the Labyrinth Core.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4e1e8e21fcd9083c36539f51099ba34965f07b09.png[/img]

Once the Labyrinth has been cleared, you'll find [b]Verus Hilla[/b] lying in wait at the end!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/85b5c74adeb99f7d2479e85e36b499363693c4ad.png[/img]

You can fight Hilla once per day, and defeat her once per week. She'll use her deadly scythe to cut your party down as well as summoning the dead souls of Necro Orchid and Necro Lotus to fight alongside her. But if you can prevail, you'll earn the following reward!
[list]
[*][b][Medal] One with the Labyrinth[/b]: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +5, MaxHP/MaxMP +1,000. Untradeable.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/8ad5b0f4ff314d6a0b94d1d9af1b3b41f6aeb24c.png[/img]

[b][u]Flame Bird Support[/u][/b]

[b]This mission will start alongside the Labyrinth of Suffering Expedition, and will last until the Alliance has made it past the Labyrinth of Suffering.[/b]

Summon a fiery foe to help you earn Determination in the [b]Flame Bird Support[/b] event! The quest can be started by accepting it through the Alliance notifier on the left-side of the screen, or by speaking to NPC Athena Pierce at the Maple Alliance Outpost. You have to accept the quest "[Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Flame Bird Support" to learn the skill "Summon the Flame Bird." Then, while out hunting monsters near your level (20 levels above or below), you'll see the option to summon the Flame Bird to help you defeat enemies!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/91d4216033175b0213fb3ccfa4b1d771e051699c.png[/img]

Any monsters that you defeat will drop Flame Bird's Determination, which will grant you [b]30 Determination[/b] and increase the Flame Bird's power! As the Flame Bird increases levels, you'll eventually be able to mount it and ride around the map hunting monsters, so power up your winged buddy and get hunting!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/a8a82577aa4709e60cd43f79c5f814068384e7c7.png[/img]

Once the daily limit for Determination (50,000) has been reached, Flame Bird can no longer be summoned that day. The daily recap resets every day at midnight (12:00 AM UTC).

[b][u]Twilight Defense[/u][/b]

[b]This mission will start alongside the Labyrinth of Suffering Expedition, and will last until the Alliance has made it past the Labyrinth of Suffering.[/b]

Protect the castle walls with your fellow Maple Alliance soldiers in [b]Twilight Defense[/b]! The quest can be started by accepting it through the Alliance notifier on the left-side of the screen, or by speaking to NPC Athena Pierce at the Maple Alliance Outpost. You have to accept the quest "[Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Twilight Defense" to join the event. You can have a party of 2-4 players in this event.

In Twilight Defense, you'll join forces with other players to defeat waves of monsters with cannonballs. As you defeat monsters, you'll earn points and increase your cannon's rank so that it deals more damage to your foes. Once you defeat the final boss, [b]Giant Omen[/b], you'll be rewarded with [b]Determination[/b] based on how many points you scored, so prepare your arsenal and hold back the enemy forces!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/69c75471493f45eeeec2e4197ed9971ec6981143.png[/img]

Once the daily limit for Determination (50,000) has been reached, you will no longer gain Determination this event; only siege defense points. The maximum number of siege defense points that can be earned in one day is 10,000. The daily recap resets every day at midnight (12:00 AM UTC).

These events are also part of [b]Maple Missions[/b]! Join the Maple Alliance and complete Maple Missions to earn extra rewards! More information on Maple Missions [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/game/mission]here[/url].
