notes.title: Celebrate the Holiday with These Special Events!
notes.content:
The holidays have come to Maple World! We're hosting a bunch of joyous seasonal activities for you to enjoy!

[b][u]Shining Santa Box[/u][/b]

[b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, December 12, 2018 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, December 25, 2018 3:59 PM
EST (UTC -5): Wednesday, December 12, 2018 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, December 25, 2018 6:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, December 12, 2018 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, December 26, 2018 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Thursday, December 13, 2018 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, December 26, 2018 10:59 AM[/b]

What are the holidays without gifts? Hunt monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above) for the chance to obtain a [b]Shining Santa Box[/b]. Open the box to find items such as [b]Alliance Medals[/b] (limit of 10 per day), [b]Rudolph’s Red Nose face accessory[/b], [b]winter buffs[/b], [b]Gingerbread Cookies[/b], or a [b]7-day Santa Sled Mount[/b] coupon! Someone's been nice this year!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3436eef7bd9ae412b8a7dbb603189ecafa29f84d.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Shining Santa Box[/b]. Receive one of the following:[list]
[*][b]Alliance Medal[/b]: Permanent, Untradeable.
[*][b]Alliance Medal (x2)[/b]: Permanent, Untradeable.
[*][b]Alliance Medal (x3)[/b]: Permanent, Untradeable.
[*][b]Alliance Medal (x5)[/b]: Permanent, Untradeable.
[*][b]Rudolph's Red Nose[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration. Req. Lv: 10, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +2, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +2, Upgrades +5.
[*][b]Rudolph's Red Nose Bandage[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration. Improve stats on Rudolph's Red Nose: STR/DEX/INT/LUK +2, Success Rate 60%.
[*][b]Magic Christmas Stocking[/b]: Permanent. Receive a Gift Filled Christmas Socks item from stocking after placing stocking in the Item Pot and giving it items and equipment from monsters around your level. The Gift Filled Christmas Socks item can only be opened within a certain time period.
[*][b]Christmas Buffs:[/b][list] 
[*][b]Lv. 1 Merry Christmas[/b]: Gives Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10 for 30 minutes.
[*][b]Lv. 2 Merry Christmas[/b]: Gives Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +15 for 30 minutes.[/list]
[*][b]Gingerbread Man Cookie (x10)[/b]: Permanent, Untradeable.
[*][b]Gingerbread Woman Cookie[/b]: Permanent, Untradeable.
[*][b]Power Elixir (x10)[/b]: Permanent.
[*][b]Cold Winter Energy Buff[/b]: Permanent. Gives Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +20 for 30 minutes. 
[*][b]Enjoyable Winter Buff[/b]: Permanent. Greatly increases EXP gained from hunting monsters for 30 minutes.
[*][b]Lucky Winter Buff[/b]: Permanent. Greatly increase item drop rate from monsters for 30 minutes.
[*][b]Santa Sled Mount 7-Day Coupon (Permanent)[/b][/list][/list]

[b][u]2x EXP & Drop Event[/u][/b]

[b]PST (UTC -8): December 12, 2018 (after maintenance) – December 31 during the times listed below
EST (UTC -5): December 12, 2018 (after maintenance) – December 31 during the times listed below
CET (UTC +1): December 12, 2018 (after maintenance) – December 31 during the times listed below
AEDT (UTC +11): December 12, 2018 (after maintenance) – December 31 during the times listed below[/b]

We will be running a [b]2x EXP & Drop event[/b] every day until the end of the year! This event will be available for all levels, so be sure to mark your calendars so you don't miss out on this chance to power through your level-ups!

[b]Event Times:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]First Event (One Time): December 12, 2018[/b][list]
[*]PST (UTC -8): 4:00 PM - 4:30 PM, 7:00 PM - 7:30 PM
[*]EST (UTC -5): 7:00 PM - 7:30 PM, 10:00 PM - 10:30 PM
[*]CET (UTC +1): 1:00 AM - 1:30 AM (December 13), 4:00 AM - 4:30 AM (December 13)
[*]AEDT (UTC +11): 11:00 AM - 11:30 AM (December 13), 2:00 PM - 2:30 PM (December 13)[/list]
[*][b]Ongoing Event (Same Times Every Day): December 13, 2018 - December 31, 2018[/b][list]
[*]PST (UTC -8): 1:00 AM - 1:30 AM, 7:00 AM - 7:30 AM, 1:00 PM - 1:30 PM, 7:00 PM - 7:30 PM
[*]EST (UTC -5): 4:00 AM - 4:30 AM, 10:00 AM - 10:30 AM, 4:00 PM - 4:30 PM, 10:00 PM - 10:30 PM
[*]CET (UTC +1): 10:00 AM - 10:30 AM, 4:00 PM - 4:30 PM, 10:00 PM - 10:30 PM, 4:00 AM - 4:30 AM
[*]AEDT (UTC +11): 8:00 PM - 8:30 PM, 2:00 AM - 2:30 AM, 8:00 AM - 8:30 AM, 2:00 PM - 2:30 PM[/list][/list]

[b][u]Christmas Sweetstravaganza[/u][/b].

[b]PST (UTC -8): Tuesday, December 18, 2018 4:00 PM – Tuesday, January 1, 2019 3:59 PM
EST (UTC -5): Tuesday, December 18, 2018 7:00 PM – Tuesday, January 1, 2019 6:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, December 19, 2018 1:00 AM – Wednesday, January 2, 2019 12:59 AM

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4e4298226aa051afe2b3291bf8f1b62361d612ed.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Christmas Costume Full Package[/b][list]
[*][b]Santa Hat[/b]: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +25. Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*][b]Santa Gloves[/b]: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +25. Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*][b]Santa Costume (M)[/b]: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +25. Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*][b]Santa Costume (F)[/b]: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +25. Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*][b]Red Santa Boots (M)[/b]: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +25. Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*][b]Red Santa Boots (F)[/b]: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +25. Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]
[*][b]Christmas Gift[/b] (Tradeable within worlds). Contains:[list]
[*][b]Alliance Medal (x10)[/b] (Permanent, Untradeable)
[*][b]2x EXP Coupon (15 min)[/b] (7-day duration, Tradeable within worlds)[/list][/list]
After that, log in once a day to receive:
[list]
[*][b]Christmas Gift (Tradeable within worlds).[/b] Contains:[list]
[*][b]Alliance Medal (x10)[/b] (Permanent, Untradeable)
[*][b]2x EXP Coupon (15 min)[/b] (7-day duration, Tradeable within worlds)[/list][/list]
You can also log in on December 24th (UTC) to receive a special gift!
[list]
[*][b]Christmas Stocking Chair[/b] (Permanent, Untradeable)[/list]
Log in every day to receive these special seasonal gifts!

[b][u]Christmas Bounce![/u][/b]

[b]PST (UTC -8): Tuesday, December 18, 2018 4:00 PM – Tuesday, January 1, 2019 3:59 PM
EST (UTC -5): Tuesday, December 18, 2018 7:00 PM – Tuesday, January 1, 2019 6:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, December 19, 2018 1:00 AM – Wednesday, January 2, 2019 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, December 19, 2018 11:00 AM – Wednesday, January 2, 2019 10:59 AM[/b]

Leap into the air to get special rewards in our [b]Christmas Bounce[/b] event! During the above times, players will receive invitations at the 30-minute mark of every hour to play Christmas Bounce. Once you accept the event, you will be moved to the event map where you and several other players will get 40 seconds to jump off platforms and try to get as many items as possible! Prizes include:
[list]
[*][b]Alliance Medal (x10)[/b]: Permanent, Untradeable.
[*][b]1,000,000 Mesos[/b]
[*][b]Spell Trace (x300)[/b]
[*][b]Trait items (x25 for each of the six traits)[/b][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/952729d35d05ad67df5f8ab5fc43bb75e681dc1c.png[/img]

notes.title: Recruit Your Friends and Earn Rewards!
notes.content:
Invite your friends to join you in MapleStory, and you’ll both earn special rewards! To get started, visit the [b][url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/recruitment]Recruit-a-Friend page[/url][/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4690667c5f8058ef9585d58e6d784036795bfc8f.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Recruiters[/b][/h1]
Players Lv. 60 or above are eligible to recruit up to 50 friends! Visit the [b][url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/recruitment]Recruit-a-Friend page[/url][/b] to find your unique recruitment code. Share this special code with your friends by sending them an email, or by posting on Facebook and Twitter. Only new players, or players who haven’t logged in to MapleStory within the past 90 days, are eligible to be recruited. The code can only be used by 50 friends, and will no longer be valid after that.

When your friend uses the code, they will become one of your recruited friends. You can keep track of your friends via your Recruitment List on the [b][url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/recruitment]Recruit-a-Friend page[/url][/b].

Help your friends level a new character to Lv. 33! The more recruited friends who reach Lv. 33, the more rewards you get! When a goal is met, your [b]Recruiter Pack[/b] prize will be waiting for you within 6 hours. Click the gift-box notifier on the left-side of the game window to collect your items (you can choose when to retrieve each item from the pack).

Only one character per account may receive these items, and rewards must be claimed in-game. All Recruiter Packs can be traded within the account.

notes.title: Level Up With the Tera Burning Project!
notes.content:
[b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, January 22, 2018 3:59 PM
EST (UTC -5): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, January 22, 2018 6:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, January 23, 2018 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, January 23, 2018 10:59 AM[/b]

[i]Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event[/i]

The [b]Tera Burning Project[/b] is here to help you level a brand-new character up to Lv. 200!

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, except for Zero characters (Illium, Cadena, and Ark are all eligible for Burning now).

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 200 (once your character hits Lv. 199, they will only be leveled up to Lv. 200)! Characters who have been given the Tera Burning effect can also begin 5th Job quests without completing the 5th Job Advancement prerequisite quest! 

[b][u]Here’s How it Works[/u][/b]

Create a brand-new character during the event period. From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect. Then, accept the quest "It's the Tera Burning Project gift giveaway!" from the star event notifier on the left-side of the game window in order to start receiving rewards! Only one character on your account can have the "Burning" effect.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/1858ac68de1a9ed90931294a226787cae5faae02.png[/img]

After completing the quest "It's the Burning Project gift giveaway!," you will receive all of your gifts immediately; however, you will not be able to use all of them until you meet the required level for each reward.

[b][u]Rewards[/u][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d928e566719fb51863b95d8e074ccfc1af5cb5ca.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Lv. 30 Equipment Box[/b]: Untradeable. Can only be opened at Lv. 30. Open to receive a weapon and armor set suitable for your class.
[*][b]Mysterious Cryptic Chest[/b]: Untradeable. 7-day duration. Open to receive:[list]

tags.feature: The [b]Tera Burning Project[/b] is here to help you level a brand-new character up to Lv. 200!
Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect.
This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, except for Zero characters (Illium, Cadena, and Ark are all eligible for Burning now).

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 200 (once your character hits Lv. 199, they will only be leveled up to Lv. 200)!
Characters who have been given the Tera Burning effect can also begin 5th Job quests without completing the 5th Job Advancement prerequisite quest!
Create a brand-new character during the event period.
From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect.
Then, accept the quest "It's the Tera Burning Project gift giveaway!" from the star event notifier on the left-side of the game window in order to start receiving rewards!
Only one character on your account can have the "Burning" effect.

After completing the quest "It's the Burning Project gift giveaway!," you will receive all of your gifts immediately; however, you will not be able to use all of them until you meet the required level for each reward.

notes.title: Maple Alliance Events!
notes.content:
The war against the Black Mage has finally begun, so join Cygnus in her quest to bring peace to Maple World with these Maple Alliance events! Players Lv. 61 and up will be able to join the Maple Alliance, and start completing Maple Alliance missions to accumulate [b]Determination[/b]. As you and other players gain Determination, the World Gauge will gradually fill up and progress the story, and help to unlock the final battle against the Black Mage!

Here's a taste of what's available this week as part of the Maple Alliance events:

[b][u]Gathering of Heroes[/u][/b]

[b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Tuesday, November 27, 2018 3:59 PM
EST (UTC -5): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Tuesday, November 27, 2018 6:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Wednesday, November 28, 2018 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Thursday, November 15, 2018 (after maintenance) - Wednesday, November 28, 2018 10:59 AM[/b]

To participate in the Gathering of Heroes event, accept the "[Black Mage] Destiny Awaits" quest from the Alliance notifier to take part in a special story. You'll then be recruited into the Maple Alliance, and after December 5, 2018 at 4:00 PM PST (7:00 PM EST / 1:00 AM CET December 6 / 11:00 AM AEDT December 6), you'll receive [b]4 Gathering of Heroes Boxes[/b] from the quest "[Black Mage] Gathering of Heroes - Receive Gift." (Players have until December 18, 2018 at 3:59 PM PST / 6:59 PM EST / 12:59 AM CET December 19 / 10:59 AEDT December 19 to claim these rewards). The gifts can only be claimed once per account, and can be traded between characters in the same world. Each box contains several guaranteed rewards and a bunch of other prizes you have a random chance to get. The boxes contain the following:

[b]Gathering of Heroes Pet Box:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Lil Neiny Pet Package[/b]: Untradeable, 3-day duration. Open to receive:[list]

[*][b]Alliance Military Strategy Book[/b][/list]

[*][b]Von Soup Pet Coupon[/b]: Use to receive a 90-day Von Soup pet.
[*][b]Ice Knight Pet Coupon[/b]: Use to receive a 90-day Ice Knight pet.

[b]Gathering of Heroes Money Box:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]2000 Maple Reward Points[/b]: Untradeable, 3-day duration.
[*]You also have a chance to receive one of the following:[list]
[*][b]3 Gaga Coins (300 million mesos)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*][b]5 Gaga Coins (500 million mesos)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*][b]5 Inkwell Coins (1 billion mesos)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*][b]25 Inkwell Coins (5 billion mesos)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*][b]50 Inkwell Coins (10 billion mesos)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*][b]3K Maple Point Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 3-day duration.
[*][b]30K Maple Point Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 3-day duration.
[*][b]50K Maple Point Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 3-day duration.
[*][b]100K Maple Point Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 3-day duration.
[*][b]500K Maple Point Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 3-day duration.
[*][b]1M Maple Point Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 3-day duration.[/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4d8f6121266f9580841117a569faf327659aec11.png[/img]

[b][u]Determination Gauge[/u][/b]

[b]Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Until Black Mage is defeated.[/b]

Complete Maple Alliance missions to accrue [b]Determination[/b] and help progress the story of the battle against Black Mage! Once you've gathered some Determination, visit the [b]Spark of Determination[/b] in the Maple Alliance Outpost, and offer your Determination to the [b]Goddess Statues[/b]. By doing so, you'll increase your Alliance Rank and add to the World Gauge, which is shared across all worlds in MapleStory. You'll also receive Alliance Medals after giving Determination! (100 Determination will grant you 1 Alliance Medal). 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/f863017a752ce5079a3e85a78e379ce28492f9c6.png[/img]

[b][u]Defense Mission: Scattered Determination[/u][/b]

[b]PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Tuesday, November 27, 2018 3:59 PM
EST (UTC -5): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Tuesday, November 27, 2018 6:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Wednesday, November 28, 2018 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Thursday, November 15, 2018 (after maintenance) - Wednesday, November 28, 2018 10:59 AM[/b]

Earn special rewards in the [b]Scattered Determination[/b] mission! To participate, accept the "[Alliance Mission] Defense Mission-Scattered Determination" mission via the Alliance notifier or NPC Athena Pierce in the Maple Alliance Outpost. You'll be granted a Determination Ember, which you can then use to spawn monsters near your level (20 levels below or above your current level) while out in the field. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d7535991acacbfe6e3cb4cfbb8383b39eb4b06b4.png[/img]

Once you've placed the Determination Ember, you'll be able to collect and transfer Determination a total of 10 times within the given time limit. Defeat monsters to obtain Determination Fragments, including [b]Brave Determination Fragments, Peaceful Determination Fragments, and Hopeful Determination Fragments[/b]! You'll need a certain number of fragments for each level, at which point they can be converted into whole Determination when you return to the Spark of Determination. Collect as many fragments as you can and give them to the Spark of Determination to help in the battle against the Battle Mage!

[b][u]Alliance Support[/u][/b]

[b]Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Until Black Mage is defeated.[/b]

Once you have a character who's joined the Maple Alliance, they'll have the chance to call in backup support while out hunting monsters! Once this character defeats an Elite Monster, they can randomly receive Alliance Support in the form of allied troops, cannons, and airships that will rush into battle to assist you! This effect will last for 30 seconds, and will only apply to normal monsters (Alliance Support cannot be used on either Elite or Boss monsters). You can receive support from the following allies:
[list]
[*][b]Troops[/b]: Maple Alliance soldiers that will fight alongside you in battle!
[*][b]Bombardment[/b]: An air attack that will drop explosions on your enemies!
[*][b]Airship[/b]: A Maple Alliance soldier piloting a deadly airship!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/1a06e323046d466138d6f758cc95063e16ac9d77.png[/img]

Defeating Elite Monsters will also grant your character 100 Determination, so go out and fight for glory with the Maple Alliance by your side!

notes.title: Sunny Sunday Event
notes.content:
Join us on Sunday (UTC) for some special perks!

[b]PST (UTC -8): Saturday, November 10, 2018 4:00 PM – Sunday, November 11, 2018 3:59 PM
EST (UTC -5): Saturday, November 10, 2018 7:00 PM – Sunday, November 11, 2018 6:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Sunday, November 11, 2018 1:00 AM – Monday, November 12, 2018 12:59 AM

Once you receive the gift box, you can open it anytime before [b]1:00 AM PST / 4:00 AM EST / 10:00 AM CET / 8:00 PM AEDT[/b] of the following day.

[list]
Monday, November 5[list]

Tuesday, November 6[list]
[*][b]Selective 8 Slot Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]
Wednesday, November 7[list]
[*][b]Trait Boost Potion[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]

[*][b]Spell Trace (x300)[/b][/list]

notes.title: Stand United with Cygnus and Earn Gifts!
notes.content:
Stand united in the fight with the Maple Alliance and receive a [b]special gift pack[/b]!

[b]PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, October 31, 2018 11:00 AM – Monday, November 12, 2018 10:59 AM (PST)
EDT (UTC -4): Wednesday, October 31, 2018 2:00 PM – Monday, November 12, 2018 1:59 PM (EST)
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, October 31, 2018 7:00 PM – Monday, November 12, 2018 7:59 PM
AEDT (UTC +11): Thursday, November 1, 2018 5:00 AM – Tuesday, November 13, 2018 5:59 AM[/b]

[url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/micro-site/blackmage/gifts][b]Click here[/b][/url] to visit the page and sign up for the event. Then log in to MapleStory after the game update on [b]November 14[/b], but before [b]December 12 at 11:59 PM PST[/b], to receive your special gift that contains the following items!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/7c157404e9c2788a160b0cdd7183e24a58766e0c.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Black Kitty Pet Coupon[/b]: (Untradeable. 7-day duration.) Use to receive a little pet to join you on your adventures! The duration cannot be extended with Water of Life. Coupon is consumed upon use.
[*][b]Cygnusroid (F)[/b]: (Untradeable.) Increase your strength with this android made in the image of Empress Cygnus! You need an Android Heart equipped to operate it.
[*][b]Mini Shinsoo Chair[/b]: (Untradeable.) Get rest in between battles with the help of Shinsoo.
[*][b]Athena Pierce's Support Mount (30 Day)[/b]: (Untradeable. 30-day duration.) Bolster your army with support from Athena Pierce! Use this coupon to receive the Athena Pierce’s Support Mount skill for 30 days. Coupon is consumed upon use.
[*][b]2,000 Maple Reward Points[/b]: (Untradeable. 7-day duration.) Use these Maple Reward Points to help resupply your army. Double-click to receive 2,000 Reward Points. It is consumed upon use.
[*][b]Alliance Medal (x250)[/b]: (Untradeable.) These medals can be used to purchase items from the Alliance Supply Depot.
[*][b]AP Reset Scroll[/b]: (Untradeable. 7-day duration.) Use this item to reset all of your character’s Ability Point stats. It is consumed upon use.
[*][b]SP Reset Scroll[/b]: (Untradeable. 7-day duration.) Use this item to reset all of your character’s Skill Point stats. It is consumed upon use.
[*][b]Selective 8 Slot Coupon (x4)[/b]: (Untradeable. 7-day duration.) Use to expand an inventory tab of your choice by 8 slots. Cannot be used on Storage. It is consumed upon use.
[*][b]Hyper Teleport Rock (7 Day) Coupon (x4)[/b]: (Untradeable. 7-day duration.) Use each coupon to receive a 7-day Hyper Teleport Rock. Use it to teleport to most locations through the World Map. You can also use it to move to a map where a specified character is (same world and channel). This item can be used repeatedly until it expires. Coupon is consumed upon use.
[*][b]Kinship Ring Exchange Coupon[/b]: (Untradeable. 14-day duration.) Use this coupon to receive a 14-day Kinship Ring. Equip the ring to earn 10% bonus EXP. When you're in a party, you and all your party members will get an extra 5% bonus EXP. Coupon is consumed upon use.
[*][b]Power Elixir x100 Coupon (x3)[/b]: (Untradeable. 7-day duration.) Double-click each coupon to receive 100 Power Elixirs. Coupon is consumed upon use.
[*][b]1-Hour 2x EXP Coupon (x6)[/b]: (Can be traded within account. 7-day duration.) Double-click this coupon to receive a 2x EXP buff for 1 hour. It is consumed upon use.
[*][b]1-Hour 2x Drop Coupon (3) (x2)[/b]: (Can be traded within account. 7-day duration.) Double-click this coupon to receive three 2x Drop buff coupons that last for 1 hour when used. Coupons are consumed upon use.
[*][b]Character Slot Expansion Coupon[/b]: (Untradeable. 7-day duration.) Double-click this coupon to receive one additional character slot in the given world. Your account may hold a maximum of 46 character slots per server world, so that you can expand your army. It is consumed upon use.
[*][b]Miracle Circulator Coupon[/b]: (Untradeable. 7-day duration.) Use to receive 3 Miracle Circulators. Double-click on this item to reset your character's Inner Ability. This Circulator will not reduce the rank of any Inner Abilities. Inner Abilities cannot be locked when this Circulator is used. The item can only be used on Epic Rank Inner Abilities or higher. Item is consumed upon use.[/list]

[b]Here’s How to Collect Your Gifts:[/b]

Log in to MapleStory in any world and click the gift-box notifier on the left-side of the game window to collect your items! You may need to log out and log back in for the rewards to appear. If you have more than 30 unclaimed gifts, you may not be able to see the rewards. Please clear any unclaimed gifts and login again to see the rewards. Only one character per account may receive these items, so be sure you are on the character you want to receive these items.

Make sure to [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/micro-site/blackmage/gifts][b]sign up[/b][/url] before [b]November 12 at 10:59 AM PST[/b].


*Limit 1 gift pack per event-registered account. Only available to accounts in good standing that have a Level 10 character or higher. Gift package will be distributed to all confirmed eligible registrants approximately 1 week after the end of the event on November 12, 2018 at 11:00 AM. Gift pack must be claimed by a character Level 10 or higher. Gift pack must be claimed in-game by December 12, 2018 at 11:59 PM and will expire thereafter if not claimed. Gifts are not transferable. Nexon America Inc.’s computers will be the official time-keeping devices. All dates and times in Pacific Time. Entrants are responsible for calculating the difference in time zones. Nexon may cancel, terminate or alter the Program and these Program rules at any time in its sole discretion, with or without notice.

notes.title: It's #Maple Hashtag Time!
notes.content:
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, October 23, 2018 5:00 PM - Tuesday, November 6, 2018 3:59 PM (PST)
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, October 23, 2018 8:00 PM - Tuesday, November 6, 2018 6:59 PM (EST)
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, October 24, 2018 2:00 AM - Wednesday, November 7, 2018 12:59 AM (CET)
AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, October 24, 2018 11:00 AM - Wednesday, November 7, 2018 10:59 AM[/b]

Become a social media celebrity on MapleStory in our brand new [b]#Maple Hashtag[/b] event! Starting October 24 (UTC), players Lv. 33 and above can participate by accepting the "[Hashtag] Maple Hashtag!" quest from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen, then visiting NPC Cassandra to receive a [b]Hashtag Chair[/b] and a [b]Hashtag Phone[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e9b3625a3391221b0dc985cd99bf3379cb062480.png[/img]

Once you have your Hashtag Chair, you can upgrade it and change its look by collecting [b]Hashtag Points[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e80529f0c58f8d0dcecf2461b4811d50bdd9e281.png[/img]

You can gain Hashtag Points by hunting monsters within your level range (20 levels above or below your current level). As you gain Hashtag Points, you'll automatically upgrade your Hashtag Chair's expression, pose, background, and Hashtag. You can earn up to 100 Hashtag Points per day, upon which you'll complete the daily quest "[Hashtag] Daily Hashtag Point," and receive a reward of [b]Spell Trace (x100)[/b]!

There are a variety of options for how to customize your Hashtag Chair, including different expressions, poses, backgrounds, and emoticons. You can decorate your Hashtag Chair with up to 14 total items, including up to 7 of the many available hashtags (each hashtag can only be used once) as well as any combination of emoticons. If you visit certain map locations, you can gain additional backgrounds for your Hashtag Chair by snapping a picture using the Hashtag Phone. You can view the full list of customization options [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/news/36727/v-199-darkness-looms-patch-notes#hashtag]here[/url].

[list]

[*]Job hashtags vary based on your character's job (such as Wind Archer, Blaster, Evan, etc).
[*]Job category hashtags vary based on your character's main job category (such as Warrior, Magician, Bowman, Thief, Pirate).
[*]Faction category hashtags vary based on your character's job faction (such as Explorer, Resistance, Hero, etc).
[*]Lv. 200 hashtags vary based on certain 5th job skills. You can only receive one of these hashtags.
[*]Legion hashtags vary based on your Legion level.
[*]Achievement hashtags vary based on the Maple Achievements you complete.
[*]Title and medal achievements vary based on which of these items you receive.
[*]Hard Boss achievements vary based on which bosses you defeat on Hard Mode.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/5342510058179629980beda4a2b6e31da1ed5cf6.png[/img]

notes.title: It's Ghoul Hunting Season!
notes.content:

EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, October 16, 2018 8:00 PM - Wednesday, October 31, 2018 7:59 PM

AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, October 17, 2018 11:00 AM - Thursday, November 1, 2018 10:59 AM[/b]

The door between the world of the living and the dead has opened, unleashing a horde of ghosts and ghouls upon Maple World! Hunt them down to restore peace to Maple World (and earn spooky rewards along the way) in our [b]Ghoulbusters[/b] event!

To start hunting ghouls, players over Lv. 33 must first accept the "[Halloween] Ghoulbusters" quest from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. Then, you'll start to encounter ghouls while you're out hunting monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above)!

There are three different types of ghouls, each of which gives out a different reward once you defeat 10 of them: 
[list]
[*][b]Frankenbalrogs[/b] give out [b]EXP[/b] based on your level. The 10th and 20th gifts grant [b]extra EXP[/b]!
[*][b]Pumpkin Zombies[/b] give out [b]mesos[/b] in amounts of [b]100 million[/b], [b]500 million[/b], and [b]1 billion mesos[/b]!
[*][b]Halloween Pumpkins[/b] give out [b]3 Ghost Coins[/b]! The 10th gift gives out [b]15 Ghost Coins[/b], and the 20th gift gives out [b]30 Ghost Coins[/b]!
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/17e52c6b69e238d5fd2da54b328e66189ed89a1f.png[/img]

To receive your Ghoulbusters rewards, select the quest "[Halloween] Let's Collect Ghosts!" from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. You can claim rewards 20 times from each type of monster per day (the daily reward limit count resets at midnight UTC each day).

You can also take the Ghost Coins earned from Halloween Pumpkins to NPC Hallowkitty to exchange them for exclusive rewards! NPC Hallowkitty is located in Henesys, Leafre, and Nameless Town, and is open for business at the following times:

notes.title: [Updated October 11] MapleStory 2 Celebration Hot Week
notes.content:
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, October 10, 2018 5:00 PM – Saturday, October 20, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Wednesday, October 10, 2018 8:00 PM – Saturday, October 20, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Thursday, October 11, 2018 2:00 AM – Sunday, October 21, 2018 1:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Thursday, October 11, 2018 11:00 AM – Sunday, October 21, 2018 10:59 AM[/b]

[b][Updated October 11][/b] The descriptions for Pendant of the Spirit and Storm Growth Potion were listed incorrectly; this has been fixed.

To celebrate MapleStory's ongoing journey toward new platforms and new dimensions, we're commemorating the Official Launch of [b][url=http://maplestory2.nexon.net/en/landing]MapleStory 2[/url][/b] with a whole week of [b]Hot Days[/b]! All you have to do is log in to MapleStory to start receiving great items!

Log in each day with a character Lv. 33 or above, and click the gift box icon on the left side of the screen to receive a Gift Box, and then double-click the box in your inventory to open it. The Gift Box can be obtained [b]once in a 24-hour period every day[/b], resetting at [b]5:00 PM PDT / 8:00 PM EDT / 2:00 AM CEST / 11:00 AM AEDT[/b].

Once you receive the gift box, you can open it anytime before [b]2:00 AM PDT / 5:00 AM EDT / 11:00 AM CEST / 8:00 PM AEDT[/b] of the following day.

If you have more than 30 unclaimed gifts, you may not be able to see the Hot Week reward. Please clear any unclaimed gifts and login again to see the Hot Week reward.

All rewards are for both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds unless specifically noted below.
[list]
[*]Thursday, October 11[list]
[*][b]Shroom Buddy Chair[/b]: Untradeable, permanent.
[*][b]Pendant of the Spirit[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration (Unique equipped item; Time Limit Extension is not possible).
[*][b]Storm Growth Potion[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/be4fa8591f9e07e554482d21bbe8011ef7e05615.png[/img]

[*]Friday, October 12[list]
[*][b]Esel[/b]: Untradeabe, 30-day duration.
[*][b]Selective 8-Slot Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/2fb6688af30246d2306e8378e01769e4201010ad.png[/img]

[*]Saturday, October 13[list]
[*][b]1,000 Maple Reward Points[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*][b]Hyper Teleport Rock Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/155e87ba747212c145868e99ad7ed216eebd66c0.png[/img]

[*]Sunday, October 14[list]
[*][b]Nodestone (x5)[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.

notes.title: Explore the Infinite Pawsibilities!
notes.content:
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Thursday, October 4, 2018 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, October 24, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Thursday, October 4, 2018 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, October 24, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Thursday, October 4, 2018 (after maintenance) – Thursday, October 25, 2018 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Friday, October 5, 2018 (after maintenance) – Thursday, October 25, 2018 10:59 AM (AEDT)[/b]

Exploring Maple World is a blast when you have an adorable puppy pal by your side! In the [b]Infinite Pawsibilities[/b] event, you can complete special missions to receive decorations for your Custom Puppy, and earn rewards along the way! Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by selecting the Infinite Pawsibilities notifier from the left side of the screen and accepting the quest ‘[Event] Explore the Infinite Pawsibilities’.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d88633dfdc130d056e65113a20a3a5a67837d755.png[/img]

[b][u]Custom Puppy[/u][/b]

Everyone will receive a [b]Summon Custom Puppy[/b] item which can be used to summon your Custom Puppy to appear by your side. Originally, your puppy has a very basic look. As you complete missions, you’ll be able to use the UI to build up the [b]Courage[/b], [b]Curiosity[/b], and [b]Stamina[/b] of your Custom Puppy. This unlocks new options to decorate your Custom Puppy, allowing you to change the face style, fur pattern, and accessories to create a puppy that’s unique.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4b820a167b3f19e58cdec9fdedef89d9defd58ea.png[/img]

[b][u]Daily Missions[/u][/b]

Complete daily missions that focus on one element of your gameplay. Build up your Courage by hunting down specific bosses including Zakum, Horntail, Magnus, and more. Work on your Curiosity by completing areas such as Monster Park or Nett’s Pyramid. Steel up your Stamina by hunting monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above).

When you complete a mission, you receive a reward box!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/fd9f1ba402a80ab5797dd4e76fd44059f3bd62f1.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Courageous Balance Box[/b]: Untradeable. Must be opened by 11:59 PM UTC on the day it’s received. Open the box to receive:[list]
[*][b]100 Reward Points[/b]: Untradeable, 1-day duration
[*][b]Mysterious Meso Pouch[/b]: Untradeable, 1-day duration[/list]
[*][b]Curious Balance Box[/b]: Untradeable. Must be opened by 11:59 PM UTC on the day it’s received. Open the box to receive:[list]
[*][b]Pollo and Fritto Entry Ticket[/b]: Untradeable, 1-day duration
[*][b]Monster Park REBORN Coupon[/b]: Tradeable within account on same world, 1-day duration[/list]
[*][b]Enduring Balance Box[/b]: Untradeable. Must be opened by 11:59 PM UTC on the day it’s received. Open the box to receive:[list]
[*][b]2x EXP Coupon (x2) (15 minutes)[/b]: Untradeable, 1-day duration
[*][b]2x Drop Coupon (x2) (15 minutes)[/b]: Untradeable, 1-day duration[/list][/list]
When you complete a mission, in addition to the rewards above, you also gain a new decoration for your Custom Puppy. Open the UI by accepting the quest ‘[Event] Caring for Your Custom Puppy’ from the Infinite Pawsibilities event notifier on the left side of the screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b6caaef1517bd3cc907e44dc1d6a3d6f88e27746.png[/img]

[b][u]Rewards[/u][/b]

Complete 15 days of daily missions, and your balance boxes will contain special rewards!
[list]
[*][b]Custom Puppy Medal[/b]: Untradeable. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, MaxHP/MaxMP +500.
[*][b]Custom Puppy Damage Skin[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
[*][b]Custom Puppy Ring[/b]: Untradeable. Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +2.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/7893e3b8d2ca9030b6537d9742d8165df0a7b3a6.png[/img]

[b][u]Groovy Smoothie[/u][/b]

While you’re working on your abilities, you may as well enjoy a healthy smoothie too. Accept the quest ‘[Event] Drink Groovy Smoothie’ and hold onto the [b]Groovy Smoothie[/b] item for 30 minutes. When you complete the quest, you can receive another balance box. This can be completed one per day per world.
[list]
[*][b]Rested Balance Box[/b]: Untradeable. Must be opened by 11:59 PM UTC on the day it’s received. Open the box to receive:[list]
[*][b]50 Reward Points[/b]: Untradeable, 1-day duration
[*][b]2x EXP Coupon (15 minutes)[/b]: Untradeable, 1-day duration
[*][b]Custom Puppy Pep[/b]: Untradeable, 1-day duration. Gives Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +20 for 15 minutes.[/list][/list]

If you log in daily and enjoy your smoothie, you can receive more rewards!
[list]
[*]Day 5 - [b]Custom Puppy Whiskers[/b]: 30-day duration
[*]Day 10 - [b]Custom Puppy Hat[/b]: 30-day duration
[*]Day 15 - [b]Custom Puppy Tail[/b]: 30-day duration[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b30fdffed7287003136f9570c7c2d2570018770d.png[/img]

notes.title: This Winter, the Black Mage Approaches
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/42d1c188abf6d2f4e34f46617b8dec6416cae086.jpg[/img]

Get ready for MapleStory’s biggest update ever as Maple World prepares for battle against the sinister Black Mage! The excitement starts with pre-events in the upcoming October update. The Black Mage updates begin in earnest in November, with the ultimate battle coming by the end of the year!

[b]Here’s the release schedule:[/b]
[list][*]November - [b]Black Mage: Gathering of Heroes[/b]
[*]November - [b]Black Mage: Prelude to War[/b]
[*]December - [b]Black Mage: Labyrinth[/b]
[*]December - [b]Black Mage: Final Battle[/b][/list]
[url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/micro-site/blackmage]Click here to visit the website and join the fight. The Maple Alliance needs you![/url]

[h1][b]EARN REWARDS WITH PRE-EVENTS[/b][/h1]

Over the coming months, we’ll feature several [b]events on the website[/b] to help you prepare, so make sure to check back regularly!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/13555bab2b7bd67130772c4ee92fd587ba662b20.png[/img]

[h1][b]JOIN THE MAPLE ALLIANCE[/b][/h1]

Starting in [b]November[/b], you can help the [b]Maple Alliance[/b] prepare for war with all-new missions! Rise through the ranks and earn rewards and special skills.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/5591f029e0db51641710819a268faaa5cd2ce4ce.png[/img]

[h1][b]LEVEL UP FASTER[/b][/h1]

Make sure you’re ready for the end-game! The [b]Tera Burning[/b] event starting in [b]November[/b] will let your character reach Lv. 200 three times faster. Content for players Lv. 200 and under will become easier and faster to complete, and the EXP curve will be lowered between Lv. 200 and 220.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b3c7bde56dec7539f3f7d3bc70979e5cc58ac284.png[/img]

[h1][b]NEW 5TH JOB SKILLS[/b][/h1]

Up your skill game in [b]December[/b] with the addition of new [b]5th job skills[/b] for all character job categories (Warrior, Magician, Bowman, Thief, Pirate)! In addition, you will now receive all 5th Job skills as soon as you complete the job advancement.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/f7a92d5adf555981bffe09b38387d41a386eb327.png[/img]

[h1][b]ARCANE RIVER EXPANDS[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Join the Bug Brawl!
notes.content:
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, September 18, 2018 5:00 PM – Wednesday, October 3, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, September 18, 2018 8:00 PM – Wednesday, October 3, 2018 at 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, September 19, 2018 2:00 AM - Thursday, October 4, 2018 at 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, September 19, 2018 10:00 AM - Thursday, October 4, 2018 at 9:59 AM[/b]

Do you have what it takes to raise the biggest and baddest bug around? Prepare for [b]Bug Brawl[/b], where insects prove their worth in a bug-eat-bug world!

Players Lv. 33 and up can participate by accepting the quest '[b][Bug Brawl] Here's Your Bug[/b]' from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen, or speaking to [b]NPC Doctor Ong[/b] to receive a starter companion bug. Once you've received the bug, you can click on its Photo Album to view its feeding and care requirements, base power, current level, and what it can evolve into. During the event, monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above) have a chance to drop different bugs. Some of these smaller insects make for great bug feed, and if you collect them, your companion bug will grow stronger and grant you bonus EXP! But be warned - monsters may also drop bigger bugs that are natural enemies to your companion, and if you or a pet picks up an insect that is the same evolution or higher than your bug, it will lose EXP. Double-check to make sure you don't have a pet automatically picking up dangerous loot!

You can also summon your companion bug by double-clicking it to receive a small stat boost. Look out for the Praying Mantis, as only the strongest bugs will be able to defeat it!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/0e39f321f2399e4401506cdd241d4d134272f096.jpg[/img]

Once your companion bug reaches a certain level, you can evolve it into a more powerful bug! To evolve your companion bug, first open the Photo Album that you obtained when you received your bug. Inside the Photo Album, you’ll be able to select which bug you’d like to evolve your companion bug into. There are multiple evolutionary paths you can take, each granting their own rewards. If you’d like to reset your bug to an Ant, accept the quest '[b][Bug Brawl] Debugging[/b]' and Doctor Ong will then replace your current bug with an Ant.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/9a4edba63ca9f137cb05deecb2089f699cb6542b.png[/img]

Each bug gives the following stat boosts:
[list]
[*][b]Ladybug[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1
[*][b]Ant[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +2
[*][b]Bee[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +3
[*][b]Dragonfly[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +4
[*][b]Beetle[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5
[*][b]Cricket[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +6
[*][b]Grasshopper[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7
[*][b]Stag Beetle[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +8
[*][b]Fire Ant[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +4
[*][b]Army Ant[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5
[*][b]Bullet Ant[/b]: Grant Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +6
[*][b]Wasp[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5
[*][b]Giant Hornet[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +6
[*][b]Rhinoceros Beetle[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7
[*][b]Elephant Beetle[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +8
[*][b]Caucasus Beetle[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +9
[*][b]Hercules Beetle[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10
[*][b]Field Cricket[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +8
[*][b]Giant Cricket[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +9
[*][b]Titan Beetle[/b]: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10[/list]
If you level up your bug all the way to the powerful Titan Beetle or Hercules Beetle level, you'll earn exclusive rewards!
[list]
[*][b]Bug Master[/b]: Title. Obtained when completing '[Bug Brawl] King of the Bugs'. Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +30, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +60, MaxHP/MaxMP +3000, Boss Damage +30%, Ignore Defense +30%. Stats have 14-day duration.
[*][b]Baddest Bug[/b]: Medal. Obtained when completing '[Bug Brawl] Baddest Bug'. Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +10, MaxHP/MaxMP +450, Boss Damage +10%, Ignore Defense +10%. Stats have 14-day duration. Note: Does not register in Medal Collection.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c9ed2413d0523c20310ab867cd697886ec924aa2.png[/img]

Turn your little insect pal into a vicious predator, and earn great rewards and stat boosts along the way! The Bug Brawl has begun!

This event is also part of [b]Maple Missions[/b]! Participate in Bug Brawl and complete Maple Missions to earn extra rewards! More information on Maple Missions [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/game/mission]here[/url].

notes.title: Sengoku High Returns!
notes.content:
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, September 11, 2018 5:00 PM – Tuesday, September 25, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, September 11, 2018 8:00 PM – Tuesday, September 25, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, September 12, 2018 2:00 AM – Wednesday, September 26, 2018 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, September 12, 2018 10:00 AM – Wednesday, September 26, 2018 9:59 AM[/b]

Oda Nobunaga has taken over [b]Sengoku High[/b]. Test your wits and skills as you battle against Oda Nobunaga’s elite students and prove yourself worthy. Step into this premium mini-dungeon and complete quests to earn [b]Oda Coins[/b]. With Oda Coins, you can purchase [b]totems[/b] and [b]pocket items[/b]—equipable stat items that boost a variety of stats. There are also other items available, including [b]restorative items[/b], [b]outfits[/b], [b]medals[/b], and more! Sharpen those pencils! The classroom just got dangerous.

[b][u]How to Play[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Requirement: Your character must be Lv. 33 or above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). The dungeon is solo only.
[*]NPC Boss Kumi will be in the Event Hall. Talk to her to enter the school.
[*]You can venture deeper into the school for free once per day by completing the daily quest "Red Leaf High: The Sengoku'ing." More entries require a special pass available in the Cash Shop or Maple Rewards Shop. Each pass will be consumed after one use.[list]
[*][b]Sengoku Class Supplementary Pass[/b][list]
[*]Non-Reboot worlds only:[list]
[*]Price (1): [b]400 NX[/b]
[*]Price (11): [b]4,000 NX[/b]
[*]Duration: 30 days[/list]
[*]Both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds:[list]
[*]Price (1): [b]400 Reward Points[/b]
[*]Duration: 30 days
[*]Purchase Limit: 5[/list][/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/374759757bfe808fccc439ee10f37032b2718518.jpg[/img]

[*]The goal is to complete all of the stages, or get as far into the school as you can before time runs out! Fight your way through all the classes and face down Mori Ranmaru.
[*]After completing each room's challenge, you will be awarded [b]Oda Coins[/b].
[*]Oda Coins can be used to purchase items from Sagacious Goemon in the homeroom. You can check the prices of each item by clicking on the shop in the school.[/list]

[b][u]Rewards[/u][/b]

Visit Sagacious Goemon and pick up the [b]Sengoku School Bag[/b] to receive a random item such as effect coupons, chairs, scrolls, potions, and more.
[list]
[*][b]Sengoku School Bag[/b]: Untradeable, Req. Lv: 60, 7-day duration. Open to receive a random item, including:[list]
[*][b]Dark Onmyouji Effect Coupons[/b] (90 day and permanent versions available)
[*][b]Fox God[/b]: Chair that emits a special effect with 2 characters sitting near each other.
[*][b]Kitsune Torii[/b]: Chair that emits a special effect with 2 characters sitting near each other.
[*][b]Ghost Fox Chair[/b]
[*]Upgrade items (all untradeable except the [b]Epic Potential Scroll 40%[/b] which is moveable within the account): [b]Gold Bonus Potential Stamp, Gold Potential Stamp, Special Potential Scroll, Epic Potential Scroll 40%, Bonus Potential Scroll 60%, Special Bonus Potential Scroll, Perfect Innocence Scroll 50%[/b][list]
[*]Note: These upgrade items are not available on Reboot world, and you will receive [b]Mysterious Meso Pouch (x10)[/b] instead.[/list]
[*][b]Superior buff potions[/b]
[*][b]Restorative items[/b][/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/6d570cbc710e482837d422012f72c6ebcd9b5992.jpg[/img]

Want to dress up nice? Pick up the [b]Kimono Box[/b] which will give you a random equip item with a 30-day duration.
[list]
[b]Kimono Box[/b]: Untradeable, Req. Lv: 60. This item cannot be used after the event has ended. Open to receive a random equip:[list]
[*][b]Dark Blue Robes[/b]: 30-day duration. Charm 60 EXP can be obtained once when equipped.
[*][b]Yang In[/b]: 30-day duration. Charm 60 EXP can be obtained once when equipped.
[*][b]Big Kimono[/b]: 30-day duration. Charm 60 EXP can be obtained once when equipped.
[*][b]Red Full Coat[/b]: 30-day duration. Charm 60 EXP can be obtained once when equipped.
[*][b]Forest Samurai Outfit[/b]: 30-day duration. Charm 60 EXP can be obtained once when equipped.
[*][b]Princess Hakama[/b]: 30-day duration. Charm 60 EXP can be obtained once when equipped.
[*][b]King Crow Suit[/b]: 30-day duration. Charm 60 EXP can be obtained once when equipped.
[*][b]Blue Shinsengumi Uniform[/b]: 30-day duration. Charm 60 EXP can be obtained once when equipped.
[*][b]Brown Shinsengumi Uniform[/b]: 30-day duration. Charm 60 EXP can be obtained once when equipped.
[*][b]Grey Full Coat[/b]: 30-day duration. Charm 60 EXP can be obtained once when equipped.[/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e8ca22a57497f6ad9e16a6c8ff6a403615a05ef3.jpg[/img]

There are also medals, pins, a title, and more items available!
[list]
[*][b]Sensei[/b]: Medal. Movement is only possible within the account, Req. Lv: 180, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +8, MaxHP/MaxMP +800, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +8, Speed +20, Jump +20.
[*][b]Senpai[/b]: Medal. Movement is only possible within the account, Req. Lv: 120, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +5, MaxHP/MaxMP +600, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, Speed +10, Jump +10.
[*][b]Kouhai[/b]: Medal. Movement is only possible within the account, Req. Lv: 1, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +4, MaxHP/MaxMP +600, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +2, Speed +10, Jump +10.
[*][b]Sagacious Goemon Pin[/b]: Pocket Item. Can be traded once within the account, Req. Lv: 30, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +3, MaxHP/MaxMP +50, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +3.
[*][b]Mori Ranmaru Pin[/b]: Pocket Item. Can be traded once within the account, Req. Lv: 120, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, MaxHP/MaxMP +150, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7.
[*][b]Headmaster Oda Pin[/b]: Pocket Item. Can be traded once within the account, Req. Lv: 200, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +15, MaxHP/MaxMP +250, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10.
[*][b]Sengoku Shodan Pin[/b]: Pocket Item. Untradeable. Req. Lv: 200. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +20, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10.
[*][b]Sengoku Hakase Badge[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 160. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +10, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10, Number of Upgrades Available +2.[list]
[*]This badge can gain Potential.[/list]
[*][b]Sengoku Renshi Title[/b]: Untradeable. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7, MaxHP/MaxMP +500.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/dd5e0b9d867c7093d6fcacfa4e252f6e9b5bf271.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Totems[/u][/b]

Collect the totems of Sanada Yukimura, Honda Tadakatsu, and Uesugi Kenshin. Each totem is a unique equipped item, so you won’t be able to have two of the same totem equipped at the same time. For example, you can have a Sanada Yukimura Totem equipped at the same time as a Honda Tadakatsu Totem, but you can’t have two Sanada Yukimura Totem equipped at the same time.
[list]
[*][b]Sanada Yukimura Totem[/b]: Untradeable, Unique Equipped Item, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +24, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +8.
[*][b]Honda Tadakatsu Totem[/b]: Untradeable, Unique Equipped Item, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +24, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +8.
[*][b]Uesugi Kenshin Totem[/b]: Untradeable, Unique Equipped Item, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +24, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +8.
[*]Upon collecting all three totems, you may complete the quest 'Red Leaf High: Secrets of War' from Oda Nobunaga. The totems need to be in your inventory (Not Equipped) to complete the quest. You will learn the skill 'Warring States Manifesto' upon completing the quest:[list]
[*][b]Warring States Manifesto[/b]: Summon the Sengoku generals to attack. Max Enemies Hit 15, Damage 500%, Cooldown 180 seconds.[/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d898397be07b8fcc4e51a5509935e03c234873d9.jpg[/img]

This event is also part of [b]Maple Missions[/b]! Participate in Sengoku High and complete Maple Missions to earn extra rewards! More information on Maple Missions [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/game/mission]here[/url].

There are also other items available, including [b]restorative items[/b], [b]outfits[/b], [b]medals[/b], and more! Sharpen those pencils! The classroom just got dangerous.
Requirement: Your character must be Lv. 33 or above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). The dungeon is solo only.

Start earning major rewards by taking part in our [b]Tomorrow's Another Day[/b] event! Players Lv. 33 and up can participate by accepting the quest "Tomorrow's Gift Box" from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. Talk to NPC Maple Admin, who will ask you to hunt 200 monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above). notes.title: Divine Intelligence Event
notes.content:
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, September 11, 2018 5:00 PM – Wednesday, October 3, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, September 11, 2018 8:00 PM – Wednesday, October 3, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, September 12, 2018 2:00 AM – Thursday, October 4, 2018 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, September 12, 2018 10:00 AM – Thursday, October 4, 2018 9:59 AM[/b]

Show off your mind with the [b]Divine Intelligence[/b] event! Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by accepting the quest 'Divine Intelligence Research Lab Open' from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. An invitation will appear above your character’s head at the 15 and 45-minute mark of every hour. You will be moved to the event map along with up to 49 other players.

This mini-game tests you on identifying Maple monsters and rewards you with points depending on how many you answer correctly. We've added new monsters and questions to the quiz, so you'll have to sharpen your knowledge to get all 10 questions right! To answer, you must quickly move to the area of the map displaying either “A” or “B”. You earn [b]points[/b] when you answer questions correctly.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4387191174f04ed3071b660a08a80b24871d33db.jpg[/img]

Each game consists of 10 stages and 1 random question is displayed for each stage. Throughout the quiz, the conditions for answering the question will change based on the NPC asking the question. The conditions are as follows:
[list]
[*]Gym Cat: No special conditions.
[*]Ursie: The answers will flip which side they're on.
[*]Flicker: You'll have less time to choose an answer.
[*]Iron Rabbit: The image is obscured, making it harder to tell which monster it is.[/list]
If you are disqualified, you can still participate by voting for your favorite player remaining in the game. If your favorite player is still standing when the stage ends, you will receive a percentage of the points. The favorite player also receives extra points based on how many players vote for them. You can participate in the event up to 5 times per day.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/395aae2eb02441dd044d8395ad07c73feebb51fd.jpg[/img]

Collect those points and then exchange them for nice rewards! Check out some of the awesome new rewards we have available for this event:
[list]
[*][b]Smarty Pants Assessment Capsule[/b]
[*][b]Data Collection Goggles Coupon[/b] (Grants permanent item)
[*][b]Gym Cat Mask Coupon[/b] (Grants permanent item)
[*][b]Ursie Mask Coupon (Grants[/b] permanent item)
[*][b]Iron Rabbit Mask Coupon[/b] (Grants permanent item)
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/75643a79c4f4700eac4a8da1f5c3014e4f4fc7f5.png[/img]

There are plenty of other items you can win as well! Rewards include:
[list]
[*][b]Smarty Pants Assessment Chair[/b]
[*][b]Ramblings of a Genius Coupon[/b]: Gives [b]Ramblings of a Genius[/b] effect that can be toggled on/off via a hotkey.
[*][b]Gym Cat's Gift Buff Coupon[/b]: Gives a buff that grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +30 for 30 minutes. Can be purchased once per day.
[*][b]Ursie's Gift Buff Coupon[/b]: Gives a buff that grants EXP +50% for 30 minutes. Can be purchased once per day.
[*][b]Iron Rabbit's Gift Buff Coupon[/b]: Gives a buff that grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +50 for 30 minutes. Can be purchased once per day.
[*][b]Flicker's Gift Buff Coupon[/b]: Gives a buff that grants EXP +100% for 30 minutes. Can be purchased once per day.
[*][b]Epic Potential Scroll 50% Coupon[/b]: Gives [b]Epic Potential Scroll 50% (x5)[/b]. 7-day duration. Coupon is usable until October 9 at 11:59 PM (UTC).
[*][b]Master Craftsman's Cube[/b]: Tradeable within account, 7-day duration. Can be purchased once per day.
[*][b]Meister's Cube[/b]: Tradeable within account, 7-day duration. Can be purchased once per day.
[*][b]Spell Trace (x5,000)[/b]
[*][b]Divine Intelligence Researcher[/b]: Medal. 30-day duration stats. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +3, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +3. Participate in the event 6 times to receive the title.
[*][b]Divine Intelligence Lead Researcher[/b]: Medal. 30-day duration stats. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7. Participate in the event 15 times to receive the title.
[*][b]Divine Intelligence Chief Researcher[/b]: Medal. 30-day duration stats. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +10, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10. Participate in the event 18 times to receive the title.

In addition to items, you can also trade your points for [b]mesos[/b] at a 1:100 ratio for a maximum of 5,000,000 mesos per day.

This event is also part of [b]Maple Missions[/b]! Participate in Divine Intelligence and complete Maple Missions to earn extra rewards! More information on Maple Missions [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/game/mission]here[/url].

Characters from [b]Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card[/b] are coming to Maple World in this limited-time crossover event! Spend time with Sakura Kinomoto and her friends as you take part in fun events.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c2507abac22866b1c8efa7acadb75f82e4c87d1a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Maple Monsters[/h1]
Sakura Kinomoto and her friends Kero-chan, Tomoyo Daidouji, and Syaoran Li are visiting Maple World, but are worried that it’s full of scary monsters! Many monsters are actually cute, and Sakura might enjoy meeting them. Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by accepting the quest ‘[Cardcaptor Sakura] Maple World's 'Cutest' Monsters’ from the event notifier on the left side of the screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/ab2bee02ba9559dca7fca93faea5011fb1b68178.jpg[/img]

Follow Sakura’s hints to find some nice monsters. Weaken a monster to lower its HP, and then use a [b]Capture Card[/b] to try to collect it and bring it back to show Sakura. You can complete this event once per character.

Each time you return a captured monster, you’ll receive the buff [b]Sakura-chan's Support[/b], which grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7 for 30 minutes. Bring her the last captured monster to receive a special title:

[list][*][b]Sakura-chan's Friend[/b]: Title. Untradeable. Grants INT +10.[/list]

Complete the quest to receive another title from Sakura:

[list][*][b]MapleStory X Cardcaptor Sakura[/b]: Title. Untradeable. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +8, MaxHP/MaxMP +50.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/44b49abd3db1ae3d8497f7b6d4f6d5c0056eb33f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hungry Kero-chan[/h1]
Kero-chan has heard that Maple World is filled with delicious food, and is anxious to try some! Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by accepting the quest ‘[Cardcaptor Sakura] Maple World Delicacies’ from the event notifier on the left side of the screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/737a1495f9cc8e85f739daa316eec55d1e1ad269.jpg[/img]

Kero-chan has an idea of some of the foods he wants to try! Collect the treats from monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above), or by visiting NPC shops, and give them to Kero-chan. You can complete this quest 5 times per day.

You’ll be rewarded with [b]Kero-chan’s Reward Box[/b], which gives you one random item when opened:

[list][*][b]Trait items[/b]
[*][b]Kero-chan's Support[/b]: Buff. 7-day duration. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7 for 30 minutes
[*][b]Kero-chan's Friend[/b]: Title. Untradeable. Grants STR +10.
[*][b]Konyanyachiwa[/b]: Title. Untradeable. Grants MaxHP/MaxMP +100.
[*][b]Dozing Together Chair[/b]
[*][b]Desserts with Kero-chan Chair[/b][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/8098eb36b0b7393f46463875e2dad3765d62d121.jpg[/img]

[h1]Commemorative Photograph[/h1]
Tomoyo wants to take a special photo with Sakura and her friends to remember their fun time in Maple World! Tomoyo has an idea for a spot to use as a backdrop. Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by accepting the quest ‘[Cardcaptor Sakura] Places in Maple World’ from the event notifier on the left side of the screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/5322c09555a2a8c82fbb0dc6d260c54634415f98.jpg[/img]

Follow Tomoyo’s hints using a [b]Walkie-Talkie[/b] to find each map. Double-click [b]Tomoyo’s Video Camera[/b] to capture an image of each map. You can complete this event once per character.

Bring the images back to Tomoyo, and she’ll give you various rewards:

[list][*][b]Tomoyo-chan's Support[/b]: Buff. 7-day duration. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7 for 30 minutes
[*][b]Tomoyo-chan's Friend[/b]: Title. Untradeable. Grants DEX +10.
[*][b]Sakura's Hair Ornament[/b][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3a77dbd6151819247b1bcda334c5ad3dc1c080fd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Time to Return[/h1]
Vacations are fun, but Syaoran is already thinking about how to head home. He was ambushed by monsters and dropped his cards! Now he needs your help. Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by accepting the quest ‘[Cardcaptor Sakura] Finding the Lost’ from the event notifier on the left side of the screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/439998d33dafbf58630448cc76b0f390fbf15eab.jpg[/img]

Help Syaoran by hunting monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above) to collect the [b]Card Vestiges[/b] they drop. You can complete this quest 5 times per day.

You’ll be rewarded with [b]Syaoran's Reward Box[/b], which gives you one random item when opened:

[list][*][b]Trait items[/b]
[*][b]Mysterious Meso Pouch[/b]
[*][b]Syaoran-kun's Support[/b]: Buff. 7-day duration. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7 for 30 minutes
[*][b]Syaoran-kun's Friend[/b]: Title. Untradeable. Grants LUK +10.
[*][b]Eating Lunch Together Chair[/b][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/78d4393503b97488f98fd3a5ba1c86c6dab0a287.jpg[/img]

[b]ⓒCLAMP, ST/KODANSHA, NEP, NHK[/b]

notes.title: v.198 – MapleStory X Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card Update Preview
notes.content:
Characters from [b]Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card[/b] are coming to MapleStory in this limited-time crossover event! We’re also preparing some game improvements and bug fixes, and adding several fun events! Show off your mind with the return of the Divine Intelligence event, and grow a bigger bug with the Bug Brawl event. All this and more is coming your way in [b]MapleStory X Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card[/b]!

[b][u]MAPLESTORY X CARDCAPTOR SAKURA: CLEAR CARD[/u][/b]
Enjoy themed events from [b]Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card[/b] and collect some fun rewards! Sakura Kinomoto and her friends Kero-chan, Tomoyo Daidouji, and Syaoran Li are visiting Maple World. Capture monsters to show them that Maple World’s monsters are cute! Bring Kero-chan some delicious food, take a commemorative photograph for Tomoyo, and help Syaoran find a way home. Complete the quests to receive [b]buffs, titles, and special chairs[/b]! Special [b]Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card[/b] themed items will also be available in the Cash Shop! Purchase a special surprise style box and get [b]equips[/b] to look like Sakura, Syaoran, or Kero-chan, as well as [b]fun hats and capes[/b]! Look for [b]chairs, a Cerberus mount[/b], and more inside the special random box. You can also update your character’s look with new [b]hairstyles[/b] designed to look just like one of the characters from [b]Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card[/b]!

Make sure to [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/micro-site/cardcaptorsakura]visit the website[/url] to register for a free gift pack when the update goes live!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/350a4d7e541f73a038a5ce24c06db1ff9b0ec79e.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c2507abac22866b1c8efa7acadb75f82e4c87d1a.jpg[/img]

[b]ⓒCLAMP, ST/KODANSHA, NEP, NHK[/b]

[b][u]DIVINE INTELLIGENCE[/u][/b]
Show off your mind with the return of the [b]Divine Intelligence[/b] event! This mini-game will test you on Maple knowledge and reward you with points depending on how much you know. The event will be updated with [b]new questions[/b], and you must quickly move to the area with the correct answer to stay in the game. Make your way through all 10 stages and earn points to redeem on [b]new rewards including masks and a fancy chair[/b]! If you’re knocked out of the game, it’s ok because you can still vote for your favorite contestant still standing, and earn a fraction of their points.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4387191174f04ed3071b660a08a80b24871d33db.jpg[/img]

[b][u]BUG BRAWL[/u][/b]
Embrace your inner entomologist in this new event! Maple World is crawling with critters, and it’s up to you to [b]catch and grow the most powerful bugs[/b] you can. Everyone will start with one beginner bug. Study its feeding and growth requirements, then hunt monsters within your level range to collect more bugs! Monsters will drop smaller bugs that can be used as food, but also larger bugs that can weaken your own special creature. When it’s ready, you will be able to [b]transform your critter[/b] into a larger, more powerful insect. Advance through the evolutionary chain until you have created the [b]ultimate bug[/b]! You’ll gain [b]stat buffs[/b] depending on what bug you have, as well as [b]earn EXP[/b] from consuming smaller bugs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/1553aa78c8f5731d78f682884f24f9f8fd4205aa.jpg[/img]

[b][u]MORE EVENTS[/u][/b]
In [b]Tomorrow's Another Day[/b], you will receive a special gift box with a catch—the gift box can’t be opened until the following day. You have the option to open the gift box and accept its rewards now, or upgrade the box to a better one! The items from each box only last 48 hours, so you need to keep coming back to claim more gift boxes! The items inside get better as you upgrade to fancier gift boxes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c6d10a485d8cb5f52fd6d6e71a426a80c3f9fc03.jpg[/img]

That’s not all—[b]Sengoku High[/b] is returning to Maple World! Step into this premium mini-dungeon and test your wits and skills as you battle against Oda Nobunaga’s elite students. Prepare to take down Mori Ranmaru, as you fight your way through all the classes. Earn Oda Coins to exchange for totems, medals, equips, and more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/5cf5c57c7b84d855d0e7cf7a18c5c79e98e216d0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Cash Inventory Transfer Event
notes.content:
[b]Thursday, August 16 to Wednesday, August 29[/b]
[list]
[*]This event will begin after the maintenance on August 16.
[*]This event will end after the maintenance on August 29.[/list]
Do you have a cash item you’ve wanted to move to another character on your account? Now you can!

For a limited time, you will be able to transfer most cash items between your characters within the same world. Take this opportunity to share a Hyper Teleport Rock, move cash cover items between characters, move a beloved pet to a new character, and more!

This event is available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds. You can only transfer cash items between characters in the same world. This does not include different worlds in the same world alliance. For example, you can transfer items between two characters on Mardia, but you cannot transfer an item from a character on Mardia to a character on Kradia.

Trading cash items between your characters is easy! All you need to do is follow these simple steps:

1. Enter the Cash Shop.
2. Pick an eligible item you would like to transfer to a different character, and move it into your Cash Inventory.
3. Right-click the item.
4. Click the ‘TRANSFER’ button.
5. Select the recipient of the item from the drop down.
6. Click the ‘OK’ button.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3c0b5a311ef300da61c0d3336329fecde77229a3.png[/img]

The selected item will now appear in the other character’s Cash Inventory the next time you login to that character. All jobs are able to transfer cash items between each other, except Explorers since they already share their Cash Inventory.

There are a few items that are not able to be transferred:
[list]
[*]EXP Coupons
[*]Potion Pot
[*]Friendship and Couple items[/list]

tags.feature: Now you can! For a limited time, you will be able to transfer most cash items between your characters within the same world.

notes.title: Double Miracle Time Event
notes.content:
[b]Saturday, August 18, 2018
[list]
[*]PDT (UTC -7): 1:30 AM – 2:30 AM & 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM & 10:00 PM – 11:00 PM
[*]EDT (UTC -4): 4:30 AM – 5:30 AM & 6:00 PM – 7:00 PM & 1:00 AM – 2:00 AM (August 19)
[*]CEST (UTC +2): 10:30 AM – 11:30 AM & 12:00 AM – 1:00 AM (August 19) & 7:00 AM – 8:00 AM (August 19)
[*]AEST (UTC +10): 6:30 PM – 7:30 PM & 8:00 AM – 9:00 AM (August 19) & 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM (August 19)[/list]
Available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds.[/b]

If you've been searching for ways to boost your power, you’re in luck! This Saturday is all about making you stronger through the mysterious power of Potential. Potential is a nifty system that allows you to add bonus effects to your equipment to make it truly heroic.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/73436475a02abe1e041461a910c5dcd3a479923c.jpg[/img]

Cube away with [b]Red Cubes[/b], [b]Black Cubes[/b], and [b]Bonus Potential Cubes[/b] during the Double Miracle Time event times with double the rates of a rank-up! If you’ve got [b]White Cubes[/b] and [b]Violet Cubes[/b], you can use them for double the rates of a rank-up as well. There’s a chance to raise your equipment's Potential rank TWICE with one cube! This means you could jump from Rare to Unique!

Make sure to earn those [b]Reward Points[/b] and visit the Maple Rewards Shop, located in the Special Promotions > Maple Rewards Shop category of the Cash Shop. You can get [b]Red Cubes[/b] and [b]Black Cubes[/b] with your points!

We’re also having the following special sales in non-Reboot worlds on [b]August 18[/b] only!
[list]
[*][b]Cube Adventurers' Packs[/b] (which contain 60 Red, Black or Bonus Potential Cubes, as well as 5 Philosopher's Book items, Violet Cubes, and a Golden Hammer 100% Coupon)
[*][b]Radiant Red Cube Pack, Brilliant Black Cube Pack,[/b] and [b]Dazzling Bonus Potential Cube Pack[/b] (which contain Red, Black or Bonus Potential Cubes, as well as a Unique Potential Scroll 30% Coupon)
[*][b]Red Cube and Black Cube Twelve Packs[/b] (which contain Red or Black Cubes and a Gold Potential Stamp Coupon)
[*][b]Gold and Silver Bonus Potential Packages[/b] (which contain Bonus Potential Cubes, Silver or Golden Bonus Potential Stamps, and a Special Bonus Potential Scroll)
[*]Discounted [b]11-packs of Red, Black and Bonus Potential Cubes[/b][/list]
We’re having the following special sale in Reboot world on [b]August 18[/b] only!
[list]
[*]Discounted single [b]Red and Black Cubes[/b]
[*]Discounted [b]6-packs of Red and Black Cubes[/b][/list]
[b]Note:[/b] We have raised the minimum level required to purchase cubes with NX Credit. You need to have a character Lv. 120 or above in order to purchase cubes with NX Credit. There is no such restriction for purchasing cubes with NX Prepaid.

Again, only the rank-up rates for [b]Red Cubes, Black Cubes, Bonus Potential Cubes, White Cubes,[/b] and [b]Violet Cubes[/b] are affected. The rank-up rates for Master Craftsman's Cubes and Meister's Cubes are not affected.

Please note that Double Miracle Time will be available on all worlds, including Reboot.
[list]
[*]A scrolling message and a Cube icon will appear at the top of the screen during Double Miracle Time.[/list]
