notes.title: Lab Server, Here for a Limited Time!
notes.content:
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, August 8, 2018 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, August 28, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Wednesday, August 8, 2018 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, August 28, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, August 8, 2018 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, August 29, 2018 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Thursday, August 9, 2018 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, August 29, 2018 9:59 AM[/b]

For a limited-time, you can play in [b]Lab world[/b] where you can experience different concepts and try out new systems! This is a hardcore game style where your character's level and stats reset after death.

To begin, select “Lab” as your world and create a character! You can create one (only one!) Explorer-class character, who will begin at Lv. 10 in Henesys. Speak with Job Instructor Dr. Bebe to choose your first job. Note that no medal is given upon job advancement. Advancing is reward enough!

As you explore Lab world, you will run into powerful monsters. All monsters have [b]twice as much HP[/b] and their stats are [b]five times stronger[/b] than on regular worlds.

If your character dies, they [b]revert to a Lv. 10 Beginner[/b], and Ability Points, Skill Points, Hit Points, and Mana Points will be reset. The character will respawn back in Henesys. Dying isn’t all bad though, as you will have a chance to receive a special skill!
[list]
[*][b]Please Stop Dying[/b]: Skill. Master Level 100. Monster Weapon DEF ignored when attacking (2+ skill level %), and Weapon ATT/Magic ATT increased (20 x skill level). This skill can be learned twice a day.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/76e13330ef328b02e053ee69a87bf3d497d00534.jpg[/img]

Potions have a 10-second cooldown applied to them, so you can’t escape death by spamming your potion button! However, the Enhancement Scroll count for all items is set high, at 255, so you’ll be able to enhance your items to their very best.

To help with all of this hunting and dying, we will also be running a [b]2x EXP & Drop event[/b] on Lab world for the entire duration! Power through your level-ups!

Note that gift boxes obtained on the Lab server will be deleted after the Lab server is closed, so think carefully about which items you want to claim! The Lab server selection button may also not appear upon first login. If this happens, select a NA server and go to the character select screen, then go back to the server menu. The button for Lab server should appear.

[b][u]Quests and Missions[/u][/b]

Complete some basic quests to gain easy rewards, including [b]Lab Server Coins[/b] which can be redeemed for useful items from the coin shop. Some rewards will not be granted until after the Lab server ends. You can also send rewards earned in the Lab server to characters in other worlds; select which world you’d like the rewards to be sent to by accessing the quest ‘[Lab Server] Please select a server to receive your reward.’

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b8ba49d57086dccdb6e89e6c2c8612e49faf172e.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b][Lab Server] A More Exciting MapleStory![/b]: Can be completed as soon as you log in, once per day. Be rewarded with:[list]
[*][b]3x EXP Coupon (x3)[/b]: Grants 3x EXP for 30 minutes. Can be used until [*][b]midnight of that day.
Lab Server Coin (x4)[/b][/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] The Dime a Dozen Quest[/b]: Hunt 500 monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above. Can be completed three times per day.[list]
[*]Complete 1st round and be rewarded with [b]Power Elixir (x5)[/b]
[*]Complete 2nd round before Lv. 200 and be rewarded with [b]Storm Growth Potion (1 Day) (x3)[/b]
[*]Complete 2nd round after Lv. 200 and be rewarded with [b]Lab Server Coin (x3)[/b]
[*]Complete 3rd round and be rewarded with [b]Lab Server Coin (x5)[/b][/list][/list]
There are also special missions for you to take on:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/0738eacecf34036ef637710ae1ed839137e60230.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Gotta Crush Crumbling Zakum![/b]: Available at Lv. 55. Hunt Easy Zakum 3 times and receive:[list]
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Strengthening Boost Potion (x4)[/b]. Increases Attack Power.[/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Gotta Crush Normal Zakum![/b]: Available at Lv. 95. Hunt Normal Zakum 3 times and receive:[list]
[b]Lab Server Coin (x30)[/b][/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Gotta Crush Normal Horntail![/b]: Available at Lv. 135. Hunt Normal Horntail 3 times and receive:[list]
[*][b]Mysterious Meso Pouch (x30).[/b][/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Gotta Crush Normal Pierre![/b]: Available at Lv. 130. Hunt Normal Pierre 3 times and receive:[list]
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Armor Supply Box (Advanced Player) (x20)[/b]. Open to receive an armor set specific to your class.[/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Gotta Crush Normal Von Bon![/b]: Available at Lv. 130. Hunt Normal Von Bon 3 times and receive:[list]
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Weapon Supply Box (Advanced Player) (x20)[/b]. Open to receive a weapon set specific to your class.[/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Gotta Crush Normal Crimson Queen![/b]: Available at Lv. 130. Hunt Normal Crimson Queen 3 times and receive:[list]
[*][b]Storm Growth Potion (7 Day) (x2)[/b][/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Gotta Crush Normal Vellum![/b]: Available at Lv. 130. Hunt Normal Vellum 3 times and receive:[list]
[*][b]Lab Server Coin (x40).[/b][/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] A Gift for 80 Successful Enhancements![/b]: Enhance equipment a total of 80 times and receive:[list]
[*][b]Eternal Rebirth Flame (1 Day)[/b]
[*][b]Lab Server Pioneer Medal[/b]: STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, MaxHP/MaxMP +500, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7. This item will be sent to the world you select, after the Lab server event ends.[/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/980b8b625d27b0f1cf1f8273d148d7b597f4b8a1.png[/img]

[b][u]Level-Up Rewards[/u][/b]

As you level up, you'll receive a quest that will grant you a reward for hitting each milestone:
[list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Lv. 30 Celebration Gift![/b]: Reach Lv. 30 and receive:[list]
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Strengthening Potion (x4)[/b]: Increases Attack Power.[/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Lv. 70 Celebration Gift![/b]: Reach Lv. 70 and receive:[list] 
[*][b]Mysterious Meso Pouch (x5)[/b][/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Lv. 85 Celebration Gift![/b]: Reach Lv. 85 and receive:[list] 
[*][b]Lab Server Coin (x20)[/b][/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Lv. 100 Celebration Gift![/b]: Reach Lv. 100 and receive:[list]
[*][b]Storm Growth Potion (7 Day) (x2)[/b][/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Lv. 120 Celebration Gift![/b]: Reach Lv. 120 and receive:[list]
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Armor Supply Box (Advanced Player) (x5)[/b]: Open to receive an armor set specific to your class.
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Weapon Supply Box (Advanced Player) (x5)[/b]: Open to receive a weapon set specific to your class.[/list]
[*][b][Lab Server] Lv. 150 Celebration Gift![/b]: Reach Lv. 150 and receive:[list]
[*][b]Legion Block[/b]: This item will be sent to the world you select, after the Lab server event ends. (See more details below.)
[*][b]Revive and Strengthen[/b]: Chair
[*][b]Eternal Rebirth Flame (1 Day)[/b][/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/658508e1acb5f7d8e0084b83e461ea71383a7e17.jpg[/img]

You can also take part in two additional quests that will become available after you've reached Lv. 150. After receiving the Lv. 150 rewards, your character must die and reset to Lv. 10. You'll then be granted access to two new quests. [b]You must accept these quests while still Lv. 10. If you level up at all, these quests will become inaccessible.[/b]
[list]
[*]Complete '[Lab Server] Level 200 Survivalist!':[list]
[*][b]Enhanced Legion Block[/b]: This item will be sent to the world you select, after the Lab server event ends. (See more details below.)
[*][b]Eternal Rebirth Flame (1 Day)[/b][/list]
[*]Complete '[Lab Server] Defeat Lab Server Von Leon with the Strange PT Bottle'[list]
[*][b]Lab Server Master Crown[/b]
[*][b]Eternal Flame Rebirth (1 Day) (x2)[/b][/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/a57103dbf532ee4eccd3513e7635bfb5f976006e.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Legion Blocks[/u][/b]

Receive Legion blocks to use in the Maple Legion with your characters from other worlds. These will be sent to the world you select, after the Lab server event ends.

[b]Legion Block Details:[/b]
[list]
[*]The level of the Legion Block is based off the maximum level your character reaches in Lab Server.[list]
[*]At Lv. 60: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5
[*]At Lv. 100: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10
[*]At Lv. 140: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +15
[*]At Lv. 150: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +20
[*]At Lv. 250: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +25[/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b49557b452aa84a1b82333e8abd622035e40386a.png[/img]

[b]Enhanced Legion Block Details:[/b]
[list]
[*]The level of the Enhanced Legion Block is based off the maximum level your character reaches in Lab Server.[list]
[*]At Lv. 60: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7
[*]At Lv. 100: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +14
[*]At Lv. 140: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +21
[*]At Lv. 150: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +28
[*]At Lv. 250: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +35[/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/bf382168f22ca849941a250282f537f1ea8fb99c.png[/img]

[b][u]Rewards from Hunting[/u][/b]

As you hunt monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above), [b]helpful boost potions and random boxes[/b] containing equipment will drop.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/faa8724a82fc7a891c4b5771d6573aa83af258d9.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Lab Server Coin[/b]
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Strengthening Boost Potion (1 Day)[/b]: Increases Attack Power.
[*][b]Mr. Saint’s Strengthening Boost Potion (Attack) (1 Day)[/b]: Increases Attack Power.
[*][b]Life Changer Box (3 Hours)[/b]: Open to receive one random item:[list]
[*][b]Mysterious Meso Pouch (x40)[/b]
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Strengthening Boost Potion (x30)[/b]
[*][b]Lab Server Coin (x30)[/b]
[*][b]Lab Server Limitless Power Elixir (5 Day)[/b][/list]
[*][b]Dr. Bebe’s Mysterious Box (1 Day)[/b]: Open to receive one random item:[list]
[*][b]Life Changer Box (1 Day)[/b]: You can only receive one per day. Open to receive one random item:[list]
[*][b]Mysterious Meso Pouch (x40)[/b]
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Strengthening Boost Potion (x30)[/b]
[*][b]Lab Server Coin (x30)[/b]
[*][b]Lab Server Limitless Power Elixir (5 Day)[/b][/list]
[*][b]Mr. Saint's Strengthening Boost Potion (HP) (1 Day)[/b]: Increases MaxHP/MaxMP.
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Weapon Supply Box (New Player)[/b]: Open to receive a weapon set specific to your class.
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Weapon Supply Box (Advanced Player)[/b]: Open to receive a weapon set specific to your class.
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Armor Supply Box (New Player)[/b]: Open to receive an armor set specific to your class.
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Armor Supply Box (Advanced Player)[/b]: Open to receive an armor set specific to your class.
[*][b]Eternal Rebirth Flame (1 Day)[/b]
[*][b]Powerful Rebirth Flame (1 Day)[/b]
[*][b]Special Medal of Honor (1 Day)[/b]
[*][b]Gold Potential Stamp (1 Day)[/b]
[*][b]Special Bonus Potential Stamp (1 Day)[/b]
[*][b]Mysterious Meso Pouch (x3)[/b]
[*][b]Mastery Book 20[/b]
[*][b]Mastery Book 30[/b]
[*][b]Spell Trace (x100)[/b]
[*][b]Power Elixir (x2)[/b]
[*][b]Reindeer Milk (x10)[/b]
[*][b]Sunrise Dew (x10)[/b][/list][/list]
[b][u]Lab Server Coin Shop[/u][/b]

Collect Lab Server Coins and then visit the coin shop in Henesys to stock up on helpful items! Here are some of the items available for purchase:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/28499d5206cbc6e90a12980f421f1d407be4f66d.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Spell Trace (x1,000)[/b] - Costs 10,000 mesos
[*][b]Special Medal of Honor[/b] - Costs 10,000 mesos
[*][b]Gold Potential Stamp[/b] - Costs 10,000 mesos
[*][b]Special Bonus Potential Stamp[/b] - Costs 10,000 mesos
[*][b]Nodestone (x10)[/b] - Costs 1 Lab Server Coin
[*][b]Eternal Rebirth Flame x3 Coupon[/b] - Costs 1 Lab Server Coin
[*][b]Occult Cube (x10)[/b] - Costs 2 Lab Server Coins
[*][b]Special Bonus Potential Scroll[/b] - Costs 2 Lab Server Coins
[*][b]Mysterious Meso Pouch[/b] - Costs 4 Lab Server Coins
[*][b]Spell Trace (x100)[/b] - Costs 1 Lab Server Coin
[*][b]Selective 8 Slot Coupon[/b] - Costs 2 Lab Server Coins
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Weapon Supply Box (New Player)[/b] - Costs 2 Lab Server Coins
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Weapon Supply Box (Advanced Player)[/b] - Costs 2 Lab Server Coins
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Armor Supply Box (New Player)[/b] - Costs 2 Lab Server Coins
[*][b]Dr. Bebe Armor Supply Box (Advanced Player)[/b] - Costs 2 Lab Server Coins[/list]

[b][u]Important Info[/u][/b]

While the Cash Shop is present, some items are unavailable: Maple Point Coupon, Safety Charm, Safety Gem, Respawn Token, Respawn Pass, Extra Character Slot Coupon, Leveling Packages, and Buff Freezer. All NX used in the Lab Cash Shop will be refunded to the player as Maple Points (MP) after the end of the event. MP will be refunded to only one region (NA or EU) of the player's choice. All MP used in the Lab Cash Shop will not be returned to the player. All Maple Reward Points used in the Lab Cash Shop will not be returned to the player.

Please be aware that all reward boxes will also be available in Lab server. Since reward boxes can only be claimed once per account, please be sure to claim your reward boxes on your desired server.

notes.title: Sunny Sugar Time Weekend Events
notes.content:
[b][u]2x EXP & Drop Event[/u][/b]

As compensation for last weekend's Sunny Sunday Star Force perk issue, we're running a special event on Saturday. Level up with [b]2x EXP & Drop[/b]!

This event will stack with 2x EXP Coupons and 2x Drop Coupons, so you could earn 4x EXP and 4x Drop during the posted times!
[list]
[*]Keep an eye on the top of your screen for the scrolling 2x EXP & Drop announcement or the left side of your screen for the 2x EXP & Drop icon.
[*]This event is available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds.[/list]
[b]Time:

Saturday, August 4, 2018
[list]
[*]PDT: 1:00 AM – 4:00 AM & 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM & 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM
[*]EDT: 4:00 AM – 7:00 AM & 2:00 PM – 5:00 PM & 10:00 PM – 1:00 AM (August 5)
[*]CEST: 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM & 8:00 PM – 11:00 PM & 4:00 AM – 7:00 AM (August 5)
[*]AEST: 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM & 4:00 AM – 7:00 AM (August 5) & 12:00 PM – 3:00 PM (August 5)[/list][/b]
[b][u]New Maple Leaf Sugar Time[/u]

PDT (UTC -7): Saturday, August 3, 2018 5:00 PM – Sunday, August 4, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT(UTC -4): Saturday, August 3, 2018 8:00 PM – Sunday, August 4, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Sunday, August 4, 2018 2:00 AM – Monday, August 5, 2018 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Sunday, August 4, 2018 10:00 AM – Monday, August 5, 2018 9:59 AM[/b]

Earn special rewards when you log in to the game on Saturday (UTC)! Players Lv. 33 and above can participate by staying logged in from 30 minutes to 2 hours. As you hit each 30-minute-milestone, you will receive rewards. You can check your time and claim your reward by clicking on the gift event icon on the left side of the screen.

Once you have received all four rewards, you can start again! You can repeat the entire event 5 times per day per account. The total time is shared across the account.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/1d6caec81b811b58871ba614be634917eb8c83c3.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Stay logged in 30 minutes and receive:
[list][*][b]Ark Coin (x10)[/b]: Untradeable.[/list]
[*]Stay logged in 60 minutes and receive:
[list][*][b]Ark Coin (x10)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*][b]2x EXP Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration. Use to receive 2x EXP for 15 minutes.
[*]The first time you complete this, you'll receive: [b]New Maple Leaf Pet Box[/b] (tradeable within characters in same world).
[*]The second time you complete this, you'll receive: [b]New Maple Leaf Beauty Box[/b] (tradeable within characters in same world).
[*]The third time you complete this, you'll receive: [b]New Maple Leaf Rare Item Box[/b] (tradeable within characters in same world).
[*]The fourth time you complete this, you'll receive: [b]New Maple Leaf Money Box[/b] (tradeable within characters in same world).
[*]The fifth time you complete this, you'll receive: [b]New Maple Leaf Assorted Box[/b] (tradeable within characters in same world).
[*]These boxes each have one guaranteed prize and a bunch of other prizes you have a random chance to get. The boxes are all tradeable within the account.[/list]
[*]Stay logged in 90 minutes and receive:
[list][*][b]Ark Coin (x10)[/b]: Untradeable.[/list]
[*]Stay logged in 120 minutes and receive:
[list][*][b]2x EXP Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration. Use to receive 2x EXP for 15 minutes.
[*][b]New Maple Leaf Sugar Coin Box[/b]: Untradeable. Can be opened anytime before [b]6:00 PM PDT August 4 / 9:00 PM EDT August 4 / 3:00 AM CEST August 5 / 11:00 AM AEST August 5[/b]. Earn various amount of Ark Coins depending on the number of times you have opened this box.
[list][*]1st Time: [b]Ark Coins (x10)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*]2nd Time: [b]Ark Coins (x15)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*]3rd Time: [b]Ark Coins (x20)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*]4th Time: [b]Ark Coins (x25)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*]5th Time: [b]Ark Coins (x30)[/b]: Untradeable.[/list]

[list][*][b]500 Maple Reward Points[/b]

[b]New Maple Leaf Box Rewards[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]New Maple Leaf Pet Box[/b]: Open to receive:
[list][*][b]Golden Pup Pet Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 3-day duration. Use to receive a 90-day [b]Golden Pup[/b] pet.
[*][b]Golden Pup Pet Equipment Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 3-day duration. Use to receive [b]Golden Pup Pet Equipment[/b].

[list][*][b]Premium Water of Life x3 Coupon[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration. Use to receive three [b]Premium Water of Life[/b] items.

[*][b]Shark Tank Pet Coupon[/b]: Use to receive a 90-day [b]Shark[/b] pet.
[*][b]Triple Angel Pets Full Package[/b]: Use to receive 90-day [b]Honey Angel[/b], [b]Lime Angel[/b], and [b]Peach Angel[/b] pets.
[*][b]Triple Roo-bot Pets Full Package[/b]: Use to receive 90-day [b]Roo-A[/b], [b]Roo-B[/b], and [b]Roo-C[/b] pets.
[*][b]Triple Root Abyss Pets Full Package[/b]: Use to receive 90-day [b]Crimson Queen[/b], [b]Von Bon[/b], and [b]Pierre[/b] pets.
[*][b]Permanent Triple Lucid Pets Full Package[/b]: Use to receive permanent [b]Ebony Lucid[/b], [b]Powder Lucid[/b], and [b]Rose Lucid[/b] pets.[/list][/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/09cec7e2944e4de7d37021be98ca238a8a035333.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]New Maple Leaf Beauty Box[/b]: Open to receive:
[list][*][b]Royal Face Coupon[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*][b]Royal Hair Coupon[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*]You also have a chance to receive the additional items:
[list][*][b]Hair Color Coupon (VIP)[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*][b]Skin Coupon[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*][b]Vivacious Wavy Hair Coupon (F)[/b]
[*][b]Lucid Hair Coupon (M)[/b]
[*][b]Lucid Hair Coupon (F)[/b]
[*][b]Cool School Trim Coupon (M)[/b]
[*][b]School Girl Pigtails Coupon (F)[/b]
[*][b]Dragon Master Hair Coupon (M)[/b]
[*][b]Side Ponytail Hair Coupon (F)[/b]
[*][b]White Mage Hair Coupon (M)[/b]
[*][b]Lady Blair Hair Coupon (F)[/b]

[list][*][b]Victory Rider Hair Coupon (M)[/b]
[*][b]Star Rider Hair Coupon (F)[/b][/list][/list][/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4267b8d4423d3f334bf7d6ffd118dc7dbc3bb606.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]New Maple Leaf Rare Item Box[/b]: Open to receive:
[list][*][b]Ark Coin (x100)[/b]: Untradeable

[*][b]Scuba Diving Chair[/b]

[*][b]Ostentation Chair[/b][/list]
[*][b]Nodestone x100[/b]
[*][b]Ancient Guardian Chair[/b]
[*][b]Unique Potential Scroll 100%[/b]
[*][b]Sun Chair[/b]
[*][b]Lucidroid[/b]: Untradeable after equipped.
[*][b]Legendary Dominator Pendant Coupon[/b]
[*][b]Flame Bird Mount Coupon (Permanent)[/b]
[*][b]Magnificent Damien Soul[/b]
[*][b]100% 20-Star Enhancement  (Lv. 160)[/b]
[*][b]Legendary AbsoLab Equipment Full Package[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration. Open to receive:
[list][*][b]Legendary AbsoLab Weapon Box[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*][b]Legendary AbsoLab Hat Box[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*][b]Legendary AbsoLab Outfit Box[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*][b]Legendary AbsoLab Shoes Box[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*][b]Legendary AbsoLab Gloves Box[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*][b]Legendary AbsoLab Cape Box[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*][b]Legendary AbsoLab Shoulder Accessory Box[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.[/list][/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/7d8fec18a8ec6b9b096abcecee03b00b6d92464a.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/37987f28e36bfc9dbdff62c6fe9f51b62efc242b.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/9bd2eec87315036962e35ebf52adea40e06eb18a.png[/img]

[*][b]New Maple Leaf Money Box[/b]: Open to receive:
[list][*][b]500 Reward Points[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.

[list][*][b]3,000 Maple Point Coupon[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*][b]Gaga Coin (x3)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*][b]30,000 Maple Point Coupon[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*][b]Gaga Coin (x5)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*][b]50,000 Maple Point Coupon[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.
[*][b]Inkwell Coin (x5)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*][b]100,000 Maple Point Coupon[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.

[*][b]1 Million Maple Point Coupon[/b]: Untradeable. 3-day duration.[/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e29371736ecf88076c4effe6289ba492c0935298.png[/img]

[*][b]New Maple Leaf Assorted Box[/b]: Open to receive:
[list][*][b]Ark Coin (x100)[/b]: Untradeable
[*]You also have a chance to receive the additional items:
[list][*][b]Any of the rewards[/b] from the Pet, Beauty, Rare, and Money Boxes[/list][/list]

[b][u]Sunny Sunday[/u]

PDT (UTC -7): Saturday, August 4, 2018 5:00 PM – Sunday, August 5, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT(UTC -4): Saturday, August 4, 2018 8:00 PM – Sunday, August 5, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Sunday, August 5, 2018 2:00 AM – Monday, August 6, 2018 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Sunday, August 5, 2018 10:00 AM – Monday, August 6, 2018 9:59 AM[/b]

Join us on Sunday (UTC) for some special perks! All day long, you can enjoy the following benefits:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/2fb8eb0a8b446425660f4d096f38705cebb857e3.png[/img]

[list]

Make sure to log in and take advantage of these perks!

notes.title: Meet the Challenge of Maple Missions!
notes.content:
Earn rewards for your playtime! 

[b]PDT (UTC -7): Thursday, August 2, 2018 11:00 AM – Tuesday, August 28, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Thursday, August 2, 2018 2:00 PM – Tuesday, August 28, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Thursday, August 2, 2018 8:00 PM – Wednesday, August 29, 2018 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Friday, August 3, 2018 4:00 AM – Wednesday, August 29, 2018 9:59 AM[/b]

With [b]Maple Missions[/b], you are tasked with completing special missions in-game. Visit the [url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/game/mission]Maple Missions page[/url] to view the missions and track your progress. Finish each mission to receive prizes, and complete all the missions in a row or column for extra rewards! Perfect your mission mastery by completing all 9 numbered missions and all extra missions to receive a grand prize.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/9caa3812eb80867a18e3b070038c6347509b3c09.jpg[/img]

We’re celebrating the [b]Ark: Monad[/b] update with missions featuring Monad, Lab Server, events, and more. You can only complete each mission once per account, and it must be completed during the event period in order to receive a reward. Mission progress is updated on the website at [b]12:00 AM, 8:00 AM, and 4:00 PM UTC[/b] each day. When a mission is marked “complete”, jump in-game to pick up the prize that’s waiting for you!

[b][u]Regular Missions[/u][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/aa253c465bac32544d7566cd94de29e7c0f3c7ae.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b][Captain Vaga][/b] Reach ‘Enforcer’ Rank: Play through the Captain Vaga content, earning promotion points, EXP, and credits! Earn enough points to be promoted to the 'Enforcer' rank.
[list][*][b]Buff Freezer (x5)[/b]: Untradeable, 14-day duration.[/list]
[*][b][Discovery Arena][/b] Complete 3 Missions: Join the Discovery Arena event, and register a character to participate in battles. Complete 3 missions.
[list][*][b]Onyx Apple (x5)[/b]: Untradeable, 30-day duration.[/list]
[*][b][Mega Burning][/b] Reach Lv. 100 With New Character: Create a new character during the Mega Burning event, and give it the ‘Burning’ effect. After you reach Lv. 10, every time that character levels up they will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 149!
[list][*][b]Miracle Circulator[/b]: Untradeable, 14-day duration.[/list]
[*][b][Ark Hot Week 3][/b] Receive All Monday-Sunday Rewards: Log in each day during Ark Hot Week 3 to receive each day’s gift box of rewards!
[list][*][b]2x EXP Coupon 1-hour (x3)[/b]: Can be traded within account, 7-day duration.[/list]
[*][b][Monad][/b] Clear Acts 1 & 2: Play through the Monad content, which is divided into multiple Acts. Experience the conflicts between different characters as they try to gain the Transcendent power of truth, and complete Acts 1 & 2.
[list][*][b]Trait Boost Potion[/b]: Can be traded within account, 7-day duration.[/list]
[*][b][Monad][/b] Complete ‘This Week's Boss: Julieta Weekly Mission All Clear!’: Check out the Monad Mission Board and complete the weekly mission! Finish all the Boss Julieta missions for the week.
[list][*][b]Arcane Symbol Selector Coupon (x5)[/b]: Can be traded within account, 14-day duration.[/list]
[*][b][Discovery Desert][/b] Rank in the Top 20: Join the Discovery Desert event, and participate in a huge Bingo game. Rank within the top 20 players when the game ends!
[list][*][b]Arcane Symbol Selector Coupon (x2)[/b]: Can be traded within account, 14-day duration.[/list]
[*][b][Monster Park][/b] Complete Twice: Challenge yourself to Monster Park, and play through it completely two times!
[list][*][b]2x Drop Coupon 1-hour (x3)[/b]: Can be traded within account, 7-day duration.[/list]
[*][b][Discovery Life][/b] Grow Parrot to Lv. 10: Join the Discovery Life event, and receive the ‘Summon Parrot’ skill. Hunt monsters to find colorful fruit. Feed the fruit to your parrot to level it up to Lv. 10.
[list][*][b]Master Craftsman’s Cube[/b]: Can be traded within account, 7-day duration.[/list][/list]

[b][u]Extra Missions[/u][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/9af5b12ce6fe28abaaa18cd05b156b8aedc0c88d.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b]Complete Missions:[/b]
[list][*][Captain Vaga] Reach ‘Enforcer’ Rank
[*][Discovery Arena] Complete 3 Missions
[*][Mega Burning] Reach Lv. 100 With New Character
[list][*][b]Nodestone (x20)[/b]: Can be traded within account.[/list][/list]
[*][b]Complete Missions:[/b]
[list][*][Ark Hot Week 3] Receive All Monday-Sunday Rewards
[*][Monad] Clear Acts 1 & 2
[*][Monad] Complete ‘This Week's Boss: Julieta Weekly Mission All Clear!’
[list][*][b]Bonus Potential Cube (x2)[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list][/list]
[*][b]Complete Missions:[/b]
[list][*][Discovery Desert] Rank in the Top 20
[*][Monster Park] Complete Twice
[*][Discovery Life] Grow Parrot to Lv. 10
[list][*][b]Black Cube[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list][/list]
[*][b]Complete Missions:[/b]
[list][*][Captain Vaga] Reach ‘Enforcer’ Rank
[*][Ark Hot Week 3] Receive All Monday-Sunday Rewards
[*][Discovery Desert] Rank in the Top 20
[list][*][b]1,000 Maple Reward Points[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list][/list]
[*][b]Complete Missions:[/b]
[list][*][Discovery Arena] Complete 3 Missions
[*][Monad] Clear Acts 1 & 2
[*][Monster Park] Complete Twice
[list][*][b]Eternal Rebirth Flame (x5)[/b]: Can be traded within account, 14-day duration.[/list][/list]
[*][b]Complete Missions:[/b]
[list][*][Mega Burning] Reach Lv. 100 With New Character
[*][Monad] Complete ‘This Week's Boss: Julieta Weekly Mission All Clear!’
[*][Discovery Life] Grow Parrot to Lv. 10
[list][*][b]2,000 Maple Reward Points[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list][/list]
[*][b]Complete All Missions:[/b]
[list][*]Complete all 9 numbered missions and all extra missions in this event!
[list][*][b]Unique Potential Scroll 100%[/b]: Can be traded within account, 7-day duration.[/list][/list][/list]

Click the gift-box notifier on the left-side of the game window to collect your items. You may need to log out and log back in for the rewards to appear. If you have more than 30 unclaimed gifts, you may not be able to see the rewards. Please clear any unclaimed gifts and login again to see the rewards. Only one character per account may receive these items, so be sure you are on the character you want to receive these items. Rewards must be claimed in-game by [b]September 29 at 11:59 UTC[/b].

notes.title: Level Up With the Mega Burning Project!
notes.content:
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, July 31, 2018 5:00 PM – Tuesday, August 14, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, July 31, 2018 8:00 PM – Tuesday, August 14, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, August 1, 2018 2:00 AM – Wednesday, August 15, 2018 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, August 1, 2018 10:00 AM – Wednesday, August 15, 2018 9:59 AM[/b]

Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.

The [b]Mega Burning Project[/b] returns, ready to help you level a brand-new character up to Lv. 150!

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 150! This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, except for Ark and Zero characters.

[b][u]Here’s How it Works[/u][/b]

Create a brand-new character during the event period. From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/658fa7b66b3892196b4c4e336e62c637d4d7b7d2.jpg[/img]

Only one character on your account can have the "Burning" effect. Log in with your character and select the quest '[Ark] 1+2 Level Up! Mega Burning Project' from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. You will receive the following special gifts!

[b][u]Rewards[/u][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/19800f227c7f00c3444653254fbdb0e29a2f064e.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Lv. 30 Equipment Box[/b]: Untradeable. Can only be opened at Lv. 30. Open to receive a weapon and armor set suitable for your class.
[*][b]Mysterious Cryptic Gift Box[/b]: Untradeable. 7-day duration. Open to receive:[list]
[*][b]Snail[/b]: 5-hour Duration. Skills: Meso Magnet, Item Pouch. Cannot be moved to Cash Inventory. Cannot be revived with the Water of Life.[/list]
[*][b]Legendary Cryptic Chest[/b]: Untradeable. Can only be opened at Lv. 100. Open to receive:[list]
[*][b]Frozen Hat[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +23 MaxHP/MaxMP +270, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +293. Upgrades available: 10.
[*][b]Frozen Cape[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7, Defense +180, Speed +9, Jump +5. Upgrades available: 7.
[*][b]Frozen Suit[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +27, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +315. Upgrades available: 10.
[*][b]Frozen Weapon Box[/b]: Untradeable. 7-day duration. Open to receive:[list] 
[*][b]Frozen Weapon[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. Stats will vary based upon your job.[/list]
[*][b]Frozen Secondary Weapon Box[/b]: Untradeable. 7-day duration. Open to receive:[list]
[*][b]Frozen Secondary Weapon[/b]: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. Stats will vary based upon your job.[/list]
[*][b]Mastery Book 20 (x2)[/b]: Untradeable.
[*][b]Mastery Book 30 (x2)[/b]: Untradeable.[/list]
[*][b]Keep on Burning Title Coupon[/b]: Untradeable. Can only be used at Lv. 130. Use to receive:[list]
[*][b]Keep on Burning[/b]: Title. Untradeable. 14-day duration on stats. Req. Lv: 130. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +10, MaxHP/MaxMP +400, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10, Boss Damage +10%, Ignore DEF +10%.[/list][/list]
Each time your character levels up, they will receive two additional levels! Work your way up to Lv. 150, so you can wear those sweet equips!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/19619f0bdf4d643c5f8ced3bc420d7ce6d26c8fa.jpg[/img]

notes.title: MapleStory M Crossover Events
notes.content:
MapleStory is officially going mobile this week, and to celebrate we’re giving out special rewards to players who link up their PC accounts with [b][url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nexon.maplem.global&referrer=adjust_reftag%3DcqOumC0CKN3ss%26utm_source%3DNxA_Website%26utm_campaign%3DMapleStoryDotCom%26utm_content%3DMS1_Web_Post]MapleStory M[/url][/b]! Take your character on the go and earn exclusive gifts for your PC account by participating in these daily mobile missions and events. These daily missions will run every day until we give further notice, so get out there and start racking up rewards!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/bf8495343d490fee9e7f96def8f232b7c83caebe.png[/img]

[b][u]How to Link Your Account[/u][/b]

Players who are Lv. 150 or above in MapleStory can link their account to MapleStory M by inputting a special UserKey. Here's how to obtain your UserKey:
[list]
[*]Go to the Event Hall and speak to the Maple Administrator.
[*]Select "Talk to a Maple Admin."
[*]In your conversation, select "Check Maple M Link String" and she will provide the UserKey. 
[*]The issued UserKey from MapleStory must match with the MapleStory M account exactly in order to be used.
[*]Even if a player has several Nexon account IDs, the rewards will only be given once to the account that registered the UserKey.
[*]Rewards can't be received while MapleStory is undergoing maintenance.
[/list]
[b][u]Daily Mission Event[/u]

Event Start:

PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, July 24, 2018 7:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, July 24, 2018 10:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, July 25, 2018 4:00 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, July 25, 2018 12:00 PM[/b]

Once you've inputted your UserKey into MapleStory M, you will start receiving Daily Missions. When you complete a Daily Mission, you will receive Reward Points in the original MapleStory. notes.title: More Discovery Events!
notes.content:
[b][u]Discovery Arena[/u]

PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, July 25 (after maintenance) - 4:59 PM Tuesday, August 7
EDT (UTC -4): Wednesday, July 25 (after maintenance) - 7:59 PM Tuesday, August 7
CEST (UTC +2): Thursday, July 26 (after maintenance) - 1:59 AM Wednesday, August 8
AEST (UTC +10): Thursday, July 26 (after maintenance) - 9:59 AM Wednesday, August 8[/b]

The time has come to show off your battle skills in our special [b]Discovery Arena event[/b]! Characters Lv. 33 and up will be qualified to participate in a special 5v5, PvE arena match, so get in there and start earning [b]Arena Points[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d38ecb6f10754c27ece87cd6495b63b15e9ff9bf.png[/img]

You can register for a battle by going to the Discovery Arena. To get there, complete the "[Discovery] Discovery Arena" quest from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen, then open the Discovery UI and move to the Discovery Arena map. Once in the waiting area, speak with the NPC Cynapse. From there, you can participate in battles, register your combat power with your current power, learn about the battle details, and view the rankings. 

Once you select "Matching," you'll be matched up with 4 other characters from your account based on your battle rank (you can register characters while participating in the battle). You can view limited information about your teammates' stats, and decide whether to battle or request a rematch. Winning will earn you [b]Arena Points[/b], which will increase your overall battle rank (battle ranks reset every week). 

Once the battle starts, your team will be placed in a stronghold with walls and turrets to help you during the fight. Walls have high HP and will block your opponents path, while turrets will attack your opponent and alert you to their position. There are two types of turrets:
[list]
[*][b]Bombarding Turrets[/b]: Detects players' positions and launches vertical attacks that can reach anywhere on the map
[*][b]Laser Turrets[/b]: Placed in a fixed location and launches horizontal attacks at specific areas to the left and right of the turret.
[/list]
If you can defeat all the enemies on the other team, you win the match! You'll receive [b]Ark Points[/b] as well as Arena Points as a reward, and your battle rank will go up. If your character is killed, you leave the match, or the client is closed, then you lose the match. Your battle rank will go down, but stronghold enhancements will remain the same. 

After the event ends, the rankings will be finalized and you’ll receive the following rewards based on your final ranking:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e8f75706a581f33d195dcaf45606afe90212e668.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Top 1%[list]
[*][b]Invincible Katara Voucher[/b] (can be used to obtain an Invincible Katara)
[*][b]Red Circuit Damage Skin[/b]
[*][b]Discovery Arena Red Title[/b]
[*][b]Arena Boundary Stone Chair[/b][/list]
[*]Top 2%-10%[list]
[*][b]Red Circuit Damage Skin[/b]
[*][b]Discovery Arena Red Title[/b]
[*][b]Arena Boundary Stone Chair[/b][/list]
[*]Top 11%~20%[list]
[*][b]Red Circuit Damage Skin[/b]
[*][b]Discovery Arena Blue Title[/b][/list]
[*]Top 21%~30%[list]
[*][b]Red Circuit Damage Skin[/b]
[*][b]Discovery Arena Yellow Title[/b][/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/a04966fa48787733b2f80d28b8a3819664b46655.png[/img]

[b]Daily Reward:[/b]

If you participate in Discovery Arena battles for 15+ minutes each day, you'll obtain [b]Arena Points[/b] based on how you ranked during your matches! Arena Points can be exchanged for [b]1 Ark Point Each[/b], and each character can exchange up to 10,000 Arena Points per day.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b525a9bab8f3724f279f69b4bb48b3fa3c23b6fc.png[/img]

[b][u]Discovery Life[/u]

PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, July 25 (after maintenance) - 4:59 PM Tuesday, August 7
EDT (UTC -4): Wednesday, July 25 (after maintenance) - 7:59 PM Tuesday, August 7
CEST (UTC +2): Thursday, July 26 (after maintenance) - 1:59 AM Wednesday, August 8
AEST (UTC +10): Thursday, July 26 (after maintenance) - 9:59 AM Wednesday, August 8[/b]

Once this event starts, your character will be given the [b]Summon Parrot[/b] skill! You can then summon a parrot that you can feed with [b]Colorful Fruit[/b] that drops when you hunt monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above). In exchange for picking up the Colorful Fruit, it will give you [b]Discovery Points[/b], which can be exchanged for [b]Ark Coins[/b]! (Each color of fruit gives the same amount of Discovery Points).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e14d9d4b2192ac2f36ddfc9a66c0678688dc6fa8.png[/img]

The parrot will grow from stage 1 to 10 as you fight monsters and feed it fruit, and its skills will increase with each stage. Once it hits stage 10, its body color will change depending on which color fruit you've been feeding it! You can use the parrot for an additional [b]two weeks[/b] after the event is over.

Here's how the parrot's stats grow with each stage:
[list]
[*]Level 1: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +2, Damage Against Normal Monsters +2%, Monster DEF Ignored 2%, Boss Damage +2%, Critical Rate +2%
[*]Level 2: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +4, Damage Against Normal Monsters +4%, Monster DEF Ignored 4%, Boss Damage +4%, Critical Rate +4%
[*]Level 3: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +6, Damage Against Normal Monsters +6%, Monster DEF Ignored 6%, Boss Damage +6%, Critical Rate +6%
[*]Level 4: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +8, Damage Against Normal Monsters +8%, Monster DEF Ignored 8%, Boss Damage +8%, Critical Rate +8%
[*]Level 5: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10, Damage Against Normal Monsters +10%, Monster DEF Ignored 10%, Boss Damage +10%, Critical Rate +10%
[*]Level 6: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +12, Damage Against Normal Monsters +12%, Monster DEF Ignored 12%, Boss Damage +12%, Critical Rate +12%
[*]Level 7: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +14, Damage Against Normal Monsters +14%, Monster DEF Ignored 14%, Boss Damage +14%, Critical Rate +14%
[*]Level 8: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +16, Damage Against Normal Monsters +16%, Monster DEF Ignored 16%, Boss Damage +16%, Critical Rate +16%
[*]Level 9: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +18, Damage Against Normal Monsters +18%, Monster DEF Ignored 18%, Boss Damage +18%, Critical Rate +18%
[*]Level 10: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +20, Damage Against Normal Monsters +20%, Monster DEF Ignored 20%, Boss Damage +20%, Critical Rate +20%
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/6faf13b58d1d7e5d96ca9117d1edf2f628d161c6.png[/img]

[b][u]Discovery Glacier[/u]

PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, July 25 (after maintenance) - 4:59 PM Tuesday, July 31
EDT (UTC -4): Wednesday, July 25 (after maintenance) - 7:59 PM Tuesday, July 31
CEST (UTC +2): Thursday, July 26 (after maintenance) - 1:59 AM Wednesday, August 1
AEST (UTC +10): Thursday, July 26 (after maintenance) - 9:59 AM Wednesday, August 1[/b]

Players with characters Lv. 33 and above can partake in a quiz for [b]Ark Points[/b]! The more questions you answer correctly, the more Ark Points you'll win!

During the event, a "Discovery Glacier" invitation will appear above your head at the 15th and 45th of minute of every hour. Accept this invitation to enter a game of OX quiz. Statements will appear at the top of the screen, and if you think the statement is true, move into the O zone. If you think the statement is false, move into the X zone. Make sure you move into one zone or the other because sitting in the middle will always get you a wrong answer. There are a total of 20 questions, but you only get to proceed to the next question by getting each one correct. The more answers you get correct, the more [b]Ark Points[/b] you will get. If you miss a question early, you are free to leave, but if you stay until everybody is done, you will receive a bonus of [b]500 Ark Points[/b]. You will not be sent an invite if you have already hit your 20,000 Ark Point limit for the day.

Here are the rewards for answering each question right:
[list]
[*]0 Correct Answers: [b]0 Ark Points[/b]
[*]1 Correct Answer: [b]100 Ark Points[/b]
[*]2 Correct Answers: [b]200 Ark Points[/b]
[*]3 Correct Answers:[b]300 Ark Points[/b]
[*]4 Correct Answers: [b]400 Ark Points[/b]
[*]5 Correct Answers: [b]500 Ark Points[/b]
[*]6 Correct Answers: [b]600 Ark Points[/b]
[*]7 Correct Answers: [b]700 Ark Points[/b]
[*]8 Correct Answers: [b]800 Ark Points[/b]
[*]9 Correct Answers: [b]900 Ark Points[/b]
[*]10 Correct Answers: [b]1,000 Ark Points[/b]
[*]11 Correct Answers: [b]1,200 Ark Points[/b]
[*]12 Correct Answers: [b]1,400 Ark Points[/b]
[*]13 Correct Answers: [b]1,600 Ark Points[/b]
[*]14 Correct Answers: [b]1,800 Ark Points[/b]
[*]15 Correct Answers: [b]2,000 Ark Points[/b]
[*]16 Correct Answers: [b]2,200 Ark Points[/b]
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e589fe385c75733691f34ca00d8f9de61e695178.png[/img]

[b][u]Discovery Desert[/u]

PDT (UTC -7): 5:00 PM Tuesday, July 31 - 4:59 PM Tuesday, August 7
EDT (UTC -4): 8:00 PM Tuesday, July 31 - 7:59 PM Tuesday, August 7
CEST (UTC +2): 2:00 AM Wednesday, August 1 - 1:59 AM Wednesday, August 8
AEST (UTC +10): 10:00 AM Wednesday, August 1 - 9:59 AM Wednesday, August 8[/b]

For a limited time, players with characters Lv. 33 and up can participate in a special game of [b]70-player Bingo[/b]! Invitations for the game will be sent out every 30 minutes at the 15-min and 45-min marks of each hour. Each game must have a minimum of 10 players, and has a maximum of 70 people. Complete the game by clicking the numbers on your bingo board when Kemdi calls it out. The round ends when 30 players have completed bingo, and each game lasts for three rounds. Each player who participates in the game will be rewarded with [b]Ark Points[/b]! (There is a daily limit of winning 20,000 Ark Points; after that, you will not receive any more invitations).

Here are the prizes for playing:
[list]
[*]1st Place: [b]3,000 Ark Points[/b]
[*]2nd-5th Place: [b]2,000 Ark Points[/b]
[*]6th-10th Place: [b]1,000 Ark Points[/b]
[*]11th-20th Place: [b]800 Ark Points[/b]
[*]21st-30th Place: [b]600 Ark Points[/b]
[*]Below 30th Place: [b]300 Ark Points[/b]
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/66d275eeada95ee55d5afa8edacde083c3a1ccdb.png[/img]

[b][u]Discovery Dome[/u]

PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, July 25 (after maintenance) - 4:59 PM Tuesday, August 7
EDT (UTC -4): Wednesday, July 25 (after maintenance) - 7:59 PM Tuesday, August 7
CEST (UTC +2): Thursday, July 26 (after maintenance) - 1:59 AM Wednesday, August 8
AEST (UTC +10): Thursday, July 26 (after maintenance) - 9:59 AM Wednesday, August 8[/b]

Players with characters Lv. 100 and up can take part in a special [b]monster hunt[/b]! To participate, go to the Discovery Dome waiting map and enter the battleground map. There, you can use Ark Coins to summon monsters and hunt them! Summoned monsters will be bound to each character, and can't be hunted by any other player. Destroying summoned monsters will grant you [b]+120% EXP[/b] compared to normal monsters!

For [b]10 Ark Coins[/b], you can summon [b]500 monsters[/b]. Here are the daily limits for summoning monsters based on your level (there cannot be more than 2,500 summoned monsters at one time):

Note that if you don't have permission to enter the respective regions of Vanishing Journey, Chu Chu Island, Lachelein, Arcana, or Morass, you cannot summon monsters from that region.

If you participate in Discovery Arena battles for 15+ minutes each day, you'll obtain [b]Arena Points[/b] based on how you ranked during your matches! Arena Points can be exchanged for [b]1 Ark Point Each[/b], and each character can exchange up to 10,000 Arena Points per day.

Once this event starts, your character will be given the [b]Summon Parrot[/b] skill! You can then summon a parrot that you can feed with [b]Colorful Fruit[/b] that drops when you hunt monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above). In exchange for picking up the Colorful Fruit, it will give you [b]Discovery Points[/b], which can be exchanged for [b]Ark Coins[/b]! (Each color of fruit gives the same amount of Discovery Points).

The parrot will grow from stage 1 to 10 as you fight monsters and feed it fruit, and its skills will increase with each stage. Once it hits stage 10, its body color will change depending on which color fruit you've been feeding it! You can use the parrot for an additional [b]two weeks[/b] after the event is over.

notes.title: v.197 – Ark: Monad Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/35d5134f145e9f1dc847e3ec28db9e4e6c1a3aea.jpg[/img]

Experience a new blockbuster adventure in multiple acts with Monad! Face down monsters with unique strategies, and experience new types of gameplay. Then take on MapleStory’s newest boss, Commander Will! Visit two new worlds: the limited-time Lab Server where you play through a hardcore game style, and Reboot (EU) making the Reboot world experience available for the Europe region. Discovery events continue, and the Mega Burning event returns too! All this and more is coming your way in [b]MapleStory Ark: Monad[/b]!

[b][u]NEW CONTENT: MONAD[/u][/b]
Experience [b]Monad[/b], a new blockbuster adventure in multiple acts! Travel to new area Abrup Basin, and lend your aid to an old woman whose granddaughter has disappeared. This content features new types of gameplay experiences such as saving the residents of a burning town, managing the resources of a caravan, and engaging in a massive town battle to save the villagers from swarms of monsters.

Battles take on epic proportions as you fight the gigantic [b]Julieta[/b], where the environment is as deadly as the monster! Escape on a [b]Shrelephant[/b] as Julieta chases you through Grim Vale. Look out for crumbling buildings as Julieta follows you into Skuas Town! There are lots of new monsters including Eyefuls, Werebeasts, and Hellfangs, but it’s not all bad. You’ll also meet new types of [b]allies[/b] that will attack enemies by your side.

Once you complete the opening acts of Monad, you’ll be able to access the [b]MONAD Mission Board[/b]. Complete daily and weekly missions by repeating the content to earn rewards such as mesos, flames, titles, and more.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/6608e043da51d8dcc63f94caf930f8c0a373b767.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/263dea97ca2950fa8f5d68aeb70bc26e1df884f6.jpg[/img]

[b][u]NEW BOSS: WILL[/u][/b]
MapleStory’s toughest boss yet, [b]Commander Will[/b], appears as you explore Esfera! Will exists in both Maple World and Mirror World and you must fight him in both at the same time. Grab a party of 1-6 players and take on Will in three phases of battle. Look out for Will's [b]spider skill attacks[/b], and beware his [b]reflection[/b], which can attack with a will of its own. Collect [b]Stone Cobweb Droplets[/b] to trade in for [b]Arachno Coins[/b]. These coins can be used to purchase Lv. 200 Arcane Umbra equips, Will’s Soul Shard, Boss Medals of Honor, Occult Cubes, and more. You can also acquire a new 5th skill node, ‘[b]True Arachnid Reflection[/b]’, by using the Mirror World Nodestone dropped by Will.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/36e919d4c82a59e9adf142870541c10ffcec6551.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d694e7c68c592329e795de1fa1079a817632ebb7.jpg[/img]

[b][u]LAB SERVER[/u][/b]
For a limited-time, you can play in [b]Lab world[/b] where you can experience different concepts and try out new systems! You’ll be able to create one Explorer-class character as you play through a hardcore game style. If you die, your character will [b]revert to a Lv. 10 Beginner[/b], and your AP/SP and HP/MP will be reset. Monsters will have more HP and their stats will be five times better than on regular worlds. Potions will also have a cooldown applied to them, so you can’t escape death by spamming your potion button! However, the Enhancement Scroll count for all items is set high, at 255, so you’ll be able to enhance your items to their very best. You can also earn [b]Lab Server Coins[/b] from monsters, which can be redeemed for useful items from the coin shop. Helpful [b]boost potions and random boxes[/b] containing equipment will also drop. Do your best to take on this hardcore world!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/76e13330ef328b02e053ee69a87bf3d497d00534.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/28499d5206cbc6e90a12980f421f1d407be4f66d.jpg[/img]

[b][u]REBOOT (EU) WORLD[/u][/b]
Get ready for [b]Reboot world[/b] which will be available in the [b]Europe region[/b]! In Reboot, the focus is on fighting monsters and earning the gear and mesos you need through monster drops and progression, rather than making purchases from the Cash Shop or buying gear from other players. Monsters are stronger, but they give more EXP and mesos when defeated, as well as equipment that matches your character’s job. Item enhancement is simplified, and trades are disabled. The emphasis is on YOU earning what you need through hard work and progression!

[url=http://maplestory.nexon.net/micro-site/32020]Click here[/url] to learn more about [b]Reboot (EU) World[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/5f771d42c1fa8d0dd742e03587b035fd71860afa.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e2a02fef01f2b8f68d04491c2a0adaf320db832a.jpg[/img]

[b][u]DISCOVERY EVENTS[/u][/b]
More [b]Discovery Events[/b] will be available! Keep earning [b]Ark Points[/b] for the Ark Coin Shop by battling other players in Discovery Arena, joining up for a huge game of OX Quiz in Discovery Glacier, or a giant Bingo game in Discovery Desert! You can also visit a battleground where you use Ark Coins to summon monsters in Discovery Dome. These monsters give [b]+120% bonus EXP[/b] when defeated to help you level up! In Discovery Life, you can find a friend when you receive a [b]parrot[/b] to raise. Hunt monsters near your level to find colorful fruit. Create a brand-new character (other than Ark) during the event period, and select it to have the special “Burning” effect when the [b]Mega Burning Project[/b] event returns. After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 150! tags.feature: Experience Monad, a new blockbuster adventure in multiple acts! Travel to new area Abrup Basin, and lend your aid to an old woman whose granddaughter has disappeared. This content features new types of gameplay experiences such as saving the residents of a burning town, managing the resources of a caravan, and engaging in a massive town battle to save the villagers from swarms of monsters.

Battles take on epic proportions as you fight the gigantic Julieta, where the environment is as deadly as the monster! Escape on a Shrelephant as Julieta chases you through Grim Vale. Look out for crumbling buildings as Julieta follows you into Skuas Town! There are lots of new monsters including Eyefuls, Werebeasts, and Hellfangs, but it’s not all bad. You’ll also meet new types of allies that will attack enemies by your side.

Once you complete the opening acts of Monad, you’ll be able to access the MONAD Mission Board. Complete daily and weekly missions by repeating the content to earn rewards such as mesos, flames, titles, and more.

MapleStory’s toughest boss yet, Commander Will, appears as you explore Esfera! Will exists in both Maple World and Mirror World and you must fight him in both at the same time. Grab a party of 1-6 players and take on Will in three phases of battle. Look out for Will's spider skill attacks, and beware his reflection, which can attack with a will of its own. Collect Stone Cobweb Droplets to trade in for Arachno Coins. These coins can be used to purchase Lv. 200 Arcane Umbra equips, Will’s Soul Shard, Boss Medals of Honor, Occult Cubes, and more. You can also acquire a new 5th skill node, ‘True Arachnid Reflection’, by using the Mirror World Nodestone dropped by Will.

For a limited-time, you can play in Lab world where you can experience different concepts and try out new systems! You’ll be able to create one Explorer-class character as you play through a hardcore game style. If you die, your character will revert to a Lv. 10 Beginner, and your AP/SP and HP/MP will be reset. Monsters will have more HP and their stats will be five times better than on regular worlds. Potions will also have a cooldown applied to them, so you can’t escape death by spamming your potion button! However, the Enhancement Scroll count for all items is set high, at 255, so you’ll be able to enhance your items to their very best. You can also earn Lab Server Coins from monsters, which can be redeemed for useful items from the coin shop. Helpful boost potions and random boxes containing equipment will also drop. Do your best to take on this hardcore world!

Get ready for Reboot world which will be available in the Europe region! In Reboot, the focus is on fighting monsters and earning the gear and mesos you need through monster drops and progression, rather than making purchases from the Cash Shop or buying gear from other players. Monsters are stronger, but they give more EXP and mesos when defeated, as well as equipment that matches your character’s job. Item enhancement is simplified, and trades are disabled. The emphasis is on YOU earning what you need through hard work and progression!

More Discovery Events will be available! Keep earning Ark Points for the Ark Coin Shop by battling other players in Discovery Arena, joining up for a huge game of OX Quiz in Discovery Glacier, or a giant Bingo game in Discovery Desert! Feed the fruit to your parrot to help it grow big and strong and level up! You’ll receive buffs as the parrot grows.

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 150! notes.title: More Discovery Events!
notes.content:
Embark on an adventure with the new [b]Discovery Events[/b] and earn [b]Ark Points[/b]! Ark Points will be converted into [b]Ark Coins[/b] which can be redeemed at the [b]Ark Coin Shop[/b]!

[h1][u][b][u]Discovery Sky[/u][/b][/u][/h1]
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, July 3, 2018 5:00 PM – Tuesday, August 7, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, July 3, 2018 8:00 PM – Tuesday, August 7, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, July 4, 2018 2:00 AM – Wednesday, August 8, 2018 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, July 4, 2018 10:00 AM – Wednesday, August 8, 2018 9:59 AM[/b]

Get yourself a parachute and take to the sky in [b]Discovery Sky[/b] to see how far you can float, collecting flower petals on the breeze. Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by accepting the quest ‘[Discovery] Discovery Sky’ from the event notifier. You can access the Discovery Sky via the Discovery Map UI located next to the star event notifier, and clicking the cloud icon. There are more flying maps to unlock, but you must complete the Flight Master quests before moving onto the next area. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/dc2e6bdd97d12ab4ec362f39246f82d779425b76.jpg[/img]
Once the event begins, dash off the platform by hitting the right arrow twice, then jump off the platform before pressing the space bar to open up your parachute. The goal is to glide as far as possible and collide with the objects in the sky to gain Sky Points and gain height. [b]Sky Points[/b] are used to automatically upgrade your [b]Flying Level[/b] when a certain threshold is reached. Bonus effects will also be unlocked when obtaining a new Flying Level. You can gain additional [b]Ark Points[/b] and Sky Points when flying certain distances.

Check out the full details about the new Discovery Events here:
http://maplestory.nexon.net/news/31766

notes.title: Ark Hot Week
notes.content:
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Sunday, July 1, 2018 5:00 PM – Sunday, July 8, 2018 4:59 PM

AEST (UTC +10): Monday, July 2, 2018 10:00 AM – Monday, July 9, 2018 9:59 AM[/b]

MapleStory will be having a whole week of [b]Hot Days[/b]! Get in-game for some great items!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/5b084285e9840d97ea404297d649c459593e0bc1.jpg[/img]

Log in each day with a character Lv. 33 or above, and click the gift box icon on the left side of the screen to receive a Gift Box, and then double-click the box in your inventory to open it. The Gift Box can be obtained [b]once in a 24-hour period every day[/b] between the hours of [b]5:00 PM PDT / 8:00 PM EDT / 2:00 AM CEST / 10:00 AM AEST, and 4:59 PM PDT / 7:59 PM EDT / 1:59 AM CEST / 9:59 AM AEST[/b].

Once you receive the gift box, you can open it anytime before [b]1:00 AM PDT / 4:00 AM EDT / 10:00 AM CEST / 8:00 PM AEST[/b] of the following day.

If you have more than 30 unclaimed gifts, you may not be able to see the Hot Week reward. Please clear any unclaimed gifts and login again to see the Hot Week reward.

All rewards are for both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds unless specifically noted below.
[list]
Monday, July 2
[list][b]Pendant of the Spirit[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]
Tuesday, July 3
[list][b]Nodestone[/b]: Untradeable.[/list]
Wednesday, July 4
[list][b]Character Slot Expansion Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.[/list]
Thursday, July 5
[list][b]2x EXP Coupon (x3)[/b]: Untradeable. 7-day duration. Use to receive 2x EXP for 30 minutes.[/list]
Friday, July 6
[list][b]Ark Coin (x30)[/b]: Untradeable.[/list]
Saturday, July 7
[list][b]Maple Rewards 1,000[/b]: Untradeable. 7-day duration.[/list]
Sunday, July 8
[list][b]Selective 8 Slot Coupon[/b]: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
Plus select one additional reward from the items given Monday through Saturday![/list][/list]

If you obtain and [b]open[/b] each Gift Box every day from Monday to Saturday, then on Sunday—in addition to Sunday's reward—you can select another gift! You can select one from all of the items that were given out from Monday to Saturday. You are not required to have received each day’s Gift Box on the same character in order to be eligible for the extra gift, but it does have to be with characters in the same world (multiple worlds in World Alliances don't count).

This event is available to players Lv. 33 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). You can receive one gift box per account per day.

notes.content:
The [b]Mega Burning Project[/b] returns, ready to help you level a brand-new character up to Lv. 150!

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. Log in with your character and select the quest '[Ark] 1+2 Mega Burning Project' from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. You will receive the following special gifts!

notes.title: v.196 – Ark Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c784801a634bc8032f2972f5a34d251673e60599.jpg[/img]

Meet new character, Ark, and harness the power of the abyss as you switch between Flora and Specter States! Improve your game with V Care, earning Matrix Points to aid your 5th Job. Complete daily quests faster and earn more rewards. Relive the story in a new episode of Grand Athenaeum, Shadow Alchemist. Explore Esfera in Arcane River while you search for Tana, and then practice your combat skills with the new Captain Vaga content. Earn tons of Ark Coins in the Discovery Events, and spend them on great items in the Ark Coin Shop. The Mega Burning event returns too! All this and more is coming your way in [b]MapleStory: Ark[/b]!

[b][u]NEW PLAYABLE CHARACTER: ARK[/u][/b]
Meet [b]brand-new character Ark[/b], a boy who is half-Flora and half-Specter. He is branded a traitor after trying to escape the military during the Flora civil war. While in captivity, he is taken over by a Specter and loses his memory. Ark’s story begins in the desert ruin of [b]Verdel[/b], where he is discovered by a traveling caravan wandering the desert. Ark uses Pirate equipment, and his main stat is Strength. He carries powerful [b]Knuckles[/b] to knock his enemies into submission, and utilizes an [b]Abyssal Path[/b] to harness the power of darkness. Because of his fusion with the Specter, Ark can switch between Flora State (uses the magical abilities of the Flora) and Specter State (gathers power from the abyss). Store up [b]Spectra[/b] while in the Flora State and unleash it to trigger Specter State. While in Specter State, Ark has many powerful skills which channel dark energy to devastate his enemies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/86888b4ef25e83c43f67b127c40475b059881e27.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/337b9b73db14447f06660d0e00828e308b3d51df.jpg[/img]

[b][u]5TH JOB UPDATES[/u][/b]
Make your [b]5th Job faster[/b] as the wait time for Arcane Stones to activate will be removed! Fill up the stones with EXP to [b]activate them immediately[/b]. Then enhance your 5th Job skills with the addition of [b]Matrix Points[/b]! Earn 1 Matrix Point with every level-up after your 5th Job advancement. These points enhance your Node Slots and increase the skill level of Nodes placed there. Use enhanced Nodes to enhance other Nodes, and you’ll get to keep all of the Nodes’ EXP. All equipped Nodes will be un-equipped during the game update so that you can start fresh. If you’re desperate to get your hands on additional Node Slots, you’ll be able to spend mesos to unlock up to 2 Node Slots early!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/0c28ae7a2bd8a7e73bc3b73525186bfd244bd3fb.jpg[/img]

[b][u]V CARE[/u][/b]
We’re bringing [b]lots of improvements[/b] to the game to help your experience! You will be able to [b]complete daily quests[/b] in Arcane River faster with decreased requirement times and fewer stages. Arcane Symbols will be easier to earn, and Dream Defender and Spirit Savior will grant more coin rewards as well. Golden Wyverns will appear more frequently in Legion raids. You can make up lost time after a maintenance, since you'll be able to enter higher stages in [b]Burning Fields[/b] and earn more EXP once the game opens.

The new [b]Arcane Catalyst[/b] item will let you move Arcane Symbols to a different character in the same world. This item can be found by visiting the Maple Legion shop in non-Reboot worlds only. Another new item, the [b]Ark Innocence Scroll[/b], will reset an item’s stats (except for Potential, Star Force, and Bonus Stats). You will be able to access it by using Spell Traces.

When you face an Elite Boss, or monsters in Pollo & Fritto bounty hunts, their HP will now be based on the HP of other monsters in the map. You will only be able to use Pollo and Fritto Entry Tickets in maps where there are monsters within your level range (20 levels below/above). Monsters will appear faster and in greater numbers during the mission ‘Pollo’s Castle Walls’, and Pollo will have a new mission! Join him and try to catch a [b]Stormwing[/b] from a map full of monsters.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/9fc1ebb0ccb295c0669692b8e9de1ae74fdc8d06.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b731345283b88eb7e6a83cc592b4201d2e991ac2.jpg[/img]

[b][u]GRAND ATHENAEUM: SHADOW ALCHEMIST[/u][/b]
[b]Shadow Alchemist[/b], the fifth episode of the Grand Athenaeum theme dungeon, will be released! Grand Athenaeum allows players Lv. 100 and above to relive important events from Maple World’s history. Enter the Dimensional Mirror and speak to NPC Skylark Rita to enter a living storybook. In this new episode, you’ll meet [b]Fang, the friend that time forgot[/b], when you enter Mirror World in this [b]prequel to Zero’s story[/b]. Visit Shadowvale and witness the friendship between Fang and Eight. Become part of the story and experience the ultimate choice Fang must make. Complete the adventure to earn a special medal.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4ae1bf93ecee49e071651706933821f0b9fe18fa.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c4f451aaa1e2bf268533fadc9ed2f25b9d1517ae.jpg[/img]

[b][u]NEW REGION: ESFERA[/u][/b]
Get ready to adventure deeper into the continent of Arcane River as you travel to [b]Esfera, Origin Sea[/b]! This brand-new region will be available to players Lv. 235 and above who have completed the questline in Morass. Esfera is a deep sea at the end of Arcane River. This area will ultimately be the start of a new world, where there are no Transcendents. When a strange black sphere appears in the sky overhead, what does it man for the future of Maple World? Explore this mysterious area, both beautiful and deadly, and search for the whereabouts of Tana. Complete the quests to receive the new [b]Arcane Symbol: Esfera[/b] and [b]Luminous Throne[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/7c0bef8d99a52b5d18081f43c391036a3f4f9f5e.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d2687f063f34fefb2d6e88a6ebc12b98ce668c2c.jpg[/img]

[b][u]CAPTAIN VAGA[/u][/b]
Get an inside look at [b]PULSAR[/b], the notorious organization from Stellar Detectives. As a new recruit, you must advance through the ranks of the company by battling monsters in a new type of [b]mini-game combat[/b]. Use the mouse and keyboard to aim and shoot at oncoming enemies! Armed with weapons including a submachine gun and a flamethrower, those monsters don’t stand a chance against you. Complete missions to earn rewards such as [b]PULSAR Coins[/b] which can be spent on tasty buff food, as well as a [b]chair and medal[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/a3182ca240fb1ce8ed359c6cee62e7df9d6f602a.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/db1cd09c357bca9dda6908528d64ab7dac18723d.jpg[/img]

[b][u]ARK EVENTS[/u][/b]
Starting [b]June 20[/b], you can [b]pre-create new character, Ark[/b]! If you pre-create your character, you will receive lots of amazing gifts when Ark becomes available to play after maintenance on [b]June 28[/b]. Participate in new events to earn [b]Ark Coins[/b] which you can exchange for great rewards such as the Chaos Ring, Arcane Symbol Selector Coupon, damage skins, chairs, scrolls, and more in the Ark Coin Shop. Create a brand-new character (other than Ark) during the event period, and select it to have the special “Burning” effect when the [b]Mega Burning Project[/b] event returns. After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 150!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3e8a0ff0397557595de3ecf2ad32e9074c0b268f.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/19619f0bdf4d643c5f8ced3bc420d7ce6d26c8fa.jpg[/img]

[b][u]DISCOVERY EVENTS[/u][/b]
Embark on adventure with new [b]Discovery events[/b] and earn [b]Ark Coins[/b]! Travel to special maps and earn Ark Coins and EXP just by visiting. Go fishing with other players and earn bigger and better boats the more fish you catch! Hunt monsters within your level range, take down Elite monsters and bosses, and unlock Runes to earn more coins. Join other players for a giant Bingo game or OX Quiz game, or correctly guess the hidden code of a keypad. Get yourself a parachute and take to the sky to see how far you can float, collecting flower petals on the breeze. Hunt large amounts of monsters to receive different weather buffs, which increase your stats and change the weather in the map each time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/2c75b42c7283a1b5dc034b215155162fad0c58aa.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/dc2e6bdd97d12ab4ec362f39246f82d779425b76.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Zero Character Creation Event
notes.content:
The Zero character job is BACK for a limited time!

[h1][u][b][u]Event Dates[/u][/b][/u][/h1]
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, June 5, 2018 5:00 PM – [b]Tuesday[/b], [b]July [/b]24, 2018 4:59 PM[/b][b]
[b]EDT (UTC[/b][/b] [b]-4):[b] [b]Tuesday[/b], June 5, 2018 8:00 PM – [b]Tuesday[/b], [b][b]July [/b]24[/b], 2018 7:59 PM[/b]
[b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, June 6, 2018 2:00 AM – [b][b]Wednesday[/b][/b], [b][b]July [/b]25[/b], 2018 1:59 AM[/b]
[b]AEST (UTC +10): [b][b]Wednesday[/b][/b], June 6, 2018 10:00 AM – [b][b]Wednesday[/b][/b], [b][b]July [/b]25[/b], 2018 9:59 AM [/b][/b]

The Zero character job is BACK for a limited time! If you have a character that is Lv. 100 or above, you are eligible to create a Zero job character in that same world. The Zero job starts at Level 100 and remains in Mirror World until the second chapter of their story is completed. After that they can explore Maple World.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/cf43ede8165771fc8767b0be322ad6e07ba9f507.jpg[/img]

Zero is the child of the goddess Rhinne, the Transcendent of Time. When she learned that the Black Mage would imprison her in the future, Rhinne created a child, a new Transcendent she hoped would one day replace her.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/8f9503af7a6f83ea3fc6c03fec9dac5d8add60fe.jpg[/img]

The Black Mage recognized the threat Zero represented. However, if he destroyed it, another Transcendent would simply take Zero's place. Thus, he gave his Commanders a task: split the Child of the Goddess into two separate entities, to prevent them from using their full powers. The two children—a boy, Alpha, and a girl, Beta—were taken to a world designed specifically to keep them locked away; Mirror World.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/f367cd63e63064a7c5cb0d0cba5f6b45ff121be4.jpg[/img]

Take control of Alpha and Beta, two characters rolled up in one, and master their distinct fighting styles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c1005e489654fcfe239e52d6b9804ab95ea12dc5.jpg[/img]

Use both at the same time for deadly combination attacks or swap between them during battle!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/306622f8002fb1e606345eb52d56f7c51e7326fc.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/2b140bb0c4a1cd5c782d30a3ce5c2191a0c146f9.jpg[/img]

Rhinne may be imprisoned but hope is not lost. Take control of Zero and escape Mirror World!

[b]Note[/b]: Zero cannot be created in Reboot world.
[h1][u][b][u]Zero Level-up Event[/u][/b][/u][/h1]
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, June 5, 2018 5:00 PM – [b]Tuesday[/b], [b]June [/b]19, 2018 4:59 PM[/b][b]
[b]EDT (UTC[/b][/b] [b]-4):[b] [b]Tuesday[/b], June 5, 2018 8:00 PM – [b]Tuesday[/b], [b][b]June [/b]19[/b], 2018 7:59 PM[/b]
[b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, June 6, 2018 2:00 AM – [b][b]Wednesday[/b][/b], [b][b]June [/b]20[/b], 2018 1:59 AM[/b]
[b]AEST (UTC +10): [b][b]Wednesday[/b][/b], June 6, 2018 10:00 AM – [b][b]Wednesday[/b][/b], [b][b]June [/b]20[/b], 2018 9:59 AM [/b][/b]

Log in to any Zero character to collect 2 free [b]2x EXP coupons[/b] once a day! This event will apply to non-Reboot worlds only. Accept the quest '[Zero Up] Ever Day 2x EXP Coupon Support!' from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen to receive your reward. Zero characters both old and new also gain [b]2x WP[/b] when clearing dungeons in Mirror World! 

[b]Note:[/b] The daily 2x EXP Coupons can only be accepted 1 time per day per world.

[b][u]Rewards:[/u][/b]
[list][*][b]2x EXP Coupons (x2):[/b] Untradeable, 1-day duration. Grants 2x EXP for 30 minutes when used.[/*][*][b]2x WP[/b][/*][/list]
[h1][u][b][u]Zero Mission Event[/u][/b][/u][/h1]
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, June 5, 2018 5:00 PM – [b]Tuesday[/b], [b]June [/b]19, 2018 4:59 PM[/b][b]
[b]EDT (UTC[/b][/b] [b]-4):[b] [b]Tuesday[/b], June 5, 2018 8:00 PM – [b]Tuesday[/b], [b][b]June [/b]19[/b], 2018 7:59 PM[/b]
[b]CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, June 6, 2018 2:00 AM – [b][b]Wednesday[/b][/b], [b][b]June [/b]20[/b], 2018 1:59 AM[/b]

Create a brand new Zero character to be able to participate in the Zero Mission Event. This event is available to non-Reboot worlds only. Each time you complete the requirements for a mission, you can obtain special rewards for your Zero character. After accepting the rewards on your Zero character, you can then receive bonus rewards for a different character in the same world!

notes.title: High Noon Gunslinger Event
notes.content:
It's high noon which means it's time for a new mini-game! In the [b]High Noon Gunslinger event[/b], you can join 3 other players for a [b]Western-style shootout[/b].

[h1][b][u]Event Dates:[/u][/b][/h1]
[b]PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 29, 2018 5:00 PM – Tuesday, June 19, 2018 4:59 PM[/b][b]
 [b]EDT (UTC -4): [b]Tuesday[/b], May 29, 2018 8:00 PM – Tuesday, June [b]19[/b], 2018 7:59 PM[/b]
